arabic: كان يوم العيد.
english: It was Eid day.
transliteration: Kaan yom el-Eid.

arabic: الأطفال كانوا كتير مبسوطين.
english: The children were very happy.
transliteration: El-atfal kanu kteer mabsooteen.

arabic: صحيوا بكير كتير.
english: They woke up very early.
transliteration: Sahyo bakeer kteer.

arabic: لبسوا تيابهم الجديدة.
english: They wore their new clothes.
transliteration: Lebso tyab-hom el-jdeede.

arabic: أمي وأبي كمان كانوا مبسوطين.
english: My mother and father were also happy.
transliteration: Ommi w abi kaman kanu mabsooteen.

arabic: بعدين، رحنا على بيت جدي وستي.
english: Then, we went to my grandfather's and grandmother's house.
transliteration: Ba'deen, rohna 'ala bayt jeddi w sitti.

arabic: البيت كان مليان ناس.
english: The house was full of people.
transliteration: El-bayt kaan malyan nas.

arabic: كل الأطفال أخذوا عيدياتهم.
english: All the children took their Eid money.
transliteration: Koll el-atfal akhado eidyat-hom.

arabic: أنا أخذت عشر ليرات.
english: I took ten pounds.
transliteration: Ana akhazt 'ashar leerat.

arabic: أختي الصغيرة أخذت خمس ليرات.
english: My little sister took five pounds.
transliteration: Okhti el-sagheera akhazat khams leerat.

arabic: لعبنا مع أولاد عمنا كتير.
english: We played a lot with our cousins.
transliteration: Le'ebna ma' awlad 'amna kteer.

arabic: أكلنا حلويات العيد الطيبة.
english: We ate the delicious Eid sweets.
transliteration: Akalna halawiyat el-Eid el-tayybe.

arabic: الأطفال دايماً بيحبوا العيد.
english: Children always love Eid.
transliteration: El-atfal dayman bihebbul-Eid.

arabic: اليوم بيضل أحلى يوم بالسنة.
english: This day remains the best day of the year.
transliteration: El-yom bidall ahla yom bil-sane.

arabic: وكل العيلة بتكون مبسوطة مع بعض.
english: And the whole family is happy together.
transliteration: W koll el-'ayle bitkoun mabsoota ma' ba'ad.

arabic: في حارتنا القديمة بدمشق، كان فيه خمسة أصحاب، قلوبهم متل الدهب.
english: In our old neighborhood in Damascus, there were five friends, their hearts like gold.
transliteration: Fi haretna l-qadimeh bi-Dimashq, kan fi khamseh aS-hab, qloub-hom mitl ad-dahab.

arabic: كل يوم بعد الشغل، كانوا يجتمعوا بساحة الحارة تحت شجرة التوت العتيقة ويشربوا قهوتهم.
english: Every day after work, they would gather in the neighborhood square under the old mulberry tree and drink their coffee.
transliteration: Koll yom ba'd esh-shoghl, kanu yijtami'u bi-sahet il-Haret taHt shajaret it-tut il-'atiqah w-yishrabu qahwet-hom.

arabic: واحد منهم، أبو كريم، كان عنده بسكليتة قديمة كتير ومكسورة بتساعده بشغل توصيل الطلبات.
english: One of them, Abu Karim, had a very old and broken bicycle that helped him with his delivery job.
transliteration: WaHed min-hom, Abu Karim, kan 'ando baskleeta qadimeh kteer u-maksourah bit-sa'do bi-shoghl tawSeel iT-Talabat.

arabic: شافوا أصحابه كيف بيتعب وبيدفع مصاري لإصلاحها كل شوي.
english: His friends saw how much he struggled and spent money fixing it every now and then.
transliteration: Shafu aS-Haboh keef biyit'ab u-biydefa' maSari la-iSlaHha koll shway.

arabic: قرروا الأصحاب يعملوا إشي إله؛ جمعوا مصاري من بعضهن البعض لحتى يصلحوها منيح أو يجيبوله قطعة جديدة.
english: The friends decided to do something for him; they collected money from each other to properly fix it or get him a new part.
transliteration: Qarraru l-aS-Hab ya'amlu ishi ilo; jam'u maSari min ba'DH-hon il-ba'DH la-Hatta yiSlaHuha mneeh aw yijeebulo qaT'ah jdeedeh.

arabic: بالسر، أخدوا البسكليتة لعند ميكانيكي الحارة، عمو حسان، وهو وعدن إنه رح يظبطها بأفضل شكل.
english: Secretly, they took the bicycle to the neighborhood mechanic, Uncle Hassan, and he promised them he would fix it in the best way.
transliteration: Bi-s-sirr, akhadu l-baskleeta la-'and mekaniki l-Haret, 'ammo Hassan, w-huwwa wa'adan innoh raH yzaBBeTHa bi-afDal shakl.

arabic: أهل الحارة كمان سمعوا بالقصة، وكتير منهم عرضوا مساعدتهن، حبًا بأبو كريم.
english: The neighborhood folk also heard about the story, and many of them offered their help, out of love for Abu Karim.
transliteration: Ahl il-Haret kaman sami'u bil-qiSSah, w-kteer min-hom 'araDu musa'adit-hon, Hubban bi-Abu Karim.

arabic: بعد كم يوم، جابوا البسكليتة الجديدة لأبو كريم، كانت بتلمع لمعة.
english: After a few days, they brought the new bicycle to Abu Karim; it was shining brightly.
transliteration: Ba'd kam yom, jabu l-baskleeta l-jdeedeh la-Abu Karim, kanat bitlamme' lam'a.

arabic: عيونه دمعت من الفرح والامتنان لما شاف جهد أصحابه وأهل حارته.
english: His eyes welled up with joy and gratitude when he saw the effort of his friends and neighborhood folk.
transliteration: 'Uyunoh dam'at min il-faraH wil-imtinaan lamma shaf jahd aS-Haboh w-ahl Haret-oh.

arabic: وهيك، ضلّت صداقتهم ومحبة الحارة أقوى وأجمل، مثال للعطاء والتعاون.
english: And so, their friendship and the neighborhood's love remained stronger and more beautiful, an example of giving and cooperation.
transliteration: W-heek, DHallat Sadaqat-hom w-maHabbet il-Haret aqwa w-ajmal, mithal lil-'aTaa' w-it-ta'awon.

arabic: قرار أبو سمير طبخ منسف لمرته أم سمير كان مفاجأة حقيقية لكل العائلة.
english: Abu Samir's decision to cook mansaf for his wife Umm Samir was a real surprise for the whole family.
transliteration: Qaraar Abu Samir tabkh mansaf la marto Umm Samir kaan mufaajaa'a haqiqa'iyye lakol il-'aa'ile.

arabic: عمره بحياته ما دخل المطبخ إلا ليشرب كاسة مي أو يسرق حبة فاكهة.
english: He had never entered the kitchen in his life except to drink a glass of water or steal a piece of fruit.
transliteration: 'Omro bi hayaato ma dakhal il-matbakh illa layishrab kaaset mayy aw yisreq habbet faakiha.

arabic: بس هالمرة، قرر يعطيها هدية غير تقليدية بمناسبة عيد جوازهم الخامس والعشرين.
english: But this time, he decided to give her an unconventional gift for their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary.
transliteration: Bas hal-marra, qarrar ya'teeha hadiyye ghayr taqleediyye bimunaasabet 'eed jawaazhom il-khaames w-il-'ishreen.

arabic: اشترى كل مكونات المنسف من السوق، والجميد كان الأهم والأصعب بالتعامل معه.
english: He bought all the mansaf ingredients from the market, and the jameed was the most important and difficult to deal with.
transliteration: Ishtara kol mukawwinaat il-mansaf min is-sooq, w-il-jameed kaan il-aham w-il-as'ab bil-ta'aamol ma'o.

arabic: بلش شغله بحماس كبير، والكمامة على وجهه كأنه جراح عم يعمل عملية خطيرة.
english: He started his work with great enthusiasm, a mask on his face as if he were a surgeon performing a dangerous operation.
transliteration: Ballash shogholo bi hamaas kbeer, w-il-kamaame 'ala wajho ka'anno jarraah 'am ya'mol 'amaliyye khatira.

arabic: المطبخ تحول لحلبة معركة خلال ساعة واحدة، والطحين والبهارات انتشروا بكل مكان.
english: The kitchen turned into a battleground within one hour; flour and spices spread everywhere.
transliteration: Il-matbakh tahawwal la-halbet ma'rake khilaal saa'a waaHda, w-it-taHHeen w-il-bahaaraat intasharu bi kol makaan.

arabic: لما حاول يذوّب الجميد، طرطش عليه وعلى الحيطان، وصار شكله بضحّك.
english: When he tried to melt the jameed, it splattered on him and the walls, making him look comical.
transliteration: Lamma Haawal yithawweb il-jameed, tarTash 'alayh w-'ala il-HeeTaan, w-Saar shaklo biDaHhek.

arabic: سمعته أم سمير وهي راجعة من السوق عم تضحك بصوت عالي، "يا لطيف، شو عم يصير هون؟"
english: Umm Samir heard him laughing loudly as she returned from the market, "Oh my God, what's happening here?"
transliteration: Sama'ato Umm Samir w-hiyye raaj'a min is-sooq 'am tiDhak bi-Soot 'aali, "Ya lateef, shoo 'am yiseer hoon?"

arabic: فتحت الباب وشافته مغطى بالجميد والطحين، والمطبخ كأنه تعرض لعاصفة ثلجية بيضاء.
english: She opened the door and saw him covered in jameed and flour, and the kitchen looked like it had been hit by a white snowstorm.
transliteration: FataHat il-baab w-shaafeto mghaTTa bil-jameed w-iT-TaHHeen, w-il-matbakh ka'anno ta'arraD la-'aaSfet thaljiyye bayDaa'.

arabic: قالها وهو عم يضحك بخجل، "كنت عم بجهزلك مفاجأة، بس شكلها قلبت كارثة!"
english: He told her, laughing shyly, "I was preparing a surprise for you, but it seems it turned into a disaster!"
transliteration: Qaalha w-huwwe 'am yiDhak bi khajal, "Kent 'am bajahhezlek mufaajaa'a, bas shaklha qallabet kaaritha!"

arabic: ضحكت أم سمير وقالت، "ولك يا زلمة، شو عملت بحالك وبمطبخي؟"
english: Umm Samir laughed and said, "Man, what did you do to yourself and my kitchen?"
transliteration: DaHeket Umm Samir w-qaalet, "Walak ya zalame, shoo 'amalt bi Haalak w-bi matbakhi?"

arabic: "المهم النية يا حبيبتي، صح؟" سألها وهو عم يحاول يمسح وجهه بكمه الملوث.
english: "The intention is what matters, my dear, right?" he asked her, trying to wipe his face with his stained sleeve.
transliteration: "Il-mohemm in-niyye ya Habeebti, SaH?" sa'alha w-huwwe 'am yiHaawel yimsaH wajho bi kommo il-milawwath.

arabic: مسكت إيديه بحنان وقالت، "خلي المنسف عليي هالمرة، وانت روح اتحمم وريح حالك."
english: She held his hands gently and said, "Leave the mansaf to me this time, and you go shower and relax yourself."
transliteration: Masakat ee'dayh bi Hanaan w-qaalet, "Khallee il-mansaf 'alayyi hal-marra, w-enta rooH itHamam w-rayyeH Haalak."

arabic: وبالفعل، أكلوا منسف أسطوري من تحت إيدين أم سمير، وأبو سمير قضى الليل عم يحكيلها مغامراته.
english: And indeed, they ate a legendary mansaf prepared by Umm Samir, and Abu Samir spent the night telling her his adventures.
transliteration: W-bil-fe'el, akalu mansaf osToori min taHt ee'dayn Umm Samir, w-Abu Samir qaDa il-layl 'am yiHkeelha mughaamaraato.

arabic: ضلوا يتذكروا هاليوم كل سنة، وصار قصة بتضحك ولادة ولادهم وأحفادهم.
english: They kept remembering this day every year, and it became a funny story for their children and grandchildren.
transliteration: Dallu yitdhakkaru hal-yom kol sane, w-Saar qeSSa biDaHhek awlaadhom w-aHfaadhom.

arabic: كل جمعة، كانت إم أحمد بتفيق بكير ببيتها العتيق بقلب الشام، عم تجهّز لجمعة العيلة.
english: Every Friday, Um Ahmad would wake up early in her old house in the heart of Damascus, preparing for the family gathering.
transliteration: Kull jum'a, kaanat imm Ahmad btefiq bakir b baytaha l'atiq b'alb esh-Sham, 'am tjahhez la jam'it el-'ayle.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: كانت بتبلش تعجن العجين للمناقيش، إيديها عم تتحرك بخبرة سنين طويلة.
english: She would start kneading the dough for mana'eesh, her hands moving with years of long experience.
transliteration: Kaanat bteballesh ta'jen el-'ajin lal mana'ish, ideyha 'am tit'harrak b khebrit sneen tawile.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: أحفادها، سليم ويارا، كانوا بيركضوا من المدرسة، ضحكاتهم عم تعبي ساحة الدار.
english: Her grandchildren, Salim and Yara, would rush in from school, their laughter filling the courtyard.
transliteration: Ahfadha, Salim w Yara, kaanu birkodu min el-madrasa, dahkathom 'am t'abbi sahat ed-dar.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: يلا يا تيتة، إيمتى بتكون المناقيش جاهزة؟" كان سليم بيسأل بحماس، عيونه على الفرن الدافي.
english: "Come on, Grandma, when will the mana'eesh be ready?" Salim would ask excitedly, his eyes fixed on the warm oven.
transliteration: "Yalla ya teta, emta btkoon el-mana'ish jahzeh?" kaan Salim byes'al bhamas, 'yoono 'ala l-furn ed-dafi.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: إم أحمد كانت بتبتسم، وعم تحكيلهم قصص عن شبابها والريحة الطيبة للزعتر وزيت الزيتون عم بتعبّي الجو.
english: Um Ahmad would smile, telling them stories about her youth while the pleasant aroma of thyme and olive oil filled the air.
transliteration: Imm Ahmad kaanat btebtesem, w 'am tahkilhom qisas 'an shababha w r-riha t-taybeh la z-za'tar w zeit ez-zeitun 'am bta'abbi el-jaw.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: بعد شوي، كل ولادها وزوجاتهم كانوا بيوصلوا، جايبين حلويات وفواكه طازجة.
english: A little later, all her children and their spouses would arrive, bringing sweets and fresh fruit.
transliteration: Ba'd shway, kull wlada w zawjathom kaanu byosalo, jaybeen halawiyat w fawakeh tazjeh.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: كانوا بيقعدوا حوالي الطاولة الواطية، عم يتشاركوا الأخبار والنكت التقليدية، والبيت كله كان حي بالحديث.
english: They would sit around the low table, sharing news and traditional jokes, and the whole house was alive with conversation.
transliteration: Kaanu byo'odu hawali t-tawle l-watie, 'am yetsharako l-akhbar w n-nukat t-taqlidiye, wel-beit kullo kaan hay bil-hadith.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: بنتها ليلى، كانت دايماً بتساعد بتقديم الأكل، وبتتأكد إنو الكل أكل منيح.
english: Her daughter, Layla, always helped serve the food, making sure everyone had eaten well.
transliteration: Bentha Layla, kaanat dayman btsa'ed b taqdim el-akl, w bteta'akad inno l-kull akal mneeh.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: هالجمعة الأسبوعية ما كانت بس للأكل؛ كانت لتقوية روابط عيلتهم وتراثهم العريق.
english: This weekly gathering was not just about food; it was about strengthening their family ties and ancient heritage.
transliteration: Hal-jam'a l-osboo'iye ma kaanat bas lal akl; kaanat li taqwiyat rawabit 'aylathom w turathhom el-'ariq.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: ولحد اليوم، ذكرى هالجمعات بتدفي قلوبهم، وشهادة على التقاليد الشامية الأصيلة اللي ما بتنتهي.
english: And to this day, the memory of those gatherings warms their hearts, a testament to the authentic Damascene traditions that never fade.
transliteration: Wa la hadd el-yom, zikra hal-jam'at btedaffi qloobhom, w shahada 'ala t-taqalid esh-Shamiye l-asileh illi ma btentahi.
storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

arabic: كانت عائلة أبو كريم متحمسة جداً لرحلتهم القادمة إلى قريتهم الجبلية الصغيرة هذا الصيف.
english: Abu Karim's family was very excited about their upcoming trip to their small mountain village this summer.
transliteration: Kanat aa'ilat Abu Karim mutahammiseh jiddan li-rihlat-hum al-qadimeh ila qariyat-hum al-jabaliyya as-saghireh hadha as-sayf.

arabic: لقد خططوا لكل تفصيلٍ دقيقٍ منذ شهرين، متأكدين أن الطقس سيكون مشمساً ودافئاً كالعادة في تموز.
english: They had planned every precise detail for two months, certain that the weather would be sunny and warm as usual in July.
transliteration: Laqad khallatu li-kull tafsilin daqiqin munzu shahrayn, muta'akkidin an al-taqs sayakunu mushmisan wa dafi'an kal-'ade bil-tammuz.

arabic: أبو كريم اشترى لولده الصغير خمسة ألعاب جديدة وعلبة بسكويت كبيرة كهدية عند وصولهم.
english: Abu Karim bought five new toys for his young son and a big box of biscuits as a gift upon their arrival.
transliteration: Abu Karim ishtara li-walad-hu as-saghir khamsat al'ab jadideh wa 'elbat biskooyt kabireh ka-hadiyyeh 'ind wusool-hum.

arabic: لكن قبل يومين من موعد سفرهم، بدأت النشرات الجوية تتحدث عن منخفضٍ جويٍ عميقٍ يتجه نحو المنطقة.
english: But two days before their travel date, weather bulletins began talking about a deep low-pressure system heading towards the region.
transliteration: Laken qabl yawmayn min maw'ed safar-hum, bada'at an-nasharat al-jawiyya tatahaddath 'an munhafad jawwi 'ameeq yattajih nahwa al-mintaqa.

arabic: أم كريم، التي كانت تحضر الحقائب بحماس، شعرت بقلقٍ يتسلل إلى قلبها وهي ترى السحب تتجمع بسرعة.
english: Um Karim, who was eagerly preparing the bags, felt anxiety creeping into her heart as she saw the clouds gathering quickly.
transliteration: Um Karim, allati kanat tuhaddir al-haqa'ib bi-hamas, sha'arat bi-qalaqin yatasallal ila qalb-ha wa hiya tara as-suhub tatajamma' bi-sur'a.

arabic: «شو رح نعمل إذا الدنيا شتّت وصار في سيول؟» سألته بقلقٍ بالغٍ مساء ذلك اليوم.
english: "What will we do if it rains heavily and there are floods?" she asked him with great concern that evening.
transliteration: "Shu rah na'mel iza ad-dunya shattat wa sar fi suyoul?" sa'alat-u bi-qalaqin balighin masa'a dhalika al-yawm.

arabic: هو طمأنها قائلاً: «ما تخافي، يا أم كريم، يمكن يتغير الطقس بعد كم ساعة، إحنا تعودنا على تقلبات الجو عنا».
english: He reassured her saying: "Don't worry, Um Karim, maybe the weather will change after a few hours, we are used to weather fluctuations here."
transliteration: Huwa tam'an-ha qa'ilan: "Ma tkhafi, ya Um Karim, yumkin yitghayyar at-taqs ba'ed kam saa'a, ehna ta'awwadna 'ala taqallubat al-jaw 'anna."

arabic: لكن توقعاته كانت خاطئة تماماً، ففي منتصف الليل، استيقظ الأولاد على صوت الرعد الرهيب والبرق الذي أضاء الغرفة.
english: But his predictions were completely wrong, for in the middle of the night, the children woke up to the sound of terrible thunder and lightning that lit up the room.
transliteration: Laken tawqqa'at-u kanat khati'a tamaman, fa-fi muntasaf al-layl, istayqaz al-awlad 'ala sawt ar-ra'd ar-raheeb wal-barq alladhi ada'a al-ghurfa.

arabic: العاصفة كانت أقوى من أي عاصفة رأوها في سنواتهم العشرين الماضية، والمطر كان غزيراً جداً، حتى سدت المصارف.
english: The storm was stronger than any storm they had seen in their past twenty years, and the rain was so heavy that it clogged the drains.
transliteration: Al-'aasifeh kanat aqwa min ayy 'aasifeh ra'aw-ha fi sanawat-hum al-'ishreen al-madiya, wal-matar kan ghazeeran jiddan, hatta saddat al-masaref.

arabic: في صباح اليوم التالي، وجدوا سيولاً جارفة قد غمرت الشوارع والأراضي المحيطة بمنزلهم الصغير.
english: The next morning, they found raging floods had submerged the streets and lands surrounding their small house.
transliteration: Fi sabah al-yawm at-tali, wajadu suyoolan jarifeh qad ghamarat ash-shawari' wal-aradi al-muhiteh bi-manzel-hum as-saghir.

arabic: عوضاً عن الذهاب للقرية، قرروا مساعدة جيرانهم في تنظيف البيوت المتضررة وتصريف المياه.
english: Instead of going to the village, they decided to help their neighbors clean the damaged houses and drain the water.
transliteration: 'Awadan 'an adh-dhahab lil-qariyyeh, qarraru musaa'adat jiran-hum fi tanzif al-buyuut al-mutadarrireh wa tasrif al-miyah.

arabic: «إحنا لازم نوقف جنب بعض بهيك ظروف، وهي فرصة لنقوي علاقاتنا» قالت أم كريم وهي تحمل دلوين مليئين بالوحل.
english: "We must stand by each other in such circumstances, and this is an opportunity to strengthen our relationships," said Um Karim, carrying two buckets full of mud.
transliteration: "Ehna lazem nuwaf jannab ba'ed bi-heik zuroof, wa hiya furssa li-naqwiyi 'alaqat-na" qalat Um Karim wa hiya tahmil dalwayn maliee'in bil-wihal.

arabic: الأطفال أيضاً ساعدوا بقدر استطاعتهم، يتعلمون درساً قيماً عن التعاون والمثابرة في وجه التحديات.
english: The children also helped as much as they could, learning a valuable lesson about cooperation and perseverance in the face of challenges.
transliteration: Al-atfal ayddan saa'adu bi-qadr istita'at-hum, yata'allamun darsan qayyiman 'an at-ta'awun wal-muthabara fi wajh at-tahaddiyat.

arabic: مع غروب شمس ذلك اليوم العاصف، كانوا متعبين ولكنهم يشعرون بالرضا الداخلي بعد إنجازهم الجماعي.
english: As the sun set on that stormy day, they were tired but felt inner satisfaction after their collective achievement.
transliteration: Ma' ghurub shams dhalika al-yawm al-'aasif, kanu mut'abeen walakin-hum yash'urun bil-rida ad-dakhili ba'da injaz-hum al-jama'i.

arabic: الآن يعرفون أن قوة عائلتهم وجيرانهم لا تقاس بالطقس الجميل فحسب، بل بقدرتهم على التكاتف في أشد الظروف.
english: Now they know that the strength of their family and neighbors is not measured only by beautiful weather, but by their ability to cooperate in the most difficult circumstances.
transliteration: Al-aan ya'rifun an quwwat 'a'ilat-hum wa jiran-hum la tuqas bil-taqs al-jamil fa-hasb, bal bi-qudrat-hum 'ala at-takatuf fi ashadd az-zuroof.

arabic: كان يوم الخميس الماضي دافي ومشمس، بس فجأة، اجا الظهر والجو انقلب بسرعة، وبلشت الشتوية تنزل بغزارة على بيتنا.
english: Last Thursday was warm and sunny, but suddenly, noon arrived and the weather changed quickly, and the winter rain started falling heavily on our house.
transliteration: kan yawm al-khamees al-madi dafi w mishmas, bas faj'a, aja ad-dhuhr wal-jaw inqalab bi-sur'a, w ballashat ash-shatawiyeh tinzil bi-ghazara 'ala betna.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: أمي، الله يطول بعمرها، صارت عم تحضّر القهوة السخنة، وإخوتي الصغار مبسوطين عم بيلعبوا جوّا البيت.
english: My mother, may God prolong her life, started preparing the hot coffee, and my younger siblings are happy playing inside the house.
transliteration: ommi, Allah ytawwil bi-'omraha, sarat amm t'haddir al-qahwe as-sukhneh, w ikhweti az-zghar mabsoteen amm bayla'bu jawwa al-bet.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: تذكرت كيف كنا صغار وأنا وإخواتي نركض تحت المطر زمان، لكن هلأ الكبار بيحبوا يقعدوا حوالين المدفأة.
english: I remembered how we were small and my siblings and I used to run under the rain a long time ago, but now the adults prefer to sit around the heater.
transliteration: t'zakkarit keef kunna zghar w ana w ikhwati nirkud taht al-matar zaman, laken halla' al-kbaar bihebbou yu'udou hawalein al-madfa'a.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: جدتي، الله يرحمها، كانت دايماً تقول إنه ثلاث أيام من المطر الصافي بيجلب الخير لكل أراضينا.
english: My grandmother, may God have mercy on her, always used to say that three days of clear rain bring goodness to all our lands.
transliteration: jaddeti, Allah yirhamha, kanat dayman t'qul inno talat iyyam min al-matar as-safi bijlib al-kheir li-kull aradheena.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: إحنا عم نخطط إنه بكرا، إذا الجو صار أحسن، رح نروح كلنا على بيت عمتي ببيروت لنشوفهم ونسلم عليهم.
english: We are planning that tomorrow, if the weather gets better, we will all go to my aunt's house in Beirut to see them and greet them.
transliteration: ihna amm n'khattat inno bukra, iza al-jaw sar ahsan, rah n'ruh kullna 'ala bet ammati bi-Beirut la-nshufhum w nisallim 'aleihem.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: أولادها، خمسة صغار بيلعبوا وبيركضوا طول اليوم، بيحبوا كثير هالأجواء العائلية لما كل العيلة تتجمع.
english: Her children, five little ones, play and run all day long; they love these family atmospheres very much when the whole family gathers.
transliteration: awladha, khamsi zghar bayla'bu w birukdu tul al-yawm, bihebbou ktheer hal-ajwa' al-'a'iliyeh lamma kull al-'eileh titjamma'.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: السنة الماضية، اجوا ضيوفنا من الشمال وقضوا معنا أيام حلوة خلال هالموجة الباردة.
english: Last year, our guests came from the North and spent beautiful days with us during this cold wave.
transliteration: as-saneh al-madiyeh, ajaw dhyoufna min ash-shamal w qadaw ma'ana ayyam helweh khilal hal-mawjeh al-barde.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: عم بتقول لي أمي: "يا ابني، إنتو لازم تستمتعوا بكل لحظة بهالشتا قبل ما يجي الصيف وحرارته."
english: My mother is telling me: "My son, you all must enjoy every moment of this winter before summer and its heat arrive."
transliteration: amm bitqul li ommi: "ya ibni, intu lazim tistamti'u bi-kull lahza bi-hash-shita qabl ma yiji as-seif w harartu."
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: وفعلاً، نتمنى إنه الشمس رح تشرق قريباً وتجفف الشوارع، عشان نطلع كلنا نعمل مشاويرنا اللي أجلناها.
english: And indeed, we hope that the sun will shine soon and dry the streets, so we can all go out and do our errands that we postponed.
transliteration: w fa'lan, nitmanna inno ash-shams rah tishroq qariban w tijaffif ash-shawari', 'ashan nitla' kullna ni'mil mashawirna illi ajjalnaha.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: بس لغاية ما يصير هيك، رح نبقى مجتمعين ببيتنا الدافئ ونستمتع بحكايات أجدادنا وأطباق أمي اللذيذة.
english: But until that happens, we will remain gathered in our warm house and enjoy the stories of our grandparents and my mother's delicious dishes.
transliteration: bas la-ghayet ma yisir hek, rah nibqa mujtami'een bi-betna ad-dafi w nistamti' bi-hikayat ajdadna w atbaq ommi al-ladhidha.
storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

arabic: كنا عم نستمتع بمسيتنا بحديقتنا، الهوا دافي وريحة قهوتنا مالية الجو.
english: We were enjoying our evening in our garden; the air was warm and our coffee's aroma filled the atmosphere.
transliteration: kanna 'am nastamte' b-masaytna b-hadeeqatna, el-hawa dafi w reehet qahwetna maliyet el-jaw.

arabic: فجأة، هبّت عاصفة قوية، حركت أوراق زيتوناتنا، وتلوّنت ألوان السما بغرابة.
english: Suddenly, a strong storm blew, rustling the leaves of our olive trees, and the sky's colors darkened remarkably.
transliteration: faj'a, habbat 'asifa qawiyye, harrakat awraaq zaytounatna, w talawwanat alwaan es-samaa b-gharaaba.

arabic: جيراني بسرعة صاروا يثبّتوا أثاثهم الخارجي، وسحبوا ولادهم لجوا بعيداً عن هبات الريح المفاجئة.
english: My neighbors quickly started securing their outdoor furniture and pulled their children inside away from the sudden gusts of wind.
transliteration: jeerani b-sor'a saaro ythabbitu athaathhom el-khaariji, w sahabu wlaadhom la-jau ba'eeda 'an habbaat er-reeh el-mufaaj'a.

arabic: أنا قمت فوراً لأجمع أغراضي وأغطي طاولتنا الخشبية، خايفاً عليها من المطر الغزير المتوقع.
english: I immediately rose to collect my belongings and cover our wooden table, fearing for it from the expected heavy rain.
transliteration: ana qomt fawran la-ajma' aghraadi w aghatti tawlatna el-khashabiyye, khayfan 'alayha min el-matar el-ghazeer el-mutawaqa'.

arabic: في غضون دقيقتين، تحولت الأجواء تماماً، وبدأت زخات المطر الغزيرة تهطل على بيوتنا وشوارعنا.
english: Within two minutes, the atmosphere changed completely, and heavy downpours began to fall on our homes and streets.
transliteration: fi ghodoon daqeeqatayn, tahawwalat el-ajwaa' tamaaman, w bada'at zakhaat el-matar el-ghazeera tahtel 'ala byootna w shawaare'na.

arabic: أختي كانت واقفة عند الشباك، عم تراقب البرق بيضوي السما والرعد بيرجف أضراسها من قوة صوته.
english: My sister was standing at the window, watching the lightning illuminate the sky and the thunder shaking her teeth from the strength of its sound.
transliteration: okhti kanat waqfe 'and esh-shubbaak, 'am traaqib el-barq byidwi es-sama w er-ra'd byirjef adraasha min quwwet sawto.

arabic: الأطفال، الذين كانوا يلعبون في الخارج، ركضوا جميعاً إلى داخل بيوتهم الضيقة، بعدما عدوا ثلاث صواعق متتالية.
english: The children, who were playing outside, all ran into their cramped homes, after they counted three consecutive lightning strikes.
transliteration: el-atfaal, illi kaano yil'abu barra, rakado jamee'an ila daakhel byoot'hom ed-dayyiqa, ba'd ma 'addu talaat sawaa'iq mutataaliyye.

arabic: "شو رأيكم نجلس هلق جوا وناكل كعك أمي اللي خبزتّو مبارح؟ رح نضل عم نتذكر هالليلية كتير!" قالت صديقتنا مها.
english: "What do you think if we sit inside now and eat my mother's cookies that she baked yesterday? We will keep remembering this night a lot!" said our friend Maha.
transliteration: "shoo ra'ykum nijles hala' jooa w naakol ka'ek immi illi khabazetto mbaareh? rah ndall 'am natzakkar hal-layliye kteer!" qaalat sadeeqatna Maha.

arabic: اتفقنا كلنا، فنحن بحاجة إلى بعض الدفء والضحكات لتبديد قلقنا من شدة الأمطار والرياح التي تضرب شبابيكنا بقوة.
english: We all agreed, for we are in need of some warmth and laughter to dispel our worry from the intensity of the rain and winds hitting our windows strongly.
transliteration: ittafaqna kullna, fa-nahnu bi-haaja ila ba'd ed-def' w ed-dahakaat la-tabdeed qalaqna min shiddet el-amtaar w er-riyaah illi tadreb shababeekna bi-quwwa.

arabic: بعدما تهدأ الأجواء، سيعود كل شخص إلى بيته، ونتمنى أن تكون بيوتهم سليمة ولم يصبها أي ضرر من هذه العاصفة المفاجئة.
english: After the weather calms down, each person will return to their home, and we hope their homes are safe and have not suffered any damage from this sudden storm.
transliteration: ba'd ma tahda el-ajwaa', say'ood kull shakhs ila bayto, w natamanna an takoon byoot'hom saleeme w lam yusib'ha ay darar min hathihi el-'asifa el-mufaaj'a.

arabic: بلش الصبح بقرية صغيرة بالجبل، و كانت السما صافية كالعادة، بس فجأة تغير الجو.
english: The morning started in a small village in the mountains, and the sky was clear as usual, but suddenly the weather changed.
transliteration: Balash es-sobuh bi-qarye zgheere bel jabal, w kanat es-sama safiye kal-aade, bas faj'a taghayyar el jaw.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: هَبِّت رياح قوية بلشت تهز بيوتنا وأشجارنا، ومطر غزير صار يتساقط بغزارة غير متوقعة.
english: Strong winds began to shake our houses and our trees, and heavy rain started to fall with unexpected intensity.
transliteration: Habbit riyah qawiyye ballashet tehizz buyuutna w ashjarna, w matar ghazir sar yetsaaqat bi-ghazara ghair mutawaqqa'a.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: شعروا أهل القرية بالخطر، خصوصاً بعد ما سمعوا توقعات الأرصاد الجوية عن عاصفة جليدية قادمة.
english: The villagers felt the danger, especially after they heard the weather forecasts about an upcoming ice storm.
transliteration: Sha'aroo ahel el-qarye bil khatar, khususan ba'd ma sami'oo tawqqa'aat el-arsad el-jawwiye 'an 'asife jalidiye qadime.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: اجتمعوا كبار الحارة ببيت المختار عشان يناقشوا شو لازم يعملوا ليحموا قريتهم وأولادهم.
english: The elders of the neighborhood gathered at the mayor's house to discuss what they should do to protect their village and their children.
transliteration: Ijtama'oo kbar el-hara b-bait el-mukhtar 'ashan ynaqsho shoo lazim ya'maloo layehmu qaryet-hum w awlad-hum.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: قال واحد منهم، "لازم نقوّي شبابيك بيوتنا و أبوابنا ونخزن مؤونة تكفي لأيام صعبة."
english: One of them said, "We must reinforce our windows and our doors and store provisions that will last for difficult days."
transliteration: Qaal waahed min-hum, "Lazem nqawwi shababeek buyuutna w abwabna w nkhazzin maw'oune takfi l-ayyam sa'be."
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: ردّت أم خالد، وهي امرأة حكيمة: "صحيح، بس الأهم نِفحص خطوط الكهربا والمي، نتأكد إنها ما رح تتضرر مع كل هالعواصف."
english: Um Khalid, a wise woman, replied: "True, but more importantly, we must check the electricity and water lines, and ensure they won't be damaged with all these storms."
transliteration: Raddat Om Khalid, w hiye imra'a hakime: "Sahih, bas el aham nifhas khutoot el-kahraba w el-mayy, nit'akkad innaha ma rah tetdarrar ma' kull hal-'awasif."
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: قرروا يوزّعوا المهام، فكل شب وصبي بالقرية رح يساعد بتأمين المعدات اللازمة وتنظيم أماكن للإخلاء.
english: They decided to distribute tasks, so every young man and boy in the village will help secure the necessary equipment and organize evacuation places.
transliteration: Qarraroo yawazzi'oo el-mahaam, fa-kull shab w sabi bil-qarye rah yesa'ed bi-ta'meen el-mu'addat el-lazime w tanzim amaken lil-ikhla'.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: أنا ورفقاتي رح نروح نجمع حطب لتدفئة البيوت، وهنّي الشباب الأكبر رح يتأكدوا من سلامة الطرقات اللي بتودي للمستشفى.
english: My friends and I will go gather firewood for heating the houses, and the older youths will ensure the safety of the roads leading to the hospital.
transliteration: Ana w rafa'ati rah nrouh nijma' hatab li-tadfi'at el-buyuut, w henni esh-shabab el-akbar rah yet'akkado men salamet et-torqat illi b-twaddi lil-mustashfa.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: و بلشوا أهل القرية، رجالك و نساؤهم، يشتغلوا بإيد واحدة قبل ما تهب العاصفة بيومين.
english: And the villagers, their men and their women, began to work hand in hand two days before the storm hit.
transliteration: W ballashoo ahel el-qarye, rjal-hum w nisaa'u-hum, yeshtighloo bi-iid wahde abl ma tehobb el-'asife b-yoomain.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: صرنا نشوف الغيمات السودا عم تتجمع فوق روس الجبال، وسمعنا صوت الرعد عم يتردد بالوادي.
english: We started to see the black clouds gathering above the mountain peaks, and we heard the sound of thunder echoing in the valley.
transliteration: Serna nshouf el-ghaimat es-sowda 'am tetjam'a fawq rus el-jibal, w sami'na sowt er-ra'd 'am yetradad bil-wadi.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: بعد كم ساعة، اجت العاصفة بقوتها الكاملة، و الرياح كانت تزأر والثلج بلش يتساقط بغزارة.
english: After a few hours, the storm arrived with its full force, and the winds were roaring and the snow began to fall heavily.
transliteration: Ba'd kam sa'a, ijet el-'asife b-qawwet-ha el-kamle, w er-riyah kanat teza'ar w eth-thalj ballash yetsaaqat bi-ghazara.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: بس بفضل جهودهم، بيوتنا صمدت، و عيالنا ناموا دافيين ومحميين جوا، بعيداً عن قساوة الجو الخارجي.
english: But thanks to their efforts, our houses stood firm, and our families slept warm and protected inside, far from the harshness of the outside weather.
transliteration: Bas b-fadel juhood-hum, buyuutna samadat, w 'iyyalna namoo dafiyyin w mahmiyyin juwwa, ba'idan 'an qasawet el-jaww el-khariji.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: إدراك المخاطر وأخذ القرارات الصائبة قبل فوات الأوان هو اللي خلانا ننجو من هالعاصفة الكبيرة.
english: Understanding the risks and making the right decisions before it was too late is what allowed us to survive this big storm.
transliteration: Idrak el-makhatir w akhdh el-qararat es-saa'ibe abl fawat el-awan howa illi khallana nanjo min hal-'asife el-kbire.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: كلنا تعلمنا درس مهم: لما نتعاون ونخطط سوا، بنقدر نواجه أصعب التحديات اللي بتجينا بالحياة.
english: We all learned an important lesson: when we cooperate and plan together, we can face the toughest challenges that come our way in life.
transliteration: Kullna ta'allamna dars muhimm: lamma neta'aawan w nkhattet sawah, benqdar nwaaje' as'ab et-tahaddiyat illi b-tejeena bil-haya.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: وهيك، بقيت قريتنا قوية ومتماسكة، ومستعدين لأي عاصفة تانية ممكن تجي، لأنه وحدتنا هي سر قوتنا.
english: And so, our village remained strong and cohesive, ready for any other storm that might come, because our unity is the secret of our strength.
transliteration: W heek, baqiyet qaryet-na qawiyye w mutamasike, w musta'iddin li-ay 'asife tanye mumkin teji, li'anno wahdet-na hiye sirr quwwet-na.
storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

arabic: كانت شمس الصيف الحارقة قد بدأت ترسم لوحات ذهبية على أسطح بيوت الشام العتيقة، في تموز الذي لا يرحم.
english: The scorching summer sun had begun to paint golden canvases on the rooftops of ancient Damascus houses, in an unforgiving July.
transliteration: Kanat shams as-sayf al-hariqa qad badaat tarsum lawhat thahabiyya ala astuh buyut ash-Sham al-atiqa, fi Tammouz allathi la yarham.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: يا الله ما أشدّ الحرارة! همست أم رامي لنفسها وهي تنهض بتثاقل بعد قيلولة الظهيرة، تشعر بتعب الأيام الطويلة.
english: "Oh my, how intense the heat is!" Um Rami whispered to herself as she slowly rose after her afternoon nap, feeling the fatigue of long days.
transliteration: Ya Allah ma ashadd al-harara! Hamasat Umm Rami li-nafsaha wa hiya tanhad bitathaqul bad qayloulet ad-dhuhr, tashour bi-taab al-ayyam at-tawila.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: كل ظهر، كانت أم رامي تجهّز إبريق الليموناضة البارد لأفراد عائلتها ولأيٍّ من الجارات اللواتي قد يزرنها فجأة.
english: Every noon, Um Rami used to prepare a pitcher of cold lemonade for her family members and for any of the neighbors who might visit her suddenly.
transliteration: Kull dhuhr, kanat Umm Rami tujahhez ibreeq al-laymounada al-bared li-afraad aa'ilatiha wa li-ayyin min al-jarat allawati qad yazurnaha faj'a.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: أطفال الحارة، وهم عشرات الأولاد والبنات، كانوا يلعبون بالماء في الساحات الضيقة هرباً من القيظ، تصفق أياديهم بفرحٍ غامر.
english: The neighborhood children, dozens of boys and girls, were playing with water in the narrow courtyards, escaping the intense heat, their hands clapping with overwhelming joy.
transliteration: Atfal al-hara, wa hum asharat al-awlad wal-banat, kanu yalaboun bil-ma' fi as-sahhat ad-dayiqa haraban min al-qaydh, tusaffiq ayadihim bi-farahin ghamir.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: وقرّرت أم رامي أن تعدّ طبقاً كبيراً من التبّولة الطازجة؛ فهي تعتقد أن هذا سينعشهم حتماً قبل الخروج لنزهة المساء الهادئة.
english: Um Rami decided to prepare a large dish of fresh Tabbouleh; she believes it will certainly refresh them before going out for the peaceful evening stroll.
transliteration: Wa qarrarat Umm Rami an tua'idd tabaqan kabeeran min at-tabbouleh at-taziha; fa hiya tataqid ann hatha sayun'ishuhum hatman qabl al-khuruj li-nuzhet al-masa' al-hadi'a.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: في المساء، تتجمع العائلة كلها على سطح منزلهم العالي، حيث يهبّ نسيمٌ عليلٌ ويتبادلون أحاديث يومهم الشاق.
english: In the evening, the entire family gathers on their high rooftop, where a gentle breeze blows, and they exchange conversations about their arduous day.
transliteration: Fi al-masa', tatajamma al-aa'ila kullaha ala satah manzilihim al-ali, haythu yahubb naseemun aleelun wa yatabadaloun ahadeeth yawmihim ash-shaqq.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: هل تتذكرون ذاك الصيف حين كنت أنا ووالدكم نشاهد النجوم لساعات طويلة؟ سألت أم رامي، مبتسمة لذكريات شبابها.
english: "Do you all remember that summer when your father and I used to watch the stars for long hours?" asked Um Rami, smiling at the memories of her youth.
transliteration: Hal tatathakkaroun thak as-sayf heen kuntu ana wa walidukum nushahid an-nujoom li-sa'at tawila? Sa'alat Umm Rami, mubtasima li-thikrayat shababaha.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: أجاب رامي، الابن الأكبر: نعم يا أمي، وسوف نُعيد هذه اللحظات قريباً، ربما بعد بضعة أسابيع في الساحل اللبناني.
english: Rami, the eldest son, replied: "Yes, Mother, and we will relive these moments soon, perhaps after a few weeks on the Lebanese coast."
transliteration: Ajab Rami, al-ibn al-akbar: Na'am ya ummi, wa sawfa nu'eed hathihi al-lahazat qariban, rubbama ba'd bida'at asabee' fi as-sahil al-lubnani.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: الجيران من خمسة بيوت مختلفة، يرون بعضهم وهم يتجولون في الأزقة الضيقة، يتبادلون التحية ويشربون قهوتهم العربية معاً.
english: Neighbors from five different houses see each other as they stroll through the narrow alleys, exchanging greetings and drinking their Arabic coffee together.
transliteration: Al-jeeran min khamsat buyut mukhtalifa, yarawn ba'dahum wa hum yatajawwaloun fi al-aziqa ad-dayiqa, yatabadaloun at-tahiyya wa yashraboun qahwatihum al-arabiya ma'an.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: وهكذا، تمرّ أيام الصيف الحارقة في المدن الشامية، لا تقوى على إطفاء دفء القلوب وصلات الروح التي تجمع أهلها.
english: Thus, the scorching summer days pass in the Levantine cities, unable to extinguish the warmth of hearts and the soul ties that unite its people.
transliteration: Wa hakatha, tamurr ayyam as-sayf al-hariqa fi al-mudun ash-shamiya, la taqwa ala itfa' dif' al-qulub wa salat ar-rouh allati tajma' ahlaha.
storyTitle: Damascus Summer and the Warmth of Hearts

arabic: كانت الصيفية الماضية ببيروت، شمسها الذهبية عم تغمر بيوتنا القديمة وشوارعنا المزدحمة بالناس.
english: Last summer in Beirut, its golden sun was embracing our old houses and our streets crowded with people.
transliteration: Kaanat es-sayfiyeh el-madhiyeh b-Beirut, shams-ha edh-dhahabiyeh 'am taghmor buyoot-na el-qadimeh w shaware'-na el-mozdaheme bi-nnas.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: أنا وأخواتي قررنا نعمل عزومة كبيرة لأصحابنا، وبلشنا نخطط شو رح نطبخ من أكلات بلدنا الطيبة.
english: My siblings and I decided to host a big feast for our friends, and we started planning what we would cook from our country's delicious dishes.
transliteration: Ana w akhawat-i qarrar-na na'mel 'azoumeh kbireh la as'hab-na, w ballash-na nkhateT shoo raH notbokh min aklat balad-na eT-taybeh.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: رحنا على السوق الشعبي، وشفنا عشرات أنواع الخضار والفواكه الفريش اللي بتعبي سلالنا الملونة.
english: We went to the popular market and saw dozens of types of fresh vegetables and fruits that filled our colorful baskets.
transliteration: RaH-na 'ala es-sou' esh-sha'bi, w shaf-na 'asharat anwa' el-khodar w el-fawakeh el-fresh illi b-ta'abbi sallaal-na el-mlawwaneh.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: أنا اخترت ورق عنب وطلبت من البياع يعطيني ثلاثة كيلو كوسا للحشي، لأن بعرف إنه الكل بيحبّوا.
english: I chose grape leaves and asked the vendor to give me three kilos of zucchini for stuffing, because I know everyone loves them.
transliteration: Ana ikhtar-t wara' 'enab w talab-t min el-bayya' ya'tee-ni talateh kilo kousa lal-hashi, la'ann ba'raf inno el-kill bi-hebb-u.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: كلّ واحد منا أخد مهمة؛ هنّي عم يحضّروا التبولة والفتوش، ونحنا عم نلف ورق العنب بحبّ ومهارة.
english: Each one of us took a task; they were preparing the tabbouleh and fattoush, while we were rolling the grape leaves with love and skill.
transliteration: Kill wahed min-na akhad mohimmeh; henni 'am yhadder-u et-tabbouleh w el-fattoush, w neh-na 'am neliff wara' el-'enab b-hobb w mahara.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: مرت ساعات طويلة بضحكاتنا وأحاديثنا الحلوة، والمطبخ صار مليان بروائح أكلنا الشهي.
english: Long hours passed with our laughter and sweet conversations, and the kitchen became filled with the aromas of our delicious food.
transliteration: Marrat sa'aat taweeleh b-daHakat-na w ahaadeeth-na el-helweh, w el-maTbakh sar malyaan b-rawa'eH akl-na esh-shaheyy.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: لما وصلوا أصحابنا، كانوا مبسوطين كتير لما شافوا مائدة أكلنا، وقعدنا كلنا نتذوق كل لقمة بحب.
english: When our friends arrived, they were very happy when they saw our feast table, and we all sat down to taste every bite with love.
transliteration: Lamma waSal-u as'hab-na, kaan-u mabsooTein kteer lamma shaf-u ma'edet akl-na, w qa'ad-na kill-na netdhawwaq kill loqmeh b-hobb.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: قالوا: "يا سلام! أكلكم بيشهّي، ما ذقنا متله من سنتين، شكراً كتير على ضيافتكم الكريمة."
english: They said: "Wow! Your food is delicious, we haven't tasted anything like it in two years, thank you very much for your generous hospitality."
transliteration: Qaal-u: "Ya salam! Akel-kum byeshahhi, ma dhoq-na mitil-uh min santayn, shokran kteer 'ala dhyafet-kum el-karimeh."
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: بالليل، بعد ما ودّعنا الكل، قعدنا نتذكّر هاليوم الحلو وقررنا نعمل عزومة تانية الشهر الجاي، لأن هي اللحظات بتجمع عيلتنا.
english: At night, after we said goodbye to everyone, we sat remembering this sweet day and decided to host another feast next month, because these moments bring our family together.
transliteration: B-ellayl, ba'ed ma wadda'-na el-kill, qa'ad-na netdhakkar hal-yom el-helw w qarrar-na na'mel 'azoumeh taniyeh esh-shahr el-jay, la'ann hay el-laHazat b-tijma' 'aylat-na.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: هيك الصيفية بمدينتنا، فرصة إلنا لنقضي أوقات حلوة مع بعض، ونعمل أكلات طيّبة بتضل ذكراها بقلوبنا.
english: This is summer in our city, an opportunity for us to spend sweet times together, and make delicious dishes whose memory remains in our hearts.
transliteration: Hayk es-sayfiyeh b-madinet-na, forSa il-na l-naqDi awqaat helweh ma' ba'ed, w na'mel aklat taybeh b-tDall zikra-ha b-quloob-na.
storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

arabic: قررت ليلى أن تذهب للتسوق اليوم، فقد كانت بحاجة إلى فستان جديد وبعض الأغراض للمنزل.
english: Layla decided to go shopping today, as she was in need of a new dress and some household items.
transliteration: Qarrarat Layla an tadhaba lil-tasawwuq al-yawm, faqad kanat bi-hajetin ila fustan jadid wa ba'd al-aghrad lil-manzil.

arabic: أولاً، دخلت محلاً للأزياء في سوق الحميدية، حيث رأت فساتين رائعة معروضة بواجهاته اللامعة.
english: First, she entered a fashion store in Souq al-Hamidiyah, where she saw wonderful dresses displayed in its shining windows.
transliteration: Awwalan, dakhalat mahallan lil-azya' fi Souq al-Hamidiyah, haythu ra'at fasatin ra'i'ah ma'rouda bi-wajehatih al-lami'ah.

arabic: سألت البائعة: "صباح الخير، هل لديكم فساتين سهرة تناسب مقاسي؟ أنا أبحث عن شيء أنيق لعرس أختي الشهر القادم."
english: She asked the saleswoman: "Good morning, do you have evening dresses that fit my size? I am looking for something elegant for my sister's wedding next month."
transliteration: Sa'alat al-ba'i'ah: "Sabah al-khayr, hal ladaykum fasatin sahra tunasib maqasi? Ana abhath 'an shay' aneeq li-'urs ukhti al-shahr al-qadim."

arabic: أجابت البائعة بحماس: "أكيد يا آنسة! تفضلي معي، سأريكِ خمسة تصاميم جديدة وصلتنا بالأمس، وأنا متأكدة أنكِ ستجدين ما يعجبكِ."
english: The saleswoman replied enthusiastically: "Certainly, miss! Please come with me, I will show you five new designs that arrived yesterday, and I am sure you will find what you like."
transliteration: Ajabat al-ba'i'ah bi-hamas: "Akeed ya anisah! Tafaddali ma'i, sa'ureeki khamsat tasameem jadidah wasalatna bil-ams, wa ana muta'akkidah annaki satjedin ma yu'jibik."

arabic: بعد أن جربت ليلى ثلاثة فساتين، وقع اختيارها على فستان أزرق طويل كانت قد رأته أولاً، ودفعَت ثمنه مئة وخمسين ألف ليرة سورية.
english: After Layla tried on three dresses, her choice fell on a long blue dress she had seen first, and she paid its price, one hundred and fifty thousand Syrian pounds.
transliteration: Ba'd an jarrabat Layla thalathat fasatin, waqa'a ikhtiyaruha 'ala fustan azraq taweel kanat qad ra'at-hu awwalan, wa dafa'at thamanahu mi'ah wa khamsin alf lira suriyah.

arabic: ثم اتجهت إلى سوق الخضار، حيث الأجواء كانت صاخبة وروائح البهارات تملأ المكان.
english: Then she headed to the vegetable market, where the atmosphere was bustling and the aromas of spices filled the place.
transliteration: Thumma itajjahat ila souq al-khudar, haythu al-ajwa' kanat sakhikhabah wa rawa'ih al-baharat tamla' al-makan.

arabic: اشترت ليلى كيلوغرامين من البندورة الحمراء، وربطتين من البقدونس الطازج، وطلبت من البائع أن يزن لها خمس حبات من التفاح الأصفر.
english: Layla bought two kilograms of red tomatoes, two bunches of fresh parsley, and asked the vendor to weigh her five yellow apples.
transliteration: Ishtarat Layla kilogramein min al-bandoura al-hamra', wa rabtatayn min al-ba'dounis al-tazaj, wa talabat min al-ba'i' an yazin laha khams habbat min al-tuffah al-asfar.

arabic: سألته عن أسعار الموز والبرتقال، فقالت: "كم سعر الكيلو من الموز عندكم اليوم؟ أريد أن أشتري كمية كافية لأولادي."
english: She asked him about the prices of bananas and oranges, saying: "How much is a kilo of bananas with you today? I want to buy enough for my children."
transliteration: Sa'alat-hu 'an as'ar al-mawz wal-burtuqal, fa-qalat: "Kam si'r al-kilo min al-mawz 'indakum al-yawm? Ureed an ashtari kammiyah kafiyah li-awladi."

arabic: أجاب البائع بلطف: "الموز اليوم بخمسة عشر ألف ليرة، والبرتقال بعشرة آلاف، كلها طازجة وممتازة، ستحبونها بالتأكيد!"
english: The vendor replied kindly: "Bananas today are fifteen thousand lira, and oranges are ten thousand, all of them fresh and excellent, you will surely love them!"
transliteration: Ajab al-ba'i' bi-lutuf: "Al-mawz al-yawm bi-khamsat 'ashar alf lira, wal-burtuqal bi-'asharat alaf, kulluha tazajah wa mumtazah, satuhibbounaha bil-ta'keed!"

arabic: بعد أن أكملت تسوقها، ستعود ليلى إلى بيتها لتحضر عشاءً شهياً لعائلتها، وتشاركهم تفاصيل يومها المزدحم.
english: After she finished her shopping, Layla will return home to prepare a delicious dinner for her family, and share the details of her busy day with them.
transliteration: Ba'd an akmalat tasawwuqaha, sat'oud Layla ila baytiha lituhaddira 'asha'an shahyyan li-'a'ilatiha, wa tusharikahum tafaseel yawmiha al-muzdahim.

arabic: نادين، أهلاً فيكي! كيف عطلتك؟ وين رح تروحي تتسوقي لهدايا أختك؟
english: Nadine, welcome! How is your vacation? Where will you go shopping for your sister's gifts?
transliteration: Nadin, ahlan fiki! Kif atlatik? Wein rah troohi tatasawwaqi la-hadaya okhtik?

arabic: أهلاً فيكي! عطلتي ممتازة، بس السنة الماضية اشترينا كل شي من المول الكبير. هالمرة لازم ألاقي محلات جديدة لفساتيني وأحذيتي.
english: Welcome! My vacation is excellent, but last year we bought everything from the big mall. This time I must find new shops for my dresses and shoes.
transliteration: Ahlan fiki! Atlaty mumtazah, bas is-sana il-madhiye ishtaraina kul shi min il-mol il-kabeer. Hal-marra lazim alaa'i mahallat jadeedeh la-fasateeni w ahziyati.

arabic: فهمت عليكي. بدك تشتري فساتين كتير، يمكن قطعتين أو ثلاثة؟ وهل رح تشوفي شي لإلنا كمان؟
english: I understand you. Do you want to buy many dresses, maybe two or three pieces? And will you look for something for us too?
transliteration: Fahimt alayki. Baddik tishtari fasateen kteer, mumkin qitatain aw talateh? Wa hal rah tshoofi shi il-ilna kaman?

arabic: آه، طبعاً! بدنا نشتري فساتين جديدة، وأنا رح شوف أحذية مناسبة إلي. وإنت بتلاقي شي لإلك كمان، لازم آخدك معي.
english: Oh, of course! We want to buy new dresses, and I will look for suitable shoes for myself. And you'll find something for yourself too, I must take you with me.
transliteration: Ah, tab'an! Baddna nishtari fasateen jadeedeh, w ana rah shoof ahziyah munasabah illi. W inti btlaqi shi illik kaman, lazim akhdik ma'i.

arabic: فكرة رائعة! بتذكر رحنا على سوق الحميدية بدمشق من سنتين، تنزيلاتهم كانت بتجنن، ولقينا كتير شغلات حلوة.
english: Great idea! I remember we went to Souk Al-Hamidiyah in Damascus two years ago, their sales were amazing, and we found many nice things.
transliteration: Fikra raa'i'ah! Batzakkar roohna ala Souk Al-Hamidiyeh bi Dimashq min sanaten, tanzeelatihom kanat bitjannen, w laqayna kteer shaghalat hilweh.

arabic: صح، سوق الحميدية دايماً خيار ممتاز. كيف بتلاقي أسعار المحلات الجديدة اللي بدك تشوفيها؟
english: True, Souk Al-Hamidiyah is always an excellent choice. How do you find the prices of the new shops you want to check out?
transliteration: Sah, Souk Al-Hamidiyeh daayman khiyar mumtaz. Kif btlaqi as'ar il-mahallat il-jadeedeh illi baddik tshoofiha?

arabic: حسب تجاربي، أسعار الفساتين بتختلف كتير، بس أنا بتوقع إنها رح تكون معقولة إذا كانت المحلات عاملة تنزيلات. ما بدي أدفع كتير.
english: Based on my experiences, dress prices vary a lot, but I expect them to be reasonable if the shops are having sales. I don't want to pay too much.
transliteration: Hasab tajaribi, as'ar il-fasateen bikhtalif kteer, bas ana batwaqqa innaha rah takoun ma'qouleh iza kanat il-mahallat amleh tanzeelat. Ma baddi adfa' kteer.

arabic: بتمنى ألاقي فستان حلو بيناسب مناسبة أخي الشهر الجاي، ويكون سعره منيح إلي.
english: I hope I find a nice dress that suits my brother's occasion next month, and its price is good for me.
transliteration: Batamanna alaa'i fustan hilu biyenasib munasabat akhi ish-shahr il-jay, w yakoun si'ruh mneeh illi.

arabic: ما عليكي! أنا متأكدة رح نلاقي لك أفضل فستان، وإذا ما عجبنا شي، منشوف محلات تانية.
english: Don't worry! I'm sure we will find you the best dress, and if we don't like anything, we'll check other shops.
transliteration: Ma alayki! Ana muta'akkedeh rah nela'iki afla fustan, w iza ma ajabna shi, minshoof mahallat tanya.

arabic: تمام، معناتها بنتقابل الساعة وحدة الظهر بكرا عند البوابة الرئيسية، هذا بيناسب مواعيدنا.
english: Okay, so we'll meet tomorrow at one in the afternoon at the main gate; this suits our appointments.
transliteration: Tamam, ma'nata bintiqabal is-saa'a wahde id-duhur bukra and il-bawwabeh ir-ra'eesiyeh, hadha biyenasib mawa'eedna.

arabic: جدتي فاطمة وأنا قررنا نروح نتسوق بالسوق القديم هذاك اليوم، عشان نلاقي أشياء حلوة لبيتنا.
english: My grandmother Fatima and I decided to go shopping in the old souk that day, to find nice things for our home.
transliteration: Jiddati Fatima w ana qarrarna nrouh ntsawwaq bil-souq il-qadeem hadak il-yom, 'ashan nla'i ashyaa' hilweh l-baytna.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: لمّا وصلنا، شفنالِك محلات كتيرة عم تلمع وتشع ألوان زاهية، وكأنها لوحة فنية بتجنن.
english: When we arrived, we saw many shops shining and radiating vibrant colors, as if they were a stunning work of art.
transliteration: Lamma wsalna, shifnalik mahallat kiteereh 'am talma' w tsha' alwaan zaahiyeh, w ka'annaha lawhet fanniyyeh btijannin.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: لينا كانت كتير بتحب الأقمشة الملونة وبتتخيل فساتين كتير حلوة لحفلاتها الجاية مع صديقاتها.
english: Lina really loved the colorful fabrics and was imagining many beautiful dresses for her upcoming parties with her friends.
transliteration: Leena kanat kteer btehibb il-aqmesheh il-mlawwaneh w btithayyal fasateen kteer hilweh l-haflatha il-jayyeh ma' sadeeqatha.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: ردّت جدتي فاطمة بابتسامة: "يا لينا، نحنا بحاجة خضراوات طازجة لوجباتنا طول الأسبوع، هاد أهم شي هلأ."
english: Grandmother Fatima replied with a smile: "Oh Lina, we need fresh vegetables for our meals all week, that's the most important thing now."
transliteration: Raddit Jiddati Fatima b-ibtisameh: "Ya Leena, nehna b-hajet khadrawaat tazejeh l-wajabatna tool il-usboo', had aham shi halla'."
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: اقتربنا من بياع شاطر كان عم يبيع بندورة وخيار مستويين بأعداد كبيرة، والناس حوليه عم يسألوا عن الأسعار.
english: We approached a clever vendor who was selling ripe tomatoes and cucumbers in large quantities, with people around him asking about prices.
transliteration: Iqtarabna min bayya' shater kan 'am yibee' banadura w khiyar mustawwayn b-a'daad kbeereh, w in-naas hawleih 'am yis'alu 'an il-as'aar.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: سألت جدتي وهي عم تختار: "كم سعر كيلوين من هالبندورة الحمرا الحلوة، يا معلم؟ وكمان كيلو خيار؟"
english: My grandmother asked while choosing: "How much are two kilos of these beautiful red tomatoes, sir? And also a kilo of cucumbers?"
transliteration: Sa'alit Jiddati w hiyyeh 'am takhtar: "Kam se'er kilowayn min hal-banadura il-hamra il-hilweh, ya mu'allim? W kaman kilo khiyar?"
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: أجاب البياع بابتسامة عريضة: "كلهم خمسة آلاف ليرة سورية بس، يا ست الحبايب! بضاعة اليوم طازجة وممتازة."
english: The vendor replied with a wide smile: "All of it is just five thousand Syrian Lira, dear lady! Today's produce is fresh and excellent."
transliteration: Ajaab il-bayya' b-ibtisameh 'areeda: "Kullhum khamset aalaaf leera sooriyyeh bas, ya sitt il-habayib! Bida'et il-yom tazejeh w mumtazeh."
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: لينا بسرعة حَسَبِت إنهم رح يقدروا يشتروا أشياء كتير تانية إذا دبروا مصاريهم منيح وما صرفوا كتير على شي واحد.
english: Lina quickly calculated that they would be able to buy many other things if they managed their money well and didn't spend too much on one item.
transliteration: Leena b-sur'a hasabit innahom rah yiqdaru yishtaru ashyaa' kteer taniyeh iza dabbaroo masarihom mneeh w ma sarrafo kteer 'ala shi wahed.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: بعد ما اشتروا كل خضراواتهم المطلوبة، وعدوا حالهم إنهم يزوروا محل الحلويات الشهير الأسبوع الجاي للمتعة.
english: After they bought all their required vegetables, they promised themselves that they would visit the famous sweets shop next week for enjoyment.
transliteration: Ba'd ma ishtaru kull khadrawathum il-matloubeh, wa'adu halhom innahom yizooru mahal il-halawiyat ish-shaheer il-usboo' il-jayy lil-mut'a.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: رجعوا للبيت، سلتهم مليانة بالخيرات، وقلوبهم فرحانة بيوم تسوقهن الممتع والمثمر في سوق دمشق العريق.
english: They returned home, their basket full of goods, and their hearts joyful with their fun and fruitful shopping day in the ancient souk of Damascus.
transliteration: Raja'u lil-bayt, sallathum malyaneh bil-khayraat, w quloobhum farhaneh b-yom tasawwuqhum il-mumti' wal-muthmir fi souq Dimashq il-'areeq.
storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

arabic: مبارح، إجوا عيلتنا أنا و أخي الصغير خالد و أختي الكبيرة سارة على الحديقة اللي جنب بيتنا.
english: Yesterday, our family, my little brother Khaled, my older sister Sara, and I came to the park next to our house.
transliteration: Mbareh, iju a'eeltna ana w akhi il-zghir Khaled w ukhti il-kbire Sara 'ala il-hadeeqa illi janb beitna.

arabic: كنا حابين نلعب ونقضي وقت حلو، بس للأسف، شفْنا كميات كبيرة من الزبالة المتناثرة على العشب وبين الأشجار.
english: We wanted to play and spend a nice time, but unfortunately, we saw large quantities of scattered trash on the grass and among the trees.
transliteration: Kunna habbeen nil'ab w niqdi wa't helu, bas lal-asaf, shifna kammiyyaat kbeereh min iz-zbaaleh il-mitnatrheh 'ala il-'ushb w bein il-ashjar.

arabic: أمي حكت بحزن: "يا حرام هالمنظر! مين عم بيرمي وسخه بهالمكان الجميل؟ لازم كل واحد فينا يهتم ببيئتنا."
english: My mother said sadly: "What a pity this sight! Who is throwing their dirt in this beautiful place? Each one of us must take care of our environment."
transliteration: Ummi hakat bi-huzn: "Ya haraam hal-manzar! Meen 'am beremi wasakho bi-hal-makaan il-jameel? Laazim kill wahed feena yahtamm bi-bee'atna."

arabic: قررنا أنا وأهلي إنو بكرة رح نرجع ومعنا أكياس لننضف الحديقة و نزرع كم شتلة جديدة.
english: My family and I decided that tomorrow we will return with bags to clean the park and plant a few new seedlings.
transliteration: Qarrarna ana w ahli inno bukra rah nirja' w ma'na ikyaas lennaddif il-hadeeqa w nizra' kam shatleh jdeedeh.

arabic: حكت أختي سارة: "يمكن إذا شفونا عم ننضف، شي عشرة أشخاص أو أكتر من الجيران رح يساعدونا ويجوا معنا."
english: My sister Sara said: "Perhaps if they see us cleaning, about ten people or more from the neighbors will help us and come with us."
transliteration: Hakat ukhti Sara: "Yimkin iza shafuna 'am nnaaddif, shi 'ashara ashkhass aw aktar min il-jeeran rah ysa'iduna w yiju ma'na."

arabic: اليوم الصبح، حطيت أنا وأبي وأمي وأخواتي قفازاتنا وأخدنا خمس أكياس كبار للزبالة.
english: This morning, my father, mother, siblings and I put on our gloves and took five large bags for trash.
transliteration: Il-youm il-sobeh, hattayt ana w abi w ummi w ikhwaati qaffazatna w akhadna khams ikyaas kbaar liz-zbaaleh.

arabic: شُفنا إنو في جيران عم يتطلعوا علينا بفضول، وبعد شوي، اجت إمرأة كبيرة بالعمر ومعها ولدها الصغير وبلشوا يساعدونا.
english: We saw that some neighbors were looking at us curiously, and after a while, an elderly woman came with her young son and they started helping us.
transliteration: Shufna inno fi jeeran 'am yitl'aw 'aleina bi-fudool, w ba'd shway, ajat imra'a kbeereh bil-'umur w ma'ha waladha il-zghir w ballashu ysa'iduna.

arabic: كلنا صرنا نحكي إنو هاد واجبنا نحمي بيئتنا ونخليها نظيفة لأطفالنا وللأجيال الجاية، و رح ننظم حملات تنظيف شهرية.
english: We all started saying that this is our duty to protect our environment and keep it clean for our children and for future generations, and we will organize monthly cleaning campaigns.
transliteration: Kullna serna nahki inno haad wajibna nahmi bee'atna w nkhalliha nadifeh la-atfalna w lal-ajyaal il-jayeh, w rah nnazzim hamlaat tanzif shahriyeh.

arabic: جمعنا حوالي ثمان أكياس مليانة بالقمامة و زرعنا أربع شتلات ورد وزيتون صغيرة.
english: We collected about eight bags full of trash and planted four small rose and olive seedlings.
transliteration: Jama'na hawali thaman ikyaas malyaneh bil-qmaameh w zara'na arba' shatlaat ward w zaytoon zghireh.

arabic: هلأ الحديقة صارت أحلى بكتير، وكل يوم بشوف الأطفال عم يلعبوا فيها بسعادة، وهذا بيعطيني أمل لمستقبل كوكبنا.
english: Now the park has become much more beautiful, and every day I see the children playing happily in it, and this gives me hope for the future of our planet.
transliteration: Hala' il-hadeeqa saarat ahla bikteer, w kill youm bashoof il-atfal 'am yil'abu fiha bi-sa'adeh, w haada bi-ya'teeni amal la-mustaqbal kawkabna.

arabic: مساء الخير مشاهدينا الكرام، ننقل لكم اليوم آخر الأخبار الشيقة من مدننا وقرانا الجميلة في منطقة الشام.
english: Good evening, esteemed viewers, today we bring you the latest interesting news from our beautiful cities and villages in the Levant region.
transliteration: Masaa el kheer mushahidina al kiraam, nanqul lakum el yoom akher el akhbar el shayyiqa min mudunina wa qurana el jameela fi minTaqat ash Sham.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: ومعنا مراسلنا أمين في بث مباشر من قرية كرم الزيتون، ليحدثنا عن مشروعهم الطموح لإنشاء جنينة عامة.
english: And with us is our reporter Amin live from Karm El Zeitoun village, to tell us about their ambitious project to establish a public garden.
transliteration: Wa ma'ana murasilna Ameen fi bath mubasher min qaryat Karm ez Zeitoun, liyuhaddithna 'an mashru'ihum at tamuuh li'inshaa' janaina 'amma.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: يا جماعة الخير، أهالي كرم الزيتون بدهم يعملوا أحلى جنينة بالمنطقة، لحتى أولادهم الصغار يلعبوا فيها بكل أمان وفرح.
english: Folks, the people of Karm El Zeitoun want to make the most beautiful garden in the region, so that their young children can play in it safely and joyfully.
transliteration: Ya jama'at el kheer, ahali Karm ez Zeitoun biddhom ya'malu ahla janaina bil minTaqah, lahatta awladhom es sghar yil'abu fiha bi kull aman w farah.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: بالأمس، جمعوا الأهالي أكثر من خمسة آلاف ليرة وتبرعات كثيرة، ثم اشتروا شتلات وأزهار متنوعة من كل الأنواع والألوان.
english: Yesterday, the locals collected more than five thousand liras and many donations, then they bought diverse saplings and flowers of all types and colors.
transliteration: Bil ams, jama'u el ahali akthar min khamsat alaaf leera wa tabarru'aat katheera, thumma ishtaru shtalaat wa azhaar mutanawwi'a min kull el anwaa' wal alwaan.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: بس صار معهم موقف مضحك مبارح: رئيس البلدية، وهو عم يسقي الزرع ببير بيته، شاف فاتورة الكهرباء تبعيته.
english: But something funny happened to them yesterday: the mayor, while watering the plants with his house's well, saw his electricity bill.
transliteration: Bass sar ma'ahom mawqaf mudhek mbarah: ra'ees el baladiyyah, w huwwa 'am yisqi ez zar' bi beer bayto, shaf fatourat el kahraba tabe'itoh.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: صرخ وقال بلهجة عصبية: 'يا عالم، بدّنا نسقي المزروعات أقل، الفاتورة رح تفلسني شخصياً!'
english: He shouted and said in an angry tone: 'Oh people, we need to water the plants less, the bill will bankrupt me personally!'
transliteration: Sarakh w qaala bi lahja 'asabiyya: 'Ya 'aalam, bidna nisqi el mazrou'aat aqall, el fatoura rah tfallisni shakhsiyyan!'
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: الناس بالبداية ما فهموا قصده، وفكروا إنو نسي مين عم يدفع مصاريف الحديقة.
english: The people initially didn't understand what he meant, and thought he forgot who was paying for the garden's expenses.
transliteration: En naas bil bidaaya ma fahimu qasdo, w fakkaru inno nisi min 'am yidfa' masareef el hadeeqa.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: بس هو وضح إنو فاتورة الكهرباء لسقاية الحديقة كانت عالية لأنه استخدم بيره الخاص.
english: But he clarified that the electricity bill for watering the garden was high because he used his own private well.
transliteration: Bass huwwa waddah inno fatourat el kahraba li siqayat el hadeeqa kanat 'aaliya li'anno istakhdam beero el khaas.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: فقرروا بالمستقبل، رح يعدّلوا جدول السقاية ليوفروا مصاري البلدية ويضمنوا استدامة المشروع.
english: So they decided that in the future, they will adjust the watering schedule to save the municipality's money and ensure the project's sustainability.
transliteration: Faqarraru bil mustaqbal, rah yi'addilu jadwal es siqayah liyuwaffiru masari el baladiyyah wa yadmanu istidamat el mashru'.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: وكمان رح يركّبوا عدّاد مي خاص بالحديقة عشان ما تتخربط الفواتير بين أملاكنا ومشاريعنا العامة.
english: And they will also install a separate water meter for the garden so that the bills don't get mixed up between our private properties and our public projects.
transliteration: Wa kamaan rah yrakkibu 'addad may khaas bil hadeeqa 'ashaan ma titkharbat el fawateer bayn amlakna wa mashari'ina el 'amma.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: هلق كل يوم بيجوا أهل الضيعة يضحكوا ويتذكروا قصة الفاتورة مع بعضهم، وصارت نكتة القرية المفضلة.
english: Now every day the villagers come to laugh and remember the story of the bill together, and it has become the village's favorite joke.
transliteration: Halak kull yoom beejoo ahl ed day'a yidhaku w yitdhakkaru qissat el fatoura ma'a ba'dhom, w sarat nuktat el qarya el mufaddala.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: عم بقولوا إنه حديقتهم الجديدة رح تخلص هاي السنة، ورح تكون بلا شك أحلى حديقة بالمحافظة كلها.
english: They are saying that their new garden will be finished this year, and it will undoubtedly be the most beautiful garden in the entire governorate.
transliteration: 'Am yiqoolu inno hadeeqathom el jadeeda rah tkhlas hay es sana, w rah takoon bila shakk ahla hadeeqa bil muhafaza kullaha.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: أنا أمين، بشكركم على متابعتكم لهذه القصة الحلوة والمليئة بالضحكات من قلب الشام.
english: I am Amin, I thank you for following this lovely story full of laughs from the heart of the Levant.
transliteration: Ana Ameen, bashkurkum 'ala mutaba'atkum li hadhihi el qissa el hilwa wal mali'a bid dahkaat min qalb es Sham.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: شكراً لأمين من كرم الزيتون، وهيك بنكون خلصنا فقرتنا الإخبارية لليوم عن المشاريع المجتمعية.
english: Thank you to Amin from Karm El Zeitoun, and with that, we have finished our news segment for today about community projects.
transliteration: Shukran li Ameen min Karm ez Zeitoun, w hayk binkoon khallasna faqratna el ikhbariyya lil yoom 'an el mashari' el mujtama'iyya.
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: نتمنى لكم ليلة سعيدة ونلقاكم في نشرتنا الإخبارية القادمة، مع السلامة!
english: We wish you a pleasant evening and we will meet you in our next news broadcast, goodbye!
transliteration: Natamanna lakum layla sa'eeda wa nalqaakum fi nashratna el ikhbariyya el qadima, ma'a es salama!
storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

arabic: كان أبو كرم وعائلته عم يتناولوا العشا سوا، والعين على التلفزيون يلي عم يبث أخبار اليوم الحصرية.
english: Abu Karam and his family were having dinner together, with their eyes on the television broadcasting today's exclusive news.
transliteration: Kaan Abu Karam w 3a'ilto 3am yetnawalu el 3asha sawa, wel 3ayn 3ala el talafizyon illi 3am yebeth akhbar el yom el 7usriyyeh.

arabic: المذيعة، بصوتها الهادئ، أعلنت عن قرار سياسي جديد سيؤثر على معيشة كل مواطن في بلادنا.
english: The announcer, with her calm voice, declared a new political decision that would affect the livelihood of every citizen in our country.
transliteration: El muzii3a, be sawtaha el haadi', a3lanat 3an qaraar siyasi jdid sayu'aththir 3ala ma3iishat kil muwaatin fi biladna.

arabic: أم كرم، اللي دايماً بتفكر بالتدبير، سألت أبو كرم: "يا أبو كرم، برايك هالقرار رح يزيد أسعار المنتجات كلها؟"
english: Um Karam, who always thinks about managing expenses, asked Abu Karam: "Abu Karam, do you think this decision will increase the prices of all products?"
transliteration: Um Karam, illi dayman btefakker bel tadbiir, sa'alat Abu Karam: "Ya Abu Karam, bra'yak hal qaraar ra7 yziid as3ar el muntajaat kullaha?"

arabic: أبو كرم، وهو عم يتنهد، جاوبها: "للأسف، أغلب الظن إنه رح يأثر علينا كلنا، خاصةً التجار الصغار اللي بيعانوا من الأساس."
english: Abu Karam, sighing, answered her: "Unfortunately, it's highly likely that it will affect all of us, especially the small merchants who are already suffering."
transliteration: Abu Karam, w huwwe 3am yetnahhad, jawabha: "Lil'asaf, aghlab el dhann inno ra7 ya'athther 3aleina kullna, khassatan el tujjaar el zghaar illi bya3anu min el asas."

arabic: لين، بنتهن الكبيرة، كانت عم تستمع بانتباه، وفكرت: "شو لازم نعمل لنحمي مصيرنا ومستقبل إخوتنا الصغار؟"
english: Leen, their eldest daughter, was listening attentively, and thought: "What must we do to protect our destiny and the future of our younger siblings?"
transliteration: Leen, bentohom el kbiireh, kaanat 3am testami3 b'intebaah, w fakkarat: "Shu laazem na3mel la na7mi masiirna w mustaqbal ikhwatna el zghaar?"

arabic: تذكرت كيف قبل سنتين، الحكومة أعلنت عن مشروع مماثل، وكيف تدهورت الأوضاع الاقتصادية وقتها.
english: She remembered how two years ago, the government announced a similar project, and how the economic situation deteriorated at that time.
transliteration: Tazakkarat kiif qabl santayn, el 7ukoumeh a3lanat 3an mashrou3 mumathil, w kiif tadahwarat el awda3 el iqtisadiyyeh waqtaha.

arabic: كرم، أخوها الأصغر، كان عم بيلعب بتلفونو بس فجأة رفع راسو وقال: "يا جماعة، هدول السياسيين دايماً بيوعدونا وعود كاذبة بس ما بيطبقوا شي!"
english: Karam, her younger brother, was playing on his phone but suddenly raised his head and said: "Guys, these politicians always promise us false promises but never implement anything!"
transliteration: Karam, akhuha el asghar, kaan 3am bil3ab be talafono bas faj'atan rafa3 raso w qaala: "Ya jami3a, hadool el siyasiyyin dayman byaw3douna wu3oud kazbeh bas ma byatabqu shi!"

arabic: أم كرم حاولت تهديهم: "يا ولاد، ما بيصير نفقد أملنا، لازم نتكاتف كعائلة وندبر حالنا بأي طريقة."
english: Um Karam tried to calm them down: "Children, we mustn't lose our hope, we must unite as a family and manage ourselves in any way."
transliteration: Um Karam 7aawalat tahaddiihom: "Ya wlaad, ma biyişir nifqod amalna, laazem netkatif k3a'ileh w ndabber 7alna b'ay tarii'a."

arabic: أبو كرم أكد كلامها: "صحيح، ما في قدامنا غير نتعاون ونكون إيجابيين حتى لو الوضع صعب جداً."
english: Abu Karam confirmed her words: "That's right, we have no choice but to cooperate and be positive, even if the situation is very difficult."
transliteration: Abu Karam akkad kalamha: "Sa7iḥ, ma fi qiddamna ghair neta3aawan w nkuun iijabiyyiin 7atta law el wada3 sa3eb jiddan."

arabic: لين قررت إنها رح تبحث عن مبادرات مجتمعية جديدة بتساعد الأهالي على التكيف مع التغييرات القادمة.
english: Leen decided that she would search for new community initiatives that help families adapt to the upcoming changes.
transliteration: Leen qararat innaha ra7 tab7ath 3an mubadarat mujtama3iyyeh jdiideh betsaa3ed el ahaali 3ala el takayof ma3 el taghyiiraat el qaademeh.

arabic: أم كرم ابتسمت وقالت: "فكرة ممتازة يا بنتي، رح نساعدك فيها ونشوف شو فينا نعمل كلنا سوا."
english: Um Karam smiled and said: "Excellent idea, my daughter, we will help you with it and see what we can all do together."
transliteration: Um Karam ibtasamat w qaalat: "Fikra mumtaazeh ya binti, ra7 nsaa3dik fiha w nshoof shu fiina na3mel kullna sawa."

arabic: كرم اللي كان عم بيفكر بعمق، اقترح: "يمكن فينا نوفر شوي من مصروفنا اليومي ونبلش مشروع صغير للمستقبل."
english: Karam, who was thinking deeply, suggested: "Maybe we can save a little from our daily expenses and start a small project for the future."
transliteration: Karam illi kaan 3am bifakker bi 3omq, iqtarah: "Yemkin fiina nwaffer shway min masroufna el yawmi w nballish mashrou3 zghir lil mustaqbal."

arabic: أبو كرم حس بفخر بأولاده وقال: "أنا متأكد إنكم رح تتجاوزوا أي تحديات بتواجهنا بذكائكم وتصميمكم."
english: Abu Karam felt proud of his children and said: "I am sure that you will overcome any challenges that face us with your intelligence and determination."
transliteration: Abu Karam 7ass be fakhr b'awlaado w qaala: "Ana mta'akked innkom ra7 tetaajawazu ayi ta7addiyat betwaajihna be zaka'kom w tasmimkom."

arabic: بهاللحظة، شعرت العائلة بروح التفاؤل والوحدة عم تملأ البيت، رغم قسوة الأخبار اللي سمعوها.
english: At that moment, the family felt a spirit of optimism and unity filling the house, despite the harsh news they had heard.
transliteration: Be hallahza, sha3arat el 3a'ileh be rou7 el tafa'ol wel we7deh 3am temla' el bayt, raghm qaswet el akhbar illi sami3ouha.

arabic: قرروا إنهم رح يبدؤوا من بكرا التخطيط لخطواتهم الجديدة، آملين بمستقبل أفضل لمدينتهم ولأجيالهم القادمة.
english: They decided that they would start planning their new steps tomorrow, hoping for a better future for their city and for their upcoming generations.
transliteration: Qarraru innahom ra7 yebda'u min bukra el takhtiit le khatwaatihom el jdiideh, aamiliin be mustaqbal afdal le madiinathom w le ajyalhom el qaademeh.

arabic: مساءً، تجتمع عائلة أبو أحمد في بيتهم الواسع بدمشق لمشاهدة نشرة الأخبار السياسية الرئيسية.
english: In the evening, Abu Ahmad's family gathers in their spacious house in Damascus to watch the main political news broadcast.
transliteration: Masa'an, tajtami' 'a'ilat Abu Ahmad fi baytihim al-wasi' bi-Dimashq li-mushahadat nashrat al-akhbar al-siyasiyya al-ra'isiyya.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: جدّي، رجلٌ حكيمٌ تجاوز السبعين عاماً، كان دائماً يقول: "يجب علينا أن نتبع كل خبر بعناية."
english: My grandfather, a wise man over seventy years old, always used to say: "We must follow every piece of news carefully."
transliteration: Jaddi, rajulun hakimun tajawaz al-sab'in 'aman, kana da'iman yaqul: "Yajib 'alayna an natba' kulla khabar bi-'inaya."
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: أمس، شاهدنا جميعاً تقريراً عن المفاوضات الإقليمية، وقد تحدّث المحلل السياسي طويلاً عن مستقبل بلادنا.
english: Yesterday, we all watched a report on regional negotiations, and the political analyst spoke at length about the future of our country.
transliteration: 'Ams, shahadna jami'an taqriran 'an al-mufawadat al-iqlimiyya, wa-qad tahaddath al-muhallil al-siyasi tawilan 'an mustaqbal biladina.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: جدتي، سيدةٌ قويةٌ، قالت بحكمة: "الأجيال القادمة تستحق أن ترى وطناً أفضل."
english: My grandmother, a strong lady, wisely said: "Future generations deserve to see a better homeland."
transliteration: Jaddati, sayyidatun qawiyyatun, qalat bi-hikma: "Al-ajyal al-qadima tastahiq an tara watanan afdal."
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: أمي وأبي، مهندسان عاملان، يتبادلان الرأي كثيراً حول الحلول الاقتصادية المطروحة.
english: My mother and father, working engineers, often exchange opinions about the proposed economic solutions.
transliteration: Ummi wa abi, muhandisan 'amilan, yatabadalan al-ra'y kathiran hawla al-hulul al-iqtisadiyya al-matruha.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: أبي يعتقد أن القرارات الصعبة ضرورية الآن لتحقيق الاستقرار المالي.
english: My father believes that difficult decisions are now necessary to achieve financial stability.
transliteration: Abi ya'taqid anna al-qararat al-sa'ba daruriyya al-'an li-tahqiq al-istiqrar al-mali.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: "ولكن هل هذه القرارات ستؤثر علينا كشعب؟" سأل أخي الأصغر بتوتر، وهو طالب جامعي.
english: "But will these decisions affect us as a people?" my younger brother nervously asked, a university student.
transliteration: "Wa-lakin hal hadhihi al-qararat sa-tu'aththir 'alayna ka-sha'b?" sa'ala akhi al-'asghar bi-tawatur, wa-huwa talib jami'i.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: أنا، كشابّة أعمل في مجال الإعلام، أرى أن صوت الشباب مهمٌ جداً في هذه النقاشات المعقدة.
english: I, as a young woman working in media, believe that the voice of youth is very important in these complex discussions.
transliteration: 'Ana, ka-shabba a'mal fi majal al-i'lam, ara anna sawt al-shabab muhimmun jiddan fi hadhihi al-niqashat al-mu'aqqada.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: سنناقش هذه القضايا بشكل أعمق في جلستنا الأسبوعية مع رفاقي في المركز الثقافي.
english: We will discuss these issues more deeply in our weekly session with my colleagues at the cultural center.
transliteration: Sa-nunaqish hadhihi al-qadaya bi-shakl a'maq fi jalsatina al-usbu'iyya ma'a rifaqi fi al-markaz al-thaqafi.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: جارتنا أم علي، وهي امرأة متفائلة، أرسلت لنا طبقاً من الكبة، قائلة: "التفاؤل هو سلاحنا الأقوى."
english: Our neighbor Umm Ali, an optimistic woman, sent us a plate of kibbeh, saying: "Optimism is our strongest weapon."
transliteration: Jaratuna Umm 'Ali, wa hiya imra'a mutafa'ila, arsalat lana tabaqan min al-kubba, qa'ila: "Al-tafa'ul huwa silahauna al-'aqwa."
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: في الأيام القادمة، ستُعقد ثلاثة اجتماعات مهمة لمناقشة التحديات الأمنية.
english: In the coming days, three important meetings will be held to discuss security challenges.
transliteration: Fi al-ayyam al-qadima, sa-tu'qad thalathat ijtima'at muhimma li-munaqashat al-tahaddiyat al-amniyya.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: كل واحد منا يملك آمالاً وطموحاتٍ خاصة ببلده وبمستقبله.
english: Each one of us has specific hopes and ambitions for his country and his future.
transliteration: Kull wahid minna yamlik amalan wa tumuhan khassa bi-baladih wa bi-mustaqbalih.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: آمل أن نرى قادةً جددًا يعملون بجدّ لتحسين الظروف المعيشية لجميع المواطنين.
english: I hope that we will see new leaders working diligently to improve the living conditions for all citizens.
transliteration: Amul an nara qadatan jududan ya'malun bi-jidd li-tahsin al-zuruuf al-ma'ishiyya li-jami' al-muwatiniin.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: لقد اتفقوا على أن الوحدة الوطنية هي المفتاح للوصول إلى مستقبل مزدهر، رغم اختلاف وجهات نظرهم.
english: They agreed that national unity is the key to achieving a prosperous future, despite their differing viewpoints.
transliteration: Laqad ittafaqu 'ala anna al-wahda al-wataniyya hiya al-miftah li-l-wusul ila mustaqbal muzdahir, raghma ikhtilaf wajhat nazarihim.
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: وربما بعد عشر سنوات، سننظر إلى الوراء ونقول: "لقد صنعنا فارقاً كبيراً في بلادنا."
english: And perhaps after ten years, we will look back and say: "We have made a big difference in our country."
transliteration: Wa rubbama ba'da 'ashar sanawat, sa-nanzur ila al-wara' wa-naqul: "Laqad sana'na fariqan kabiran fi biladina."
storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

arabic: ديمة وعلي، طالبان جامعيان، عم يشاهدوا نشرة الأخبار السياسية بلهفة على شاشة الكلية الكبيرة.
english: Dima and Ali, two university students, were eagerly watching the political news broadcast on the large college screen.
transliteration: Dima w Ali, taliban jami'iyyan, 'am yshaahdu nashret el-akhbar el-siyasiya bi-lehfeh 'ala shashet el-kulliyeh el-kbireh.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: كانت الأخبار عم تحكي عن نقاشات الحكومة الأخيرة بخصوص إصلاحات اقتصادية جديدة.
english: The news was talking about the government's recent discussions regarding new economic reforms.
transliteration: Kanat el-akhbar 'am teḥki 'an naqashat el-ḥukuma el-akheera bi-khusus islahat iqtisadiya jdeedeh.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: يا ديمة، أنا كتير متضايق من هالمشاكل اللي عم تتراكم ببلدنا!
english: Oh Dima, I'm very upset about these problems that are accumulating in our country!
