transliteration: Ya Dima, ana kteer mtadhayeq min hal-mashakel elli 'am tetrakam bi-bladna!
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: ديمة، اللي كانت دايماً أكثر هدوءاً، جاوبته: "صحيح، بس شفت كيف المسؤولين عم يحاولوا يحلوا بعض القضايا القديمة؟"
english: Dima, who was always calmer, answered him: "True, but did you see how the officials are trying to solve some of the old issues?"
transliteration: Dima, elli kanat dayman aktar hudu'an, jaawabetu: "Saḥeeḥ, bas shu'fet keef el-mas'oolin 'am yiḥawlu yiḥallu ba'dh el-qadaya el-qadeemeh?"
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: عرض المذيع أرقاماً بتشير إلى ارتفاع نسبة البطالة بين الشباب خلال الخمس سنوات الماضية.
english: The announcer presented numbers indicating a rise in youth unemployment over the past five years.
transliteration: 'Aradh el-mudhee' arqaman bit-sheer ila irtifa' nisbet el-baṭala bayn el-shabab khilal el-khams sanawat el-madhiyah.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: بتتوقع هاي الإصلاحات رح تفيدنا إحنا كجيل جديد ولا بس رح تكون وعود فارغة؟
english: "Do you expect these reforms to benefit us as a new generation, or will they just be empty promises?" Dima asked hesitantly.
transliteration: Btetwaqa'a hay el-islahat raḥ tfeedna iḥna ka-jeel jdeed wala bas raḥ tkoon wu'ood fargheh? Sa'alat Dima bi-ḥayra.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: علي جاوبها بجدية: "بتمنى إنهم يركزوا على فرص العمل للمواطنين ويفتحوا أبواب جديدة للمستقبل."
english: Ali answered her seriously: "I hope they focus on job opportunities for citizens and open new doors for the future."
transliteration: Ali jaawabha bi-jidiyyeh: "Batmanna innhom yarkezu 'ala furs el-'amal lil-mowaṭenin w yiftaḥu abwab jdeedeh lil-mustaqbal."
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: خلال نقاشهم، انضمت إليهم صديقتهم ليلى، وقالت: "أهلي بيحكوا إنه من عشر سنين كانت الأوضاع أصعب بكثير، بس كمان ما شفنا تغيير حقيقي."
english: During their discussion, their friend Layla joined them and said: "My parents say that ten years ago, conditions were much harder, but we also haven't seen real change."
transliteration: Khilal naqashihim, indhammat ilayhim sadeeqatihim Layla, w qaalt: "Ahli biyḥku inno min 'ashar sneen kanat el-awdha'a as'ab bi-kteer, bas kaman ma shufna taghyeer ḥaqeeqi."
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: هاد هو سؤالي الدائم: ليش القرارات المهمة ما بتشمل كل فئات المجتمع؟
english: "This is my constant question: Why don't important decisions include all segments of society?" Ali added thoughtfully.
transliteration: Haad hu su'ali el-daa'im: Leish el-qararat el-muhimmeh ma bitishmel kull fa'at el-mujtama'? Adaf Ali bi-tafkeer.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: ديمة ردت عليه: "يمكن عم يحاولوا، بس إحنا كمواطنين لازم نعبر عن آراءنا بصراحة أكبر."
english: Dima replied to him: "Maybe they are trying, but we, as citizens, must express our opinions more frankly."
transliteration: Dima raddet 'alayh: "Yemkin 'am yiḥawlu, bas iḥna ka-mowatenin lazem na'abber 'an araa'na bi-ṣaraḥa akbar."
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: ليلى اقترحت: "لازم ننظم جلسات حوار بالجامعة لنسمع وجهات نظر طلاب كثر."
english: Layla suggested: "We should organize dialogue sessions at the university to hear the viewpoints of many students."
transliteration: Layla iqtaraḥat: "Lazem n'anẓem jalasat ḥiwar bil-jami'a l-nisma' wujhat naẓar ṭullab kuthur."
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: فكرتك ممتازة يا ليلى! لو قدرنا نجمع أفكارنا ممكن نقدم مقترحات للحكومة.
english: "Your idea is excellent, Layla! If we can gather our thoughts, we might present proposals to the government." Ali said enthusiastically.
transliteration: Fikratik mumtazah ya Layla! Law qdarna n'ajma' afkar-na mumkin nqaddem muqtarahat lil-ḥukuma. Qaal Ali bi-ḥamas.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: ديمة أضافت: "وإذا كل واحد منا شارك برأيه، رح نشوف تغيير حقيقي وملموس بمجتمعنا."
english: Dima added: "And if each one of us shares their opinion, we will see real and tangible change in our society."
transliteration: Dima adafat: "W iza kull waḥad minna sharrak bi-ra'yoh, raḥ nshouf taghyeer ḥaqeeqi w malmoos bi-mujtama'na."
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: هم يعتقدون أن مشاركة الشباب ضرورية جداً لبناء مستقبل أفضل للجميع.
english: They believe that youth participation is very necessary to build a better future for everyone.
transliteration: Humme ya'taqidoon anna musharakat el-shabab daruriya jiddan li-bina' mustaqbal afḍal lil-jamee'.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: بالتالي، قرروا يتواصلوا مع زملائهم الطلاب لترتيب أول اجتماع لهم الأسبوع القادم.
english: Therefore, they decided to contact their fellow students to arrange their first meeting next week.
transliteration: Bil-tali, qarraroo yitwasaloo ma' zumalai'ihim el-ṭullab li-tartib awwal ijtima' lahom el-usbū' el-qadem.
storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

arabic: مساء الخير مشاهدينا الكرام، نبدأ نشرتنا الإخبارية اليوم بآخر التطورات السياسية الهامة.
english: Good evening, dear viewers, we begin our news broadcast today with the latest important political developments.
transliteration: Masaa al-khair mashaahidina al-kiraam, nabdaa nashratina al-ikhbaareeya al-youm bi-aakhir at-tatawuraat as-siyaaseeya al-haamma.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: قبل ثلاث ساعات، اتفق رؤساء الوفود السياسية الخمسة على الجلوس إلى طاولة الحوار في عمان.
english: Three hours ago, the heads of the five political delegations agreed to sit at the dialogue table in Amman.
transliteration: Qabl thalaath saa'aat, ittafaq ru'asaa' al-wufood as-siyaaseeya al-khamsa ala al-julooz ila tawilat al-hiwaar fi Amman.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: هذه اللحظة التاريخية ننتظرها منذ سنوات طويلة، ومواطنو المنطقة يتطلعون إليها بأمل كبير.
english: We have been waiting for this historic moment for many long years, and the citizens of the region look forward to it with great hope.
transliteration: Haathihi al-lahdha at-taareekheeya nantaaziruha munthoo sanawaat taweela, wa muwaatinu al-mintaqa yatalawwn ilayha bi-amal kabeer.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: كانوا يعتقدون أن الخلافات بينهم لن تنتهي أبداً، لكن يبدو أن الأوضاع تغيرت.
english: They used to believe that the disagreements between them would never end, but it seems the situation has changed.
transliteration: Kaanu ya'taqidoon anna al-khilaafaat baynahum lan tantahi abadan, lakin yabdoo anna al-awdhaa' taghayyarat.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: الآن ينضم إلينا الدكتور رامي، محللنا السياسي، ليشاركنا رؤيته حول هذه القمة.
english: Now Dr. Rami, our political analyst, joins us to share his vision on this summit.
transliteration: Al-aan yandhum ilayna ad-doktor Raami, muhalliluna as-siyaasi, li-yushaarikuna ru'yatahu hawla haathihi al-qimma.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: دكتور رامي، كيف ترى هذه الخطوة بعد كل التوترات التي شهدتها بلادنا؟ تسأل ليلى.
english: Dr. Rami, how do you see this step after all the tensions our country has witnessed? Layla asks.
transliteration: Doktor Raami, kayf tara haathihi al-khatwa ba'd kull at-tawaturaat allati shahidat'ha bilaadina? Tasa'al Layla.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: يا ليلى، شعوبنا تستحق السلام والاستقرار؛ نحن نرى بصيص أمل بعد مفاوضاتهم المكثفة. يجيب د. رامي.
english: Layla, our peoples deserve peace and stability; we see a glimmer of hope after their intensive negotiations. Dr. Rami replies.
transliteration: Ya Layla, shu'oobuna tastaheqq as-salaam wal-istiqraar; nahnu nara basees amal ba'd mufaawadatehum al-mukathafa. Yujeeb Dr. Raami.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: خلال الشهرين الماضيين، عقدوا جلسات سرية عديدة بهدف تقريب وجهات نظرهم المتباعدة.
english: During the past two months, they held numerous secret sessions with the aim of bringing their diverging viewpoints closer.
transliteration: Khilaal ash-shahrayn al-maadhiyayn, aqadu jalasaat sirreya adeeda bi-hadaf taqreeb wujahaat nadharihim al-mutabaa'ida.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: الناس في الشوارع، من دمشق إلى بيروت ومن رام الله إلى عمان، يتحدثون عن مستقبل أطفالهم.
english: People in the streets, from Damascus to Beirut and from Ramallah to Amman, are talking about the future of their children.
transliteration: An-naas fi ash-shawari', min Dimashq ila Beirut wa min Ramallah ila Amman, yatahaddathoon an mustaqbal atfaalihim.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: هل تعتقد أنهم سيصلون إلى قرارات حاسمة ستفيد جميع الأطراف؟ تستفسر ليلى.
english: Do you think they will reach decisive decisions that will benefit all parties? Layla inquires.
transliteration: Hal ta'taqid annahum sayasiloona ila qararaat haasima satufeed jamee' al-atraaf? Tastafsir Layla.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: كل الأطراف، بما فيهم نحن، يجب أن نعمل معاً لبناء جسور الثقة المفقودة بينهم، ولن نتركهم وحدهم. يوضح د. رامي.
english: All parties, including us, must work together to build the lost bridges of trust between them, and we will not leave them alone. Dr. Rami clarifies.
transliteration: Kull al-atraaf, bima feehim nahnu, yajib an na'mal ma'an li-binaa jusoor ath-thiqa al-mafquda baynahum, wa lan natrukuhum wahdahum. Yuwaddih Dr. Raami.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: سيجتمعون غداً مرة أخرى لمناقشة التفاصيل الاقتصادية وخطط إعادة الإعمار لمناطقهم المتضررة.
english: They will meet again tomorrow to discuss economic details and reconstruction plans for their damaged regions.
transliteration: Sayajtemi'oon ghadan marra ukhra li-munaaqashat at-tafaaseel al-iqtisaadeeya wa khutat i'aadat al-i'maar li-manatiqihim al-mutadharrira.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: آلاف النازحين في المخيمات يأملون أن يعودوا إلى بيوتهم وقراهم قريباً جداً.
english: Thousands of displaced people in the camps hope to return to their homes and villages very soon.
transliteration: Aalaaf an-naaziheen fi al-mukhaiyamaat ya'muloona an ya'oodoo ila buyootihim wa quraahum qareeban jiddan.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: قراراتهم ستؤثر على حيات الملايين، لذا مسؤوليتهم كبيرة جداً.
english: Their decisions will affect the lives of millions, so their responsibility is very great.
transliteration: Qararaatuhum satu'aththir ala hayaat al-malaayeen, litha mas'ooliyatuhum kabeera jiddan.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: نأمل أن تحمل الأيام القادمة أخباراً أفضل لنا ولأجيالنا القادمة، وشكراً لكم مشاهدينا.
english: We hope that the coming days will bring better news for us and for our future generations, and thank you, dear viewers.
transliteration: Na'mal an tahmil al-ayyaam al-qaadima akhbaaran afdhal lana wa li-ajyaalina al-qaadima, wa shukran lakum mashaahidina.
storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

arabic: صباح الخير مستمعينا الكرام من إذاعة 'صوت الشام'، معكم المذيع أحمد نعرض لكم آخر مستجدات الوضع الإقليمي.
english: Good morning, dear listeners, from 'Voice of the Levant' radio; with you, announcer Ahmed, presenting the latest regional developments.
transliteration: Sabah al-kheir mustami'ina al-kiram min idhaa'at 'Sawt ash-Sham', ma'akum al-mudhee' Ahmad na'red lakum akher mustajaddat al-wadha' al-iqlimi.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: فقد شهدت بلادنا الأسبوع الماضي أزمة مياه حادة طالت قرى عديدة ومدناً رئيسية، مما أثر سلباً على حياة الملايين.
english: Our countries last week witnessed a severe water crisis that affected numerous villages and major cities, negatively impacting the lives of millions.
transliteration: Faqad shahadat biladna al-usbu' al-madi azmat miyah haddah talat qura adidah wa mudunan ra'isiyyah, mimma aththar salban ala hayat al-malayin.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: الآن، يجتمع قادتنا في قمة طارئة في بيروت لبحث حلول مستدامة لهذه المشكلة الملحة التي تؤرق شعوبنا.
english: Now, our leaders are meeting in an emergency summit in Beirut to discuss sustainable solutions for this pressing problem that troubles our peoples.
transliteration: Al-aan, yajtame' qadatna fi qimmat tari'ah fi Beirut libahth hulul mustadamah li-hadhihi al-mushkilah al-mulihhah allati tu'arriq shu'oobana.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: صرح المسؤولون بأنهم قد عقدوا ثلاث جلسات مكثفة خلال اليومين الماضيين لتقييم الوضع وتحديد الأولويات.
english: Officials stated that they had held three intensive sessions over the past two days to assess the situation and identify priorities.
transliteration: Sarrah al-mas'uuloon bi'annahum qad 'aqadoo thalath jalasat mukaththafah khilal al-yawmain al-madhiyain li-taqyeem al-wadha' wa tahdeed al-awlawiyyat.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: ومن المتوقع أن يصدروا بياناً مشتركاً غداً، يتضمن خططاً عملية لإدارة مواردنا المائية بشكل أفضل.
english: It is expected that they will issue a joint statement tomorrow, including practical plans for better managing our water resources.
transliteration: Wa min al-mutawaqqa' an yusdiru biyanan mushtarakkan ghadan, yutadamman khutatan amaliyyah li'idarat mawaridna al-ma'iyyah bishakl afdhal.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: ويؤكد وزير الموارد المائية اللبناني أن وزارته تعمل بجد على مشاريع ري جديدة لتوفير الماء للمناطق الأكثر تضرراً.
english: The Lebanese Minister of Water Resources affirms that his ministry is working hard on new irrigation projects to provide water to the most affected areas.
transliteration: Wa yu'akkid wazir al-mawarid al-ma'iyyah al-Lubnani anna wizaratahu ta'mal bijidd ala mashari' riyy jadidah li-tawfir al-ma' lil-manatiq al-akthar tadarruran.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: في مقابلة حصرية، قال لنا أحد المشاركين في القمة: 'لقد تعلمنا من أخطائنا السابقة وسنتخذ قرارات جريئة الآن'.
english: In an exclusive interview, one of the summit participants told us: 'We have learned from our past mistakes, and we will make bold decisions now'.
transliteration: Fi muqabalat hasriyyah, qala lana ahad al-musharakin fi al-qimmah: 'Laqad ta'allamna min akhta'ina al-sabihah wa sanattakhith qararat jari'ah al-aan'.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: وأضاف: 'نأمل أن تستوعبوا أهمية التعاون الإقليمي لتحقيق أمننا المائي جميعاً'.
english: He added: 'We hope that you all understand the importance of regional cooperation to achieve our water security'.
transliteration: Wa adaf: 'Na'mal an tastaw'iboo ahammiyyat at-ta'awun al-iqlimi li-tahqiq amninan al-ma'i jami'an'.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: من المخطط أن تبدأ ورش عمل تقنية خلال خمسة أسابيع لدراسة أفضل الممارسات الدولية في حصاد الأمطار.
english: Technical workshops are planned to begin within five weeks to study the best international practices in rainwater harvesting.
transliteration: Min al-mukhattat an tabda' warash amal taqaniyyah khilal khamsat asabi' lidirasat afdhal al-mumarsat ad-duwaliyyah fi hasad al-amtar.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: ويطالب العديد من المنظمات الشبابية حكومتهم بالتحرك السريع نحو تبني حلول مستدامة لتأمين مستقبل أطفالنا.
english: Many youth organizations demand that their government move quickly towards adopting sustainable solutions to secure the future of our children.
transliteration: Wa yutaaib al-adīd min al-munadhamat ash-shababiyyah hukumatahum bil-taharruk as-saree' nahwa tabanni hulul mustadamah li-ta'min mustaqbal atfalina.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: وفي حديثي مع مواطنين أمس، شعرت بقلقهم العميق ولكن أيضاً بأملهم في أن تتغير الأمور.
english: In my conversation with citizens yesterday, I felt their deep concern but also their hope that things will change.
transliteration: Wa fi hadithi ma' muwatinin ams, sha'artu biqalihim al-'amiq walakin ayduan bi'amalihim fi an tataghayyar al-umur.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: القادة يتعهدون اليوم بأنهم سيعملون معاً لتجاوز هذه المحنة وتطوير سياسات جديدة لخدمة شعوبهم.
english: The leaders pledge today that they will work together to overcome this ordeal and develop new policies to serve their peoples.
transliteration: Al-qadah yat'ahhadun al-yawm bi'annahum saya'maloon ma'an li-tajawoz hadhihi al-mihnah wa tatweer siyasat jadidah li-khidmat shu'oobihim.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: من المتوقع أن يزور وفدان من ثلاثة دول متأثرة المناطق الحدودية الأسبوع المقبل لتقييم الاحتياجات على الأرض.
english: Two delegations from three affected countries are expected to visit the border regions next week to assess on-the-ground needs.
transliteration: Min al-mutawaqqa' an yazoor wafdan min thalathat duwal muta'aththirah al-manatiq al-hududiyyah al-usbu' al-muqbil li-taqyeem al-ihtiyajat ala al-ardh.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: هذه الأزمة تظهر أن مستقبلنا المشترك يعتمد بشكل كبير على رؤيتنا وقدرتنا على اتخاذ قرارات صعبة.
english: This crisis shows that our common future largely depends on our vision and our ability to make difficult decisions.
transliteration: Hadhihi al-azmah tudh-hir anna mustaqbalna al-mushtarak ya'tamid bishakl kabir ala ru'yatina wa qudratina ala ittikhaz qararat sa'bah.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: سنواصل نحن في 'صوت الشام' متابعة هذه التطورات الهامة لحظة بلحظة، ونأمل أن نسمع قريباً أخباراً سارة لبلادنا العزيزة.
english: We at 'Voice of the Levant' will continue to follow these important developments moment by moment, and we hope to soon hear good news for our beloved countries.
transliteration: Sanawasil nahnu fi 'Sawt ash-Sham' mutaba'at hadhihi at-tatowwurat al-hammah lahzat bilahzah, wa na'mal an nasma' qareeban akhbaran sarratan li-biladina al-'azizah.
storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

arabic: أخبار المساء من إذاعة بلدنا، معكم محمد العمري. أُقدّمُ لكم آخر التطورات السياسية والاجتماعية في بلادنا العزيزة.
english: Evening news from our country's radio, with you Mohammad Al-Omari. I present to you the latest political and social developments in our dear country.
transliteration: Akhbar el-masa men idha'at baladna, ma'akon Mohammad el-Omari. Uqaddim l'kum akher et-tatowwurat es-siyasiyya wel-ijtima'iyya fi biladna el-'aziza.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: لقد استقبلت قرانا الثلاث، قرية الزيتون ومرج السوسن، هذا الأسبوع وفوداً شعبية عديدة من مختلف المدن والجبال.
english: Our three villages, Zaitoun Village and Marj al-Sawson, received numerous popular delegations this week from various cities and mountains.
transliteration: Laqad istaqbalat qurana eth-thalath, qaryat az-zaytoun wa Marj as-sawsan, hadha el-usbu' wufoodan sha'biyyan 'adeedah min mukhtalaf el-mudun wal-jibal.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: المواطنون والمواطنات في كل بيت يعتقدون أن هذا الحراك يعكس مدى اهتمامهم بمستقبل منطقتنا.
english: Male and female citizens in every house believe that this movement reflects the extent of their interest in our region's future.
transliteration: El-muwaatanoon wal-muwaatanat fi koll bayt ya'taqidoon anna hadha el-haraak ya'kes madah ihtimamihim bi-mustaqbal manatiqatna.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: في اجتماعاتهم العديدة، حاول القادة السياسيون إيجاد حلول للمشاكل التي واجهتها قراهم طويلاً.
english: In their many meetings, political leaders tried to find solutions to the problems their villages faced for a long time.
transliteration: Fi ijtima'atihim el-'adeedah, haawal el-qaada es-siyasiyoon eejad hulool lil-mashaakil allati waajahaatha quraahum taweelan.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: وتتوقع مصادرنا أن الحكومة ستبدأ قريباً بمشروعين تنمويين كبيرين سيوفران مئات فرص العمل لشبابنا.
english: And our sources expect that the government will soon begin two major development projects that will provide hundreds of job opportunities for our youth.
transliteration: Wa tatawaqqa' masaadirna anna el-hukoomah satabda' qareeban bi-mashroo'ayn tanmawiyayn kabeerayn sayuwaffiran mi'aat furas el-'amal li-shabaabna.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: يتذكر كبار السن كيف كانت الأسواق المحلية تعج بالناس وتبيع منتجاتهم اليدوية الشهية، وهم يأملون أن تعود هذه الأيام قريباً.
english: The elders remember how local markets used to bustle with people and sell their delicious handmade products, and they hope these days will return soon.
transliteration: Yatadhakkar kibaar es-sinn kayf kaanat el-aswaaq el-mahalliyya ta'ujj bin-naas wa tabee' muntajaatihim el-yadawiyya esh-shahiyyah, wa hum ya'maloona an ta'ood hadhihi el-ayyaam qareeban.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: ونحن كإعلاميين، ندعو جميع الأطراف إلى العمل يداً بيد لتطوير مجتمعنا وحماية تراثنا الغني.
english: And we, as media professionals, call upon all parties to work hand in hand to develop our society and protect our rich heritage.
transliteration: Wa nahnu ka-i'laamiyyeen, nad'oo jamee' el-atraf ila el-'amal yadan bi-yad li-tatweer mujtama'na wa himayat turaathna el-ghani.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: بالأمس، تحدثت مع عشرة من أصحاب المحال التجارية الذين أكدوا لي أنهم شاهدوا زيادة في إقبال الزبائن.
english: Yesterday, I spoke with ten shop owners who confirmed to me that they saw an increase in customer traffic.
transliteration: Bil-ams, tahaddathtu ma'a 'asharah min as-haab el-mahaall et-tijaariyyah alladheena akkadou li annahum shaahadoo ziyadah fi iqbaal ez-zabaa'in.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: أولادنا يستحقون مستقبلاً أفضل، ويجب علينا كلّنا أن نعمل معاً لكي نحقق لهم أحلامهم.
english: Our children deserve a better future, and all of us must work together to achieve their dreams for them.
transliteration: Awlaadna yastahiqqun mustaqbalan afdal, wa yajib 'alayna kullna an na'mal ma'an likay nuhaqqiq lahum ahlaamihim.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: هذه كانت آخر أخبارنا لهذا المساء، نلقاكم في نشرة قادمة مع كل جديد في منطقتنا.
english: This was our last news for this evening. We will meet you in an upcoming broadcast with all that is new in our region.
transliteration: Hadhihi kaanat akher akhbaarna li-hadha el-masa', nalqaakum fi nashrah qaadimah ma'a koll jadeed fi manatiqatna.
storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations

arabic: كان الجو بالخريف عم يتقلب كتير هالأيام بقرية جبيل، وهالأجواء كانت بتوحي بشتا قاسي.
english: The weather in Jbeil village was very changeable these days in autumn, and this atmosphere suggested a harsh winter.
transliteration: Kan el jaww bil khareef amm yetaqallab kteer hal-ayyem b-qaryet Jbeil, w hal-ajwa' kanat btohi b-sheta qase.

arabic: الكل لسا بتذكر العاصفة القوية اللي ضربت المنطقة السنة الماضية وتركت أضرار كبيرة.
english: Everyone still remembered the strong storm that hit the region last year and left significant damage.
transliteration: El koll lissa btetzakkar el aasifa el qawiyyeh illi darabit el mintaqa es-saneh el madyieh w tarakat adrar kbeereh.

arabic: مشان هيك، اجتمع قادةً البلد بجدّ ليدرسوا المستجدات ويحطوا خطة محكمة للمواجهة.
english: That's why the village leaders met seriously to study the latest developments and put a solid plan for confrontation.
transliteration: Mishan heik, ejtama'u qadatan el balad bagadd la-yedrusu el mustajaddat w ya7uttu khuTTeh mu7kameh lil-muwajaha.

arabic: عقدوا جلسات مكثفة استمرت لساعات متأخرة من الليل، وناقشوا فيها كل التحديات المعقدة.
english: They held intensive sessions that lasted until late hours of the night, discussing all the complex challenges.
transliteration: Aqadu galasat mokaththafa estamarrat la-sa'at muta'akhkhira min el leil, w naqashu fiha kell al-tahaddiyat el-mo'aqqadah.

arabic: الصبايا والشباب كمان شاركوا بطموحاتٍ كبيرة، وعرضوا أفكار خلاقة لدعم المجتمع.
english: Young men and women also participated with great aspirations, presenting creative ideas to support the community.
transliteration: Es-sabaya w esh-shabab kaman sharku b-watuumuuhat kbeereh, w aradu afkar khallaqe la-da'm el mujtama'.

arabic: كان التفاؤل سلاحهم الأول، عم يبنوا آمالاً كبيرة بصيف قادم مشمس ودافي.
english: Optimism was their primary weapon; they were building great hopes for a coming sunny and warm summer.
transliteration: Kan altafaul silaahhom el awwal, amm yebnu amalan kbeereh b-seif qadem mushmis w dafi.

arabic: جمعوا الحطب والمؤن، وتأكدوا إنو كل بيت جاهز للبرد القارس اللي ممكن يجي بأي لحظة.
english: They gathered firewood and supplies, and made sure every house was ready for the biting cold that could arrive at any moment.
transliteration: Jam'u el 7aTab w el mu'an, w ta'akkadu inno kell beit jahez lal barad el qares illi mumkin yeji b-ayyi la7za.

arabic: هالروح الجماعية عززت الاستقرار وخلقوا شعور بالوحدة ما بين الأهالي.
english: This collective spirit strengthened stability and created a sense of unity among the residents.
transliteration: Hal-ruh el jama'iyyeh azzazat al-istiqrar w khalaqu shu'oor bil we7deh ma bein el ahali.

arabic: تعلموا من الماضي إنو الصعاب بتقوي العزيمة، وهالشي خلاهن أقوى.
english: They learned from the past that difficulties strengthen resolve, and this made them stronger.
transliteration: Ta'allamu min el maDi inno es-sa'ab bteqawwi el azimeh, w hal-shee khallahom aqwa.

arabic: وهيك، استقبلت قرية جبيل شتاءها الجديد بقلوب متفائلة وعزيمة ما بتنكسر.
english: And so, Jbeil village welcomed its new winter with optimistic hearts and unbreakable determination.
transliteration: W heik, estaqbalet qaryet Jbeil shita'ha el jdeed b-quloob mutafaila w azimeh ma btenkaser.

arabic: اليوم، نتابع بتركيز كبير قمة "الأمل المشترك" التي تُعقد في عاصمتنا، حيث يجتمع مسؤولون من أربع دول في المنطقة.
english: Today, we follow with great focus the "Common Hope" summit being held in our capital, where officials from four countries in the region are meeting.
transliteration: El-yoom, nettabe' bi-tarkeez kabeer qimmat "Al-Amal Al-Mushtarak" illi tu'qad fi 'aasimatna, hayth yajtame' mas'ooloon min arba' duwal bil-mintaqa.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: قبل ثلاثة أشهر، شهدت بلادنا تحديات سياسية واقتصادية كثيرة، أثرت على حياة شعوبنا بشكل مباشر.
english: Three months ago, our countries witnessed many political and economic challenges, which directly affected the lives of our peoples.
transliteration: Qabl talata ash-hor, shahadat biladna tahaddiyat siyasiyya wa iqtisadiyya ktheera, aththarat 'ala hayat shu'oobna bi-shakl mubashar.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: الوفود المشاركة تحاول إيجاد حلول جذرية لقضايا المنطقة، ويتوقع أن يناقشوا خططاً لمستقبل أفضل.
english: The participating delegations are trying to find radical solutions to the region's issues, and they are expected to discuss plans for a better future.
transliteration: El-wufoood el-musharika it-hawaweel eejaad hulool jadriyyeh la-qadhaya el-mintaqa, w-yitwaqqa' en yinaqshoo khutat la-mustaqbal afdhal.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: وقال أحد القادة، وهو السيد أحمد، إنهم يسعون لتحقيق الأمن والاستقرار لجميع أبناء المنطقة.
english: One of the leaders, Mr. Ahmed, said that they are striving to achieve security and stability for all the people of the region.
transliteration: Wa qaal ahad el-qada, w-huwwa es-Sayyed Ahmad, innhom yas'awna li-tahqeeq el-amn wal-istiqrar li-jamee' abna' el-mintaqa.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: الناس في شوارعنا يعبرون عن آمالهم الكبيرة بأن تُثمر هذه الاجتماعات قرارات حاسمة تفيد حياتهم.
english: People in our streets are expressing their great hopes that these meetings will yield decisive decisions that benefit their lives.
transliteration: En-nas fi shawari'na yi'abbiroo 'an aamalhom el-kbeereh bi-ann tuthmir haadhi el-ijtima'aat qararat hasimeh tifeed hayat-hom.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: لكن المحللين السياسيين يرون أن طريق التوافق ليس سهلاً، وأن هناك تحديات عديدة قد تواجه جهودهم.
english: But political analysts see that the path to consensus is not easy, and that there are many challenges that might face their efforts.
transliteration: Lakin el-muhallileen es-siyasiyyeen yarawna inn tareeq el-tawafuq laysa sahlan, w-inn honak tahaddiyat 'adeedeh qad tuwajih juhoodhom.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: من المتوقع أن يوقع القادة على وثيقتين مهمتين في نهاية المؤتمر، إحداهما تتعلق بالأمن المشترك والأخرى بالتنمية الاقتصادية.
english: It is expected that the leaders will sign two important documents at the end of the conference, one of which concerns common security and the other economic development.
transliteration: Min el-mutawaqqa' ann yuwaqqi' el-qada 'ala watheeqatayn muhimmatayn fi nihayat el-mu'tamar, ihdahuma tata'allaq bil-amn el-mushtarak wal-ukra bit-tanmiya el-iqtisadiyya.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: علينا جميعاً أن نتعاون وندعم قراراتهم لضمان مستقبل مشرق لأطفالنا وأجيالنا القادمة.
english: We all must cooperate and support their decisions to ensure a bright future for our children and our coming generations.
transliteration: 'Alayna jamee'an ann nata'aawan w-nad'am qararat-hom li-dhamaan mustaqbal mushriq li-atfalna w-ajyalna el-qadimeh.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: آمالنا معلقة على هذه القمة، ونحن نأمل أن نرى نتائج إيجابية قريباً تساهم في بناء المنطقة من جديد.
english: Our hopes are tied to this summit, and we hope to see positive results soon that contribute to rebuilding the region anew.
transliteration: Aamalna mu'allaqa 'ala haadhi el-qimma, w-nahna na'mal ann nara nata'ej eejaabiyya qareeban tusahem fi bina' el-mintaqa min jadeed.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: سنوافيكم بآخر التطورات لحظة بلحظة على مدار الأيام القليلة القادمة من مركز المؤتمر.
english: We will update you with the latest developments moment by moment over the next few days from the conference center.
transliteration: Sanaweefeekom bi-aakhir et-tatawwuraat lahza bi-lahza 'ala madar el-ayyam el-qaleeleh el-qadimeh min markaz el-mu'tamar.
storyTitle: The Common Hope Summit: Regional Political Moves Towards a Better Future

arabic: أهلاً وسهلاً بكم مستمعينا الكرام في نشرتنا الإخبارية الخاصة، حيث نسلط الضوء اليوم على أبرز الأحداث الدولية.
english: Welcome, dear listeners, to our special news bulletin, where today we highlight the most prominent international events.
transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan bikum mustami'ina al-kiram fi nashratina al-ikhbariya al-khassa, hayth nusallit ad-daw' al-yawm 'ala abraz al-ahdath ad-dawliya.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: لقد استضافت ثلاث دول مجاورة هذا الشتاء قمة إقليمية مهمة، وناقشوا خلالها قضايا الأمن المشترك.
english: Three neighboring countries hosted an important regional summit this winter, and they discussed common security issues during it.
transliteration: Laqad istadafat thalath duwal mujawira hadha ash-shita' qimmat iqlimiya muhimma, wa naqashu khilalaha qadaya al-amn al-mushtarak.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: نحن الآن نشاهد نتائج هذا التعاون المثمر، الذي قد يؤثر على مستقبل منطقتنا وعلاقاتها الدولية.
english: We are now observing the results of this fruitful cooperation, which may influence our region's future and its international relations.
transliteration: Nahnu al-an nushahid nata'ij hadha at-ta'awun al-muthmir, alladhi qad yu'aththir 'ala mustaqbal mintaqatna wa 'alaqatiha ad-dawliya.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: وكان رئيس الوفد السوري قد أعلن عن نيته لتقديم مبادرات جديدة لتعزيز السلام بين شعوبنا.
english: The head of the Syrian delegation had announced his intention to present new initiatives to strengthen peace among our peoples.
transliteration: Wa kana ra'is al-wafd as-suri qad a'lana 'an niyyatihi li-taqdim mubadarat jadida li-ta'ziz as-salam bayna shu'ubina.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: ومن المتوقع أن يستضيفوا مؤتمراً آخر في الربيع المقبل لمناقشة التحديات الاقتصادية.
english: It is expected that they will host another conference next spring to discuss economic challenges.
transliteration: Wa min al-mutawaqqa' an yastaḍifu mu'tamaran akhar fi ar-rabi' al-muqbil li-munāqashat at-tahaddiyat al-iqtisadiya.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: يا مستمعنا الكريم، أنت ترى كيف تتشابك مصالح دولنا وتؤثر على حياتنا اليومية.
english: Dear listener, you see how the interests of our countries intertwine and affect our daily lives.
transliteration: Ya mustami'ana al-karim, anta tara kayfa tatashabak masaliḥ duwaluna wa tu'aththir 'ala hayatina al-yawmiya.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: قبل عامين، واجهت مناطقهم صعوبات جمة بسبب الأزمات المتتالية، لكن إرادتهم كانت أقوى.
english: Two years ago, their regions faced immense difficulties due to successive crises, but their will was stronger.
transliteration: Qabl 'amayni, wajahaṭ manatiquhum ṣu'ūbāt jamma bisabab al-azamāt al-mutataliya, lakin iradatuham kanat aqwa.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: كل قائد الآن يسعى جاهداً لكي يرسخ مبادئ التعاون ويضمن استقرار بلاده.
english: Every leader now strives diligently to solidify the principles of cooperation and ensure the stability of his country.
transliteration: Kull qa'id al-an yas'a jahidan li-kay yurasikh mabadi' at-ta'awun wa yadman istiqrar biladihi.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: ونتمنى أن نشهد في أعيادنا القادمة مزيداً من التفاهم بين شعوبنا الشقيقة.
english: And we hope that in our upcoming holidays, we will witness more understanding among our brotherly peoples.
transliteration: Wa natamanna an nashhad fi 'ayadina al-qadima mazidan min at-tafahum bayna shu'ubina ash-shaqiqa.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: إلى هنا نكون قد وصلنا إلى ختام نشرتنا لهذا المساء، وإلى لقاء قريب.
english: Here we conclude our bulletin for this evening, and until we meet again soon.
transliteration: Ila huna nakun qad waṣalna ila khitam nashratina li-hadha al-masa', wa ila liqa' qarib.
storyTitle: Winter News Bulletin: The Regional Peace Summit

arabic: وصلت ليلى وعائلتها إلى اليونان بعد رحلة طويلة ومتعبة، حاملين معهم أحلاماً بسيطة بحياة أفضل.
english: Layla and her family arrived in Greece after a long and tiring journey, carrying simple dreams of a better life.
transliteration: Wasalat Layla wa 'a'ilatuha ila al-Yunan ba'da rihla tawila wa mut'iba, hamilin ma'ahum ahlaman basita bi-hayah afdal.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: كانت المخيمات في الجزر اليونانية مكتظة بالناس، والظروف المعيشية هناك صعبة للغاية.
english: The camps on the Greek islands were overcrowded with people, and the living conditions there were extremely difficult.
transliteration: Kanat al-mukhayyamat fi al-juzur al-yunaniyya makhtazza bil-nas, wal-thuroof al-ma'eeshiya hunak sa'ba lil-ghaya.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: في البداية، شعرت ليلى باليأس والإحباط من نقص الطعام والماء النظيف.
english: At first, Layla felt despair and frustration due to the lack of food and clean water.
transliteration: Fi al-bidayah, sha'arat Layla bil-ya's wal-ihbat min naqs al-ta'am wal-ma' al-natheef.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: مرض أخوها الصغير حسام بسبب البرد وسوء التغذية، ولم يكن هناك طبيب متخصص متوفر بسهولة.
english: Her younger brother Hussam fell ill due to the cold and malnutrition, and there wasn't an easily available specialist doctor.
transliteration: Marid akhuha al-sagheer Hussam bisabab al-bard wa su' al-taghthiya, wa lam yakun hunak tabeeb mutakhassis mutawaffir bi-suhoola.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: قضت لياليَ طويلة وهي تسهر بجانبه، تدعو له بالشفاء وتتعلم كيفية الاعتناء به بأقل الإمكانيات.
english: She spent long nights staying up next to him, praying for his recovery and learning how to take care of him with minimal resources.
transliteration: Qadat layaliya tawila wa hiya tashar bi-janibihi, tad'u lahu bil-shifa' wa tata'allam kayfiyat al-i'tina' bihi bi-aqall al-imkaniyat.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: شاهدت أيضاً الكثير من العائلات تكافح يومياً لتوفير الدفء لأطفالها في الخيام الباردة.
english: She also watched many families struggle daily to provide warmth for their children in the cold tents.
transliteration: Shahadat aydaan al-katheer min al-'a'ilat tukafih yawmiyan li-tawfir al-dif' li-atfaliha fi al-khiyam al-barida.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: كانت المساعدات اللوجستية تصل بشكل متقطع وغير كافٍ لتلبية احتياجات جميع اللاجئين.
english: Logistical aid arrived sporadically and was insufficient to meet the needs of all refugees.
transliteration: Kanat al-musa'adat al-lojistiya tasel bi-shakl mutaqatti' wa ghayr kafi li-talbiyat ihtiyajat jamee' al-laji'een.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: تعلمت ليلى كيف تتحدث مع المتطوعين ببعض الكلمات اليونانية والإنجليزية لتفهم الوضع أكثر.
english: Layla learned how to speak with volunteers using some Greek and English words to understand the situation better.
transliteration: Ta'allamat Layla kayfa tatahaddath ma' al-mutataw'een bi-ba'd al-kalimat al-yunaniyya wal-ingliziyya li-tafham al-wad' akthar.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: بدأت تساعد النساء الأخريات في المخيم بترجمة طلباتهن وشكواهن للمنظمات الإنسانية العاملة هناك.
english: She started helping other women in the camp by translating their requests and complaints to the humanitarian organizations working there.
transliteration: Bada'at tusa'id al-nisa' al-ukhrayat fi al-mukhayyam bi-tarjamat talabatihin wa shakwahen lil-munazzamat al-insaniyya al-'amila hunak.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: اكتشفت أن لديها قوة داخلية لم تكن تعرف بوجودها من قبل في قريتها الصغيرة.
english: She discovered that she had an inner strength she hadn't known existed before in her small village.
transliteration: Iktashafat ann ladayha quwwa dakhiliyya lam takun ta'raf bi-wujoodiha min qabl fi qaryatiha al-saghira.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: مع مرور الأيام، أصبحت ليلى مرجعاً للكثيرين، مقدمة الدعم والمشورة لمن حولها بصبر كبير.
english: As days passed, Layla became a reference for many, offering support and advice to those around her with great patience.
transliteration: Ma' murur al-ayyam, asbahat Layla marja'an lil-katheerin, muqaddimat al-da'm wal-mashwara li-man hawlaha bi-sabr kabeer.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: قررت أن تستغل وقتها في تعلم مهارات جديدة، مثل الخياطة والتطريز، لتصنع أشياء بسيطة ومفيدة.
english: She decided to use her time to learn new skills, such as sewing and embroidery, to make simple and useful things.
transliteration: Qarrarat an tastaghill waqtuha fi ta'allum maharat jadeeda, mithl al-khiyatta wal-tatreez, li-tasna' ashya' basita wa mufeeda.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: كانت هذه الأشياء الصغيرة تجلب بعض البهجة وتساعدها على الشعور بالإنجاز في ظل تلك الظروف.
english: These small things brought some joy and helped her feel a sense of accomplishment amidst those circumstances.
transliteration: Kanat hathihi al-ashya' al-saghira tajlib ba'd al-bahja wa tusa'iduha 'ala al-shu'oor bil-injaz fi thill tilk al-thuroof.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: بالرغم من كل الصعوبات، أدركت ليلى أن التجارب القاسية يمكن أن تبني شخصيات أقوى وأكثر حكمة.
english: Despite all the difficulties, Layla realized that harsh experiences can build stronger and wiser characters.
transliteration: Bil-raghm min kull al-su'ubat, adrakat Layla ann al-tajareb al-qasiya yumkin an tabni shakhsiyat aqwa wa akthar hikma.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: لم تعد تلك الفتاة اليائسة؛ بل صارت شابة ملهمة، تنظر إلى المستقبل بعين الأمل رغم كل التحديات.
english: She was no longer that desperate girl; rather, she became an inspiring young woman, looking to the future with hope despite all challenges.
transliteration: Lam ta'ud tilk al-fatat al-ya'isa; bal sarat shabba mulhima, tanzur ila al-mustaqbal bi-'ayn al-amal raghm kull al-tahaddiyat.
storyTitle: Layla in the Camps of Hope

arabic: صباح الخير مستمعينا الكرام، معكم مراسلكم رامي من وسط البلد، حيث نسمع شكاوى كثيرة حول ارتفاع أسعار السلع الأساسية.
english: Good morning our dear listeners, with you your reporter Rami from downtown, where we hear many complaints about the rise in prices of basic goods.
transliteration: Sabah al-kheir mustami'eena al-kiraam, ma'akum murasilukum Rami min wasat al-balad, haythu nasma' shakwa katheera hawla irtefa' as'aar as-sela' al-asasiyya.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: بالأمس، تحدثنا مع بائع خضار اسمه أبو أحمد، وقال: 'أسعار الخضار والفواكه ارتفعت بنسبة تتجاوز المئة بالمئة'.
english: Yesterday, we spoke with a vegetable seller named Abu Ahmad, and he said: 'The prices of vegetables and fruits have risen by over one hundred percent'.
transliteration: Bil-ams, tahaddathna ma' baae' khodaar ismuhu Abu Ahmad, wa qaal: 'As'aar al-khodaar wal-fawakeh irtafa'at bi-nisbeh tatajaawaz al-mi'ah bil-mi'ah'.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: أضاف: 'أنا أبيع بضاعتي بأقل هامش ربح ممكن، لكن التكلفة الأساسية من الموردين هي مشكلتي الكبيرة'.
english: He added: 'I sell my goods with the lowest possible profit margin, but the basic cost from suppliers is my big problem'.
transliteration: Adaf: 'Ana abee' boda'ati bi-aqall haamesh rebh mumkin, lakin at-taklifa al-asasiyya min al-muwarrideen hiya mushkilati al-kabeera'.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: السيدة أم محمد، زبونة دائمة، اشتكت وقالت: 'ابني الصغير كان يشتري خمسة أرغفة خبز يومياً بعشرة آلاف ليرة، أما اليوم فنشتري ثلاثة فقط'.
english: Mrs. Umm Mohammad, a regular customer, complained and said: 'My young son used to buy five loaves of bread daily for ten thousand liras, but today we only buy three'.
transliteration: As-sayyida Umm Mohammad, zabouneh daa'imeh, ishtakat wa qaalat: 'Ibni as-sagheer kaan yashtari khamsat arghifeh khobz yawmiyan bi-'asharat alaaf leera, amma al-yawm fa-nashtari thalathah faqat'.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: كثير من العائلات باتت تجد صعوبة في تأمين حاجاتها اليومية، وهم لا يعرفون كيف ستسير أمور بيتهم.
english: Many families now find it difficult to secure their daily needs, and they don't know how the affairs of their home will proceed.
transliteration: Katheer min al-'aa'ilaat baatat tajid su'oubah fi ta'meen haajaatiha al-yawmiyya, wa hum la ya'rifoon kayf sataseer umoor baytihim.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: الحكومة وعدتنا بتحسين الأوضاع، لكن نحن نتساءل: متى رح نلاقي حلول جذرية لهذه الأزمة؟
english: The government promised us to improve the situation, but we ask ourselves: when will we find fundamental solutions for this crisis?
transliteration: Al-hukoumeh wa'adatna bi-tahseen al-awda', lakin nahnu natasaa'al: mata rah nelaqi hulool jidhriyya li-hathihi al-azmeh?
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: أطفالنا باتوا يلاحظون هذه التغييرات في حياتهم ويشعرون بعبء الأوضاع الاقتصادية.
english: Our children have started noticing these changes in their lives and feel the burden of the economic situation.
transliteration: Atfaluna baatou yulahizoon hathihi at-taghyeeraat fi hayaatihim wa yash'uroon bi-'ib' al-awda' al-iqtisadiyya.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: ورغم كل شيء، شعبنا ببلاد الشام معروف بصبره وقدرته على تحمل الصعاب، ونحن نأمل أن مستقبلنا رح يكون أفضل.
english: And despite everything, our people in the Levant are known for their patience and ability to endure hardships, and we hope that our future will be better.
transliteration: Wa raghm kull shay', sha'buna bi-bilad ash-sham ma'roof bi-sabrihi wa qudratihi 'ala tahammul as-sa'aab, wa nahnu na'mal an mustaqbaluna rah yakoon afdal.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: سأبقى أتابع هذه التطورات الاقتصادية وأقدم لكم تقاريرنا المقبلة حول تأثيرها على طبقات المجتمع المختلفة.
english: I will continue to follow these economic developments and present to you our upcoming reports about their impact on different societal classes.
transliteration: Sa-abqa utaabi' hathihi at-tatawwuraat al-iqtisadiyya wa uqaddim lakum taqareeruna al-muqbila hawla ta'theeriha 'ala tabaqat al-mujtama' al-mukhtalifa.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: إلى اللقاء في نشراتنا القادمة، كان معكم مراسلكم رامي.
english: Until next time in our upcoming broadcasts, your reporter Rami was with you.
transliteration: Ila al-liqa' fi nashraatuna al-qadimeh, kaan ma'akum murasilukum Rami.
storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

arabic: اليوم قررت اروح السوق لاشتري ملابس جديدة
english: Today I decided to go to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: El yom qarart aruh es suq la ashtari malabes jdideh

arabic: دخلت محل كبير وشفت تيشرتات وبناطيل حلوة كتير
english: I entered a big shop and saw many nice t-shirts and trousers.
transliteration: Dakhalt mahall kbir w sheft tishertat w banateel helweh kteer

arabic: جربت كم قطعة بس ما عجبني السعر
english: I tried on a few items but I didn't like the price.
transliteration: Jarabt kam qit'ah bas ma ajabni es sa'er

arabic: سالت البائع اذا في خصم على هاي القطع
english: I asked the seller if there was a discount on these items.
transliteration: Sa'alt el ba'e' iza fi khasm 'ala hay el qita'

arabic: اخيرا لقيت بلوزة حلوة وسعرها مناسب واشتريتها
english: Finally, I found a nice blouse and its price was suitable, and I bought it.
transliteration: Akheeran laqeet bloozeh helweh w sa'erha monaseb w ashtaraytha

arabic: سامي راح عالسوق بكير بالصبح.
english: Sami went to the market early in the morning.
transliteration: Sami rah aal sooq bakkeer bil sobeh.

arabic: هو أخد أخته ليلى معه.
english: He took his sister Laila with him.
transliteration: Huwweh akhed ukhtu Laila ma-u.

arabic: بدهن يشتروا خضرة جديدة وفواكه حلوة.
english: They want to buy fresh vegetables and sweet fruits.
transliteration: Bidhon yishteru khudra jdeedeh w fawakeh helweh.

arabic: بالسوق في ناس كتير ومحلات كبيرة.
english: In the market there are many people and big shops.
transliteration: Bil sooq fee nas kteer w mahallat kbeereh.

arabic: سامي قال: يا ليلى، عنا خبز ببيتنا؟
english: Sami said: Laila, do we have bread at our house?
transliteration: Sami qal: Ya Laila, anna khobz bi baytna?

arabic: ليلى جاوبت: لا، بدنا خبز أبيض وحليب.
english: Laila answered: No, we need white bread and milk.
transliteration: Laila jawabet: La, bidna khobz abyad w haleeb.

arabic: هن اشتروا تلات أكياس تفاح أحمر.
english: They bought three bags of red apples.
transliteration: Hinneh ishtaru talat akyas tuffah ahmar.

arabic: البياع كان زلمة طيب من المدينة.
english: The seller was a nice man from the city.
transliteration: El bayaa kan zalameh tayyeb min el madineh.

arabic: هلأ، سامي وليلى كتير مبسوطين بالأكل.
english: Now, Sami and Laila are very happy with the food.
transliteration: Halla, Sami w Laila kteer mabsooteen bil akel.

arabic: هن رجعوا على بيتهن بعد الظهر.
english: They returned to their home in the afternoon.
transliteration: Hinneh rejou ala bayton baad el duher.

arabic: رامي شاب من مدينة عمان.
english: Rami is a young man from the city of Amman.
transliteration: Rami shab min madinat Amman.

arabic: هو بيحب رفقاته سارة وسامر كتير.
english: He loves his friends Sarah and Samer a lot.
transliteration: Huwe bihib rifqatu Sarah wa Samer kteer.

arabic: مبارح هن راحوا لـ مقهى صغير بالمدينة.
english: Yesterday, they went to a small cafe in the city.
transliteration: Mbareh hinne rahu la maqha sghir bil madineh.

arabic: سارة طالبة من بيروت وهي ساكنة جنب الحديقة.
english: Sarah is a student from Beirut and she lives next to the park.
transliteration: Sarah talibe min Beirut wa hiye sakne janb al hadiqa.

arabic: سامر طباخ وهو طبخ وجبة كبيرة لـ إلهن.
english: Samer is a cook and he cooked a big meal for them.
transliteration: Samer tabbakh wa huwe tabakh wajbe kbire la elon.

arabic: هن أكلوا خبز تازه وحمص طيب.
english: They ate fresh bread and delicious hummus.
transliteration: Hinne akalu khubz taza wa hummus tayyeb.

arabic: القهوة كانت سخنة والشاي كان حلو.
english: The coffee was hot and the tea was sweet.
transliteration: Al qahwa kanat sukhne wal shay kan hulu.

arabic: رامي قال أهلاً وسهلاً ب بيتي يا رفقاتي.
english: Rami said welcome to my house, my friends.
transliteration: Rami qal ahlan wa sahlan bi bayti ya rifqati.

arabic: سارة عندها كتب كتير ب شنطتها الكبيرة.
english: Sarah has many books in her big bag.
transliteration: Sarah indha kutub kteer bi shantatha al kbire.

arabic: نحنا شفنا غياب الشمس الحلو من الشباك.
english: We saw the beautiful sunset from the window.
transliteration: Nihna shufna ghiyab al shams al hulu min al shibbak.

arabic: هلأ الأولاد عم يلعبوا ب ألعابهن الجديدة.
english: Now the children are playing with their new toys.
transliteration: Halla al awlad am yilabu bi alabon al jadide.

arabic: سامر بيشتري خضرة وفواكة من السوق كل يوم.
english: Samer buys vegetables and fruits from the market every day.
transliteration: Samer biyshtari khudra wa fawake min al suq kull yom.

arabic: مدرستي جنب مكتبك يا رامي.
english: My school is next to your office, Rami.
transliteration: Madrasti janb maktabak ya Rami.

arabic: هن حكوا عن عيلهن وبيوتهن القديمة.
english: They talked about their families and their old houses.
transliteration: Hinne haku an aielon wa biyuton al qadime.

arabic: الكل كان مبسوط واليوم كان كتير حلو.
english: Everyone was happy and the day was very beautiful.
transliteration: Al kull kan mabsut wal yom kan kteer hulu.

arabic: يسعد صباحكم يا مستمعينا الكرام، وأهلاً فيكم بنشرتنا اليومية من قلب المدينة.
english: Good morning, our dear listeners, and welcome to our daily broadcast from the heart of the city.
transliteration: Yis-ed sabahkum ya mustami-eena el-kiraam, wa ahla fikom bi-nashretna el-yawmiyye min qalb el-madine.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: اليوم عم نحكي عن المدرسة الابتدائية ياللي تحولت لملجأ للعائلات النازحة.
english: Today we are talking about the primary school that turned into a shelter for displaced families.
transliteration: el-yawm am nihki an el-madrase el-ibtidaiyye yalli t-hawwalet la-malja la-l-aylat el-nazha.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: المعلمين قرروا يكملوا دروسهم بالممرات لأن التعليم هو سلاحنا الأقوى.
english: The teachers decided to continue their lessons in the corridors because education is our strongest weapon.
transliteration: el-mu-allimeen qarraru ykammilu droushum bel-mamarrat la-anno el-ta-leem huwa silahna el-aqwa.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: الأطفال كانوا قاعدين على الأرض مع دفاترهم الملونة وعم يرسموا أحلامهم الجميلة.
english: The children were sitting on the ground with their colorful notebooks and drawing their beautiful dreams.
transliteration: el-atfal kaanu qa-ideen ala el-ard ma-a dafatirhum el-mlawwane wa am yirsumu ahlamhum el-jamile.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: المعلمة ليلى قالت إنها بتشتاق لصفها القديم ومكتبها الخشبي المريح.
english: Teacher Laila said that she misses her old classroom and her comfortable wooden desk.
transliteration: el-mu-allime Laila qalet in-ha btishtaq la-saff-ha el-qadim wa maktab-ha el-khashabi el-muriih.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: أضافت إنو أسئلة الطلاب عن المستقبل صارت أصعب من منهج الرياضيات.
english: She added that the students' questions about the future have become more difficult than the mathematics curriculum.
transliteration: Adafet innu as-ilet el-tullab an el-mustaqbal saarat as-ab min manhaj el-riyadiyyat.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: رغماً عن أصوات الصفارات العالية برّة، صوت أغنية الأحرف عم يعبّي المكان.
english: Despite the loud sounds of the sirens outside, the sound of the alphabet song fills the place.
transliteration: Raghman an aswat el-safarat el-aliye barra, sawt aghniyet el-ahruf am yi-abbi el-makan.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: مكتب المدير صار مطبخ صغير لتحضير الوجبات السخنة لكل الناس كل بعد الظهر.
english: The principal's office has become a small kitchen to prepare hot meals for everyone every afternoon.
transliteration: Maktab el-mudiir saar matbakh sghir la-tahdiir el-wajabat el-sukhne la-kel el-naas kel baad el-duhur.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: الجيران بيجيبوا خبز وزيتون ليتشاركوا مع العائلات ياللي خسروا بيوتهم.
english: The neighbors bring bread and olives to share with the families who lost their homes.
transliteration: el-jiran bijeebu khubez wa zaytun la-yitsharaku ma-a el-aylat yalli khisru buyuthum.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: شفنا بنت صغيرة عم تقرأ قصة لأخوها الصغير لتلهيه عن صوت الطيارات.
english: We saw a young girl reading a story to her small brother to distract him from the noise of the airplanes.
transliteration: Shufna bint sghire am tiqra qissa la-akha-ha el-sghir la-til-hii an sawt el-tayyarat.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: هاي الإذاعة بتحيي كل عامل ومعلم ياللي باقيين صامدين بهالظروف الصعبة.
english: This radio station salutes every worker and teacher who remains steadfast in these difficult circumstances.
transliteration: Hay el-itha-a btihayyi kel amel wa mu-allim yalli baqiin samdiin bi-ha-l-zuruf el-sa-be.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: مراسلنا خبرنا إنو جنينة المدرسة هلا مليانة خيم صغيرة بدل الزهور.
english: Our correspondent reported that the school garden is now full of small tents instead of flowers.
transliteration: Murasilna khabbarna innu jneynet el-madrase halla malyane khiyam sghire badal el-zhur.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: الكل بيتمنوا إنو الحرب تخلص قريباً كرمال الأطفال يرجعوا لبيوتهم الحقيقية.
english: Everyone hopes that the war will end soon so the children can return to their real homes.
transliteration: el-kel byitmannu innu el-harb tikhlas qariban kirmal el-atfal yirja-u la-buyuthum el-haqiqiyye.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: لحد ما يصير هاد، الناس هون عم يثبتوا إنو الحياة بتكمل بالحب والتعاون.
english: Until that happens, the people here are proving that life continues with love and cooperation.
transliteration: La-hadd ma ysir hada, el-naas haun am yit-hbitu innu el-hayat btikammel bel-hubb wal-ta-awun.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: شكراً لاستماعكم، ورح نلتقي مرة تانية بنشرة الأخبار الجاية.
english: Thank you for listening, and we will meet again in the next news bulletin.
transliteration: Shukran la-istima-kum, wa rah niltiqi marra tanya bi-nashret el-akhbar el-jaye.
storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

arabic: سارة: مرحبا سارة، كيفك وكيف عيلتك اليوم؟
english: Sarah: Hello Sarah, how are you and how is your family today?
transliteration: Sara: Marhaba Sara, keefik w keef ailatik alyom?
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: أهلاً سارة، نحن بخير، وإخواتي راحوا عالسوق مبارح.
english: Sarah: Welcome Sarah, we are fine, and my brothers went to the market yesterday.
transliteration: Sara: Ahlan Sara, nehna bkhair, w ikhwati rahoo a-souq mbarah.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: هل شربتي قهوة ولا شاي اليوم؟
english: Sarah: Did you drink coffee or tea today?
transliteration: Sara: Hal shribti qahwa wala shay alyom?
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: أنا شربت شاي مع رفيقاتي بالصبح.
english: Sarah: I drank tea with my friends in the morning.
transliteration: Sara: Ana shribet shay ma rafeeqati bil subuh.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: حلو، أنا بدي فنجان قهوة كبير هلق.
english: Sarah: Nice, I want a big cup of coffee now.
transliteration: Sara: Helou, ana baddi finjan qahwa kbeer hallaq.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: تفضلي، خدي هاد الفنجان من عالطاولة.
english: Sarah: Please, take this cup from the table.
transliteration: Sara: Tfaddali, khidi had il finjan min a-tawla.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: شكراً، هل عندك كتب جديدة مشان نقرأ؟
english: Sarah: Thank you, do you have new books for us to read?
transliteration: Sara: Shukran, hal andik kutub jdeedi mshan niqra?
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: إي، عندي كتب صغيرة لولادنا.
english: Sarah: Yes, I have small books for our kids.
transliteration: Sara: Ee, andi kutub sghiree lal-wladna.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: ولادي بيحبوا قصص عن البيوت القديمة.
english: Sarah: My children love stories about old houses.
transliteration: Sara: Wladi bihibbou qisas an il byout il qadimi.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: سارة: هدول القصص حلوة ومفيدة للكل.
english: Sarah: These stories are beautiful and useful for everyone.
transliteration: Sara: Hadol il qisas helwi w mufeedi lal kill.
storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

arabic: صباح الخير لكل المستمعين ببرنامج صوت الناس على إذاعة عمان.
english: Good morning to all listeners on the 'Voice of the People' program on Amman Radio.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir la kull el mustamieen bi barnamaj sawt el nas ala idhaaet Amman.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: اليوم بدنا نحكي عن حالة المدارس بمناطق الحدود بسبب الأحداث الأخيرة.
english: Today we want to talk about the state of schools in border areas because of recent events.
transliteration: Elyom badna nehki an halet el madaris bi manateq el hudoud bi sabab el ahdath el akheereh.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: المعلمين عم بشاوروا بعضهم كيف بدهم يكملوا الحصص الدرسية تحت هالشروط الصعبة.
english: Teachers are consulting each other on how they want to complete the lessons under these difficult conditions.
transliteration: El mualimeen am bishawrou badon keef baddon yikmilou el hisas el darsiyeh tahet ha shurout el saba.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: سامي، مدير المدرسة، قال إنه الطلبة مستمرين بدراستهم بكل نشاط.
english: Sami, the school principal, said that the students are continuing their studies with full activity.
transliteration: Sami mudeer el madraseh qal inno el talabeh mustamireen bi dirasethon bi kull nashat.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: زميلي المراسل زياد كان هناك الصبح وشاف الشباب عم بساعدوا بعضهم.
english: My colleague, reporter Ziad, was there this morning and saw the youth helping each other.
transliteration: Zameeli el murasel Ziad kan hneek el subuh wa shaf el shabab am bisaadou badon.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: الصفوف كانت مليانة، والبنات كانوا عم بكتبوا دروسهم بحذر.
english: The classrooms were full, and the girls were writing their lessons carefully.
transliteration: El sufouf kanet melyaneh wal banat kanou am biktbu drouson bi hadhar.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: بعض الأهالي خايفين على أولادهم، بس التعليم بضل هو الأساس.
english: Some parents are afraid for their children, but education remains the foundation.
transliteration: Bad el ahali khayfeen ala awladon bas el taleem bidal huwwe el asas.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: المعلمات اشتروا كتب جديدة ودربوا الطلاب على خطط الطوارئ.
english: The female teachers bought new books and trained the students on emergency plans.
transliteration: El mualimat ishtaru kutub jdeedeh wa darrabu el tullab ala khutat el taware.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: في مستشفى قريب من المدرسة، الدكاترة عم بجهزوا الغرف لأي طوارئ.
english: In a hospital near the school, doctors are preparing rooms for any emergency.
transliteration: Fee mustashfa qareeb min el madraseh el dakatreh am bijahzou el ghuraf la ay taware.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: مع إنه الأصوات البعيدة مخيفة، الأطفال عم بيلعبوا بساحة المدرسة.
english: Even though the distant sounds are scary, the children are playing in the school courtyard.
transliteration: Ma inno el aswat el baeedeh mukhifeh el atfal am biyilabu bi sahat el madraseh.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: هيك قصص بتعطينا أمل إنه الحياة لازم تستمر رغم الحروب.
english: Such stories give us hope that life must continue despite wars.
transliteration: Heik qisas bitatina amal inno el hayat lazem tustamir raghm el huroub.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: نحن بإذاعتنا رح نضل نخبّركم عن كل التطورات المحلية.
english: We at our radio station will keep informing you of all local developments.
transliteration: Nehna bi idhaaetna rah ndal nkhabberkon an kull el tatawwurat el mahalliyeh.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: شو رأيكم بهي الشجاعة يلي عم نشوفها من معلمينا وطلابنا؟
english: What is your opinion of this courage that we are seeing from our teachers and our students?
transliteration: Shu raykon bi hay el shajaa yalli am nshoufha min mualimeena wa tullabna?
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: تواصلوا معنا على رقم الإذاعة وخبرونا قصص من مناطقكم.
english: Contact us on the radio number and tell us stories from your areas.
transliteration: Twaslou maana ala raqam el idhaa wa khabbrouna qisas min manateqkon.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: كنت معكم أحمد بتحيات الفريق كله، وان شاء الله نهاركم سعيد.
english: I was with you, Ahmad, with greetings from the whole team, and God willing your day is happy.
transliteration: Kunt maakon Ahmad bi tahiyat el fareeq kullo wa in shaa Allah nharkon saeed.
storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

arabic: كان سامي شب خجول كتير بضيعة صغيرة.
english: Sami was a very shy young man in a small village.
transliteration: Kan Sami shabb khajool kteer be-daya sagheera.

arabic: هو كان دايماً بيحب يسمع قصص الحكواتية بالساحة.
english: He always loved listening to the storytellers' stories in the square.
transliteration: Huwwe kan dayman bihibb yisma qisas al-hakawatiyye be-saha.

arabic: كان بدو يحكي متلهم بس كان بيخاف من الناس.
english: He wanted to speak like them but he was afraid of people.
transliteration: Kan biddo yihki mithlohom bas kan biyikhaf min an-nas.

arabic: بيوم من الإيام، جدو أعطاه كتاب قديم ومغبر.
english: One day, his grandfather gave him an old and dusty book.
transliteration: Be-yom min al-iyam, jiddo ataah ktab qadeem wa mghabbar.

arabic: هاد الكتاب كان فيه حكايات حلوة عن أجدادنا.
english: This book had beautiful tales about our ancestors.
transliteration: Had al-ktab kan fee hikayat hilwa an ajdadna.

arabic: سامي بلش يقرأ القصص كل ليلة بغرفته.
english: Sami started reading the stories every night in his room.
transliteration: Sami ballash yiqra al-qisas kull layla be-ghurfato.

arabic: أخواته البنات ساعدوه يتدرب بالصالون قدامهم.
english: His sisters helped him practice in the living room in front of them.
transliteration: Akhwato al-banat sa-adooh yitdarrab be-saloon iddamom.

arabic: هنّي ضحكوا سوا لما كان بيغلط بالكلمات.
english: They laughed together when he used to make mistakes with the words.
transliteration: Hinni dehko sawa lamma kan biyighlat be-alkalimat.

arabic: شوي شوي، ثقته بنفسه صارت أكبر بكتير.
english: Slowly, his self-confidence became much bigger.
transliteration: Shway shway, thiqto be-nafso sarat akbar be-kteer.

arabic: يوم الجمعة الماضي، كان في حفلة كبيرة بالساحة.
english: Last Friday, there was a big party in the square.
transliteration: Yom al-juma al-madi, kan fee hafla kbeera be-saha.

arabic: الناس كانوا ناطرين يسمعوا قصة جديدة ومميزة.
english: The people were waiting to hear a new and special story.
transliteration: An-nas kano natreen yisma-oo qissa jdeede wa mumayyaze.

arabic: وقف سامي بنص الساحة وقلبه كان عم يدق بسرعة.
english: Sami stood in the middle of the square and his heart was beating fast.
transliteration: Waqaf Sami be-nuss as-saha wa qalbo kan am yiduqq be-sur-a.

arabic: بلش يحكي قصته بصوت عالي وواضح للكل.
english: He started telling his story with a loud and clear voice for everyone.
transliteration: Ballash yihki qissato be-sawt alee wa wadehh lal-kull.

arabic: الكل سمعوا بانتباه وزقفوا له بحرارة بالأخير.
english: Everyone listened attentively and clapped for him warmly at the end.
transliteration: Al-kull sem-oo be-intibah wa zaqqafou lo be-harara bel-akheer.

arabic: هو تعلم إنه الشجاعة بتجي مع التدريب المستمر.
english: He learned that courage comes with continuous practice.
transliteration: Huwwe t-allam inno ash-shajaa-a bitji maa at-tadreeb al-mustamirr.

arabic: كان سامي، الخباز القديم، بيقضي نهاره بوسط الردم بمدينة حلب وهو عم يحاول يرجع الحياة لمخبزه الصغير يلي تهدم نصه.
english: Sami, the old baker, was spending his day in the middle of the rubble in Aleppo city, trying to bring life back to his small bakery, half of which was destroyed.
transliteration: Kan Sami, al-khabbaz al-qadim, biyaqdi naharo bi-wasat al-radm bi-madinat Halab wa-huwa am yuhawil yarajji al-hayat li-makhbazo al-saghir yalli thaddam nusso.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: بكل زاوية من الشوارع المهجورة، كانت ذكريات القذائف بتلاحق الناس، بس ريحة الخبز الطازة كانت بتعطيهم أمل مخبى.
english: In every corner of the abandoned streets, memories of the shells were haunting the people, but the smell of fresh bread was giving them a hidden hope.
transliteration: Bi-kull zawiya min al-shawari al-mahjoura, kanat dhikrayat al-qadha'if bit-lahiq al-nas, bass rihat al-khubz al-taza kanat bit-atihom amal mkhabba.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: فجأة، دخلت بنت صغيرة وعيونها مليانة خوف، وعطته كيس طحين كان مخبى تحت أنقاض بيت جيرانهم يلي تهجروا من زمان.
english: Suddenly, a young girl entered with eyes full of fear, and gave him a bag of flour that was hidden under the ruins of their neighbors' house who were displaced long ago.
transliteration: Faj'a, dakhalat bint saghira wa-uyouna malyana khawf, wa-atato kis tHin kan mkhabba taHt anqad bayt jiranhom yalli thajjarou min zaman.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: لما فتح سامي الكيس، لقى بين حبات الطحين مفتاح مصدي ورسالة قديمة مكتوبة بخط إيد بيعرفه كتير منيح.
english: When Sami opened the bag, he found among the grains of flour a rusty key and an old letter written in a handwriting he knew very well.
transliteration: Lamma fataH Sami al-kis, la'a bayn habbat al-tHin miftah mSaddi wa-risala qadima maktouba bi-khatt id bi-ya'rifo ktir mniH.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: اكتشف إنه جاره أبو عمر، يلي كان بيفكر إنه صار عدوه بسبب الحرب، كان عم يحمي بيته من الحرامية طول هالسنين.
english: He discovered that his neighbor Abu Omar, whom he thought had become his enemy because of the war, had been protecting his house from thieves all these years.
transliteration: Aktashaf inno jaro Abou Omar, yalli kan bi-fakkir inno sar adouwo bi-sabab al-Harb, kan am yiHmi bayto min al-haramiyya toul hal-sinin.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: الرسالة كانت بتقول: "يا رفيقي، هاد المفتاح لأمانتك، والخبز هو الطريق الوحيد ليرجع يجمعنا مرة تانية بميدان الحارة."
english: The letter said: "My friend, this key is for your trust, and bread is the only way for it to bring us together again in the neighborhood square."
transliteration: Al-risala kanat bit-qoul: Ya rafiqi, had al-miftah li-amanatk, wal-khubz huwa al-tariq al-waHid li-yarja yijmana marra taniya bi-midan al-hara.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: بلش سامي يعجن الطحين بدموعه وهو عم يفكر كيف الكره بيعمي القلوب، بس المحبة بتضل محفورة بالخبز والملح.
english: Sami started kneading the flour with his tears, thinking about how hate blinds hearts, but love remains engraved in bread and salt.
transliteration: Ballash Sami ya'jin al-tHin bi-dmou'o wa-huwa am yifakkir kif al-kureh bi-ya'mi al-quloub, bass al-maHabba b-tdall maHfourra bil-khubz wal-milH.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: ببنفس اللحظة، هدي صوت الرصاص وطلع من المذياع القديم خبر عن هدنة مفاجئة بتبشر بنهاية سنين القهر والوجع.
english: At that same moment, the sound of bullets calmed down and news came out of the old radio about a sudden ceasefire promising the end of years of oppression and pain.
transliteration: Bi-nafs al-laHza, hidi sawt al-rasas wa-tala min al-midya al-qadim khabar an hudna mufaji'a b-tbashshir bi-nihayat sinin al-qahr wal-waja.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: حمل سامي الرغيف السخن ومشي فوق الحجار المكسرة ليوصل للطرف التاني، وشاف أبو عمر ناطره وعيونه عم تلمع من الفرحة.
english: Sami carried the hot loaf and walked over the broken stones to reach the other side, and saw Abu Omar waiting for him, his eyes shining with joy.
transliteration: Hamal Sami al-raghif al-sukhn wa-mishi fawq al-hajar al-mkassar li-yuSal lil-taraf al-tani, wa-shaf Abou Omar natro wa-uyouno am tilma min al-farha.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: قعدوا الاتنين على رصيف الطريق، قسموا الخبزة بيناتهم، وتعاهدوا إنهم يعمروا الحارة من جديد حجر ورا حجر.
english: The two of them sat on the sidewalk of the road, divided the bread between them, and pledged to rebuild the neighborhood anew, stone by stone.
transliteration: Qa'adou al-itnayn ala rasif al-tariq, qasamou al-khubza baynathom, wa-ta'ahadou innhom yu'ammirou al-hara min jadid hajar wara hajar.
storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

arabic: فقت بكير بصباح غائم بفصل الخريف
english: I woke up early on a cloudy morning in the autumn season
transliteration: Fiqit bakkir bi sabah ghaem bi fasl al kharif

arabic: طلعت من الشباك وشفت الجو فيه ضباب كتير
english: I looked out the window and saw the weather was very foggy
transliteration: Tlaat min al shibbak w shifet al jaw fi dabab ktir

arabic: فجاة صار الجو عاصف وصار في رعد وبرق
english: Suddenly the weather became windy and there was thunder and lightning
transliteration: Faja sar al jaw aasef w sar fi raed w barq

arabic: شربت قهوتي الدافية بسرعة وانا عم حضر حالي لعاصفة
english: I drank my warm coffee quickly while I was preparing myself for a storm
transliteration: Shribit qahwiti al dafiye bi sura w ana am haddir hali la aasifa

arabic: ركضت لمحطة الباص وانا عم اتمنى ما اتاخر على اجتماعي
english: I ran to the bus station while hoping I wouldn't be late for my meeting
transliteration: Rakadt la mahattat al bas w ana am atamanna ma ata khar ala ijtima i

arabic: رحت مع اختي على المحل
english: I went with my sister to the shop
transliteration: Ruhet ma okhti ala el mahall
storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

arabic: هاد الفستان الازرق كتير صغير
english: This blue dress is very small
transliteration: Had el fustan el azraq kteer sghir
storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

arabic: بدنا نرجع الفستان وناخد واحد كبير
english: We want to return the dress and take a big one
transliteration: Bedna nraji el fustan w nakhod wahed kbir
storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

arabic: صاحب المحل زلمة كتير طيب
english: The shop owner is a very kind man
transliteration: Saheb el mahall zalameh kteer tayyeb
storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

arabic: هو بيسلم على عيلتي وبساعدنا
english: He says hello to my family and helps us
transliteration: Huwweh bi sallem ala aylti w bi saedna
storyTitle: A Visit to the Shop with My Sister

arabic: الجد بيقول اسف بدي رجع هاد التلفون بعد يوم واحد
english: The grandpa says sorry I want to return this phone after one day
transliteration: al jadd biqul asif biddi rajje had al telfon bad yom wahad

arabic: الشاب بيقول شو اسمك ومن وين انت
english: The young man says what is your name and where are you from
transliteration: ash shab biqul shu ismak wa min wein inta

arabic: الجد بيقول انا من سوريا ويمكن الجيل الجديد غريب
english: The grandpa says I am from Syria and maybe the new generation is strange
transliteration: al jadd biqul ana min suriya wa yimkin al jil al jdid gharib

arabic: الشاب بيضحك وبيقول اهلا وسهلا تفضل مصاريك
english: The young man laughs and says welcome here is your money
transliteration: ash shab byidhak wa biqul ahlan wa sahlan tfaddal masarik

arabic: الجد بياخد المصاري وبيقول بشوفك بعدين
english: The grandpa takes the money and says see you later
transliteration: al jadd biyakhud al masari wa biqul bashufak baden

arabic: كل يوم احد بزور جدتي
english: Every Sunday I visit my grandmother.
transliteration: kull yom ahad bzour jidati

arabic: بروح ع بيتها الصبح
english: I go to her house in the morning.
transliteration: brouh a baytha assubuh

arabic: منشرب قهوة ومناكل خبز
english: We drink coffee and eat bread.
transliteration: mnishrab ahwa w mnakol khobz

arabic: هي بتحكي عن رفقاتها
english: She talks about her friends.
transliteration: hiye btihki an rifatha

arabic: برجع ع بيتي المسا
english: I return to my house in the evening.
transliteration: birja a bayti almasa

arabic: عندي عيلة صغيرة ولد واحد و بنت
english: I have a small family, one boy and a girl.
transliteration: indi ayleh zgheereh walad waahad wa bint

arabic: اليوم بروح ع المدرسة مع ابني و بنتي
english: Today I go to school with my son and my daughter.
transliteration: al yom brooh a al madrasa ma ibni wa binti

arabic: بنتي بتشرب حليب سخن و ابني بياكل تفاحة
english: My daughter drinks hot milk and my son eats an apple.
transliteration: binti btishrab haleeb sukhn wa ibni byaakul tuffaaha

arabic: بالمدرسة المعلم بيسال ابني من وين انت
english: At the school the teacher asks my son where are you from.
transliteration: bil madrasa al muallem byisal ibni min wein inta

arabic: ابني بيجاوب بصوت عالي انا من سوريا
english: My son answers in a loud voice I am from Syria.
transliteration: ibni bjaweb bisot aali ana min souriya

arabic: كل يوم أحد بتجتمع العيلة كلها حوالين طاولة ستي المليانة بالأكلات التقليدية
english: Every Sunday, the entire family gathers around my grandmother's table full of traditional dishes.
transliteration: kill yom ahad btejtme3 el 3eileh kella hawalayn tawlet setti el malyaneh bel aklat el taqlidiyyeh

arabic: وبوقت يلي الأجداد بيحكوا عن ذكريات ماضيهم بيكونوا الشباب ملتهيين بالفرجة على شاشات موبايلاتهم
english: And while the grandparents talk about their past memories, the youth are distracted looking at their smartphone screens.
transliteration: w bwaqt yalli el ajdad byehkou 3an zikrayat madihom bikounou el chabab meltehiyyin bel ferjeh 3ala chachat mobaylatom

arabic: جدي بيحس بشوية انزعاج لأنه بيعتبر هاد السكوت المتواصل على السفرة قلة احترام
english: My grandfather feels a bit annoyed because he considers this continuous silence at the dining table a lack of respect.
transliteration: jeddi bihess bshwayyet inzi3aj la2enno bye3teber had el sukut el metwasel 3ala el sefra qellet htiram

arabic: من جهة تانية بيحاولوا أهلي يغيروا الجو من خلال طرح مواضيع بتهم الجيلين بنفس الوقت
english: On the other hand, my parents try to change the atmosphere by proposing topics that interest both generations at the same time.
transliteration: min jiha tanyeh biyhawlou ahli yghayrou el jaw min khilal tareh mawadi3 bithemm el jilayn bi nafs el waqt

arabic: بالرغم من هي الاختلافات الواضحة بنمط الحياة بتضل العزيمة فرصة مهمة بتجمعنا بمحبة
english: Despite these clear differences in lifestyle, the gathering remains an important opportunity that brings us together with love.
transliteration: bel roghem min hay el ikhtilafat el wadha bi namat el hayat btodall el 3azimeh forsa mhemmeh btejma3na bi mahabbeh

arabic: رحت ع الدكان مع ابني عشان نرجع قميص واحد
english: I went to the shop with my son to return one shirt.
transliteration: ruht a dukkan ma ibni ashan nrajje amis wahad
storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

arabic: صاحب الدكان قال لي من وين انت قلت انا من سوريا
english: The shop owner said to me where are you from I said I am from Syria.
transliteration: saheb dukkan aal li min wein inta ult ana min suriya
storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

arabic: قلتلو بدي ارجع هاد القميص
english: I told him I want to return this shirt.
transliteration: ultilo biddi arajje had amis
storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

arabic: اخي جابو هدية بس القميص كتير كبير
english: My brother brought it as a gift but the shirt is very big.
transliteration: akhi jabo hadiyye bas amis ktir kbir
storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

arabic: صاحب الدكان ضحك وقال هاد القميص لكل العيلة
english: The shop owner laughed and said this shirt is for the whole family.
transliteration: saheb dukkan dehek wa aal had amis lakil aayle
storyTitle: A Shirt for the Whole Family

arabic: رنا بتقول لسامر وين بدنا نروح بالعطلة
english: Rana says to Samer where do we want to go on the weekend.
transliteration: Rana betqoul la Samer wein baddna nrouh bel otleh

arabic: سامر بيقول خلينا نروح عالجبل
english: Samer says let us go to the mountain.
transliteration: Samer biqoul khallina nrouh aal jabal

arabic: رنا بتسأل شو بدنا ناخد معنا
english: Rana asks what do we want to take with us.
transliteration: Rana btesal shou baddna nakhod maana

arabic: سامر بيقول رح ناخد اكل ومي
english: Samer says we will take food and water.
transliteration: Samer biqoul rah nakhod akl w mayy

arabic: رنا بتقول هاي فكرة حلوة كتير
english: Rana says this is a very nice idea.
transliteration: Rana betqoul hay fekra helweh ktir

arabic: رنيت لرفيقي مبارح عشان اخبره انه رح نسافر علي تلات مدن بلبنان مع رفقاتنا الشهر الجاي
english: I called my friend yesterday to tell him that we will travel to three cities in Lebanon with our friends next month.
transliteration: raneyt larafiqi mbareh ashan akhabro eno rah nsafer aala talat modon blebnan maa refaatna ashshaher aljay

arabic: ما رد عليي لانه بيشتغل عشر ساعات كل يوم بالمستشفي
english: He did not answer me because he works ten hours every day in the hospital.
transliteration: ma rad aalayi laeno byeshteghel aasher saat kel yom belmestashfa

arabic: تركت له رساله وقلت له اني اشتريت اربع قمصان جداد من السوق للرحله
english: I left him a message and told him that I bought four new shirts from the market for the trip.
transliteration: tarakt lo risale waqelt lo enni eshtareyt arbaa oumsan jdad min alsouq lalrehleh

arabic: بعد ساعه اتصل فيي وقلي انه ما بيقدر يجي معنا
english: After an hour he called me and told me that he cannot come with us.
transliteration: baad saa etasal fiyi waalli eno ma byeqdar yiji maana

arabic: طلع قرر يبيع سيارته القديمه ويشتري تلات تلفونات جديده عشان شغله بدل السفر
english: It turned out he decided to sell his old car and buy three new phones for his work instead of traveling.
transliteration: telea qarar yebie sayarto alqadime wayeshtari talat telefonat jdide ashan sheghlo badal assafar

arabic: بينما كنت عم اتمشى بالسوق القديم لمحت وجه مالوف ما شفته من اكتر من عشر سنين
english: While I was walking in the old market, I caught sight of a familiar face I hadn't seen for over ten years.
transliteration: baynama kint aam atamashsha bissuuq alqadiim lamahat wihj maaluuf ma shifto min aktar min aashar sniin

arabic: ركضت لعنده بحماس وعانقته بحرارة وانا عم اساله عن اخباره وحياته بالغربة
