english: I rushed towards him excitedly and hugged him warmly while asking him about his news and his life abroad.
transliteration: rakadt laaando bihamaas wa aanaqto biharaara wa ana aam isalo aan akhbaaro wa hayaato bilghurba

arabic: تطلع فيي باستغراب شديد وقلي بتوتر انه ما بيعرفني ابدا
english: He looked at me with great astonishment and told me nervously that he didn't know me at all.
transliteration: ttallaa fiyyi bi istighraab shadiid wa aalli bitawattur inno ma biyaarafni abadan

arabic: بهديك اللحظة المحرجة استوعبت انه مجرد شخص بيشبه رفيقي القديم بشكل مو طبيعي
english: In that awkward moment, I realized that he was just someone who looked exactly like my old friend.
transliteration: bi hadiik allahza almuhrija istawaabt inno mujarrad shakhs biyishbah rfiiqi alqadiim bishakl mu tabiiy

arabic: اعتذرت منه بشدة ومشيت بسرعة لحتى الاقي رفيقي الحقيقي قاعد بالقهوة التانية عم يراقب المشهد ويضحك
english: I apologized profusely and hurried away, only to find my real friend sitting at the next café watching the whole scene and laughing.
transliteration: iaatazart minno bishidda wa mshiit bisuraa lahatta laaqi rfiiqi alhaqiiqi qaaid bilqahwa attaanya aam yuraaqib almashhad wa yidhak

arabic: رحت عالدكان اليوم عشان ارجع شنطه لاني مو مرتاح فيها
english: I went to the shop today to return a bag because I am not comfortable with it.
transliteration: ruhet aal dekkan el yom ashan arrajea shanta laenni mo mertah feeha

arabic: الموظف كان مشغول بس ساعدني بسرعه
english: The employee was busy but he helped me quickly.
transliteration: el mowazzaf kan mashghool bas saaedni bseraa

arabic: قلت له بدي اغيرها او اخذ مصاري
english: I told him I want to change it or take money.
transliteration: qolt lo beddi aghayyerha aw akhod masari

arabic: حكالي انه بقدر اخذ شنطه جديده هلا
english: He told me that I can take a new bag now.
transliteration: hakali enno baqdar akhod shanta jdedeh hala

arabic: الشنطه الجديده مفضله عندي و رح ابلش استخدمها بكرا
english: The new bag is my favorite and I will start using it tomorrow.
transliteration: el shanta el jdedeh mfaddaleh eandi w rah aballesh astakhdemha bokra

arabic: بعد ما تمشينا لساعتين باسواق الشام القديمة ابي استوعب انه ضيعنا طريقنا لبيت عمتي تماما
english: After we walked for two hours in the old markets of Damascus, my father realized that we had completely lost our way to my aunt's house.
transliteration: baad ma tmashayna la saatein b aswaq ashsham al qadimeh abi stawab inno dayyaana tariqna la bayt ammti tamaman
storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

arabic: امي ضحكت بحنية وقالتله ما يعتل هم لان نسال الناس بهي الحارات متعة ومو احراج ابدا
english: My mother laughed affectionately and told him not to worry because asking people in these neighborhoods is a pleasure and not embarrassing at all.
transliteration: immi dehekt b henniyeh w aletlo ma yeetal hamm laen nesal annas b hay al harat mutea w mo ehraj abadan
storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

arabic: وقفنا ختيار بشوش قاعد قدام دكانه وسالناه عن زقاق البهارات المعروف
english: We stopped a smiling old man sitting in front of his shop and asked him about the famous spice alley.
transliteration: waafna khtyar bashoush aaed eddam dekkano w saalnah an zuqaq al bharat al maarouf
storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

arabic: هو ما اكتفى انه يوصفلنا الطريق بس اصر انه نشرب كاسة شاي معه قبل ما نكمل مشوارنا
english: He didn't just give us the directions, but insisted that we drink a cup of tea with him before completing our journey.
transliteration: huwwe ma ktafa inno yoosfelna attariq bas asarr inno neshrab kaset shay maao abel ma nkammel meshwarna
storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

arabic: وصلنا بالاخير لبيت عمتي ونحن حاملين قصص حلوة عن كرم الغربا ودفا البلد
english: We eventually reached my aunt's house carrying beautiful stories about the generosity of strangers and the warmth of the country.
transliteration: wselna b al akhir la bayt ammti w nehna hamlin esas helweh an karam al ghuraba w dafa al balad
storyTitle: Getting Lost in the Old Markets

arabic: انا صفيت سيارتي القديمه ونزلت على السوق بس ضيعت الطريق
english: I parked my old car and went down to the market but I lost the way.
transliteration: ana saffeyt sayarti alqadime wnezelt aala alsouq bas dayyaat attariq

arabic: سالت رجال بالشارع وين السوق الكبير
english: I asked a man in the street where the big market is.
transliteration: saalt rjal beshshareh wayn alsouq alkbir

arabic: قال لازم تمشي دغري عشر دقايق وبعدين تلف يمين
english: He said you must walk straight for ten minutes and then turn right.
transliteration: qal lazem temshi deghri aasher daqayeq wbaadayn tlef yamin

arabic: رح تشوف عيادة الدكتور والسوق وراها
english: You will see the doctor clinic and the market is behind it.
transliteration: rah tshouf iyadat aldoktor walsouq waraha

arabic: شكرته واشتريت اربع قمصان جداد من السوق
english: I thanked him and bought four new shirts from the market.
transliteration: shakarto weshtareyt arbaa oumsan jdad min alsouq

arabic: كل يوم بحمل شنطتي وبروح ع البنايه الكبيره
english: Every day I carry my bag and go to the big building.
transliteration: kel yom bahmel shantati w brooh a al binayeh al kbeereh

arabic: انا موظف جديد هون وشغلي ببلش بكير
english: I am a new employee here and my work starts early.
transliteration: ana mowazzaf jdeed hon w shoghli bballesh bakeer

arabic: المكتب كتير مرتاح بس انا دايما مشغول
english: The office is very comfortable but I am always busy.
transliteration: al maktab kteer mertah bas ana dayman mashghool

arabic: الظهر باكل اكلي المفضل لانه كتير زكي
english: At noon I eat my favorite food because it is very delicious.
transliteration: al dohor bakol akli al mfaddal lanno kteer zaki

arabic: بعد الشغل بغير تيابي وبحط مصاري بالبنك
english: After work I change my clothes and put money in the bank.
transliteration: baad al shoghel bghayer tyabi w bhot masari b al bank

arabic: سامي ضل كل اليوم يسال امه اسئلة
english: Sami kept asking his mother questions all day.
transliteration: Sami dall kel el yom yesal emmo aseela

arabic: سالها ليش السما زرقا وكيف العصافير بتطير
english: He asked her why the sky is blue and how birds fly.
transliteration: salaha lesh el sama zarka w kif el asafeer betteer

arabic: الام كانت تعبانة كثير بس جاوبته بابتسامة
english: The mother was very tired but answered him with a smile.
transliteration: el em kanet taabane ktiir bas jawabto bebtisame

arabic: بالليل سالها سؤال غريب كثير عن كلبهم
english: At night he asked her a very strange question about their dog.
transliteration: bel lel salaha suaal gharib ktiir aan kalbon

arabic: بده يعرف ايمتى الكلب رح يبلش يحكي عربي
english: He wants to know when the dog will start speaking Arabic.
transliteration: beddo yaaref emta el kaleb rah yballesh yehki aarabi

arabic: كان الجو غائم بفصل الخريف فقررت امي تاخدنا على المول لنشتري تياب
english: The weather was cloudy in the autumn season, so my mom decided to take us to the mall to buy clothes.
transliteration: kan el jaw ghaem bfasl el kharif fqararet emi takhedna ala el mall laneshtri tyab

arabic: كنا عم نمشي بسرعة لان كان في عاصفة كبيرة جاية وفي رعد وبرق
english: We were walking quickly because there was a big storm coming and there is thunder and lightning.
transliteration: kena am nemshi bsera lan kan fi aasifa kbereh jayeh w fi raed w barq

arabic: بالمحل اختي اختارت جاكيت دافي وسالتني عن رايي
english: In the shop my sister chose a warm jacket and asked me for my opinion.
transliteration: bel mahal ekhti khtaret jacket dafi w saletni an rayei

arabic: ابي اشترى لي معطف حلو ليحميني من الجو العاصف والضباب برا
english: My father bought me a nice coat to protect me from the windy weather and the fog outside.
transliteration: abi shtara li maataf helo liyahmini men el jaw el aasef w el dabab barra

arabic: رجعنا عالبيت مبسوطين وشربنا شاي سخن مع بعض ونحنا عم نتفرج عالمطر
english: We returned home happy and drank hot tea together while watching the rain.
transliteration: rjeana aal bayt mabsoutin w shrebna shay sekhn maa baad w nehna am netfaraj aal matar

arabic: انا بدي روح على الجبل بالعطلة
english: I want to go to the mountain on the weekend.
transliteration: ana biddi ruuh ala al jabal bil utla

arabic: رفيقي بده ينام كتير
english: My friend wants to sleep a lot.
transliteration: rafiqi biddo ynaam ktiir

arabic: مشان هيك رايحين بسيارته الكبيرة
english: So we are going in his big car.
transliteration: mishaan hek rayhiin bi sayyarto al kbiira

arabic: هو بيقدر ينام بالسيارة
english: He can sleep in the car.
transliteration: huwwe byiqdar ynaam bis sayyara

arabic: بس انا ما بعرف سوق
english: But I do not know how to drive.
transliteration: bas ana ma barif suuq

arabic: انا طالب جديد بالمدينة وانا ضايع
english: I am a new student in the city and I am lost
transliteration: ana taleb jdid bil madineh w ana dayea

arabic: شفت زلمة ورحت لعنده
english: I saw a man and went to him
transliteration: shefet zalameh w ruht laando

arabic: قلتله لو سمحت وين الجامعة
english: I said to him excuse me where is the university
transliteration: eltlo law samaht wayn el jameah

arabic: قال روح دغري بعدين يمين
english: He said go straight then right
transliteration: aal rouh deghri baaden yamin

arabic: شكرته ومشيت للجامعة
english: I thanked him and walked to the university
transliteration: shakarto w mshit lal jameah

arabic: فات الاب عالبيت وقالتله نور مساء الخير كيفك
english: The father entered the house and Nour said to him, good evening, how are you?
transliteration: fat el ab aal beit w qaletlo nour masa el kheir kifak

arabic: قال الاب انا منيح بس باب الخزانة خربان
english: The father said, I am fine, but the closet door is broken.
transliteration: qal el ab ana mnih bas bab el khezane kharban

arabic: صلح الاب الباب بسرعة ونور ساعدته
english: The father fixed the door quickly and Nour helped him.
transliteration: sallah el ab el bab bi suraa w nour saaadeto

arabic: قالت نور انا منيحة شكرا على مساعدتك
english: Nour said, I am fine, thank you for your help.
transliteration: qalet nour ana mniha shukran aala musaadetak

arabic: بعدين طلعت نور مع رفقاتها وقالت مع السلامة باي
english: Then Nour went out with her friends and said goodbye, bye.
transliteration: baadein talaet nour maa refqata w qalet ma el salama bai

arabic: اليوم بدي اطبخ اكل جديد
english: Today I want to cook new food.
transliteration: alyom biddi otbokh akel jdid

arabic: اخي بشتغل طباخ وبساعدني اليوم
english: My brother works as a chef and helps me today.
transliteration: akhi bishtighel tabbakh w bisaidni alyom

arabic: انا بعمل دجاج ورز
english: I make chicken and rice.
transliteration: ana bamel dajaj w ruz

arabic: بس الاكل محروق ومو طيب
english: But the food is burnt and not tasty.
transliteration: bas el akel mahrouq w mu tayyeb

arabic: بالاخر الكلب بياكل كل الاكل
english: In the end the dog eats all the food.
transliteration: bil akher el kaleb biyakel kel el akel

arabic: يوم الجمعة قعدت انا وعيلتي بغرفة القعدة عشان نخطط لرحلة العطلة
english: On Friday my family and I sat in the living room to plan the weekend trip.
transliteration: yom aljumaa qaadat ana w aaylati bi ghurfat alqaada ashan nukhattat li rihlat alutla

arabic: بابا كان بده يروح ع الجبل بس ماما فضلت البحر
english: My dad wanted to go to the mountain but my mom preferred the sea.
transliteration: baba kan biddo yrouh a aljabal bas mama faddalat albahr

arabic: بعد نقاش طويل قررنا نروح ع قرية حلوة قريبة من البحر
english: After a long discussion we decided to go to a nice village near the sea.
transliteration: baad niqash taweel qarrarna nrouh a qarya hilwa qareeba min albahr

arabic: اختي بلشت تجهز الاكل وانا نظفت السيارة
english: My sister started preparing the food and I cleaned the car.
transliteration: ukhti ballashat tujahhiz alakel wa ana naddaft alsayyara

arabic: نحن متحمسين كتير عشان نقضي وقت حلو مع بعض
english: We are very excited to spend a beautiful time together.
transliteration: nahn mutahamseen kteer ashan naqdi waqt hilw maa baad

arabic: نحنا عم نخطط لعرس اختي
english: We are planning my sister's wedding.
transliteration: nehna aam nkhatet la eres ekhti

arabic: امي بدها عرس كبير كتير
english: My mother wants a very big wedding.
transliteration: emmi bedha eres kbeer kteer

arabic: بس اختي بدها حفلة صغيرة
english: But my sister wants a small party.
transliteration: bas ekhti bedha hafle sgheere

arabic: ستي بتحب الموسيقى العربية القديمة
english: My grandmother loves old Arabic music.
transliteration: sitti betheb el mousiqa el arabiyye el adeeme

arabic: واختي بدها موسيقى انجليزية جديدة
english: And my sister wants new English music.
transliteration: wa ekhti bedha mousiqa enjleeziyye jdeede

arabic: سامي شاف جاره رامي وهو زعلان
english: Sami saw his neighbor Rami and he was sad.
transliteration: sami shaf jaro rami w huwe zaalan

arabic: سامي سأل رامي ليش هو تعبان اليوم
english: Sami asked Rami why he is tired today.
transliteration: sami saal rami lesh huwe taaban el yom

arabic: رامي قال انه عنده شغل كتير
english: Rami said that he has a lot of work.
transliteration: rami aal inno ando shoghol ktir

arabic: سامي عزم جاره يشرب قهوة ببيته
english: Sami invited his neighbor to drink coffee in his house.
transliteration: sami azam jaro yeshrab ahwe bbayto

arabic: رامي ابتسم وصار مبسوط كتير
english: Rami smiled and became very happy.
transliteration: rami btasam w sar mabsut ktir

arabic: عمري عشرين سنة وانا ضايع بالسوق
english: I am twenty years old and I am lost in the market.
transliteration: omri ishreen sane w ana daye bil souq

arabic: بسال طباخ وين المطعم
english: I ask a chef where the restaurant is.
transliteration: basal tabbakh wayn el mataam

arabic: هو بشتغل هنيك والدجاج محروق
english: He works there and the chicken is burnt.
transliteration: huwwe bishtighel honik w el dajaj mahrouq

arabic: الطباخ حكى امشي دغري من عند الكلب
english: The chef says walk straight from the dog.
transliteration: el tabbakh haka imshi deghri min end el kaleb

arabic: بعدين بضحك وبسال شو رقم تلفونك
english: Then he laughs and asks what is your phone number.
transliteration: baadayn byidhak w byisal shu raqam telefonak

arabic: امبارح قررنا نلعب مباراة طابة لان الجو بالخريف بالعادة بكون دافي
english: Yesterday we decided to play a football match because the weather in autumn is usually warm.
transliteration: Mbareh qararna nel'ab mubarat tabeh la'en el jaw bil kharif bil aadeh bkon dafi

arabic: بس فجاة الجو صار غائم وكان في ضباب كتير على الملعب
english: But suddenly the weather became cloudy and it was very foggy on the field.
transliteration: Bas faja'a el jaw sar gha'em w kan fi dabab ktir ala el mal'ab

arabic: الحكم وقع عالارض لانه ما قدر يشوف الطابة من الضباب
english: The referee fell on the ground because he couldn't see the ball in the fog.
transliteration: El hakam weqee' aal ard la'enno ma qeder yeshouf el tabeh men el dabab

arabic: بعد شوي بلشت عاصفة والجو صار عاصف
english: After a little bit a storm started and the weather became windy.
transliteration: Ba'ed shway ballashat aasifa wel jaw sar aasef

arabic: كل اللعيبة هربوا لما شافوا انه في رعد وبرق
english: All the players ran away when they saw that there is thunder and lightning.
transliteration: Kel el la'eebah harabou lamma shafou enno fi ra'ed w barq

arabic: رنيت لرفيقي عشيه لاني كنت مستوي من الروتين اليومي والعجقه الفظيعه عالطريق
english: I called my friend in the evening because I was exhausted from the daily routine and the terrible traffic on the road
transliteration: ranneit la rfiqi ashiyeh lanni kent mestwi men el rotin el yawmi wal ajqa el faziea aal tariq

arabic: حكيتلو اني دايما عم اماطل بشغل البيت لان مديري بالشغل كتير متسلط
english: I told him that I always procrastinate doing the house chores because my boss at work is very domineering
transliteration: hakeitlo enni dayman am amatel bishoghol el beit lan mudiri bil shoghol ktiir metsalet

arabic: جرب يواسيني بس ما قدرت استوعب كيف هو دايما بضل رايق ضمنيا
english: He tried to comfort me but I could not comprehend how he always stays implicitly calm
transliteration: jarrab ywassini bas ma qdret estaweb kif huwwe dayman bydal rayeq dimniyan

arabic: نصحني اني ما اطنش صحتي واخد استراحه بدل ما اكون متردد بكل تفصيل
english: He advised me not to ignore my health and to take a break instead of being indecisive about every detail
transliteration: nasahni enni ma atanesh sehti wa akhed istiraha badal ma akoun metradded bikol tafsil

arabic: باخر المكالمه بطلت مقهور واتفقنا نلتقي بكرا بعد الشغل لنغير جو
english: At the end of the call I was no longer devastated and we agreed to meet tomorrow after work to change the mood
transliteration: biakher el mukalame battalt maqhour wa ettafaqna nelteqi bukra baad el shoghol la nghayyer jaw

arabic: بحكي مع رفيقتي على التلفون وانا كتير مبسوطة
english: I talk to my friend on the phone and I am very happy
transliteration: Ba7ki ma3 rfeeqti 3ala el telephon w ana kteer mabsoota

arabic: انا بشرب قهوتي كل يوم الصبح وبسمعها
english: I drink my coffee every day in the morning and I listen to her
transliteration: Ana bashrab ahweti kol yom el sobe7 w basma3ha

arabic: هي بتشرب قهوتها وبتحكيلي قصة حزينة
english: She drinks her coffee and tells me a sad story
transliteration: Hiya bteshrab ahwetha w bte7keeli ossa 7azeena

arabic: انا بزعل عليها وهي بتبكي شوي
english: I feel sad for her and she cries a little
transliteration: Ana baz3al 3aleiha w hiya btebki shway

arabic: نحنا منشرب شاينا بعدين ومنضحك سوا
english: We drink our tea later and we laugh together
transliteration: Ne7na mneshrab shayna ba3den w mned7ak sawa

arabic: قررت روح ع المول اليوم لان الجو غائم ونحنا بفصل الخريف
english: I decided to go to the mall today because the weather is cloudy and we are in the autumn season.
transliteration: Qarart rouh aa el mall el yom laen el jaw ghaem w nehna bi fasl el kharif

arabic: بدي اشتري جاكيت دافي قبل ما تبلش عاصفة كبيرة
english: I want to buy a warm jacket before a big storm starts.
transliteration: Baddi ishtiri jacket dafi qabel ma tballesh aasifa kbeereh

arabic: فتت ع محل كبير وقست كتير تياب شتوية بتجنن
english: I entered a big shop and tried on many amazing winter clothes.
transliteration: Fetet aa mahal kbeer w qeset kteer tyab shetwiyeh betjannen

arabic: فجاة شفت برق من الشباك وعرفت انو الطقس صار عاصف
english: Suddenly I saw lightning from the window and I knew that the weather became windy.
transliteration: Fajaah shefet barq men el shubbak w arafet inno el taqes sar aasef

arabic: دفعت حق الجاكيت فورا ورجعت ع البيت قبل ما يصير في رعد وبرق
english: I paid for the jacket immediately and returned home before there is thunder and lightning.
transliteration: Dafaet haqq el jacket fawran w rjeet aa el bayt qabel ma yseer fi raed w barq

arabic: انا بدي روح ع السوق وبسال رفيقي عندك وقت بكرة
english: I want to go to the market and I ask my friend do you have time tomorrow.
transliteration: ana baddi ruuh aa ssuu wa basaal rfeeqi aindak waet bukra

arabic: هو بيقول اي وبيسال اي ساعة بتحب نلتقي
english: He says yes and asks what time would you like us to meet.
transliteration: huwwa biuul ee wa bisaal ayy saa bithebb neltaee

arabic: انا بقول خلينا نلتقي الساعة سبعة الصبح
english: I say let us meet at seven in the morning.
transliteration: ana buul khalleena neltaee assaa sabaa asubeh

arabic: نحن بنروح ع السوق وبنشتري تفاح وخبز
english: We go to the market and buy apples and bread.
transliteration: nehna binruuh aa ssuu wa binishtiri tuffaah wa khibz

arabic: بعدين بنرجع ع البيت الساعة تنتين الضهر
english: Then we return home at two in the afternoon.
transliteration: baadeen binirja aa lbeet assaa tinteen aduhr

arabic: عم خطط لعرسي بفصل الخريف لانو الطقس بالعادة بيكون دافي
english: I am planning my wedding in the autumn because the weather is usually warm.
transliteration: Am khattat la ersi bi fasel el kharif la enno el takes bil aadeh bikoun dafi

arabic: بس اليوم السما غايمة وفي ضباب بكل مكان
english: But today the sky is cloudy and there is fog everywhere.
transliteration: Bas el yom el sama ghaima w fi dabab bi kel makan

arabic: خفت انو تيجي عاصفة قوية بيوم الحفلة
english: I was afraid that a strong storm would come on the day of the party.
transliteration: Kheft enno tiji aasifa qawiyeh bi yom el hafleh

arabic: فجاة صار في رعد وبرق فوق الجنينة الخارجية
english: Suddenly there was thunder and lightning above the outdoor garden.
transliteration: Faja sar fi raed w barq foq el jneineh el kharijiyeh

arabic: مشان هيك قررنا ننقل كل الطاولات لجوا الصالة لنحمي المعازيم
english: So we decided to move all the tables inside the hall to protect the guests.
transliteration: Mshan heik qararna nenqel kel el tawlat la juwa el saleh la nehme el maazim

arabic: انصدم رامي، صاحب القهوة العصبي اللي عمرو خمسة وتلاتين سنة، لما فتح خزانته بشارع الحمرا واكتشف إنو عمال التوصيل ما جابوا كياس البن.
english: Rami, the stressed thirty-five-year-old coffee shop owner, was shocked when he opened his cabinet on Hamra street and discovered that the delivery workers did not bring the bags of coffee beans.
transliteration: Insadam Rami, saheb el ahwe el asabi elli amro khamse w tlatin sene, lamma fatah khazanto bi sharee el Hamra w iktashaf inno ommal el tawsil ma jabu kiyas el bon.

arabic: المشكلة إنو زباينه ناطرين برا، وما ضل عنده غير كيسين بس، وهاد الشي ما بيكفي ليعمل قهاويهم اللي بيشربوها مع مناقيش الزعتر.
english: The problem is that his customers are waiting outside, and he only has two bags left, and this thing does not suffice to make their coffees which they drink with thyme manakish.
transliteration: El mushkle inno zabayno natrin barra, w ma dall ando gher kisin bas, w had el shi ma byekfi la yaamel ahawihom elli byeshrabuha maa manakish el zaatar.

arabic: مسح رامي جبينه المعرق، ومسك تليفونه ليتصل برفيقه طارق اللي عنده دكانة بالجميزة، وقله "كيفك يا طارق، يلا ساعدني، شو بدك لتعطيني كياس البن تبعاتك؟"
english: Rami wiped his sweaty forehead, and grabbed his phone to call his friend Tariq who has a shop in Gemmayzeh, and told him, "How are you Tariq, come on help me, what do you want to give me your bags of coffee beans?"
transliteration: Masah Rami jbino el moarraa, w masak telephono la yettisel bi rfio Tareq elli ando dekkane bil Gemmayzeh, w aallo "kifak ya Tareq, yalla saaedni, shu baddak la taatini kiyas el bon tabaatak?"

arabic: جاوبه طارق بضحكة خفيفة وقله "بعطيك ياهن بمليونين ليرة لبنانية، بس لازم تسوق سيارتك البيجو القديمة وتجي تاخدهن هلق."
english: Tariq answered him with a light laugh and told him, "I give them to you for two million Lebanese liras, but you must drive your old Peugeot car and come take them now."
transliteration: Jawabo Tareq bi dahke khafife w aallo "baatik yahon bi malyonein lira lebneniyye, bas lazem tsouq sayyartak el peugeot el adime w tiji takhodhon hallaq."

arabic: تنفس رامي بارتياح كبير، وسكر المحل مؤقتاً وهو عم يقول "معلش، يسلمو ايديك، بكرا إنشالله بجيبلك صحون كنافة معي تعويضا عن غلبتك."
english: Rami breathed with great relief, and closed the shop temporarily while he was saying, "It is okay, bless your hands, tomorrow God willing I bring to you plates of knafeh with me as compensation for your trouble."
transliteration: Tanaffas Rami bi irtiyah kbir, w sakkar el mahal muaqqatan w huwwe am bioul "maalesh, yeslamo ideik, bukra inshallah bjiblak shoun knafeh mai tawidan an ghalabtak."

arabic: مرحبا صباح الخير واهلا وسهلا في عرسي
english: Hello, good morning, and welcome to my wedding.
transliteration: marhaba sabah al khayr wa ahlan wa sahlan fi irsi

arabic: الفستان الابيض حلو كتير وطويل
english: The white dress is very beautiful and long.
transliteration: al fustan al abyad hilo ktir wa tawil

arabic: نحن منشم الورد الاحمر الحلو هون
english: We smell the sweet red roses here.
transliteration: nihna mnesham al ward al ahmar al hilo hon

arabic: الكيكة الكبيرة طيبة وحلوة كتير
english: The big cake is very tasty and sweet.
transliteration: al keke al kbire taybe wa hilwe ktir

arabic: الموسيقى عالية والناس مبسوطين
english: The music is loud and the people are happy.
transliteration: al musiqa aalye wa al nas mabsutin

arabic: فادي بيفيق الصبح وبيقول صباح الخير
english: Fadi wakes up in the morning and says good morning
transliteration: fadi bifiq asubuh w biqul sabah alkhayr

arabic: مرته بتقول صباح النور اهلا وسهلا
english: His wife says good morning and welcome
transliteration: martu bitqul sabah annur ahlan wa sahlan

arabic: فادي بده يشرب قهوة بس في مشكلة
english: Fadi wants to drink coffee but there is a problem
transliteration: fadi bidu yishrab qahwa bas fi mushkila

arabic: ما في مي بالمطبخ اليوم
english: There is no water in the kitchen today
transliteration: ma fi may bilmatbakh alyawm

arabic: فادي بيروح ع الدكان ليشتري مي
english: Fadi goes to the shop to buy water
transliteration: fadi biruh a addukan liyishtiri may

arabic: طارق، الميكانيكي العنيد يلي عمرو تنين وأربعين سنة، صفن بتلفونو المكسور على أرض الكراج المزيتة بالجميزة، واكتشف إنو ضيع الرقم الوحيد لتاجر قزاز البيجو القديمة.
english: Tariq, the stubborn forty-two-year-old mechanic, stared at his broken phone on the oily floor of the garage in Gemmayzeh, and realized that he lost the only number for the vintage Peugeot glass merchant.
transliteration: Tariq, el mikaniki el anid yalli omro tnein wa arbein seneh, safan bitelefono el maksour ala ard el karaj el mzayyateh bil Gemmayzeh, wa ktashaf inno dayya el raqam el wahid la tajer qzaz el peugeot el adimeh.
storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

arabic: "يا زلمة، شو بدي أعمل هلق؟ هاد شوفير التكسي بدو سيارتو بكرا، والقزاز الجديد حقو تلات ملايين ليرة لبنانية!" تمتم بعصبية وهو عم يمسح إيديه بخرقة وسخة.
english: "Oh man, what do I want to do now? This taxi driver wants his car tomorrow, and the new glass costs three million Lebanese liras!" he muttered angrily while wiping his hands with a dirty rag.
transliteration: "Ya zalameh, shu biddi aamal hallaq? Had shofair el taksi biddo sayyarto bukra, wa el qzaz el jdid haqqo tlat malayin lira libnaniyyeh!" tamtam bi asabiyyeh wa huwweh am yimsah ideyh bi khirqa wiskha.
storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

arabic: فجأة، دخل جارو الختيار أبو سامي حامل منقوشتين زعتر سخنين وسألو عن المشكلة.
english: Suddenly, his elderly neighbor Abu Sami entered holding two hot zaatar manakish and asked him about the problem.
transliteration: Fajaah, dakhal jaro el khtyar Abu Sami hamil manqoushtein zaatar sukhnin wa saalo an el mushkileh.
storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

arabic: تنهد طارق، وشرحلو الوضع، وتفاجأ كتير لما الختيار طالع دفتر صغير من جيبتو.
english: Tariq sighed, and explained the situation to him, and was very surprised when the old man took out a small notebook from his pocket.
transliteration: Tanahhad Tariq, wa sharahlo el wade, wa tfaja ktir lamma el khtyar taala daftar sghir min jibto.
storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

arabic: "خد هالورقة، ابن عمي بيبيع هالقطع بالأشرفية، فروح لهنيك بسرعة، يلا!" قال أبو سامي بابتسامة دافية.
english: "Take this paper, my cousin sells these parts in Achrafieh, so go there quickly, yalla!" Abu Sami said with a warm smile.
transliteration: "Khud hal waraqa, ibn ammi bibi hal qita bil Achrafieh, fa rouh la hnik bi sura, yalla!" qaal Abu Sami bi ibtisameh dafyeh.
storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

arabic: انا قاعد بالقهوة وعم بستنى صاحبي
english: I am sitting in the cafe and waiting for my friend
transliteration: ana aaed bel ahweh w aam bestanna sahbi

arabic: بطلب قهوة عربية حلوة
english: I order sweet Arabic coffee
transliteration: botlob ahweh arabiyyeh helweh

arabic: الجرسون بيجيب القهوة مع كاسة مي
english: The waiter brings the coffee with a glass of water
transliteration: el garson byejib el ahweh maa kaset may

arabic: في رجال جنبي عم يلعبوا طاولة
english: There are men next to me playing backgammon
transliteration: fi rjal janbi aam yelaabou tawleh

arabic: بيوصل صاحبي ومنشرب القهوة سوا
english: My friend arrives and we drink the coffee together
transliteration: byewsal sahbi w mneshrab el ahweh sawa

arabic: كانت ليلة خريف والطقس غائم وعاصف برا
english: It was an autumn night and the weather was cloudy and windy outside
transliteration: Kanat laylat kharif w el taqs ghaem w aasef barra

arabic: برا كان في رعد وبرق بس البيت كان دافي من جوا
english: Outside there was thunder and lightning but the house was warm from the inside
transliteration: Barra kan fi raed w barq bas el bayt kan dafi mn juwa

arabic: كل رفقاتي تجمعوا حوالين الكيكة الكبيرة يلي مليانة شموع
english: All my friends gathered around the big cake that was full of candles
transliteration: Kel refqati tajammaou hawalayn el kaykeh el kbireh yali malyaneh shmou

arabic: غنينا بصوت عالي وريحة الفانيلا الحلوة عبت الغرفة
english: We sang loudly and the sweet smell of vanilla filled the room
transliteration: Ghannayna bsawt aali w rihet el vanilla el helweh abbat el gherfeh

arabic: غمضت عيوني وتمنيت امنية حلوة قبل ما اطفي النار
english: I closed my eyes and made a sweet wish before blowing out the fire
transliteration: Ghammadet oyouni w tmannayt omniyeh helweh abel ma atfi el nar

arabic: ريحة الزعتر السخن والخبز الطازة بتعبي شارع الجميزة الساعة سبعة الصبح.
english: The smell of hot thyme and fresh bread fills Gemmayzeh street at seven in the morning.
transliteration: Rihat el zaatar el sukhun wa el khubz el taza bitabbi sharie Gemmayzeh el saa sabaa el subh.

arabic: طارق، طالب عمرو عشرين سنة ودايماً متوتر، بدو منقوشة، بس معو بس خمسين ألف ليرة بجيبتو.
english: Tariq, a student whose age is twenty years and is always nervous, wants a man'oushe, but he has only fifty thousand liras in his pocket.
transliteration: Tariq, taleb omro ishrin sana wa dayman mutawattir, biddo manoushe, bas mao bas khamsin alef lira bi jibto.

arabic: هو سأل الخباز أبو فادي، مرحبا، كيفك، هدول بكفوا لمنقوشة زعتر؟
english: He asked the baker Abu Fadi, hello, how are you, are these enough for a thyme man'oushe?
transliteration: Huwwe saal el khabbaz Abu Fadi, marhaba, kifak, hadol bikaffu la manoushet zaatar?

arabic: أبو فادي ضحك وقال، يلا معلش، عطيني المصاري وخد فطورك.
english: Abu Fadi laughed and said, come on it is fine, give me the money and take your breakfast.
transliteration: Abu Fadi dihik wa aal, yalla maalesh, atini el masari wa khud ftourak.

arabic: طارق قال يسلمو، وأكل المنقوشة الطيبة قبل صفوفو بالجامعة.
english: Tariq said thank you, and ate the delicious man'oushe before his classes at the university.
transliteration: Tariq aal yeslamo, wa akal el manoushe el tayyibe abel sfoufo bil jameaa.

arabic: ريحة مناقيش الزعتر السخنة ملت شارع الحمرا الصبح، ورامي، طالب جامعة عمرو عشرين سنة ودائماً مستعجل، كان كتير جوعان.
english: The smell of hot zaatar manakish filled Hamra Street in the morning, and Rami, a twenty-year-old university student who is always in a hurry, was very hungry.
transliteration: rihet manaqeesh el-zaatar el-sukhneh malet shareh el-hamra el-soboh, w-rami, taleb jameah omro ishrin sneh w-daiman mistaajel, kan keteer juaan.

arabic: سأل أبو شادي، الخباز الختيار: "مرحبا، كيفك؟ بدي منقوشة زعتر هلق لو سمحت، بقديش؟"
english: He asked Abu Shadi, the old baker: "Hello, how are you? I want a zaatar manakish now please, how much is it?"
transliteration: sa'al abu shadi, el-khabbaz el-khetyar: "marhaba, kifak? biddi manqoushet zaatar hallaq law samaht, biqaddesh?"

arabic: مسح أبو شادي إيديه من الطحين وقال ببطء: "أهلا يا ابني، المنقوشة بمية وخمسين ألف ليرة لبنانية، بس إنت معك مية ألف بس."
english: Abu Shadi wiped his hands from the flour and said slowly: "Welcome my son, the manakish is for one hundred and fifty thousand Lebanese liras, but you only have one hundred thousand."
transliteration: masah abu shadi ideh min el-tahin w-qal bi-bot': "ahlan ya ibni, el-manqousheh bi-miyyeh w-khamseen alef lirah libnaniyyeh, bas inteh maak miyyet alef bas."

arabic: دور رامي بجياب شنتتو بسرعة، ومنيح إنو لقى خمسين ألف ليرة تانية جنب كتبو.
english: Rami searched in his bag's pockets quickly, and good thing that he found another fifty thousand liras next to his books.
transliteration: dawwar rami bi-jyab shantato bi-suraah, w-mneeh inno laqa khamseen alef lirah tanyeh janb kotbo.

arabic: "يلا، خذ المصاري أبو شادي، أعطيني المنقوشة لأنو صفوفي بتبلش بعد عشر دقايق!"
english: "Come on, take the money Abu Shadi, give me the manakish because my classes start after ten minutes!"
transliteration: "yalla, khid el-masari abu shadi, aateeni el-manqousheh la'inno sfoufi btabballish baad ayshar daqayeq!"

arabic: "يلا، بدي أي منقوشة بسرعة!" حكى طارق، طالب جامعة مستعجل عمرو تنين وعشرين سنة، للخباز بشارع الحمرا.
english: "Yalla, I want any man'ouche quickly!" said Tariq, an impatient university student who is twenty-two years old, to the baker on Hamra Street.
transliteration: "Yalla, biddi ay man'oucheh bisur'ah!" haka Tariq, talib jami'ah musta'jel 'umro tnein wa 'ishrin sanah, lil-khabbaz bishari' al-Hamra.

arabic: طارق كان بدو مناقيش لحمة، بس كان معو خمسين ألف ليرة لبنانية بس بجيباتو.
english: Tariq wanted meat manakish, but he had fifty thousand Lebanese Liras only in his pockets.
transliteration: Tariq kan biddo manaqish lahmeh, bas kan ma'o khamsin alf lirah libnaniyyeh bas bijiyabato.

arabic: "مناقيش اللحمة غالية هلق، بس عنا مناقيش زعتر رخيصة"، جاوبو أبو فادي، صاحب المحل الختيار.
english: "Meat manakish are expensive now, but we have cheap zaatar manakish," Abu Fadi, the old shop owner, answered him.
transliteration: "Manaqish al-lahmeh ghaliyeh hallaq, bas 'anna manaqish za'tar rakhisah," jawabo Abu Fadi, sahib al-mahal al-khtyar.

arabic: طارق غير رأيو واشترى منقوشتين زعتر لرفقاتو كمان.
english: Tariq changed his mind and bought two zaatar manouches for his friends too.
transliteration: Tariq ghayyar ra'yo wa ishtara man'oushtein za'tar lirifqato kaman.

arabic: الشباب أكلوا فطورهم وهن مبسوطين، وبعدين راحوا على صفوفهم بالجامعة.
english: The guys ate their breakfast while they were happy, and then they went to their classes at the university.
transliteration: Al-shabab akalu ftourhom wa henne mabsoutin, wa ba'dein rahu 'ala sfoufhom biljami'ah.

arabic: كان الجو غائم في الخريف وليث عم يسأل امه ليش السما هيك
english: The weather was cloudy in autumn and Laith was asking his mother why the sky was like this.
transliteration: Kan el jaw gha'em fil kharif w Laith am yis'al immo laish es-sama hek.

arabic: الام جاوبته بهدوء بس ليث ضل يسأل عن العاصفة والرياح القوية
english: His mother answered him calmly but Laith kept asking about the storm and the strong winds.
transliteration: El em jawabto bi hudoo bas Laith dall yis'al an el aasifa w er-riyah el qawiyyeh.

arabic: كل ما تجاوب سؤال كان عنده عشرة غيره والام بلشت تحس بالتعب شوي
english: Every time she answered a question he had ten others and the mother started to feel a bit tired.
transliteration: Kull ma tjawib su'al kan ando ashara ghairo w el em ballashit tehes bil ta'ab shway.

arabic: ماما شو هاد الصوت العالي وهاد الضو اللي بيطلع فجأة سأل ليث وهو بيأشر على الرعد والبرق
english: "Mama what is this loud sound and this light that appears suddenly" Laith asked pointing at the thunder and lightning.
transliteration: "Mama shoo had es-sowt el aali w had ed-daww illi bitla' faj'a" sa'al Laith w howe bya'asher ala er-ra'ed w el barq.

arabic: الام ابتسمت بتعب وحضنته عارفة ان فضوله ما رح يخلص اليوم
english: The mother smiled tiredly and hugged him knowing that his curiosity wouldn't end today.
transliteration: El em ibtasamit bi ta'ab w hadanto arfa in fudoolo ma rah yikhlas el yom.

arabic: ريحة القهوة القوية من كافيه قريب اختلطت بدخان عوادم السيارات القديمة بشارع الحمرا عصر هاليوم الخميس، وليلى، الطالبة الطموحة بالهندسة المعمارية وعمرها ٢٢ سنة، عم تتفقد ساعتها بعصبية.
english: The scent of strong coffee from a nearby café mingled with the exhaust fumes of old cars on Hamra Street this Thursday afternoon, as Layla, a determined 22-year-old architecture student, nervously checked her watch.
transliteration: Reehet al-qahwe al-qawiyye min kafeh qareeb ikhtalatat bi-dukhaan `awaadim as-sayyarat al-qadeeme bi-shaari` al-Hamra `asr ha-al-yom al-khamees, wa Layla, at-taalibe at-tamooha bil-handase al-mi`maariyye wa `omraha itnen wa `ishreen sane, `am titfaqad saa`itha bi-`asabiyye.

arabic: كانت كتير بدها توصل لورشة عمل مهمة بالأشرفية، عند ساحة ساسين، بس تاكسي السرفيس المشترك تبعها، مرسيدس قديمة مصدّية، كان عم يمشي بصعوبة بزحمة بيروت، وهالشي خلاها تقلق من التأخير.
english: She desperately needed to reach a crucial workshop in Achrafieh, near Sassine Square, but her shared service taxi, a rusty old Mercedes, was barely moving in the Beirut traffic, making her worry about being late.
transliteration: Kaanat kteer bidda tosal la-worshet `amal mohimme bil-Ashrafiye, `and saahet Sassine, bas taksi as-servees al-mushtarak taba`ha, Mercedes qadeeme msaddiye, kaan `am yemshee bi-so`oobe bi-zahmet Beirut, wa ha-al-shee khallaha taqlaq min at-ta'kheer.

arabic: السايق أبو فادي، الشب الحبوب اللي بيحكي كتير، ضل عم يسرد قصص عن أيام بيروت الحلوة، وليلى ببالها عم تحسب كم ليرة لبنانية وفرتها بأخد السرفيس بدل التاكسي الخاص، بس هلق الوقت صار أثمن.
english: The friendly, talkative driver, Abu Fadi, kept sharing stories about the city's golden days, while Layla mentally calculated how many Lebanese Liras she'd saved by taking a service instead of a private taxi, but now time was more precious.
transliteration: As-sayeq Abu Fadi, ash-shab al-haboob illi bi-yehki kteer, dall `am yesrod qisas `an ayyam Beirut al-helwe, wa Layla bi-balha `am tehseb kam leera Libnaniyye waffaratha bi-akhd as-servees badal at-taksi al-khaas, bas hallaq al-waqt saar athman.

arabic: "يا عمو، معلش تاخدني لحالي وتسرّع شوي؟ رح أدفع الأجرة كاملة كرمال الورشة،" قالت أخيراً بنبرة يأس خفيفة، وهي بتعرف إن هاد القرار رح يكلّفها جزء كبير من مصروفها الأسبوعي.
english: "Uncle, please, can you take me alone and speed up a bit? I'll pay the full fare for the workshop," she finally said with a hint of desperation, knowing this decision would cost her a significant chunk of her weekly allowance.
transliteration: "Ya `ammo, ma`lesh takhodni la-haali wa tsarre` shway? Rah adfa` al-ojra kaamlatan karamaal al-worshe," qaalat akheeran bi-nabret ya's khafeefe, wa heye bit`raf in haad al-qaraar rah ykallifha joz'a kabeer min masroofha al-osboo`i.

arabic: أبو فادي، متفاجئ بس متفهم، ابتسم وهز براسه، وبـ"يلا، تكرم عينك يا بنتي!" غير مساره باتجاه ساسين، متمنياً لليلى توصل بالوقت المناسب لحلمها.
english: Abu Fadi, surprised but understanding, smiled, nodded, and with a "Yalla, my dear daughter!" changed his route towards Sassine, hoping Layla would make it just in time for her dream.
transliteration: Abu Fadi, mutafaji' bas mutafahhem, ibtasam wa hazz bi-raso, wa bi-"Yalla, tekram `aynek ya binti!" ghayyar masareh b-ittejah Sassine, mutamanniyan li-Layla tosal bil-waqt al-munaaseb li-hilmaha.

arabic: كان في عتمة بالبيت بسبب انقطاع الكهرباء
english: There was darkness in the house because of the power cut.
transliteration: Kan fi a'tameh bel beit bisabab inqita' el kahraba.

arabic: ماما قالت الثلاجة ما عم تشتغل منيح وهالوضع صار صعب
english: Mom said the fridge isn't working well and this situation became difficult.
transliteration: Mama qalat el tallajeh ma am tishtaghel mneeh w hal wada' sar sa'ab.

arabic: بابا فكر شوي وقال لازم نلاقي حل سريع للحمة والخضرة
english: Dad thought a bit and said we need to find a quick solution for the meat and vegetables.
transliteration: Baba fakkar shway w qal lazim nlaqi hall saree' lal lahme w el khodra.

arabic: كل العيلة اجت تقعد معنا لنفكر سوا وهيك ما في داعي للنزوح من المطبخ
english: The whole family came to sit with us to think together, and this way there's no need to "displace" from the kitchen.
transliteration: Kull el ayleh ajat tiq'od ma'na lennfakker sawa w hek ma fi da'i la nnuzuh min el matbakh.

arabic: وبالآخر اتفقنا نحط كل شي عند بيت عمو لأن عنده مولد والجو دافي دايماً
english: And in the end, we agreed to put everything at Uncle's house because he has a generator and the atmosphere is always warm.
transliteration: W bel akher ettafa'na nhoT kull shi 'and beit ammo li'ann 'ando mawallid wel jaw dafi dayman.

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بس يوعى رامي بيقعد يسأل امه مليون سؤال
english: Every morning when Rami wakes up, he sits and asks his mother a million questions.
transliteration: Kull yom es-subeh bas yoo'a Rami biq'od yis'al immo malyoon su'al

arabic: صباح الخير ماما ليش لازم نفرشي اسناننا كل يوم قبل الفطور
english: Good morning mom, why do we have to brush our teeth every day before breakfast?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir mama leish laazem nfarshi asnan-na kull yom qabel el-fatoor

arabic: وبعدين بيرجع بيسأل ليش بتلبسي اواعي الشغل قبل ما انا البس تيابي
english: And then he returns to ask, "Why do you wear your work clothes before I wear my clothes?"
transliteration: W ba'dein bi'erja' bi'es'al leish btilbisi awa'i esh-shoghl qabel ma ana albos tiyabi

arabic: الام بتجاوب بتعب شوي بس بصبر يا حبيبي هيك كلنا بنعمل لنروح على شغلنا ومدارسنا
english: The mother answers with a little tiredness but with patience: "My darling, this is how we all do it to go to our work and schools."
transliteration: El-umm btijaweb bi ta'ab shway bass bi saber ya habibi heek kullna bni'mal la nrouh 'ala shoghlna w madarisna

arabic: رامي ما بيوقف اسئلة وبس يشوف ابوه بقوله السلام عليكم بابا ليش ما اكلت معنا
english: Rami doesn't stop asking questions, and when he sees his father, he says, "Peace be upon you dad, why didn't you eat with us?"
transliteration: Rami ma biwaqqif as'ila w bas yishouf abuh bi'ullu as-salāmu ʿalaykum baba leish ma akalt ma'na

arabic: مساء الخير ماما كيفك
english: Good evening mom, how are you?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr mama kayfik?

arabic: الام قالت انا منيحة شكرا حبيبي
english: The mother said: "I'm fine, thank you my dear."
transliteration: Al-omm qālat: Ana mnīḥa shukran habibi.

arabic: سأل كريم شو عم تعملي هلأ
english: Kareem asked: "What are you doing now?"
transliteration: Sa'al Kareem: Shoo 'am ta'mali hala'?

arabic: وبعدين شو بدك تاكلي
english: And then what do you want to eat?
transliteration: W ba'dein shoo biddik tākli?

arabic: الام ابتسمت وقالت يلا باي يا شاطر
english: The mother smiled and said: "Come on, bye clever one."
transliteration: Al-omm ibtasamat w qālat: Yalla bāy ya shāṭer.

arabic: رنت تلفون ليلى فجاوبت بسرعة
english: Layla's phone rang, so she answered quickly.
transliteration: Rannat telefon Layla fajaawabat bisur'a

arabic: قال صديقها احمد صباح الخير مرحبا كيفك ليلى
english: Her friend Ahmad said, "Good morning, hello, how are you Layla?"
transliteration: Qāl ṣadīqha Aḥmad ṣabāḥ al-khayr marḥaba kayfak Layla

arabic: ردت ليلى صباح النور اهلا وسهلا يا احمد انا بخير الحمد لله
english: Layla replied, "Morning of light, welcome Ahmad, I am fine, thank God."
transliteration: Raddat Layla ṣabāḥ an-nūr ahlan wa sahlan ya Aḥmad ana bikhayr al-ḥamdulillah

arabic: سالها احمد شو عم تعملي اليوم يا ليلى عندك شغل
english: Ahmad asked her, "What are you doing today, Layla? Do you have work?"
transliteration: Sa'alha Aḥmad shū ʿam taʿmali al-yōm yā Layla ʿandek shughl

arabic: جاوبت ليلى لا اليوم عطلة يمكن نطلع نشرب قهوة سوا
english: Layla replied, "No, today is a holiday. Maybe we can go out for coffee together."
transliteration: Jaawabat Layla la al-yōm ʿuṭla yumken niṭlaʿ nishrab qahwa sawa

arabic: ليلى وصديقاتها قرروا يخططوا لرحلة نهاية الأسبوع لأنهن حاسين بتعب كتير
english: Layla and her friends decided to plan a weekend trip because they were feeling very tired.
transliteration: Layla w sadeeqatiha qararo ykhattato la rehlet nihayet el osboo' la annahon haseen bi taab kteer.

arabic: اليوم كان طويل والشغل كتير وهالمشكلة المزعجة ما خلصت
english: The day was long and work was a lot, and this annoying problem wasn't over.
transliteration: El youm kan taweel w el shoghl kteer w hal mushkile el moezije ma khalleset.

arabic: فجأة نادين قالت بفرحة ليش ما نروح على الجبل ونغير جو شوي
english: Suddenly Nadine said joyfully, "Why don't we go to the mountain and change the atmosphere a bit!"
transliteration: Faj'a Nadeen qalet bi farha leish ma nrouh ala el jabal w nghayyer jaw shway!

arabic: كل البنات تحمسوا كتير لهالفكرة وصاروا يفكروا شو رح يعملوا هناك
english: All the girls got very excited about this idea and started thinking about what they would do there.
transliteration: Kull el banat tahammasu kteer la hal fekra w saru yfakkru shoo rah ya'melo honak.

arabic: حسوا براحة كبيرة إنهم رح يهربوا من ضغط المدينة ولو ليومين بس
english: They felt a great relief that they would escape the city's pressure, even if only for two days.
transliteration: Hassu bi raha kbeereh innahon rah yahrabu min daght el madeeneh w law la yomayn bas.

arabic: اليوم بدي اطبخ اكلة جديدة لاول مرة
english: Today I want to cook a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: Il-yoom biddi aṭbokh akle jdeedeh la awwal marra.

arabic: انا و ماما بندور على الوصفة على الانترنت
english: Me and mom are searching for the recipe on the internet.
transliteration: Ana w mama binḍawwer 3ala il-waṣfeh 3ala il-internet.

arabic: حطينا مي كتير وخضرا ودجاج
english: We put a lot of water, vegetables, and chicken.
transliteration: Ḥaṭṭeena mayy kteer w khaḍra w djaaj.

arabic: اخوي الصغير كتير مبسوط وعم بساعدنا
english: My little brother is very happy and helping us.
transliteration: Akhouy il-ṣgheer kteer mabṣouṭ w 3am bisa3idna.

arabic: الاكلة طلعت زاكية كتير وكلنا اكلنا
english: The dish turned out very tasty and we all ate.
transliteration: Il-akleh ṭil3et zakyeh kteer w kullna akalna.

arabic: الجرس رن فجأة ورفعت السماعة كان في عاصفة خريف قوية برة
english: The phone suddenly rang and I picked up the receiver; there was a strong autumn storm outside.
transliteration: Il-jaras rann faj'a w rafa't is-sama'a kaan fi 'aasifa khareef qawiyye barra.
storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

arabic: صوت صاحبتي كان واضح ودافي رغم الرعد والبرق يلي كانوا ماليين الجو
english: My friend's voice was clear and warm despite the thunder and lightning filling the air.
transliteration: Sawt sahbeti kaan wadeh w dafi raghm ir-ra'ed wil-barq yalli kaanu malliyeen il-jaw.
storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

arabic: سمعنا صوت الرعد بيقوى ويخف وضوء البرق عم يضوي الغرفة بسرعة خاطفة
english: We heard the sound of thunder getting stronger and weaker, and the lightning's light flashing through the room quickly.
transliteration: Sme'na sawt ir-ra'ed biyqwa w ykheff w dow' il-barq 'am yidawwi il-ghurfe bi-sur'a khatfa.
storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

arabic: ضحكنا على صوت الريح العاصف يلي هز الشباك وحكينا عن خططنا ليوم غائم دافي بالبيت
english: We laughed at the sound of the windy air shaking the window and talked about our plans for a warm cloudy day at home.
transliteration: Dehekna 'ala sawt ir-reeh il-'aasef yalli hazz ish-shubbak w hakeena 'an khutatna la-yom gha'em dafi bil-beet.
storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

arabic: وقت سكرت الخط ضليت حاسة بالجو البارد برة بس قلبي كان دافي من حكيها
english: When I hung up, I still felt the cold weather outside, but my heart was warm from her talk.
transliteration: Wa't sakkart il-khat dalleet hassa bil-jaw il-bared barra bas qalbi kaan dafi min hakyiha.
storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

arabic: رانيا عم تستنى سرفيس بشارع الحمرا، الساعة ٨:١٥ الصبح، وامتحانا ببلش على التسعة.
english: Rania is waiting for a shared taxi on Hamra Street; it's 8:15 AM, and her exam starts at nine.
transliteration: Rania a'm testanna servees bi shari' el Hamra, el saa'a tamanye w khamstaa'sh el subuh, w imtihana biballish 'ala el tis'a.

arabic: عادةً هي بتاخد السرفيس لأنه أرخص، تقريباً ٥ آلاف ليرة بالشخص الواحد.
english: Usually, she takes the shared taxi because it's cheaper, approximately 5,000 Liras per person.
transliteration: 'Aadatan hiye bta'khod el servees la'enno arkhas, taqriban khamsat alaf leera bish-shakhs el wahed.

arabic: بس اليوم، والله، ولا سرفيس عم يجي، أو يمكن كلهم مليانين. هي شافت كتير سيارات، بس ولا وحدة وقّفت.
english: But today, really, no shared taxi is coming, or maybe all of them are full. She saw many cars, but not a single one stopped.
transliteration: Bas el yoom, walla, wala servees a'm yiji, aw yumkin kulluhum malyanin. Hiye shafat kteer sayyarat, bas wala wahde waqqafet.

arabic: امتحانا، "مشاريع التخطيط العمراني"، كتير مهم لعلاماتها النهائية وهي درستله أيام طويلة.
english: Her exam, "Urban Planning Projects," is very important for her final grades, and she studied for it for many long days.
transliteration: Imtihana, "Mashari' el Takhteet el 'Omrani," kteer muhimm li'alamataha en-niha'iyeh w hiye darasetlu ayyam taweeleh.

arabic: هي رجعت شافت ساعتها؛ الساعة صارت ٨:٣٥، باقي بس ٢٥ دقيقة!
english: She looked at her watch again; it's 8:35 now, only 25 minutes left!
transliteration: Hiye raja'at shafat saa'atha; el saa'a sarat tamanye w khamse w talateen, baqi bas khamse w 'ishreen daqiqa!

arabic: رانيا قررت بسرعة: "رح آخد تاكسي عادي، لو كلّفني ٢٠ ألف ليرة!"
english: Rania decided quickly: "I will take a regular taxi, even if it costs me 20,000 Liras!"
transliteration: Rania qarrarat bi sur'a: "Rah akhed taxi 'aadi, law kallafni 'ishreen alf leera!"

arabic: وقّفت تاكسي بيجو قديم، دهانه باهت ونوافذه شوي معتمة.
english: She flagged down an old Peugeot taxi, its paint faded and its windows slightly tinted.
transliteration: Waqqafet taxi Peugeot qadeem, dihanu bahet w nawafedhu shwayy ma'teme.

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو! على الـ AUB لو سمحت، عندي امتحان مستعجل كتير، قالت وهي عم تلهث.
english: Good morning, uncle! To AUB please, I have a very urgent exam, she said, panting.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya 'ammu! 'Ala el AUB law samaht, 'andi imtihan musta'jel kteer, qalat w hiye 'am talhath.

arabic: السائق، أبو سامي، رجال كبير بالسن ولطيف، قال: "ما تاكلي هم يا بنتي، رح نوصل بالوقت، إنشالله." وابتسم.
english: The driver, Abu Sami, a kind elderly man, said: "Don't worry, my daughter, we will arrive on time, God willing." And he smiled.
transliteration: Es-sa'eq, Abu Sami, rajjal kbeer bissinn w lateef, qal: "Ma takli hamm ya binti, rah noosol bil waqt, inshallah." W ibtasam.

arabic: رانيا حست بشوي راحة؛ بتمنى مشاريعها رح تبهر أساتذتها هاد الفصل.
english: Rania felt a little relieved; she hopes her projects will impress her professors this semester.
transliteration: Rania hassat bi shwayy raha; bitmanna masharee'ha rah tibher asatizetha had el fasl.

arabic: اليوم أنا محتاجة تياب جديدة لأنو تيابي القديمة صغيرة
english: Today I need new clothes because my old clothes are small.
transliteration: Elyom ana mehtaja tiyab jdeede lianno tiyabi el adeeme sagheera

arabic: فرحت على المول الكبير والأضواء كانت كتير ساطعة
english: So I went to the big mall and the lights were very bright.
transliteration: Fa roht ala el mall el kbeer wal adwaa kanat kteer sate'a

arabic: جوا المحل كان فيه ريحة قماش جديد حلوة وموسيقى ناعمة عم تعزف
english: Inside the shop, there was a nice smell of new fabric and soft music playing.
transliteration: Juwwa el mahal kan fee reehet qamash jdeed helwe w museeqa naame am taazef

arabic: لمست قميص أزرق حسيتو كتير ناعم وقلت لازم قيس هاد
english: I touched a blue shirt that felt very soft and said "I must try this one."
transliteration: Lamast qamees azraq haseeto kteer naem w olt lazim qees had

arabic: بعد ما قستو حسيت حالي مبسوطة واشتريتو فوراً
english: After I tried it on, I felt happy and bought it immediately.
transliteration: Baad ma qesto haseet hali mabsoota w eshtareeto fawran

arabic: رحت السوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today
transliteration: Raḥt is-suu' il-yoom

arabic: شفت كتير اشيا
english: I saw many things
transliteration: Shuft ktiir ashya

arabic: كان في زلمة لابس قميص ازرق
english: There was a man wearing a blue shirt
transliteration: Kaan fii zalameh laabis qamiis azraq

arabic: وفي مرة كان عندها فستان احمر
english: And a woman had a red dress
transliteration: Wi fii mara kaan 'andaha fustaan aḥmar

arabic: اشتريت حذاء ابيض جديد
english: I bought new white shoes
transliteration: Ishtareet ḥiða' abyaḍ jdiid

arabic: انا وبنت اختي منخطط لعرس كبير
english: My niece and I are planning a big wedding.
transliteration: Ana w bint ukhti mnkhattat la 'arus kbeer.

arabic: هي بدها عرس جديد هون ببيت كبير
english: She wants a new wedding here in a big house.
transliteration: Hiyye baddaha 'arus jdeed hon b-beet kbeer.

arabic: بس بابا بدو عرس صغير وقديم بالضيعة
english: But Baba wants a small and old wedding in the village.
transliteration: Bas Baba baddo 'arus sagheer w adeem b-ad-day'a.

arabic: انا ما بحب عرس الضيعة كتير
english: I don't like the village wedding much.
transliteration: Ana ma bahebb 'arus ad-day'a kteer.

arabic: في مشكلة صغيرة هون
english: There is a small problem here.
transliteration: Fi mushkile sagheere hon.

arabic: نحنا قاعدين بالكافيه ومنستنى بابا
english: We are sitting at the cafe and waiting for Dad.
transliteration: Niḥna qaʿdiin bil kafe w mnestanna baba.

arabic: اختي سالتني شو بتحبي تلبسي
english: My sister asked me, "What do you (fem) like to wear?"
transliteration: Ukhti saʾalitni shu bteḥebbi telbesi?

arabic: انا بحب البس فساتين بس اليوم لبست كنزة صوف
english: I like to wear dresses, but today I wore a wool sweater.
transliteration: Ana baḥebb albass fasatiin bas el yoom labast kanze soof.

arabic: اخي سال شو بحب بابا يلبس
english: My brother asked, "What does Dad like to wear?"
transliteration: Akhi saʾal shu baḥebb baba yilbas?

arabic: بابا بحب يلبس تي شيرت قطن بالصيف
english: Dad likes to wear a cotton t-shirt in summer.
transliteration: Baba baḥebb yilbas ti-sheert qoṭon biṣ-ṣeif.

arabic: أنا كتير متحمس لرحلة نهاية الأسبوع يا ريت نخطط لمكان حلو
english: I'm very enthusiastic for the weekend trip, I wish we'd plan a nice place.
transliteration: Ana kteer mutahammis la reḥlit nihāyet il-usbūʿ ya reet nkhaṭṭeṭ la makan ḥelū.

arabic: أنا واثق إنو الشوف بجبال لبنان رح يكون روعة مع هوا منعش ومناظر خضرا
english: I'm confident that the Shouf in the mountains of Lebanon will be wonderful with fresh air and green views.
transliteration: Ana wathiq inno ash-Shouf bi-jbāl Lubnān raḥ ykūn rawʿa maʿ hawa mnaʿish w manāẓir khaḍra.

arabic: بس سؤال أنا فضولي أعرف في مكان فينا نقعد فيه قريب من النهر
english: But a question, I'm curious to know if there's a place where we can stay near the river?
transliteration: Bas su'āl ana fudooli aʿref fi makān fīna noqʿod fīh qareeb min in-nahar?

arabic: ايوة أنا متأكد لقينا كابين صغير ريحته خشب وجنبه صوت المي الحلو
english: Yes, I'm sure we found a small cabin that smells of wood and next to it is the sweet sound of the water.
transliteration: Aywa ana mta'akked laqeena cabin zghīr rīḥto khashab w janbo ṣōt il-mayy il-ḥelū.

arabic: خلينا نجهز أغراضنا ونشوف هالمكان الجميل قريباً
english: Let's prepare our things and see this beautiful place soon.
transliteration: Khallīna njehhiz aghrāḍna w nshūf hal-makān il-jamīl qarīban.

arabic: اهلا يا اصحاب خلينا نخطط لطلعة حلوة هالويك اند بعيد عن البيت
english: Hello friends, let's plan a nice trip this weekend away from the house.
transliteration: Ahla ya ashab, khallina nkhattat la tal'a helwe hal weekend ba'id 'an el bayt.

arabic: فكرت نروح بالسياره على الجبل نشم هوا نضيف ونشوف خضار حلو
english: I thought we could go by car to the mountain to smell fresh air and see beautiful greenery.
transliteration: Fakkart nruh bel sayyara 'al jabal nshemm hawa ndif w nshuf khdar helu.

arabic: اكيد بدنا نحضر اكل طيب ومي باردة كثير عشان نستمتع هناك
english: Of course, we need to prepare tasty food and a lot of cold water so we can enjoy ourselves there.
transliteration: Akid bedna nhaddir akel tayyeb w mayy barde ktir 'ashan nestamte' hnak.

arabic: لازم نجهز الفلوس ونخلص كل الشغل قبل ما نروح مشان نرتاح
english: We must prepare the money and finish all the work before we go so we can relax.
transliteration: Lazem njahez el flus w nkhalles koll el shoghl qabel ma nruh meshhan nertaah.

arabic: كيف رح يكون هالويك اند رائع مليان ضحكات وشمس دافية
english: How wonderful this weekend will be, full of laughter and warm sun!
transliteration: Kiif rah ykun hal weekend ra'e' malyan dahakat w shames dafye!

arabic: انا كنت ماشي بالشارع الصبح
english: I was walking in the street in the morning.
transliteration: Ana kuntu māshi bish-shāreʿ ṣubḥ.

arabic: فجأة شفت صديقي القديم احمد
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed!
transliteration: Faj'atan shuftu ṣadīqī al-qadīm Aḥmad!

arabic: احمد قال مرحبا صباح الخير
english: Ahmed said: "Hello! Good morning!"
transliteration: Aḥmad qāl: "Marḥaba! ṣabāḥ al-khayr!"

arabic: انا رديت صباح النور يا احمد اهلا وسهلا
english: I replied: "Morning of light, Ahmed, welcome!"
transliteration: Ana raddayt: "ṣabāḥ an-nūr yā Aḥmad, ahlan wa sahlan!"

arabic: كان يوم حلو كتير لما شفته
english: It was a very nice day when I saw him.
transliteration: Kān yawm ḥilu ktīr lammā shuftuh.

arabic: اجتمعت العائلة ببيت الجدة و ريحة الاكل اللذيذ ملت المطبخ
english: The family gathered at grandmother's house, and the smell of delicious food filled the kitchen.
transliteration: Ijtama'at il-'aa'ila b-beit il-jidde w rīḥit il-akl il-ladhīdh mallat il-maṭbakh.

arabic: كانت السفرة مليانة اطباق ملونة و صوت الضحك اختلط بالاحاديث الحلوة
english: The dining table was full of colorful dishes, and the sound of laughter mixed with sweet conversations.
transliteration: Kānat is-sufra malyāne aṭbāq mulawwane w ṣōt iḍ-ḍiḥik ikhtalaṭ bil-aḥādīth il-ḥilwe.

arabic: عمتي جابت خبز طازج و صحن سلطة فيه بصل و توم و كتير زيت زيتون
english: My aunt brought fresh bread and a bowl of salad with onions, garlic, and plenty of olive oil.
transliteration: 'Ammati jābat khubz ṭāzej w ṣaḥn salaṭa fīh baṣal w tūm w ktīr zeit zeitoun.

arabic: الكل كان عم ياكل و هو مبسوط مستمتعين بالجو الدافي و النكهات الرائعة
english: Everyone was eating happily, enjoying the warm atmosphere and the wonderful flavors.
transliteration: Il-kill kān 'am yākōl w huwwa mabsūṭ, mustamti'īn bil-jaww id-dāfī w in-nakahāt ir-rā'i'a.

arabic: بعد الاكل قعدنا كلنا عم نشرب شاي سخن و نكمل سهرتنا الممتعة
english: After the meal, we all sat together drinking hot tea and continuing our pleasant evening gathering.
transliteration: Ba'd il-akl qa'adna killna 'am nishrab shāy sukhan w inkammil sahratna il-mumti'a.

arabic: كان يوم خريف غائم وممطر بشدة في رعد وبرق
english: It was a cloudy and heavily rainy autumn day with thunder and lightning.
transliteration: Kan yom kharif gha'em w momter bi shidda fi ra'ed w barq.

arabic: جدتي وجدي قاعدين جنب الشباك عم يشربوا شاي دافي ومبسوطين بالجو العاصف
english: My grandma and grandpa were sitting by the window drinking warm tea and enjoying the stormy weather.
transliteration: Jaddeti w jaddi qa'din janb esh-shubbak 'am yishrabu shay dafi w mabsootin bil jaw el 'asef.

arabic: بس أحفادهم الصغار كانوا عم يتذمروا من الملل وبدهم يلعبوا برا وما فارق معهم المطر
english: But their young grandchildren were complaining of boredom and wanted to play outside, not caring about the rain.
transliteration: Bas ahfādhum es-sghar kanu 'am yitdhammaru min el malal w baddhum yil'abu barra w ma fareq ma'hum el matar.

arabic: جدتي حكت بزمانا كنا نركض تحت المطر ونفرح بالعاصفة ما كانت تهمنا البرودة
english: My grandma said, "In our time, we used to run under the rain and be happy with the storm; the cold didn't matter to us."
transliteration: Jaddeti hakat "bi zamana kunna norkod taht el matar w nifrah bil 'asifa ma kanat tihimna el buruda."

arabic: هيك كل واحد بالبيت عم يعيش نفس يوم الخريف بطريقته الخاصة
english: Thus, everyone in the house was living the same autumn day in their own special way.
transliteration: Hayk koll wahad bil bayt 'am ya'ish nafs yom el kharif bi tariqto el khassa.

arabic: بينما ليلى، طالبة الادب اللي عمرها ٢٨ سنة والمشهورة بعينها الحادة، كانت عم تدور على دلة مميزة بسوق الحميدية بدمشق لـ عيد ميلاد ستي، وقع نظرها فجأة على دلة نحاسية قديمة عم تلمع ومخبية بين اكياس البهارات بمحل ابو ماجد الصغير اللي ريحته بتشهي.
english: While Layla, a 28-year-old literature student famous for her sharp eye, was searching for a unique dallah in Damascus's bustling Souk Al-Hamidiyah for her grandmother's birthday, her gaze unexpectedly fell upon a gleaming, antique copper coffee pot hidden amongst sacks of spices in Abu Majed's small, fragrant shop.
transliteration: Baynama Layla, talibat al-adab illi 'omraha 28 saneh wil-mashhoora bi 'ainha al-hadda, kanat 'am tidawwer 'ala dallah mumayyazeh bi Souq al-Hamidiyah bi Dimashq la 'eid milad sitti, waqa' nazarha faj'atan 'ala dallah nahhasieh qadimah 'am tilma' wimkhabbayeh bein akyaas il-baharat bi mahall Abu Majed il-saghir illi reehto bittishahi.
storyTitle: A Hidden Gem in Souk Al-Hamidiyah

arabic: خير يا ستي، هي شو عم تعمل هون؟ تمتمت وهي تستغرب وجود تحفة فنية كهذه في محل بهارات، متسائلة إن كانت معروضة للبيع أم أنها مجرد قطعة زينة.
english: "Oh dear, what is this doing here?" she murmured, wondering at the presence of such a work of art in a spice shop, questioning whether it was for sale or merely a decorative piece.
transliteration: "Kheir ya sitti, hay shoo 'am ta'mel hoon?" tamtamit wiyye istaghribat wujoud tuhfah fanniyyah ka-hazih fi mahall baharat, mutasa'ilah in kanat ma'roudah lil-bei' am innaha mujarrad qit'at zeenah.
storyTitle: A Hidden Gem in Souk Al-Hamidiyah

arabic: اقتربت من ابو ماجد، صاحب المحل الطيب والملتحي، لتسأله عنها، فاجاب بتردد: هي كانت دلة الست الله يرحمها... ما ببيعها هيك بسهولة، يا بنتي.
english: She approached Abu Majed, the kind, bearded shop owner, to ask him about it, and he replied hesitantly: "This was my late wife's dallah... I don't sell it easily like this, my daughter."
transliteration: Iqtarabat min Abu Majed, sahib il-mahall il-tayyib wil-multahi, litas'aloh 'anha, fa-ajab bi-taraddud: "Hay kanat dallit is-sitt Allah yirhamha... ma babee'aha heik bi-suhoola, ya binti."
storyTitle: A Hidden Gem in Souk Al-Hamidiyah

arabic: بعد ان شرحت ليلى بصدق عن نيتها شراء الدلة كهدية لجدتها المحبة للقهوة، لاحظ ابو ماجد الاخلاص في عينيها اللتين تذكرانه بعيني زوجته الراحلة.
english: After Layla sincerely explained her intention to buy the dallah as a gift for her coffee-loving grandmother, Abu Majed noticed the sincerity in her eyes, which reminded him of his late wife's eyes.
transliteration: Ba'da an sharahat Layla bi-sidq 'an niyyatha shira' ad-dallah ka-hadiyeh li-jaddatha al-muhibbah lil-qahwah, لاحظ Abu Majed al-ikhlas fi 'ainayha illatain tudhakkiranaho bi-'ainai zawjatihi ar-rahilah.
storyTitle: A Hidden Gem in Souk Al-Hamidiyah

arabic: فابتسم وقال: خلص، خديها مني يا بنتي، بس على شرط واحد: تعملي فيها قهوة سادة لجدتك كل يوم، وعليها بركة امي. ثم اعطاها الدلة بسعر رمزي، مؤكداً أن قيمتها المعنوية أهم من أي ليرة سورية.
english: So he smiled and said: "Alright, take it from me, my daughter, but on one condition: that you make plain coffee in it for your grandmother every day, and it carries my mother's blessing." Then he gave her the dallah for a symbolic price, affirming that its sentimental value was more important than any Syrian lira.
transliteration: Fa-ibtassam wa qal: "Kallas, khudiha minni ya binti, bas 'ala shart wahad: ta'mali fiha qahwah sada la-jaddatik kull yawm, wa 'alayha barakat ummi." Thumma a'taha ad-dallah bi-si'r ramzi, mu'akkidan anna qimatha al-ma'nawiyyah ahamm min ayy lira Suriyyah.
storyTitle: A Hidden Gem in Souk Al-Hamidiyah

arabic: الشتي كتير برا اليوم
english: It's raining a lot outside today.
transliteration: El sheti kteer barra el yom

arabic: انا بدي قهوة سخنة هلق
english: I want hot coffee now.
transliteration: Ana biddi ahwe sakhne hallaq

arabic: يا امي بدك شاي كمان
english: Mom, do you want tea too?
transliteration: Ya emmi biddik shay kaman?

arabic: امي قالت اي عندي كعك طيب
english: Mom said, 'Yes, I have delicious cookies.'
transliteration: Emmi alet ee endi ka'ek tayyeb

arabic: بدنا نقعد سوا ونسمع المطر
english: We want to sit together and listen to the rain.
transliteration: Bidna niq'od sawa w nisma' el matar

arabic: انا بدي روح رحلة بكرا
english: I want to go on a trip tomorrow.
transliteration: Ana biddi rooh rihla bukra.

arabic: وين نروح على الجبل
english: Where do we go? To the mountain?
transliteration: Wain nrooh? Ala el jabal?

arabic: ايوا الجبل حلو كتير ومعنا سيارة
english: Yes, the mountain is very nice and we have a car.
transliteration: Aywa el jabal helu kteer w ma'ana sayyara.

arabic: بدي قهوة حلوة وفندق صغير هناك
english: I want nice coffee and a small hotel there.
transliteration: Biddi ahwe helwe w funduq zghir honik.

arabic: بس السيارة مو هون اليوم
english: But... the car is not here today!
transliteration: Bas... el sayyara moo hoon el yom!

arabic: اليوم قررت اجرب وصفة جديدة بالمطبخ
english: Today I decided to try a new recipe in the kitchen.
transliteration: El-yom qarrart ajareb wasfe jdide bil-matbakh.

arabic: فكرت انها رح تكون سهل بس كانت شوي صعب
english: I thought it would be easy but it was a bit difficult.
transliteration: Fakkart enna-ha raḥ tkun sahel bas kanat shway sa'eb.

arabic: عملت كل شي خطوة بخطوة وكنت قلقانة كتير
english: I did everything step by step and I was very worried.
transliteration: Amalt koll shi khatwe b-khatwe w-kent qala'ane kteer.

arabic: بعد ما خلصت اكلت اول لقمة وكانت لذيذة كتير
english: After I finished, I ate the first bite and it was very delicious.
transliteration: Ba'ed ma khallaṣet akalt awwal loqme w-kanat ladheedha kteer.

arabic: صرت كتير مبسوطة ورح اعملها مرة تانية بكرة
english: I became very happy and I will make it again tomorrow.
transliteration: Sert kteer mabsooṭa w-raḥ a'melha marra tanye bokra.

arabic: اليوم الصبح انا ماشي على الشغل
english: Today morning I am walking to work.
transliteration: Al-yoom as-sobuh ana maashi a'al ash-shoghl.

arabic: فجأة شفت صديقي القديم رامي
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Rami.
transliteration: Faj'ah shoft sadeeqi al-qadeem Rami.

arabic: قلتله صباح الخير كيفك وهو رد صباح النور اهلا وسهلا
english: I told him "Good morning, how are you?" and he replied "Morning of light, welcome."
transliteration: Qultillo sabah al-khayr keefak w huwa radd sabah an-noor ahlan wa sahlan.

arabic: سألته انت كمان رايح عالشغل
english: I asked him "Are you also going to work?"
transliteration: Sa'alto inta kamaan rayeh a'al ash-shoghl?

arabic: هو قال اي عندي شغل هلا
english: He said "Yes, I have work now."
transliteration: Huwa qaal ee indi shoghl halla.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي كيفك اليوم
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you today?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya jaarti, keefik el-yoom?
storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

arabic: الحمد لله انا مبسوطة كتير انا اترقيت الشهر هاد بالشغل
english: Thank God, I'm very happy. I got a promotion this month at work.
transliteration: El-hamdu lillah, ana mabsoota kteer. Ana -traggēt iššáhir hād bil-shoghl.
storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

arabic: مبروك حبيبتي بس احنا كمان مبسوطين عم نجهز للعرس الجديد بالعيلة
english: Congratulations, my dear! But we are also happy, we are preparing for the new wedding in the family.
transliteration: Mabrook habibti! Bas ihna kamaan mabsooteen, am njehhez lil-ers il-jdeed bil-a'ileh.
storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

arabic: اه العرس مهم و اكيد في فرح كبير بس انا عندي هدف اكبر لعملي
english: Oh, the wedding is important and surely there is great joy, but I have a bigger goal for my work.
transliteration: Ah, el-ers mohemm w akeed fee farah kbeer, bas ana a'andi hadaf akbar li-'amali.
storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

arabic: ان شاء الله كلنا بنكون مبسوطين باهدافنا وعيلتنا يا رب
english: God willing, we will all be happy with our goals and our family, O Lord.
transliteration: In sha Allah kullna binkoon mabsooteen bi-ahdafna w a'ilatna ya rabb.
storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

arabic: مساء الخير يا جدتي الإنترنت بالبيت بطيء كتير اليوم
english: Good evening, grandma. The internet at home is very slow today.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr ya jaddati. Al-internet bil-bayt baṭīʾ ktīr il-yōm.

arabic: الجدة قالت لليلى زمان ما كان في إنترنت وكنا منيحين
english: The grandmother said to Layla, "In the past, there was no internet, and we were fine."
transliteration: Al-jadda qālat li-Layla: "Zamān ma kān fī internet, w-kunnā mnīḥīn."

arabic: ليلى بدها تشوف فيديو بس ما عم يشتغل
english: Layla wants to watch a video but it's not working.
transliteration: Layla biddha tishūf fīdyū bas ma ʿam yishtaghil.

arabic: الجدة قالت بس انتي فيكي تقراي كتاب يا حبيبتي
english: The grandmother said, "But you can read a book, my dear."
transliteration: Al-jadda qālat: "Bas inti fīki taqraʾī kitāb ya ḥabībti."

arabic: ليلى تنهدت وقالت انا منيحة شكراً جدتي
english: Layla sighed and said, "I'm fine, thank you, grandma."
transliteration: Layla tanahhadat w-qālat: "Ana mnīḥa, shukran jaddati."

arabic: كنت عم بمشي بالسوق القديم وشميت ريحة قهوة طازة
english: I was walking in the old market and smelled fresh coffee.
transliteration: Kunt 'am bamshi bi-s-souq el-qadeem w shammeit reehet qahwe taza

arabic: فجأة شفت وش مألوف كان رفيقي القديم رامي
english: Suddenly I saw a familiar face, it was my old friend Rami.
transliteration: Faj'a shuft wesh ma'louf, kaan rafee'i el-qadeem Rami

arabic: ناديت على اسمه بصوت عالي ولف وشافني بابتسامة كبيرة
english: I called his name loudly and he turned around and saw me with a big smile.
transliteration: Nadeit 'ala ismo bi-sout 'aali w laff w shafni b-ibtisaame kbeere

arabic: حضنا بعض بحرارة وبلشنا نحكي عن حياتنا وذكرياتنا
english: We hugged each other warmly and started talking about our lives and memories.
transliteration: Hadanna ba'd bi-haraara w ballashna nehki 'an hayaatna w zikrayaatna

arabic: قررنا نلتقي للغدا الأسبوع الجاي لنحكي أكتر
english: We decided to meet for lunch next week to talk more.
transliteration: Qarrarna nilta'i lil-ghada el-usbou' el-jaay l-nehki aktar

arabic: راحت ليلا على السوق وكانت كتير مبسوطة
english: Layla went to the market and was very happy
transliteration: Rāḥat Laylā ʿala s-sūq w kānatt ktīr mabṣūṭa

arabic: شافت صديقتها منى هناك
english: She saw her friend Mona there
transliteration: Shāfat ṣadīqtahā Munā hunāk

arabic: قالت لها مساء الخير كيفك يا منى
english: She said to her Good evening, how are you Mona
transliteration: Qālat lahā masāʾ al-khayr kayfik yā Munā

arabic: منى جاوبت انا منيحة شكرا
english: Mona answered I'm fine thank you
transliteration: Munā jāwabat ana mnīḥa shukran

arabic: بعدين ليلا ومنى قالوا مع السلامة
english: Then Layla and Mona said goodbye
transliteration: Baʿdīn Laylā w Munā qālū maʿ as-salāma

arabic: امبارح نمت بكير كتير بس اليوم صحيت متاخر
english: Yesterday I slept very early, but today I woke up late.
transliteration: Imbaareh nemt bakkeer kteer bas el yoom saḥeet mit'akhkher.

arabic: رحت عالشغل بسرعة ونسيت فطوري على الطاولة
english: I went to work quickly and forgot my breakfast on the table.
transliteration: Roḥt 3ash-shoġol bi sur3a w nseet fuṭoori 3al ṭaawle.

arabic: بالمكتب رفيقي قالي انت اكلت الغداء
english: At the office, my friend asked me,
transliteration: Bil maktab rfi'i 'aali enta akalt el ghada?

arabic: ضحكت وقلت له انا حتى ما اكلت فطوري اليوم
english: I laughed and told him,
transliteration: Ḍiḥekt w 'ultello ana ḥatta ma akalt fuṭoori el yoom.

arabic: بعدين رحت على الكافتيريا وشربت كل القهوة الموجودة
english: Then I went to the cafeteria and drank all the coffee there.
transliteration: Ba3deen roḥt 3al kaafiteeria w sharibt kell el 'ahwe el mawjoode.

arabic: بدنا نروح مشوار هالويكند
english: We want to go on a trip this weekend.
transliteration: Bedna nrouḥ meshwar halweeknd.

arabic: بس اول شي لازم نشتري اغراض من السوق
english: But first, we need to buy things from the market.
transliteration: Bas awwal shi lazim neshtari aghrad men es-souq.

arabic: رحت على السوق بسرعة لاشتري خضرة وتفاح
english: I went to the market quickly to buy vegetables and apples.
transliteration: Roḥt 'ala es-souq be sor'a la'ashtari khoḍra w tuffaḥ.

arabic: كان في ناس كتير وبياع واحد عم ببيع تفاح كتير مضحك
english: There were many people and one vendor was selling very funny apples.
transliteration: Kan fi nas kteer w bayya' waḥad 'am byabee' tuffaḥ kteer moḍḥek.

arabic: اشتريت التفاح بس بعدين السما صارت تمطر والمشوار يمكن يصير للمطبخ
english: I bought the apples, but then the sky started to rain, so the trip might be to the kitchen instead!
transliteration: Eshtarayt et-tuffaḥ bas ba'deen es-sama ṣarat tomṭor wal-meshwar yemkin yseer lel-maṭbakh.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي كيفك اليوم
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you today?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya jarti keifik el-yom

arabic: صباح النور الحمد لله بس سقف المطبخ عم ينقط
english: Good morning, praise be to God, but the kitchen ceiling is dripping.
transliteration: Sabah en-nour alhamdulillah bas saqf el-maṭbakh 'am yenqoṭ

arabic: يا الله الدنيا عم تمطر كتير ويمكن لازم تصلحيها بسرعة
english: Oh God, it's raining a lot, and maybe you need to fix it quickly.
transliteration: Ya Allah ed-dunya 'am tomṭor kteer w yemken lazem tṣallḥiha be sor'a

arabic: اي والله مبارح اجا البياع وصلحها كويس
english: Yes, by God, yesterday the vendor came and fixed it well.
transliteration: Ay wallah mbareḥ aja el-bayya' w ṣallaḥha kwayyes

arabic: ممتاز هيك ما بتخافي من المطر والسوق في تفاح وخضرة كتير
english: Excellent, this way you won't be afraid of the rain. And the market has many apples and vegetables.
transliteration: Mumtaz heik ma betkhafi men el-maṭar. W es-souq fi tuffaḥ w khoḍra kteer

arabic: الجو عم يتغير صار خريف وبدي اواعي دافية جديدة
english: The weather is changing, it's autumn, and I need new warm clothes.
transliteration: El jaw a'am yitghayyar, sar kharif w biddee awa'i dafiyeh jidideh.

arabic: رحت على السوق لادور على جاكيت دافي وحلو
english: I went to the market to look for a nice warm jacket.
transliteration: Ruht a'al souq la'addawwar a'ala jacket dafi w helu.

arabic: البياع قال عندنا خيارات كتيرة خاصة لهاد الجو الغائم والعاصف
english: The salesperson said We have many options, especially for this cloudy and windy weather.
transliteration: El bayya' qaal a'andna khiyarat ktireh khasseh lahad el jaw el gha'em wal a'asef.

arabic: قست كنزة سميكة وكانت كتير دافية ومريحة
english: I tried on a thick sweater, it was very warm and comfortable.
transliteration: Qist kanzeh smikeh w kanat kteer dafiyeh w mriheh.

arabic: اشتريتها فورا لانه بدي شي لما يصير في رعد وبرق
english: I bought it immediately because I needed something for when there's thunder and lightning.
transliteration: Ishtarayta fawran la'anno biddee shi lamma yseer fi ra'ed w barq.

arabic: ليلى شافت موبايلها مرة تانية، بس الشاشة كانت سودا؛ هي ضاعت بحمرا أكيد، واجتماع التبرعات قرب.
english: Layla checked her phone again, but the screen was black; she was definitely lost in Hamra, and the donations meeting was soon.
transliteration: Layla shafet mobaylha marra tanya, bas el shasha kanet sawda; hiya da'et bi Hamra akeed, w'ejtima' el tabarru'at 'arrab.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: هي كانت تتساءل عن كيفية الوصول لملجأ الأيتام الجديد اللي تخص فيه جلسات مكثفة للبنات النازحة.
english: She was wondering about how to get to the new orphanage shelter that concerns intensive sessions for displaced girls.
transliteration: Hiya kanet tatasa'al 'an kayfiyyat el wusool li-malja' el aytam el jadeed illi takhus feeh jalasat mukaththafa lil-banat el nazihah.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: معلش، يا عمو، ممكن تدلني على مكتب جمعية "أمل مستدامة" قريبة من هون؟
english: Excuse me, uncle, could you show me the way to the office of the "Sustainable Hope" association near here?
transliteration: Ma'lesh, ya 'ammu, mumkin tedellni 'ala maktab jam'iyyat "Amal Mustadama" 'areebeh min hon?
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: الشايب صاحب محل الفلافل، اللي قادة كتير متل حكيم، ابتسم وقال: "شوفي يا بنتي، إمشي دغري وبعدين لفّي يمين عند كشك الجرائد الملونة."
english: The elderly owner of the falafel shop, who has guided many like a wise person, smiled and said: "Look, my daughter, walk straight and then turn right at the colorful newspaper stand."
transliteration: El shayeb sahib mahal el falafel, illi qadah kteer metl hakeem, ibtasam w 'al: "Shufi ya binti, imshi doghri w ba'deen laffi yameen 'ind koshk el jara'ed el mulawwana."
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: "وبعدين؟" سألت ليلى وهي بتحاول تتذكر كل التفاصيل، "يعني مش بعيد كتير عن جامع الحمرا؟"
english: "And then?" Layla asked, trying to remember all the details, "So it's not very far from Hamra Mosque?"
transliteration: "W ba'deen?" sa'alet Layla w hiya bit-hawel titdhakkar kull el tafaseel, "Ya'ni mish ba'eed kteer 'an Jame' el Hamra?"
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: "بالزبط، هو قدامك بعد لفتين صغار، بس انتبهي فيه بسطة عصير جلاب تناثرت حواليها كاسات."
english: "Exactly, it's in front of you after two small turns, but pay attention, there's a jallab juice stand with scattered cups around it."
transliteration: "Bilzabt, huwwa 'uddamak ba'd laftayn zghar, bas intibhi feeh bastet 'aseer jallab tanatharat hawaliha kasat."
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: ليلى نهضت بسرعة وشكرت العم أبو فادي، شعرت إنه كلامه كان وحكيماً وواضحاً جداً.
english: Layla quickly got up and thanked Uncle Abu Fadi, feeling that his words were wise and very clear.
transliteration: Layla nahadat bi sur'ah w shakarit el 'amm Abu Fadi, sha'arat inno kalamy kan wa hakiman w wadehan jiddan.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: مشيت ليلى دغري، مثل ما قال، وفعلاً لقت كشك الجرائد الملونة على يمينها، بالضبط عند الزاوية.
english: Layla walked straight, as he said, and indeed she found the colorful newspaper stand on her right, exactly at the corner.
transliteration: Mashyet Layla doghri, mithel ma 'al, w fa'lan la'at koshk el jara'ed el mulawwana 'ala yameenha, bil dabt 'ind el zawyeh.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: وبعد لفتين صغار، شافت اللافتة الكبيرة لجمعية "أمل مستدامة" فوق محل قديم، قبل بسطة الجلاب الطارئة.
english: And after two small turns, she saw the large sign for the "Sustainable Hope" association above an old shop, just before the emergency jallab stand.
transliteration: W ba'd laftayn zghar, shafet el lafteh el kbeereh li-jam'iyyat "Amal Mustadama" fawq mahal 'adeem, qabl bastet el jallab el tare'a.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: تنفست الصعداء ودخلت، جاهزة لمناقشة المشاريع المستدامة وتقديم التبرعات، شاكرةً العم أبو فادي على مساعدته وحكيماً.
english: She breathed a sigh of relief and entered, ready to discuss the sustainable projects and deliver the donations, thanking Uncle Abu Fadi for his help and wisdom.
transliteration: Tanaffasat el su'ada' w dakhalat, jaheza li-munaqashat el mashare' el mustadama w taqdeem el tabarru'at, shakira 'amm Abu Fadi 'ala musa'adetoh wa hakiman.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: خلال طريقها، لاحظت ليلى كيف تناثرت الأوراق الملونة من إعلانات قديمة على الأرض بالقرب من المكتب.
english: On her way, Layla noticed how colorful papers from old advertisements were scattered on the ground near the office.
transliteration: Khilal tareeqha, lahazat Layla kayfa tanatharat el awraq el mulawwana min i'lanat qadeema 'ala el ard bil qurb min el maktab.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: كانت تفكر في قادة المجتمع وكيف يجب أن يتعاملوا بحكمة مع قضايا النازحة والاحتياجات الطارئة.
english: She was thinking about community leaders and how they should wisely deal with the issues of the displaced and emergency needs.
transliteration: Kanet tfakker fi qadat el mujtama' w kayfa yajib an yata'amalu bi hikmah ma' qadaya el nazihah w el ihtiyajat el tare'a.
storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

arabic: اليوم كان الجو غائم كتير وبلش الخريف
english: Today the weather was very cloudy and autumn began.
transliteration: El yōm kān el jaw ghā'em ktīr w ballash el kharīf.

arabic: اتصلت بصديقتي مريم لحتى اطمن عليها واسالها كيف الجو عندها
english: I called my friend Mariam to check on her and ask her how the weather was with her.
transliteration: Ettasalt b sadeeqati Maryam la hatta atma'en 'alayha w as'alha kayf el jaw 'endaha.

arabic: قالتلي الجو هون عاصفة قوية وفي رعد وبرق عم يخوفوا
english: She told me the weather here is a strong storm and there is frightening thunder and lightning.
transliteration: Qalatli el jaw hōn 'asifa qawiyya w fi ra'ed w barq 'am yekhawwfu.

arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت برق كتير قوي وقطعت الكهربا والخط انقطع
english: Suddenly I heard a very loud lightning sound, the electricity cut off, and the line disconnected.
