transliteration: Faj'atan same't sawt barq ktīr qawe w qata'at el kahraba w el khatt enqata'.

arabic: لما رجع الخط ضحكت مريم وقالت انا برا بيتك سمعت نفس الصوت وهلا رح ادخل
english: When the line reconnected, Mariam laughed and said I'm outside your house, I heard the same sound, and now I'm coming in.
transliteration: Lamma raja' el khatt dahaket Maryam w qalat ana barra baytak same't nafs el sawt w hala rah adkhul.

arabic: انا بروح على الشغل الصبح
english: I go to work in the morning.
transliteration: ana barūḥ ‘ala esh-shoghl eṣ-ṣobeḥ

arabic: بشوف ناس كتير وبياع بالسوق
english: I see many people and a vendor in the market.
transliteration: bashūf nas ktīr w bayya‘ bi-s-sūq

arabic: البياع عنده تفاح وخضرة حلوة
english: The vendor has nice apples and vegetables.
transliteration: el-bayya‘ ‘endo tuffaḥ w khoḍra ḥelwe

arabic: فجأة بلشت تمطر بسرعة
english: Suddenly it started to rain quickly.
transliteration: faj'a ballashit tomṭor be sor'a

arabic: رجعت على البيت ودخلت المطبخ
english: I returned home and entered the kitchen.
transliteration: reji‘t ‘ala el-bēt w dakhalet el-maṭbakh

arabic: اليوم رحت انا وجدي على السوق
english: Today, my grandfather and I went to the market.
transliteration: Al-yom roht ana w jeddi 3al souq
storyTitle: A Trip to the Market: Different Generations

arabic: جدي بيحب يشتري الخضار من البياع القديم اللي بيعرفه
english: My grandfather likes to buy vegetables from the old seller he knows.
transliteration: Jeddi bihebb yeshteri al-khodar men al-bayya' al-adeem illi bi3arfo
storyTitle: A Trip to the Market: Different Generations

arabic: انا بدي شوف المحلات الجديدة وبشوف الاسعار
english: I want to see the new shops and check the prices.
transliteration: Ana beddi shouf al-mahallat al-jdeedeh w bashouf al-as3ar
storyTitle: A Trip to the Market: Different Generations

arabic: هو بيقول الخضار القديمة احلى بس انا بفكر الاسعار كتير غالية اليوم
english: He says the old vegetables are nicer but I think the prices are very expensive today.
transliteration: Howwe biqoul al-khodar al-adeemeh ahla bass ana bafakker al-as3ar ktheer ghaliyeh al-yom
storyTitle: A Trip to the Market: Different Generations

arabic: يمكن كل جيل عنده طريقة مختلفة يحب السوق فيها
english: Maybe each generation has a different way they like the market.
transliteration: Yemken koll jeel 3ando taree'a mokhtalifeh yihebb al-souq feeha
storyTitle: A Trip to the Market: Different Generations

arabic: اليوم في مطر كثير برا البيت
english: Today there is a lot of rain outside the house.
transliteration: Elyōm fī maṭar kthīr barra el-beit.

arabic: انا قاعد جوا البيت
english: I am sitting inside the house.
transliteration: Ana qaa'ed juwwa el-beit.

arabic: الطقس حلو بس بارد شوي
english: The weather is nice, but a little cold.
transliteration: Eṭ-ṭa's ḥilw bas bāred shway.

arabic: بشرب شاي دافي هلأ
english: I am drinking warm tea now.
transliteration: Bashrab shāy dāfi halla'.

arabic: وبعدين بعمل اكل بسيط
english: And then I make simple food.
transliteration: W baʻdein ba'mal akel basīṭ.

arabic: صباح الخير يا أمي اليوم بدنا نحكي بالعرس
english: Good morning, Mom. Today we need to talk about the wedding.
transliteration: Sabah al-khayr ya ummi el-yom bedna nehki bel-ers.

arabic: صباح النور يا بنتي كيفك الشغل كتير بس حلو
english: Morning of light, my daughter. How are you? The work is a lot but it's nice.
transliteration: Sabah an-nur ya binti keefak? Ash-shoghl ktir bas helw.

arabic: أهلاً بكل العيلة الكبيرة معنا
english: Welcome to all the big family with us.
transliteration: Ahlan be-kull el-a'ileh el-kbireh ma'ana.

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين كرمال العرس الجديد
english: We are all happy for the new wedding.
transliteration: Kullna mabsooteen karamal el-ers el-jdeed.

arabic: ماشي رح نبلش نجهز سوا بفرح
english: Okay, we will start preparing together with joy.
transliteration: Maashi rah nballesh njehhez sawa bi-farah.

arabic: اجتماع العائلة بيترك دائما شعور خاص وفرح كبير بقلب كل واحد منا
english: The family gathering always leaves a special feeling and great joy in the heart of each one of us.
transliteration: ijtimaa3 il 3a'ile bi-ytruk daa'iman shu3oor khaaSs w faraH kabeer bi-qalb kull waaHed minna

arabic: حضرت الأم أطيب وصفة من أكلة المقلوبة بالمطبخ مع جو مليء بالمحبة والضحك
english: The mother prepared the tastiest recipe of makloubeh in the kitchen with an atmosphere full of love and laughter.
transliteration: HaDDr-at il umm aTyab waSfe min aklet il maqloobeh bil maTbakh ma3 jaww malee' bil maHabbeh w il DaHek

arabic: ولما وصلوا كل واحد من الأخوة والبنات استقبلهم الأب بابتسامة دافئة وشاركوهم مواضيع مختلفة
english: And when each one of the brothers and sisters arrived, the father welcomed them with a warm smile, and they shared different topics.
transliteration: w lamma waSalo kull waaHed min il ikhwe w il banaat istaqbalhom il ab bi-btisaameh daafiye w shaarakoohum mawaadi3 mukhtalife

arabic: عالمائدة العائلية اللذيذة تبادلوا تفاصيل يومهم واقتراحوا خطط للعطلة القادمة بمتعة كبيرة
english: At the delicious family dining table, they exchanged details of their day and suggested plans for the upcoming holiday with great enjoyment.
transliteration: 3a-lma'ideh il 3a'iliyeh il ladheedhe tabaadaloo tafaSeel yawmihom w aqtaraHoo khoTaT lil 3oTleh il qaadimeh bi-mut3a kbeereh

arabic: ورغم إنو الوقت مر بسرعة ضل شعور شوق جميل لهي اللحظات الدافئة الفريدة من نوعها
english: And even though time passed quickly, a beautiful longing remained for these warm, unique moments.
transliteration: w raghm inno il wa't marr bi-sur3a Daal shu3oor shawq jameel la-hay il laHazaat id-daafiyeh il fareedeh min naw3-ha

arabic: الصبح سامي بدو يلبس للمدرسة
english: In the morning, Sami wants to get dressed for school.
transliteration: eṣ-ṣubeḥ, Sami baddo yilbas lal-madrasa.

arabic: امه سالته شو بتحب تلبس اليوم يا سامي
english: His mother asked him: What do you like to wear today, Sami?
transliteration: Ommo sa'aleto: Shu bteḥebb telbas el-yoom ya Sami?

arabic: سامي قال بحب البس تي شيرت قطن
english: Sami said: I like to wear a cotton t-shirt.
transliteration: Sami aal: Baḥebb albass ti-sheert qoṭon.

arabic: بس كل التي شيرتات والكنزات مو نضيفة
english: But all the t-shirts and sweaters are not clean.
transliteration: Bass kull et-ti-sheertaat wal-kanazaat mo nḍiife.

arabic: لازم نغسل غسيل كتير اليوم
english: We need to wash a lot of laundry today.
transliteration: Laazem neghsel ghasiil ktiir el-yoom.

arabic: مساء الخير يا اهل البيت اليوم رح نطبخ اكلة جديدة سوا
english: Good evening family! Today we will cook a new dish together.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr yā ahl el-bēt! El-yōm raḥ noṭbokh akle jdīde sawa.

arabic: مساء النور يا بنتي امي ردت انا منيحة شكرا وانتو كيفكن
english: "Evening of light, my daughter," my mom replied, "I'm fine, thank you, and how are you all?"
transliteration: Masāʾ an-nūr yā bintī, immī raddat: "Ana mnīḥa shukran, w intu kēfkon?"

arabic: طبق جديد عم نحضره لاول مرة وماما علمتني كل خطوة بحب
english: We are preparing a new dish for the first time, and Mom taught me every step with love.
transliteration: Ṭabaʾ jdīd ʿam nḥaḍḍro la awwal marra, w māmā ʿallamatnī kill khaṭwe b-ḥubb.

arabic: لما استوى الاكل الريحة ملت البيت وابي قال شو هالريحة الطيبة شكرا
english: When the food was cooked, the smell filled the house and my dad said, "What is this delicious smell, thank you!"
transliteration: Lammā istāwā l-ʾakl, r-rīḥa mallat el-bēt w abī ʾāl: "Shū hal-rīḥa ṭ-ṭayybe, shukran!"

arabic: الكل قعد على السفرة وعيلتنا انبسطت بالعشا كتير
english: Everyone sat at the dining table and our family enjoyed dinner a lot.
transliteration: El-kull qaʿad ʿala s-sufra w ʿēltna inbaṣṭat bil-ʿasha ktīr.

arabic: صباح الخير العيلة بدها تجهز للغداء
english: Good morning. The family wants to prepare for lunch.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer el-a'ileh beddha tjehhez lal ghada.

arabic: بس البراد مو بارد والفاكهة صارت دافية
english: But the fridge is not cold and the fruit became warm.
transliteration: Bas el barrad moo bared wel fakha saarat dafiyeh.

arabic: احنا مو مبسوطين هلا لانو الاكل رح يخرب
english: We are not happy now because the food will spoil.
transliteration: Ehna moo mabsooteen hala la'anno el akl raḥ yikhrob.

arabic: مين رح يصلح البراد بسرعة
english: Who will fix the fridge quickly?
transliteration: Meen raḥ yṣalleḥ el barrad besoraa?

arabic: لازم نصلحه بسرعة حتى العيلة تكون مبسوطة
english: We must fix it quickly so the family can be happy.
transliteration: Lazim nṣalleḥo besoraa ḥatta el-a'ileh tkoun mabsootah.

arabic: زرت خالتي مبارح وكنت متفاجئ بالتغيير الكبير ببيتها
english: I visited my aunt yesterday and was surprised by the big change in her house.
transliteration: Zurt khalti mbarieh w kuntu mutafaje' bil taghyeer el kabeer b bayt'ha.
storyTitle: A Delightful Visit to My Aunt

arabic: الصالة كانت بتصميم مودرن والوان جريئة مع لوحة فن تجريدي كبيرة معلقة على الحيط
english: The living room had a modern design and bold colors, with a large abstract art painting hanging on the wall.
transliteration: Es-saleh kanat b tasmim modern w alwan jaree'ah ma' law7et fann tajreedee kabeereh mu'allaqa 'al hayt.
storyTitle: A Delightful Visit to My Aunt

arabic: خالتي بطبعها مرحة كتير وقابلتني بابتسامة دافية بس حسيت أخي الصغير كان خجول شوي كالعادة
english: My aunt, being very cheerful by nature, greeted me with a warm smile, but I felt my little brother was a bit shy as usual.
transliteration: Khalti b tab'ha mariha kteer w qabalatni b ebtisameh dafyeh bas 7asayt akhi es-sagheer kan khajool shway kal'adeh.
storyTitle: A Delightful Visit to My Aunt

arabic: ما توقعت خالتي تكون متابعة لهاد المستوى من الثقافة الفنية وتناقشنا عن اللوحة وذوقها الرفيع اللي بتدل على انها ذكية ومثقفة
english: I didn't expect my aunt to be following this level of artistic culture, and we discussed the painting and her refined taste, which indicates she is intelligent and cultured.
transliteration: Ma tawwaqa't khalti tkoun mutabe'a l had el mustawa min et-thaqafeh el fanniyyeh w tanaqashna 'an el law7a w zawq'ha er-rafee' illi btedull 'ala enn'ha zakiyyeh w muthaqqafa.
storyTitle: A Delightful Visit to My Aunt

arabic: بعد هالزيارة الممتعة شعرت بسعادة غامرة وتقدير أكبر لخالتي وجمال روحها رغم إنها كانت دايماً بتبين عصبية
english: After this enjoyable visit, I felt immense happiness and greater appreciation for my aunt and her beautiful spirit, even though she always seemed nervous.
transliteration: Ba'd hal ziyara el mumti'a sha'art b sa'adeh ghamireh w taqdeer akbar l khalti w jamal rou7'ha raghm enn'ha kanat dayman btebayyen asabiyyeh.
storyTitle: A Delightful Visit to My Aunt

arabic: اليوم انا شفت صديق قديم بالسوق
english: Today I saw an old friend in the market.
transliteration: El yom ana shuft sadeeq adeem bil sooq.

arabic: قلت له مرحبا كيفك كتير اشتقنا لك
english: I said to him, "Hello, how are you? We missed you a lot."
transliteration: Ulitlo marhaba kifak kteer ishta'na lak.

arabic: هو قال الحمد لله انا بخير اهلا وسهلا فيك
english: He said, "Praise be to God, I am fine, welcome!"
transliteration: Huwwa qal alhamdulillah ana bikhair ahlan wa sahlan feek.

arabic: قلت له تعال نشرب قهوة ببيتي
english: I said to him, "Come, let's drink coffee at my house."
transliteration: Ulitlo ta'aal nishrab qahwe b-beiti.

arabic: هو قال شكرا كتير على الدعوة الحلوة
english: He said, "Thank you very much for the nice invitation."
transliteration: Huwwa qal shukran kteer 'ala ed da'we el helwe.

arabic: كيفك يا صديقي القديم سأل احمد في الملعب
english: How are you, my old friend? Ahmad asked at the stadium.
transliteration: Keefak ya sadeeqi al-qadeem? Sa'al Ahmad fil-mal'ab.

arabic: المباراة حلوة كتير وفريقنا سجل هدف
english: The match is very good and our team scored a goal.
transliteration: El-mubaaraat helwe kteer w fareeqna sajjal hadaf.

arabic: احنا كتير مبسوطين بهالفرح والكل عم بيهتف
english: We are very happy with this joy, and everyone is cheering.
transliteration: Eḥna kteer mabsooteen bhal-faraḥ, wel-koll 'am bēhtef.

arabic: لازم نجهز للاحتفال بعد المباراة كمان قال سامي
english: We also need to prepare for the celebration after the match, Sami said.
transliteration: Laazem njehhez lil-iḥtefaal ba'd el-mubaaraat kamaan, qaall Sami.

arabic: ننسى الشغل اليوم ونستمتع بالمباراة بس
english: Let's forget about work today and just enjoy the match.
transliteration: Nensa ash-shoghl el-yoom w nistamte' bil-mubaaraat bass.

arabic: مساء الخير كيفكَ يا احمد البيت كله برد والمدفأة مو شغالة
english: Good evening, how are you Ahmad? The whole house is cold and the heater is not working.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr, kayfak ya Ahmad? El bēt kello bard w il madfaʾa mū shaghghāle.

arabic: مساء النور يا سارة انا منيح بس عنجد الجو صاير ثلج ليش ما خبرتيني من قبل
english: Evening of light Sara, I'm fine, but truly the weather has become like ice, why didn't you tell me earlier?
transliteration: Masāʾ an-nūr ya Sāra, ana mnīḥ bas ʿanjad il jaww ṣāyer talj, lēsh mā khabbartīni min qabl?

arabic: حاولت اصلحها طول النهار بس بلا فايدة واكيد اولادك رح يجو من المدرسة وعم بيرجفوا من البرد
english: I tried to fix it all day but to no avail, and surely your children will come from school shivering from the cold.
transliteration: Ḥāwalt aṣalliḥha ṭūl an-nahār bas bilā fāyde w akīd awlādak raḥ yiju min il madrasa w ʿam biyirjifu min il bard.

arabic: طيب هلا رح اتصل بالكهربجي فورا واطلب منه يجي يشوفها قبل ما الدنيا تغمق اكثر
english: Okay, now I will call the electrician immediately and ask him to come check it before it gets darker.
transliteration: Ṭayyeb hallaʾ raḥ attaṣil bil kahrabji fawran w aṭlub minno yiji yishūfha qabl mā id-dunya tghammaq akthar.

arabic: تمام شكرا ليك بتمنى يلحق يجي بسرعة مشان الجو ما يبرد زيادة مع السلامة
english: Okay, thank you. I hope he manages to come quickly so the weather doesn't get colder. Goodbye.
transliteration: Tamām shukran lēk batmanna yilḥaq yiji bisurʿa mishān il jaww mā yibrad ziyāde maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: اليوم رحت على بيت جدتي
english: Today I went to my grandmother's house.
transliteration: Elyoum reḥt ʿala bayt jiddeti.

arabic: جدتي كانت كتير مبسوطة
english: My grandmother was very happy.
transliteration: Jiddeti kanat kteer mabsuṭa.

arabic: قالت أهلاً وسهلاً يا حبيبتي
english: She said, "Welcome, my dear!"
transliteration: Qalat "Ahlan wa sahlan ya ḥabibti."

arabic: أكلنا أكل طيب وشربنا شاي
english: We ate delicious food and drank tea.
transliteration: Akalna akel ṭayyib w sheribna shay.

arabic: حكيت شكراً الزيارة كانت حلوة كتير
english: I said, "Thank you, the visit was very nice."
transliteration: Ḥakeet "Shukran, az-ziyara kanat ḥelwe kteer."

arabic: انا قاعد بالمقهى بستنى صاحبي
english: I am sitting at the cafe waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bel-maqha bastanna sahbi.

arabic: النادل جابلي قهوة سخنة
english: The waiter brought me hot coffee.
transliteration: En-naadel jaabli gahwe sokhne.

arabic: صاحبي وصل وهلا احنا مبسوطين
english: My friend arrived and now we are happy.
transliteration: Sahbi wasal w halla ehna mabsooteen.

arabic: عم نحكي عن الشغل والعيلة
english: We are talking about work and family.
transliteration: Am nehki an esh-shoghl wel-a'ileh.

arabic: بدنا نجهز لفرح كبير للعيلة قريبا
english: We want to prepare for a big family celebration soon.
transliteration: Bedna njehhez la-farah kbeer lel-a'ileh gareeban.

arabic: امي اشترت كنزة جديدة لاخي احمد
english: My mom bought a new sweater for my brother Ahmad.
transliteration: Ummi ishtarat kanze jdiide la'akhi Ahmad.

arabic: بس احمد ما بحب يلبس كنزة كبيرة
english: But Ahmad doesn't like to wear a big sweater.
transliteration: Bass Ahmad ma biḥebb yilbas kanze kbiire.

arabic: رحنا انا و امي عالسوق لنرجعها
english: My mom and I went to the market to return it.
transliteration: Riḥna ana w'ummi ʿas-suu' lanrajjiʿha.

arabic: البياع كان لطيف كتير وساعدنا
english: The seller was very kind and helped us.
transliteration: El-bayyaaʿ kaan laṭiif ktiir wi-saaʿadna.

arabic: اخدنا كنزة قطن صغيرة وهلأ احمد سعيد
english: We took a small cotton sweater and now Ahmad is happy.
transliteration: Akhadna kanze qoṭon ṣghiire w-halla' Ahmad saʿiid.

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بروح على الدكان أشتري خبز
english: Every morning I go to the shop to buy bread
transliteration: Kull yom es-sobh barooh 'ala ed-dukan ashtaree khebez

arabic: إمبارح كنت ماشي شفت رفيقي القديم علي
english: Yesterday I was walking and saw my old friend Ali
transliteration: Embareh kunt meshi shoft rafee'i el qadeem Ali

arabic: مرحباً يا علي السلام عليكم كيفك
english: Hello Ali peace be upon you how are you
transliteration: Marhaba ya Ali as-salamu alaykum keefak

arabic: وعليكم السلام أهلاً وسهلاً فيك أنا منيح شو عم تعمل هون
english: And upon you be peace welcome to you I am good what are you doing here
transliteration: Wa alaykum as-salam ahlan wa sahlan feek ana mneeh shu 'am ta'mel hon

arabic: كنت جاي أشتري قهوة كالعادة وبعدين رح روح الشغل
english: I was coming to buy coffee as usual and then I will go to work
transliteration: Kunt jay ashtaree gahwe kal-'ade w ba'dein rah rooh esh-shoghol

arabic: اليوم انا و صاحبي رحنا على مقهى
english: Today my friend and I went to a cafe.
transliteration: El-yom ana w sahiby rehna ala maqha.

arabic: النادل جاب لنا قهوة
english: The waiter brought us coffee.
transliteration: El-naadel jaab lana gahwe.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي عن عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: We were talking about the weekend.
transliteration: Kenna am nehki an otlet nehayet el-osbou'.

arabic: قررنا نروح على المشي يوم السبت
english: We decided to go for a walk on Saturday.
transliteration: Qarrarna nrouh ala el-mashy yom el-sabt.

arabic: انا بستنى يوم السبت كتير
english: I am really waiting for Saturday.
transliteration: Ana bastanna yom el-sabt kteer.

arabic: مساء الخير كيفك يا سارة؟
english: Good evening, how are you, Sarah?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr kayfik ya Sāra?

arabic: أنا منيحة شكرا وانتي كيفك؟
english: I'm fine, thank you, and how are you (female)?
transliteration: Ana mnīḥa shukran w anti kayfik?

arabic: أكلنا ساندويشات مع بعض بالفرصة.
english: We ate sandwiches together during the break.
transliteration: Akālna sāndwīshāt maʿ baʿḍ bil-fursa.

arabic: بعدين شفت احمد وحكيتلو كيفك؟
english: Then I saw Ahmed and told him, 'How are you (male)?'
transliteration: Baʿdēn shuft Aḥmad w ḥakētlo kayfak?

arabic: بعد الحصة حكينا باي ومع السلامة.
english: After the class, we said bye and goodbye.
transliteration: Baʿd il-ḥiṣṣa ḥakēna bāy w maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: صباح الخير انا بروح على الشغل بكير كل يوم
english: Good morning! I go to work early every day.
transliteration: Ṣabāḥ al-khayr! Ana ba-rūḥ 'ala ash-shughl bakeer kull yōm.
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Generational Differences

arabic: زميلي الكبير بالعمر بيقول السلام عليكم دايما
english: My older colleague always says "Peace be upon you".
transliteration: Zameelī al-kabeer bil-'umur bi-yqūl "as-salāmu 'alaykum" dāyman.
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Generational Differences

arabic: انا برد مرحبا وبشتغل بسرعة على اللابتوب
english: I reply "Hello" and work quickly on the laptop.
transliteration: Ana ba-rudd "marḥaba" wa bashtaghil bi-sur'a 'ala al-lāptōp.
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Generational Differences

arabic: هو بيحب يكتب كل شي بالقلم والورقة القديمة
english: He likes to write everything with the old pen and paper.
transliteration: Hū bi-yḥibb yiktub kull shī bil-qalam wal-waraqa al-qadeema.
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Generational Differences

arabic: كل جيل عنده طريقة شغل مختلفة بس منشتغل سوا
english: Every generation has a different way of working, but we work together.
transliteration: Kull jeel 'andu ṭaree'it shughl mukhtalifa bas minishtaghil sawa.
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Generational Differences

arabic: اليوم كان عيد ميلاد تيتا بالبيت وكل العيلة اجتمعوا بفرح
english: Today was Grandma's birthday at home, and the whole family gathered joyfully.
transliteration: El-yōm kān ʿīd mīlād tīta bil-bēt w kull el-ʿēle ejtamaʿu bi-faraḥ.

arabic: كانت طاولة الأكل مليانة أطايب والكيكة كبيرة كتير
english: The dining table was full of delicious food, and the cake was very big.
transliteration: Kānat ṭāwlet el-akl malyāne aṭāyeb wel-kēke kbīre ktīr.

arabic: أهلاً شو إسمكَ سأل كريم طفل صغير أنا كريم وأنتَ
english: "Hello, what is your name?" Karim asked a little boy, "I am Karim, and you?"
transliteration: Ahlan shū ismak? sa'al Karim tefl zġīr, Ana Karim w enta?

arabic: رد الصغير إسمي يوسف ثم قدم لكريم رسمة جميلة وقال شكراً أجاب كريم عفواً
english: The little one replied, "My name is Youssef," then gave Karim a beautiful drawing and said "Thank you." Karim replied, "You're welcome."
transliteration: Radd ez-zġīr Ismee Youssef thumma qaddam li-Karim rasme jamīle w qāl Shukran. Ajāb Karim ʿafwan.

arabic: قضينا وقت حلو كتير وبعد ما الكل أكل الكيكة قالت ليلى لريم بشوفكِ بعدين
english: We had a wonderful time, and after everyone ate the cake, Layla told Reem, "See you later!"
transliteration: Qaḍḍayna wa't ḥilu ktīr, w baʿd ma el-kull akal el-kēke, qālat Layla li-Reem bashūfik baʿdēn!

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد يلا قوم الشغل متأخر
english: Good morning, Ahmed, come on get up, work is late (we are late for work).
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmad, yalla 'oom, esh-shughol muta'akhkher.

arabic: بدي قهوة هلأ ما في وقت كثير
english: I want coffee now, there isn't much time.
transliteration: Biddi qahwe halla', ma fi wa't ktheer.

arabic: وين الخبز لازم ناكل سريع
english: Where is the bread? We must eat quickly.
transliteration: Ween el khubez? Laazem nakol saree'.

arabic: ما في خبز جديد بدنا نطلع هلأ
english: There is no new bread, we need to leave now.
transliteration: Ma fi khubez jadeed, bedna netla' halla'.

arabic: انا لازم روح على الشغل يلا بسرعة
english: I must go to work, come on quickly!
transliteration: Ana laazem rooh 'ala esh-shughol, yalla b-sur'a!

arabic: انا بستنى صاحبي ب مقهى جديد
english: I am waiting for my friend at a new cafe.
transliteration: Ana bastanna sahbi b maqha jdeed.

arabic: حسيت بملل شوي بس المكان حلو
english: I felt a little bored, but the place is nice.
transliteration: Hasseit b malal shway bas el makan helw.

arabic: اجا النادل وسألني شو بدي
english: The waiter came and asked me what I want.
transliteration: Aja en-naadel w sa'alni shoo baddi.

arabic: طلبت قهوة وقعدت اتطلع عالناس
english: I ordered coffee and sat looking at the people.
transliteration: Talabt gahwe w a'adt at'tall'a 'a an-naas.

arabic: بعد شوي صاحبي وصل وهلأ عم نحكي
english: After a while, my friend arrived, and now we are talking.
transliteration: Ba'ed shway, sahbi wasal w halla' am nehki.

arabic: اليوم بدي اطبخ اكلة جديدة
english: Today I want to cook a new dish.
transliteration: El-yom biddi atbokh akle jdide.

arabic: سألت صاحبي عن الوصفة
english: I asked my friend about the recipe.
transliteration: Sa'alt sahbi 'an el-wasfe.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي عنها ونشرب قهوة
english: We were talking about it and drinking coffee.
transliteration: Kunna 'am nehki 'anha w nishrab gahwe.

arabic: هلا انا بالمطبخ عم اطبخ شوي شوي
english: Now I am in the kitchen, cooking slowly.
transliteration: Hala' ana bil-matbakh 'am atbokh shway shway.

arabic: بتمنى الاكل يكون زاكي
english: I hope the food is delicious.
transliteration: Batmanna el-akel ykoon zaki.

arabic: اليوم رحت زور عمي احمد وصلت لعنده وقلتله صباح الخير كيفك
english: Today I went to visit my Uncle Ahmed. I arrived at his place and told him, "Good morning, how are you?"
transliteration: El-yōm riḥt zōr ʿammī Aḥmad. Waṣalt laʿinduh w-ʾiltilluh ṣabāḥ el-khayr kifak?

arabic: هو رد عليي وقال اهلين فيك انا منيح تمام الحمد لله
english: He replied to me saying, "Welcome, I am good, fine, thank God."
transliteration: Huwwe radd ʿalayyi w-ʾāl ʾahlīn fīk ana mnīḥ tamām el-ḥamdu lillah.

arabic: قعدنا شوي وشربنا قهوة وحكينا كتير مواضيع حلوة
english: We sat for a bit, drank coffee, and talked about many nice topics.
transliteration: ʾAʿadnā shwayy w-shribnā ʾahwe w-ḥakīnā ktīr mawāḍīʿ ḥilwe.

arabic: لما بدي امشي شفت صورة غريبة على الحيط وسألته يمكن هاي مو صور عيلتنا
english: When I wanted to leave, I saw a strange picture on the wall and asked him, "Maybe this isn't our family's picture?"
transliteration: Lammā baddī ʾimshī shuft ṣūra gharībe ʿala el-ḥīṭ w-saʾaltuh yimkin hāy mū ṣuwar ʿēlitnā?

arabic: ضحك عمي وقال لأ يا حبيبي انا مو عمك احمد انا جارو بشوفك بعدين
english: My "uncle" laughed and said, "No, my dear, I am not your Uncle Ahmed; I am his neighbor. See you later."
transliteration: Ḍiḥik ʿammī w-ʾāl laʾ yā ḥabībī ana mū ʿammak Aḥmad ana jāruh. Bashūfak baʿdēn.

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما قالت سارة بحب يلا نروح نشتري تياب جديدة
english: "Good morning, Mama," said Sarah lovingly. "Let's go buy new clothes."
transliteration: Sabāḥ al-khayr ya mama qālat Sāra bi ḥubb yalla nrūḥ nishtarī tyāb jdīde.

arabic: الام ابتسمت وقالت صباح النور حبيبتي اهلا وسهلا
english: The mother smiled and said, "Morning of light, my darling, welcome!"
transliteration: Al-umm ibtasamat w qālat "Sabāḥ an-nūr ḥabībti ahlan wa sahlan."

arabic: راحوا على السوق مع بابا وكان الجو دافي وحلو كتير
english: They went to the market with Papa, and the weather was very warm and nice.
transliteration: Rāḥū ʿala as-sūq maʿ bāba w kān il-jaww dāfī w ḥilu ktīr.

arabic: بالمحل شافوا قميص ازرق كتير حلو وسارة حبته كتير
english: At the shop, they saw a very nice blue shirt, and Sarah loved it a lot.
transliteration: Bil-maḥall shāfū qamīṣ azraq ktīr ḥilu w Sāra ḥabbatoh ktīr.

arabic: كلهم كانوا مبسوطين ورجعوا عالبيت وهمي فرحانين بالتياب الجديدة
english: Everyone was happy, and they returned home joyful with the new clothes.
transliteration: Kullhum kānū mabṣūṭīn w rajaʿū ʿal-bēt w hummi farḥānīn bil-tyāb il-jdīde.

arabic: كل يوم جمعة الصبح بكير بروح على سوق الخضرا
english: Every Friday morning early, I go to the vegetable market.
transliteration: Kull yom jum'a es-sobeh bakīr barūḥ 'ala sūq el-khaḍra.
storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

arabic: الجو اليوم خريف ودافي شوي بس غائم
english: The weather today is autumn and a little warm, but cloudy.
transliteration: El-jaww el-yōm kharīf w dāfi shway bass ghā'em.
storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

arabic: بشتري بندورة وخيار طازة من البائع اللي بعرفه من زمان
english: I buy fresh tomatoes and cucumbers from the seller I've known for a long time.
transliteration: Bashtarī banadūra w khiyār ṭāza min el-bā'e' elli ba'rafo min zamān.
storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

arabic: بنسلم على بعض وبنسأل عن الأحوال قبل ما أدفع الحساب
english: We greet each other and ask about conditions before I pay the bill.
transliteration: Binsallem 'ala ba'ḍ w binsa'al 'an el-aḥwāl qabl ma adfa' el-ḥisāb.
storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

arabic: بعدين برجع عالبيت وبجهز الفطور لكل العيلة
english: Then I return home and prepare breakfast for the whole family.
transliteration: Ba'dēn barja' 'al-bēt w bjahhez el-fuṭūr lekull el-'ēle.
storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

arabic: انا وصاحبي رحنا على مقهى
english: My friend and I went to a cafe.
transliteration: Ana w sahiby rehna 'ala maqha.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي عن المباراة
english: We were talking about the match.
transliteration: Kenna 'am nehki 'an el-mubaaraat.

arabic: النادل جاب إلنا قهوة
english: The waiter brought us coffee.
transliteration: El-naadel jab elna gahwe.

arabic: المباراة بلشت وصار هدف
english: The match started and a goal happened.
transliteration: El-mubaaraat ballashat w sar hadaf.

arabic: الكل صرخ وفرح كتير
english: Everyone shouted and was very happy!
transliteration: El-kull sarakh w fareh kteer!

arabic: اجتمعت العيلة على سفرة زاكية ببيت ستي
english: The family gathered for a delicious meal at Grandma's house.
transliteration: Ijtema'at il-'ayle 'ala sufrat zakye b-beit sitti.

arabic: عمي هو سوري ودايماً بيحكي قصص بتضحك
english: My uncle, who is Syrian, always tells funny stories.
transliteration: 'Ammi huwa Suri w dayman biy-ihki qisas btiDhHak.

arabic: خالتي هي فلسطينية وجابت حلو زاكي كتير
english: My aunt, who is Palestinian, brought a very delicious dessert.
transliteration: Khaalti hiyya Filastiniya w jaabet Hilu zaky kteer.

arabic: بنت عمي سألتني شو جنسيتكِ؟ جاوبت انا اردنية
english: My cousin asked me, "What is your nationality?" I replied, "I am Jordanian."
transliteration: Bint 'ammi sa'alatni 'Shu jinsiyytik?' Jawwabt 'Ana Urduniyya.'

arabic: الكل ضحك واكل سوا بجو دافي ومحب
english: Everyone laughed and ate together in a warm and loving atmosphere.
transliteration: Il-kull DHihik w akal sawa b-jaww daafi w muHebb.

arabic: رحنا على المقهى
english: We went to the cafe.
transliteration: Rehna ala el maqha

arabic: بلشت استنى صاحبي هناك
english: I started waiting for my friend there.
transliteration: Ballashat astanna saahebi hnaak

arabic: النادل جابلي مي
english: The waiter brought me water.
transliteration: En-naadel jabli mayy

arabic: قهوتي كانت لسا هدفي
english: My coffee was still my goal.
transliteration: Gahweti kaanet lessa hadafi

arabic: هلأ عم نحكي عن هاد الانتظار الطويل
english: Now we are talking about this long wait.
transliteration: Halla' am nehki an haad el entezaar et-taweel

arabic: اجتمع افراد العائلة حول مائدة الطعام التي تفوح منها رائحة المأكولات التقليدية احتفاء بتجمع اجيالها المتعددة
english: Family members gathered around the dining table, from which the aroma of traditional dishes wafted, celebrating the gathering of its multiple generations.
transliteration: Ijtema'a afraad al-a'ile hawl ma'idet at-ta'am illi tifooh minna ra'ihet al-ma'koolat at-taqleediyye ihti'fa'an bi-tajammu' ajiyaalha al-muta'addide.

arabic: الكبار في السن يتحدثون عن قيم الاصالة وعادات الزمن الجميل وتحديات الحياة المعاصرة التي لم تكن موجودة بعهدهم
english: The elders speak of the values of authenticity and the customs of the beautiful past, and the challenges of modern life that did not exist in their era.
transliteration: Al-kbaar fis-sinn yethaaddasoo an qiyam al-asala wa 'aadāt iz-zaman il-jameel wa tahaddiyaat il-hayaat il-mu'aasira illi ma kaanat mawjooda bi-ahd-hum.

arabic: بينما ينهمك الشباب بالتقاط الصور بهواتفهم الذكية ويتبادلون الاحاديث العصرية حول التقنية وتاثيرها العميق على اساليب التواصل
english: Meanwhile, the youth are busy taking photos with their smartphones and exchanging modern conversations about technology and its deep impact on communication methods.
transliteration: Baynama yanhamik ish-shabab bi-iltaqaat is-suwar bi-hawātifhum iz-zakiyye wa yatabaadaloon al-ahaadeeth al-'asriyye hawl at-taqniya wa ta'theerha al-'ameeq 'ala asaalib at-tawāṣul.

arabic: يتضح جليا تناقض المنظور بين الاجيال في مواضيع عدة من الحياة اليومية الى المعتقدات الشخصية
english: The contradiction in perspectives between the generations is clearly evident in several topics, from daily life to personal beliefs.
transliteration: Yettadeḥ jaliyan tanaquḍ al-manẓūr bayn al-ajiyāl fi mawadi' idde min al-ḥayaat il-yawmiyye ila al-mu'taqadāt ish-shakhṣiyye.

arabic: ورغم هذه الفوارق الجوهرية يبقى خيط التآلف الاسري يشد الجميع معا محاولين التكيف مع التطور المستمر للعالم من حولهم
english: And despite these fundamental differences, the thread of family harmony continues to bind everyone together, as they try to adapt to the continuous evolution of the world around them.
transliteration: Wa raghm haadhih al-fawāriq al-jawhariyye yabqa khayṭ at-ta'āluf al-usari yeshidd il-jamee' ma'an muḥāwilīn at-takayyuf ma' at-taṭawwur al-mustamirr lil-'ālam min ḥawl-hum.

arabic: اليوم انا مبسوط في البيت
english: Today I am happy in the house.
transliteration: Ilyoom ana mabsuuT fi il-bayt.

arabic: بس باب المطبخ مش كويس
english: But the kitchen door is not good.
transliteration: Bas baab il-matbakh mish kwayyes.

arabic: انا بدي روح اشوف شو في هناك
english: I want to go see what is there.
transliteration: Ana beddi ruuH ashouf shuu fi hnaak.

arabic: شفت قطة صغيرة فوق الطاولة
english: I saw a small cat on the table!
transliteration: Shuft qiTTa sgheera fawq iT-Taawle!

arabic: هي بدها تاكل خبز من المطبخ
english: It wants to eat bread from the kitchen.
transliteration: Hiyye beddha taakul khubz min il-matbakh.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ام سامي
english: Good morning, my neighbor Umm Sami.
transliteration: Sabah el kher ya jarti Umm Sami.

arabic: صباح النور يا ام علي شو جنسيتك انت كل مرة بسمعك بتحكي لهجة شكل
english: Good morning, Umm Ali. What's your nationality? Every time I hear you speaking a different accent!
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Umm Ali. Shu jinsiyytik inti? Kul marra basma'ik btehki lahje shakel!

arabic: ههههههه انا اردنية بس جوزي سوري وجارتنا التانية هي فلسطينية
english: Hahahaha, I'm Jordanian, but my husband is Syrian, and our other neighbor is Palestinian.
transliteration: Hahahahaha ana Urduniyya bas jawzi Suri w jartna et-tanye hiyya Filastiniya.

arabic: اها عشان هيك انت بتعرفي كل شي عن الكل انا فكرتك انتي كمان جنسيتك لبنانية
english: Ah, that's why you know everything about everyone! I thought your nationality was Lebanese too.
transliteration: Aha 'ashan heik inti bte'rafi kul shi 'an el kul! Ana fakkartek inti kaman jinsiyytik Lubnaniya.

arabic: لا انا اردنية بس مع الجيران الحلوين بتصير العيلة اكبر وبتتعلم لهجات جديدة
english: No, I am Jordanian, but with lovely neighbors, the family gets bigger and you learn new accents!
transliteration: La ana Urduniyya bas ma' el jeeran el helween btseer el 'ayle akbar w btitta'allam lahajat jdeede!

arabic: مساء الخير يا عيلة
english: Good evening, family.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr yā ʿayla

arabic: الام قالت كيفكن كلكم
english: The mother said, "How are you all?"
transliteration: Al-ʾumm qālat kayfkon kullkon

arabic: الاب قال انا منيح شكرا
english: The father said, "I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: Al-ʾab qāl ana mnīḥ shukran

arabic: كلنا اكلنا عشا طيب سوا
english: We all ate a delicious dinner together.
transliteration: Kullnā akalnā ʿashā ṭayyeb sawa

arabic: بعد العشا كل واحد قال مع السلامة
english: After dinner, everyone said goodbye.
transliteration: Baʿd al-ʿashā kull wāḥed qāl maʿ as-salāma

arabic: انا وصاحبي رحنا على مقهى
english: My friend and I went to a cafe.
transliteration: Ana w sahiby rehna a'la maqha.

arabic: بلشت المباراة الساعة سبعة
english: The match started at seven o'clock.
transliteration: Ballashat el mubaraah el saa'a sab'a.

arabic: النادل جاب لنا قهوة
english: The waiter brought us coffee.
transliteration: El naadel jab lana gahwe.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي عن الفريقين
english: We were talking about the two teams.
transliteration: Kenna am nehki an el fareeqain.

arabic: فجأة الفريق سجل هدف
english: Suddenly the team scored a goal.
transliteration: Faj'atan el fareeq sajjlal hadaf.

arabic: قعدت بالكافيه بستنى صاحبي وكان الجو حلو والشمس خفيفة
english: I sat at the café waiting for my friend, and the weather was nice with mild sun.
transliteration: Qa'adt bil-kafiyeh bastanna sahbi w kan al-jaww hilu w ash-shams khafifa.

arabic: سمعت صوت الموسيقى الهادية وشميت ريحة القهوة الطيبة من كل مكان
english: I heard the sound of quiet music and smelled the good coffee aroma from everywhere.
transliteration: Sime't sawt al-musiqa al-hadiya w shammeit rihet al-qahwa at-tayyiba min kull makan.

arabic: شفت بنت قاعدة لحالها وقلت بقلبي هي فلسطينية يمكن
english: I saw a girl sitting by herself and thought to myself, 'Maybe she is Palestinian.'
transliteration: Shuft bint qa'ida lahalha w qult b-qalbi 'hiyya Filastiniya yumkin'.

arabic: الموظف جابلي كاسة المي الباردة وشفت البخار طالع من فناجين القهوة التانية
english: The waiter brought me a glass of cold water, and I saw steam rising from the other coffee cups.
transliteration: Al-muwazzaf jabli kaset al-mayy al-barida w shuft al-bukhar tale' min fanajeen al-qahwa at-taniyeh.

arabic: كنت مبسوط كتير أنا سوري وبحب قعدة الكافيهات بالشام
english: I was very happy; I am Syrian and I love sitting in cafés in Damascus.
transliteration: Kunt mabsoot kiteer, ana Suri w b-hebb qa'det al-kafihat bish-Sham.

arabic: اتصل كريم بصديقته ليلى وقال لها اهلاً كيفكِ
english: Karim called his friend Layla and said to her, "Hello, how are you?"
transliteration: Ittaṣal Karim bi-ṣadīqatihi Layla wa qāl lahā ahlan kīfik?

arabic: ليلى ردت وقالت الحمد لله بخير وانتَ كيفكَ يا كريم
english: Layla replied, "I'm fine, thank God, and how are you, Karim?"
transliteration: Layla raddat wa qālat al-ḥamdulillāh bi-khēr w inta kīfak ya Karim?

arabic: كريم قال بدي ابعتلك صورنا عن طريق برنامج جديد سريع كتير بس ليلى ما فهمت الفكرة
english: Karim said, "I want to send you our photos through a new, very fast app," but Layla didn't understand the idea.
transliteration: Karim qāl biddī ab'atlik suwarnā 'an ṭarīq barnāmij jdīd sarī' ktīr bass Layla mā fahmit al-fikra.

arabic: ليلى قالت انا بفضل انك تبعتلي ياهم على الواتساب عادي او تحكيلي بالتلفون احسن
english: Layla said, "I prefer that you send them to me on WhatsApp normally or talk to me on the phone; that's better."
transliteration: Layla qālat ana bfaḍḍel innak tab'atli yāhum 'ala al-WhatsApp 'ādī aw tiḥkīli bil-tilifon aḥsan.

arabic: كريم ضحك وقال ماشي يا ليلى بشوفكِ بعدين وبنشوف حل
english: Karim laughed and said, "Okay, Layla, I'll see you later, and we'll find a solution."
transliteration: Karim ḍiḥik wa qāl māshī ya Layla bashūfik baʿdēn w bnshūf ḥall.

arabic: كنت ماشي بالبلد و فجأة حسيت إني ضعت
english: I was walking in the city and suddenly felt I was lost.
transliteration: kunt maashi bil-balad w faj'a ḥasseit inni ḍiʿt

arabic: شفت رجال كبير بالسن و قررت أسأله
english: I saw an old man and decided to ask him.
transliteration: shuft rajjaal kbeer bil-sinn w qarrart as'alu

arabic: عفواً يا عمو أهلاً ممكن تساعدني لو سمحت
english: Excuse me, uncle, hello, could you help me please?
transliteration: ʿafwan ya ʿammo ahlan mumkin tsaʿedni law samaḥt?

arabic: أهلاً فيك يا ابني الحمد لله بخير إسمي أبو أحمد
english: Hello to you, my son, I'm fine, thank God. My name is Abu Ahmad.
transliteration: ahlan feek ya ibni al-ḥamdulillāh bikhēr ismee Abu Ahmad

arabic: إسمي كريم وأنا ضايع وما عم لاقي السوق
english: My name is Karim, and I am lost and can't find the market.
transliteration: ismee Karim w ana ḍaayeʿ w ma ʿam laa'i as-souq

arabic: استقبلت مكالمة من رفيقتي لينا وبقلبي فرحة كبيرة
english: I received a call from my friend Lina, and in my heart was great joy.
transliteration: Istaqbalt mukalama min rafiqti Lina w biqalbi farha kbira.

arabic: خبرتني إنها رح تيجي تزورني هالخريف وأنا نطيت من الفرح
english: She told me she would come visit me this autumn, and I jumped for joy.
transliteration: Khabbartini innaha rah tiji tazurni hal-kharīf w ana naṭṭayt min il-faraḥ.

arabic: برا الجو كان عاصف وفي رعد وبرق بس صوتها الدافئ طمن قلبي
english: Outside, the weather was stormy with thunder and lightning, but her warm voice reassured my heart.
transliteration: Barra il-jaww kan aasef w fi ra'ed w barq bas sawtaha id-dāfi ṭamman qalbi.

arabic: قالت إنها ما بتخاف من العواصف بس بتفضل الأيام الغائمة الهادية
english: She said she doesn't fear storms but prefers calm cloudy days.
transliteration: Qālat innaha ma betkhāf min il-ʿawāṣef bas betfaḍḍel il-ayyām il-gha'ema il-hādiya.

arabic: حكيتلها إني رح أستناها على نار لأني اشتقتلها كتير وبقيت عم ابتسم بعد ما سكرت
english: I told her I would wait eagerly for her because I missed her a lot, and I kept smiling after she hung up.
transliteration: Ḥakaytelha inni rah astanāhā ʿala nar la'anni ishta'atellaha ktīr w baqayt ʿam abtasm baʿd ma sakkart.

arabic: بلشت اليوم بدري وسريع
english: The day started early and fast.
transliteration: Ballashat el yom badri w sari'

arabic: ريحة القهوة الحلوة عبت البيت
english: The sweet smell of coffee filled the house.
transliteration: Reehet el gahwe el helwe abbit el beit

arabic: انا عم بستنى صاحبي بالشارع
english: I am waiting for my friend in the street.
transliteration: Ana am bastanna sahbi bil shaare'

arabic: السواق جاب التكسي بسرعة
english: The driver brought the taxi quickly.
transliteration: Es sawwa' jab et taxi be sur'a

arabic: بعدين رحنا على الشغل بسرعة
english: Then we went to work quickly.
transliteration: Ba'deen rehna aal shoghl be sur'a

arabic: انا و صاحبي رحنا على مقهى امبارح
english: My friend and I went to a cafe yesterday.
transliteration: Ana w saahibi rehna ala maqha imbaareh

arabic: ريحة القهوة كانت قوية وزاكية
english: The smell of coffee was strong and good.
transliteration: Reehet el gahwe kaanat qawiyye w zaakiyeh

arabic: بلشنا نحكي عن سفرة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: We started talking about a weekend trip.
transliteration: Ballashna nehki an safra otlet nihaayet el usbuu3

arabic: عم نحكي نروح على الجبل
english: We are talking about going to the mountain.
transliteration: Am nehki nrouh ala el jabal

arabic: هاي السفرة رح تكون حلوة وممتعة كتير
english: This trip will be nice and very fun.
transliteration: Hay el safra rah tkoun helwe w mumteaa kteer

arabic: انا اليوم رحت على السوق
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana el-yom roht 'ala es-souk.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: السوق كبير كتير وشفت خضرة وفواكه حلوة
english: The market is very big and I saw nice vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Es-souk kbeer kteer w sheft khudra w fawakeh helwe.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: اشتريت كيلو طماطم واحد بس
english: I only bought one kilo of tomatoes.
transliteration: Ishtareit kilo tamatem wahed bas.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: البياع سألني كم بدك انا قلت واحد
english: The seller asked me "How much do you want?" I said "One."
transliteration: El-bayya' sa'alni "Kam baddak?" ana qolt "Wahed."
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: هو ضحك وانا كمان ضحكت السوق مو منيح للمحفظة
english: He laughed and I also laughed, the market is not good for the wallet.
transliteration: Huwwa dahak w ana kamaan dahakt, es-souk mo mnih lel mahfaza.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: ليلى و سامي عم بيخططوا لعرس كبير و حلو
english: Layla and Sami are planning for a big and beautiful wedding.
transliteration: Layla w Sami 'am bikhaṭṭṭu la-'urs kbir w ḥilu

arabic: اليوم ليلى قابلت منظم الحفلات اسمه كريم
english: Today Layla met the event planner, his name is Karim.
transliteration: Al-yōm Layla qābalat munaẓẓim al-ḥaflaāt ismuh Karim

arabic: قالت له اهلا كيفك فاجاب الحمد لله بخير
english: She said to him "Hello, how are you?" so he replied "I'm fine, thank God."
transliteration: Qālat lah ahlan kifak fa-ajāb al-ḥamdulillāh bi-khēr

arabic: حكينا عن تفاصيل كتير بشوفكَ بعدين يا كريم
english: We talked about many details, I'll see you later, Karim.
transliteration: Ḥakīna 'an tafāṣīl ktīr bashūfak baʿdēn ya Karim

arabic: بس بعد ما ودعت كريم تذكرت ليلى انها نسيت تخبره انها اصلا ما بدها تتجوز
english: But after she said goodbye to Karim, Layla remembered that she forgot to tell him that she doesn't actually want to get married.
transliteration: Bas baʿd ma waddaʿat Karim tdhakkarat Layla innaha nisiyat tkhabiru innaha aṣlan ma bidda titjawwaz

arabic: اليوم كان اول يوم شغل بعد العطلة والكل كان كسلان
english: Today was the first day of work after the holiday and everyone was lazy
transliteration: El youm kan awwal youm shoghl ba'd el otleh wal kull kan kaslan

arabic: حاولت شغل البروجيكتور بس النت كان كتير بطيء وما عم يشتغل ابدا
english: I tried to turn on the projector but the internet was very slow and wasn't working at all
transliteration: Hawalt shagghal el projector bas el net kan kteer batee' w ma am yeshteghil abadan

arabic: الطلاب صاروا يضحكوا علي وصار الصف كله فوضى كبيرة
english: The students started laughing at me and the whole class became a big mess
transliteration: Et tullab saru yidhaku alayya w sar el saff kullu fawda kbeereh

arabic: قلت لهن هاي مشكلة مزعجة كتير لازم نحلها بسرعة
english: I told them this is a very annoying problem that we need to solve quickly
transliteration: Qult lahon hay mushkileh moz'ajeh kteer lazem nehella bi sur'a

arabic: ولما رحت للمدير لقيته عم يدور على النت تحت مكتبه كمان
english: And when I went to the manager, I found him looking for the internet under his desk too
transliteration: W lamma roht lil mudeer laqeeto am yidawwer ala el net taht maktabo kaman

arabic: رنا وامها راحوا عالمحل يلبسوا اواعي جديدة
english: Rana and her mother went to the store to try on new clothes.
transliteration: Rana w emma raaḥu ʿal maḥall yilbasu awaʿi jdeede.

arabic: الام سألت رنا شو بتحبي تلبسي
english: The mother asked Rana, "What do you like to wear?"
transliteration: El-emm saʾalet Rana shu bteḥebbi telbesi?

arabic: رنا قالت بحب البس تي شيرت قطن
english: Rana said, "I like to wear cotton t-shirts."
transliteration: Rana aalet baḥebb albass ti-sheert qoṭon.

arabic: الام شافت فساتين حرير كتير حلوة
english: The mother saw very beautiful silk dresses.
transliteration: El-emm shaafet fasatiin ḥariir ktiir ḥelwe.

arabic: كل وحدة لبست شي بتحبه وهنن مبسوطين
english: Each one wore something she liked, and they were happy.
transliteration: Kull waḥde labaset shi bteḥebbo w hennen mabsuṭiin.

arabic: ما في قهوة بالبيت اليوم
english: There is no coffee at home today.
transliteration: Ma fi gahwe bil beit elyom

arabic: بلشت ادور عليها كثير
english: I started looking for it a lot.
transliteration: Ballashat adawwer alayha kteer

arabic: صاحبي اجا يزورني
english: My friend came to visit me.
transliteration: Sahiby aja yzoorni

arabic: هو جاب معه قهوة جديدة
english: He brought new coffee with him.
transliteration: Huwe jab ma'o gahwe jdide

arabic: بس انا نسيت انه كان عندي قهوة من اول
english: But I forgot that I already had coffee from before.
transliteration: Bas ana nseet enno kaan a'ndi gahwe min awwal

arabic: اليوم الصبح اتصلت بصديقتي رنا
english: This morning, I called my friend Rana.
transliteration: El-yom es-subeḥ ettaṣalt bi-ṣadiiqti Rana.

arabic: سألتها كيفك وكيف عم بيكون يومك
english: I asked her, "How are you and how is your day going?"
transliteration: Sa'altaha kiifek w kiif 3am b-yiikoun yomik?

arabic: بعدين سألتها كيف عيلتك هلأ
english: Then I asked her, "How is your family now?"
transliteration: Ba3deen sa'altaha kiif 3ayltik halla'?

arabic: هي جاوبتني ابني وبنتي هون عم بيلعبوا
english: She answered me, "My son and my daughter are playing here."
transliteration: Hiyye jaawabtni, "Ibni w binti hon 3am bi-yel3abu."

arabic: حكينا شوي وبعدين سلمنا على بعض
english: We talked a little and then said goodbye to each other.
transliteration: Ḥakeina shway w ba3deen sallamna 3ala ba3d.

arabic: اليوم انا برجع عالبيت متأخر
english: Today I go back home late.
transliteration: El-yōm ana barjaʻ ʻal-bēt mitaʼakhkhir.

arabic: بدي اطبخ العشا بس ما في خبز
english: I want to cook dinner but there is no bread.
transliteration: Biddi aṭbukh el-ʻasha bas ma fī khubz.

arabic: ما بقدر اتعشى هلأ
english: I cannot have dinner now.
transliteration: Ma baqdir ataʻashsha hallaʼ.

arabic: لازم اروح على الدكان
english: I must go to the shop.
transliteration: Lāzim arūḥ ʻalā ed-dukkān.

arabic: بعدين بنام بالليل
english: Then I sleep at night.
transliteration: Baʻdēn banām bil-lēl.

arabic: رحنا انا وجدتي على السوق
english: My grandmother and I went to the market.
transliteration: Rehna ana w jaddeti ala suq

arabic: هي بلشت تدور على اشياء قديمة وانا بلشت ادور على اشياء جديدة
english: She started looking for old things and I started looking for new things.
transliteration: Hiyye ballashat tdawwer ala ashyaa qadime w ana ballashat adawwer ala ashyaa jdide

arabic: هي جابت خضار كتير وانا جبت قهوة من مقهى صغير
english: She brought a lot of vegetables and I brought coffee from a small cafe.
transliteration: Hiyye jabit khodar kteer w ana jabit gahwe min maqha zghir

arabic: عم نحكي عن الفرق بين التسوق زمان وهلأ
english: We are talking about the difference between shopping then and now.
transliteration: Am nehki an il-faraq bayn it-tasawwoq zamaan w halla

arabic: السوق حلو للكل بس بطرق مختلفة
english: The market is nice for everyone but in different ways.
transliteration: Is-suq helu lil-kull bas bi turuq mukhtalife

arabic: كان يوم خريف دافي بس في ضباب كتير وطلعت اتمشى وضيعت طريقي
english: It was a warm autumn day, but very foggy, and I went out for a walk and lost my way.
transliteration: Kān yōm kharīf dāfi bas fi dabāb ktīr w tala't atamsha w dayya't tarī'i.

arabic: صرت ادور على اي حدا اسألو وما لقيت غير قطة عم تتطلع فيني باستغراب
english: I started looking for anyone to ask, and I only found a cat staring at me in surprise.
transliteration: Ṣirt adawwer 'ala ayy ḥada as'alo w ma laqēt ghayr qiṭṭa 'am titla' fīni bi-stighrāb.

arabic: قلت للقطة يا قطة يا حلوة وين الطريق لمار مخايل
english: I said to the cat, 'Oh sweet cat, where is the road to Mar Mikhayel?'
transliteration: Qult lil-qiṭṭa ya qiṭṭa ya ḥilwa wēn aṭ-ṭarīq la Mar Mikhayel.

arabic: وفجأة طلع شب عم يضحك وقلي تفضلي من هاد الشارع بعدين يمين
english: Suddenly, a young man appeared laughing and told me, 'Go straight down this street, then turn right.'
transliteration: W faj'a ṭala' shab 'am yiḍḥak w qali tafaḍḍali min hād ash-shāre' ba'dēn yamīn.

arabic: ضحكت وقلت لنفسي الحمدلله ما سألت القطة كان زماني لسا ضايعة
english: I laughed and told myself, 'Thank God I didn't ask the cat, I'd still be lost!'
transliteration: Ḍiḥikt w qult la-nafsi al-ḥamdulillah ma sa'alt il-qiṭṭa kān zamāni lissa ḍāy'a.

arabic: شعرت ليلى، المعمارية النشيطة، بخوف حاد لأوراق مشروعها الملونة التي تناثرت، فاليأس تسلل لقلبها بعد رفض جديد في الحمرا.
english: Layla, the active architect, felt a sharp fear for her project's colorful papers that scattered, so despair crept into her heart after a new rejection in Hamra.
transliteration: Shaarat Layla, al-mimariya an-nashita, bi-khawf hadd li-awraq mashru'aha al-mulawwana allati tanatharat, fa-l-yaas tasallal li-qalbiha ba'da rafd jadid fi al-Hamra.

arabic: فجأة، تحول حزنها لحماس كبير بتذكر آمال النازحة، وقررت بجدّ المحاولة مجدداً لمستقبل أفضل.
english: Suddenly, her sadness turned into great excitement by remembering the hopes of the displaced, and she seriously decided to try again for a better future.
transliteration: Faj'atan, tahawwal huznuha li-hamas kabir bi-tadakkur amal an-naziha, wa qarrarat bi-jidd al-muhawala mujaddadan li-mustaqbal afdal.

arabic: تنهدت بحزن شديد على التحديات بعد رفض البلدية تصريح لملجأ، لكنها أصرت ألا تستسلم.
english: She sighed with deep sadness over the challenges after the municipality rejected a permit for a shelter, but she insisted not to surrender.
transliteration: Tanahhadat bi-huzn shadid ala at-tahaddiyat bad rafd al-baladiya tasrih li-malja', lakinaha asarrat alla tastaslim.

arabic: بالدهشة والسرور، تلقت ليلى رسالة من أحد قادة المجتمع يعرض المساعدة لحلول مستدامة.
english: With surprise and joy, Layla received a message from one of the community leaders offering help for sustainable solutions.
transliteration: Bi-d-dahsha wa-s-surur, talaqqat Layla risala min ahad qadat al-mujtama' ya'rid al-musa'ada li-hulul mustadama.

arabic: ارتسمت بسمة سعادة على وجهها؛ فدعوة لجلسات مكثفة مع مانحين بدت كضوء أمل كبير.
english: A smile of happiness appeared on her face; an invitation for intensive sessions with donors seemed like a great ray of hope.
transliteration: Artasamat basmat sa'ada ala wajhiha; fa-da'wa li-jalasat mukaththafa ma' manihin badat ka-daw' amal kabir.

arabic: لكن قلق طارئ خفيف بقي يساورها: هل تكفي هذه الجلسات لتغطية مستجدات المشروع الصعبة؟
english: But a slight emergency anxiety remained troubling her: will these sessions be enough to cover the project's difficult latest developments?
transliteration: Lakin qalaq tari' khafif baqi yusawiruha: Hal takfi hadhihi al-jalasat li-taghtiyat mustajaddat al-mashru' as-sa'ba?

arabic: شعور قوي بالإثارة دفعها لتجهيز ملفات مشروعها وطموحاتها بعناية، فهذه فرصتها الأخيرة.
english: A strong feeling of excitement pushed her to carefully prepare her project files and aspirations, as this was her last chance.
transliteration: Shu'ur qawi bi-l-ithara dafa'aha li-tajhiz milaffat mashru'aha wa-ṭumuḥatiha bi-'inaya, fa-hadhihi fursatuha al-akhira.

arabic: وفجأة، بتناول Mate، اكتشفت بفرح عارم حملة تبرعات ضخمة لدعم قضيتها.
english: And suddenly, while having Mate, she discovered with immense joy a huge donation campaign to support her cause.
transliteration: Wa-faj'atan, bi-tanawul Mate, aktashafat bi-faraḥ 'arim hamlat tabarru'at dhakhma li-da'm qadiyatiha.

arabic: يا سلام، شعرت بسعادة لا توصف، فهمت أن دعم المجتمع هو سلاحنا الأقوى لمواجهة الصعاب.
english: Wow, she felt indescribable happiness, understanding that community support is our strongest weapon to face difficulties.
transliteration: Ya salam, shaarat bi-sa'ada la tuwsaf, fahimat anna da'm al-mujtama' huwa silahunā al-aqwa li-muwajahat as-si'ab.

arabic: بقلبٍ مليء بالآمال، بدأت ليلى تخطط بجدية لمستقبل أفضل للجميع في بيروت.
english: With a heart full of hopes, Layla seriously began planning for a better future for everyone in Beirut.
transliteration: Bi-qalbin mali' bi-l-amal, bada'at Layla tukhattit bi-jiddiya li-mustaqbal afdal li-l-jami' fi Bayrut.

arabic: اليوم رحت على مباراة كرة سلة مهمة بالجامعة
english: Today I went to an important basketball game at the university
transliteration: il-yōm ruḥt ʿala mubārat kurat salla muhimma bil-jāmiʿa

arabic: فريقنا بلش اللعب مش منيح بس كان في لاعب طويل كتير
english: Our team started playing not well, but there was a very tall player
transliteration: farīqna ballash il-laʿeb mish mnīḥ bas kān fī lāʿeb ṭawīl ktīr

arabic: قبل نهاية الشوط الأول هاد اللاعب أخذ الكرة وسجل ثلاث نقاط حلوة
english: Before the end of the first half, this player took the ball and scored three nice points
transliteration: qabl nihāyet ish-shōṭ il-ʾawwal hād il-lāʿeb ʾakhað il-kura w-sajjal talāt niqāṭ ḥilwe

arabic: فجأة جو المباراة اتغير وصار الكل يصرخ ويشجع بحماس
english: Suddenly, the atmosphere of the game changed and everyone started shouting and cheering with enthusiasm
transliteration: fajʾa jaww il-mubārāh itghayyar w-ṣār il-kull yiṣrukh w-yishajjeʿ bi-ḥamās

arabic: هلا أنا متأكد إنو فريقنا بدها تفوز بالكاس مثلاً هاد شعور كل المشجعين
english: Now I'm sure that our team wants to win the cup, for example, this is every fan's feeling
transliteration: hala ana mtaʾakkid inno farīqna bidda tifūz bil-kās masalan hād shuʿūr kull il-mushajjiʿīn

arabic: صباح الخير اليوم قررت اطبخ طبخة جديدة
english: Good morning, today I decided to cook a new dish.
transliteration: Sabah al-khayr el-yom qarrart atbokh tabkha jdide.

arabic: اشتريت خضرا طازة وريحتها كانت كتير حلوة
english: I bought fresh vegetables and their smell was very nice.
transliteration: Ishtarayt khadra taza w rihet-ha kanat ktir helwe.

arabic: بالأول قطعت البصل وبعدين قليت الدجاج وسمعت صوت الطقطقة
english: First I chopped the onions, then I fried the chicken and heard the sizzling sound.
transliteration: Bel-awwal qaṭṭa't el-baṣal w ba'dein qaleit ed-djaj w same't ṣawt eṭ-ṭaqṭaqa.

arabic: البيت كله صار مليان ريحة البهارات الشهية
english: The whole house became filled with the delicious smell of spices.
transliteration: El-beit kollo ṣar malyan riḥet el-baharat ash-shahiyya.

arabic: أهلاً وسهلاً بالطعام الجاهز طعمه كان رائع جداً
english: Welcome to the ready food, its taste was very wonderful.
transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan bel-ṭa'am el-jahez ta'mo kan ra'e' jiddan.

arabic: رحنا نشوف مباراة مع العيلة
english: We went to watch a game with the family.
transliteration: Rehna nshuuf mubaara ma3 il-3eile

arabic: المباراة بلشت بسرعة
english: The game started quickly.
transliteration: Il-mubaara ballashat bi-sur3a

arabic: اخي سجل هدف حلو كتير
english: My brother scored a very nice goal.
transliteration: Akhi sajjjal hadaf helu ktiir

arabic: كلنا كنا مبسوطين وعم نحكي بصوت عالي
english: We were all happy and talking loudly.
transliteration: Kullna kunna mabsuutiin w am nehki bi-sawt 3aali

arabic: بابا جاب قهوة وشاي للكل بعد المباراة
english: Dad brought coffee and tea for everyone after the game.
transliteration: Baba jab gahwe w shay lil-kull ba3d il-mubaara

arabic: انا قاعد بكافيه
english: I am sitting at a cafe.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bi kafeh.

arabic: بدي اشرب قهوة واستنى صديقي
english: I want to drink coffee and wait for my friend.
transliteration: Biddi ashrab ahweh w astanna sadeeqi.

arabic: بشوف زلمة بيقرا كتاب على الطاولة التانية
english: I see a man reading a book at the other table.
transliteration: Bashoof zalameh biqra kitab 'ala at-tawleh it-tanyeh.

arabic: بعد شوي الزلمة بيقوم وبيروح
english: After a while, the man stands up and leaves.
transliteration: Ba'd shway, iz-zalameh biqoom w byrooh.

arabic: الويتر بيجي وبيقول صديقك شرب قهوتك وراح
english: The waiter comes and says: "Your friend drank your coffee and left!"
transliteration: Il-weeter byeeji w biqool: "Sadeeqak sharib ahwetak w raah!"

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد خلينا نخطط لرحلة نهاية الأسبوع
english: Good morning, Ahmad. Let's plan a weekend trip.
transliteration: Sabah al-khayr ya Ahmad khallīna nkhaṭṭeṭ la reḥlit nihāyet al-usbūʿ

arabic: صباح النور فكرة حلوة وين نروح
english: Morning of light. Good idea. Where should we go?
transliteration: Sabah an-nūr fikra ḥelwe wēn nruḥ

arabic: رح نروح على البحر الجو كتير حلو هناك
english: We will go to the beach. The weather is very nice there.
transliteration: Raḥ nruḥ ʿal baḥer al-jaw ktīr ḥelu hunāk

arabic: تمام رح نحضر الشنط بكرا
english: Okay, we will pack the bags tomorrow.
transliteration: Tamām raḥ neḥḍar ash-shanaṭ bukra

arabic: بس نسينا انو بكرا يوم دوام
english: But we forgot that tomorrow is a workday.
transliteration: Bas nesīna inno bukra yōm dawām

arabic: صباح الخير يا جاري بلشت احكي معك.
english: Good morning, my neighbor, I started talking to you.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya jari, ballashat ahki ma'ak.

arabic: رحنا انا وياك على مقهى قريب.
english: You and I went to a nearby cafe.
transliteration: Rehna ana we iyak 'ala maqha 'areeb.

arabic: قعدنا وشربنا قهوة وصرنا عم نحكي كتير.
english: We sat, drank coffee, and started talking a lot.
transliteration: Qa'adna we sheribna gahwe we serna am nehki kteer.

arabic: بعد شوي اجا النادل وجاب القهوة.
english: After a while, the waiter came and brought the coffee.
transliteration: Ba'ed shway aja el-naadel we jab el-gahwe.

arabic: تفاجأت لما عرفت انه جاري الجديد هو النادل.
english: I was surprised when I learned that my new neighbor is the waiter.
transliteration: Tafaja'at lamma 'areft enno jari el-jadeed howa el-naadel.

arabic: رن تلفوني الصبح وكان رفيقي علي عم يحكي
english: My phone rang in the morning and my friend Ali was talking.
transliteration: rann telefonī aṣ-ṣubḥ w kān rifīqī ʿalī ʿam yaḥkī

arabic: سالته كيفك وشو عم تعمل اليوم
english: I asked him, "How are you?" and "What are you doing today?"
transliteration: sa'altu keefak w shū ʿam taʿmal al-yōm

arabic: حكى معي انه عم يدرس وعمره عشرين سنة هلا
english: He told me he's studying and he is twenty years old now.
transliteration: ḥaka maʿī innuh ʿam yidrus w ʿumruh ʿishreen sane hallā'

arabic: قال لي عندي سبع شغلات لازم اخلصها قبل العشا
english: He told me, "I have seven things I need to finish before dinner."
transliteration: qāl lī ʿandi sabʿa shaghlāt lāzim akhalliṣha qabl al-ʿasha

arabic: اتفقنا نلتقي بعدين وشكرته على اتصالو
english: We agreed to meet later and I thanked him for his call.
transliteration: ittafaqnā niltaqī baʿdēn w shakartuh ʿala ittiṣāluh

arabic: نور، كيفك؟ عندي خبر حلو!
english: Noor, how are you? I have good news!
transliteration: Noor, keefik? 'Andi khabar helu!

arabic: هلا وسام! أنا منيحة، شو في؟
english: Hello Wissam! I'm fine, what is it?
transliteration: Hala Wissam! Ana mnīḥa, shū fī?

arabic: تذكرتي الكتاب يلي بدك ياه؟
english: Do you remember the book you wanted?
transliteration: Tzakartī el-kitāb yallī biddik yāh?

arabic: اي! بس سعره غالي كتير.
english: Yes! But its price is very expensive.
transliteration: ʾEe! Bas se'ro ghālī ktīr.

arabic: بشوف محل كتب جديدة اليوم.
english: I see a new bookstore today.
transliteration: Bashoof maḥall kutub jdīde el-yōm.

arabic: عنجد؟ وين العنوان لو سمحت؟
english: Really? Where is the address, please?
transliteration: 'Anjad? Wayne el-'unwān law samaḥt?

arabic: هو بـ "شارع الحمرا" جنب "مقهى الورد".
english: It's on "Hamra Street" next to "Al-Ward Cafe".
transliteration: Huwwe b- "Shāre' el-Hamra" janb "Maqha el-Ward".

arabic: طيب، انا لازم روح شوفه هلق.
english: Okay, I must go see it now.
transliteration: Tayyib, ana lāzim rooḥ shoofo hallaq.

arabic: بيعرفوا يعطوا خصم للطلاب.
english: They know how to give a discount to students.
transliteration: Bya'rafo ye'ṭū khaṣm lel-ṭullāb.

arabic: عنجد! هيك بقدر اشتريه. شكراً كتير!
english: Really! This way I can buy it. Thank you very much!
transliteration: 'Anjad! Heek bi'dar ashtarīh. Shukran ktīr!

arabic: أنا وصاحبي رحنا على مقهى مبارح
english: My friend and I went to a cafe yesterday
transliteration: Ana w sahiby rehna ala maqha mbarah

arabic: بلشنا عم نحكي عن خطة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: We started talking about the weekend trip plan
transliteration: Ballashna am nehki an khuttat utlat nihayat al usbu

arabic: النادل جاب قهوة كبيرة إلي وقهوة صغيرة لصاحبي
english: The waiter brought a big coffee for me and a small coffee for my friend
transliteration: An-naadel jab gahwe kbire eli w gahwe sghire la sahiby

arabic: أنا كنت بستنى صاحبي يعطيني فكرة حلوة
english: I was waiting for my friend to give me a nice idea
transliteration: Ana kunt bastanna sahiby yi'teeni fikra helwe

arabic: بس هدف صاحبي الوحيد كان يشرب القهوة ويمشي
english: But my friend's only goal was to drink the coffee and leave
transliteration: Bas hadaf sahiby al waheed kan yishrab al gahwe w yimshi

arabic: انا اشتريت قميص من المحل مبارح
english: I bought a shirt from the shop yesterday.
transliteration: Ana ishtareet qamees min il-mahall mbarah.

arabic: اليوم بدي ارجعو لانو كتير كبير
english: Today I want to return it because it's very big.
transliteration: Ilyawm biddi arja3o la'anno kteer kbeer.

arabic: صاحب المحل سالني ليش بدك ترجعو
english: The shop owner asked me why you want to return it.
transliteration: Sahb il-mahall sa'alni laysh biddak tarja3o.

arabic: قلتلو هو مو الي هو لقطتي بس كبير عليها
english: I told him it's not for me, it's for my cat but it's big on her.
transliteration: Qultillo huwwe mo ili huwwe liqiTTati bas kbeer 3alayha.

arabic: ضحك صاحب المحل و رجعلي مصاري
english: The shop owner laughed and returned my money.
transliteration: Dahek sahib il-mahall w rajja3li masari.

arabic: لانا بنت صغيرة تحب تسال كتير كل يوم
english: Lana is a small girl who loves to ask a lot every day.
transliteration: Lana bint saghira bit-hibb tis'al kteer kull yawm.

arabic: بالصباح بتسال ماما شو بدنا ناكل اليوم
english: In the morning she asks mom "What do we want to eat today?"
transliteration: Bil-sabah bit-tes'al mama "Shu badna nakul al-yawm?"

arabic: وبعدين بتسال متى بدنا نطلع على برا البيت
english: And then she asks "When do we want to go outside the house?"
transliteration: Wa ba'dein bit-tes'al "Mata badna nitla' 'ala barra al-bayt?"

arabic: المساء بتجي وبتقول ليش لازم ننام بكير
english: In the evening she comes and says "Why do we have to sleep early?"
transliteration: Bil-masa bit-tiji w bit-qul "Leish lazim nnam bakkeer?"

arabic: ماما دايما بتجاوبها بحب وصبر كبير
english: Mom always answers her with great love and patience.
transliteration: Mama dayman bit-jawibha bi-hubb w sabr kbeer.

arabic: اليوم عرس اختي
english: Today is my sister's wedding.
transliteration: Elyom 3ars okhti

arabic: ماما بتعمل اكل طيب
english: Mama makes good food.
transliteration: Mama bte3mal akl tayeb

arabic: هذا باباي بيساعد
english: This is my dad helping.
transliteration: Hada babay bysaa3ed

arabic: اختي مبسوطة كتير
english: My sister is very happy.
transliteration: Okhti mabsoota kteer

arabic: كل يوم منجهز شي جديد
english: Every day we prepare something new.
transliteration: Kol yom mnejahhez shi jdid

arabic: الدنيا عم تمطر برا والجو بارد
english: It's raining outside and the weather is cold.
transliteration: Ad-dunya 'am tumtur barra wal-jaw barid.

arabic: جوا البيت دافي ومريح
english: Inside the house it's warm and comfortable.
transliteration: Juwwa al-bayt dafi w mureeh.

arabic: امي بتقول لابي مساء الخير
english: My mother says "Good evening" to my father.
transliteration: Ummi bte'ul la-abi masaa al-khayr.

arabic: نحن عم نشرب شاي سخن سوا
english: We are drinking hot tea together.
transliteration: Nehna 'am neshrab shay sokhon sawa.

arabic: هاد مساء كتير حلو النا
english: This is a very beautiful evening for us.
transliteration: Had masaa ktir helu elna.

arabic: ماما بلشت تشوف انه الكرسي بالصالون مكسور
english: Mama started to see that the chair in the living room was broken.
transliteration: Mama ballashat tshoof enno el kursi bil salon maksoor.

arabic: قعدنا كلنا عم نحكي شو نعمل
english: We all sat down talking about what to do.
transliteration: Ga'adna kulluna am nehki shoo ne'mel.

arabic: بابا جاب عدة صغيرة من الخزانة
english: Dad brought a small toolbox from the cupboard.
transliteration: Baba jab edde zghireh min el khzaneh.

arabic: قال بدنا نصلحه مع بعض هذا هدفنا
english: He said we need to fix it together, this is our goal.
transliteration: Gal bedna nsalleho ma' ba'ad hada hadafna.

arabic: كل العيلة مبسوطة انه رح نشتغل سوا
english: The whole family is happy that we will work together.
transliteration: Kull el 'ayleh mabsoota enno rah neshteghel sawa.

arabic: كان يوم خريف غايم والجو بره كتير بارد
english: It was a cloudy autumn day and the weather outside was very cold.
transliteration: Kan yom kharif gha'em wal-jaw barra ktir bared.

arabic: بس جوات البيت كان دافي والعيلة كلها متجمعة عالسفرة
english: But inside the house it was warm and the whole family was gathered at the dining table.
transliteration: Bas juwwat il-bayt kan dafi wal-'ayle kullha mutajamma'a 'al-sufra.

arabic: الكل عم ياكل منسف ويتبادل الاخبار والضحكات
english: Everyone was eating Mansaf and exchanging news and laughter.
transliteration: Il-kull 'am ya'kul mansaf w yetbadal il-akhbar wad-dahakat.

arabic: ستي كانت توزع اللبن وتوصينا ناكل منيح ونشرب الشاي السخن
english: My grandmother was serving the yogurt and advising us to eat well and drink the hot tea.
transliteration: Sitti kanat tuwazzi' al-laban w tuwassina na'kul mnīh w nashrab ash-shay as-sukhn.

arabic: هي اللحظات الحلوة اللي بتجمعنا وبتخلي قلوبنا دافية
english: These are the sweet moments that bring us together and keep our hearts warm.
transliteration: Hiye al-lahazat al-helwe illi betjamme'na w betkhalli 'ulubna dafiye.

arabic: رحنا المقهى مع صاحبي لنحضر المباراة
english: We went to the cafe with my friend to watch the match.
transliteration: Rehna el maqha ma'a sahiby lenahdor el mubara.

arabic: المباراة بلشت الساعة تمانية
english: The match started at eight o'clock.
transliteration: El mubara ballashat el sa'a tamanye.

arabic: صاحبي طلب قهوة
english: My friend ordered coffee.
transliteration: Sahiby talab gahwe.

arabic: فجأة صاحبي صرخ هدف
english: Suddenly, my friend shouted 'Goal!'.
transliteration: Faj'a sahiby sarakh hadaf.

arabic: كانت مباراة كتير حلوة
english: It was a very exciting match.
transliteration: Kanat mubara kteer helwe.

arabic: استيقظت ليلى بسعادة، لكن رسالة على هاتفها أظهرت مستجدات غير متوقعة للمشروع.
english: Layla woke up happily, but a message on her phone showed unexpected latest developments for the project.
transliteration: Istayqazat Layla bi-sa'adah, lakin risalah 'ala hatifiha azharat mustajaddat ghayr mutawaqqa'ah lil-mashrou'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: تناثرت أفكارها وهي تتساءل عن التحديات الجديدة التي قد تواجه النازحة.
english: Her thoughts were scattered as she wondered about the new challenges that might face the displaced.
transliteration: Tanatharat afkaruha wa hiya tatasa'al 'an al-tahaddiyat al-jadidah allati qad tuwajih al-nazihah.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: نهضت من سريرها، ونظرت إلى رسوماتها الملونة للمركز المجتمعي في بيروت.
english: She got up from her bed, and looked at her colorful drawings for the community center in Beirut.
transliteration: Nahadat min saririha, wa nazarat ila rusoomatiha al-mulawwanah lil-markaz al-mujtama'i fi Bayrou'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: تناولت منقوشة زعتر سريعة، تفكر بجدّ في كيفية حل المشاكل الطارئة.
english: She ate a quick za'atar manakeesh, seriously thinking about how to solve the emergency problems.
transliteration: Tanawalat man'oushet za'tar sari'ah, tufakkir bi-jidd fi kayfiyyat hall al-mashakil al-tari'ah.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: ارتدت ملابسها بسرعة، فاليوم لديها جلسات مكثفة لمناقشة تمويل الملجأ.
english: She got dressed quickly, as today she has intensive sessions to discuss funding for the shelter.
transliteration: Irtadat malabisha bi-sur'ah, fal-yawm ladayha jalasat mukaththafah li-munaqashat tamwil al-malja'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: في طريقها إلى الاجتماع، كانت تراجع أوراقها لتواجه التحديات التي ظهرت.
english: On her way to the meeting, she was reviewing her papers to face the challenges that appeared.
transliteration: Fi tariqiha ila al-ijtima', kanat turaji' awraqiha li-tuwajih al-tahaddiyat allati zaharat.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: تذكرت البريد الإلكتروني الذي ذكر مستجدات طارئة تخص التبرعات للمشروع.
english: She remembered the email that mentioned emergency latest developments regarding donations for the project.
transliteration: Tazakkarat al-bareed al-iliktroni allathi zakar mustajaddat tari'ah takhuss al-tabarru'at lil-mashrou'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: شعرت بضغط حاد، فالموقف يتطلب قراراً سريعاً وحكيماً من قادة المشروع.
english: She felt a sharp pressure, as the situation requires a quick and wise decision from the project leaders.
transliteration: Sha'arat bi-daght hadd, fal-mawqif yatalabb qarraran sari'an wa hakiman min qadat al-mashrou'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: قررت بوعيٍ تغيير استراتيجيتها لتركز على الجوانب المستدامة وطموحاتٍ طويلة الأمد.
english: She consciously decided to change her strategy to focus on sustainable aspects and long-term aspirations.
transliteration: Qarrarat bi-wa'yin taghyir istratijiyyatiha li-turakkiz 'ala al-jawanib al-mustadamah wa tumuhat tawilat al-amad.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: كانت آمالاً كبيرة معقودة على هذا الاجتماع لتأمين التبرعات الكافية للملجأ.
english: Great hopes were tied to this meeting to secure sufficient donations for the shelter.
transliteration: Kanat amalan kabirah ma'qoudah 'ala hatha al-ijtima' li-ta'min al-tabarru'at al-kafiyah lil-malja'.
storyTitle: Layla's Morning: Challenges of the Shelter Project

arabic: اهلا يا جارتي صار لي زمان ما شفتك
english: Hello my neighbor, it's been a long time since I saw you.
transliteration: Ahlan ya jarti sar li zaman ma shoftik.

arabic: اهلين هذه اختي سارة
english: Hello, this is my sister Sara.
transliteration: Ahlein haathihi okhti Sara.

arabic: يا اهلا كيف ماما
english: Welcome, how is Mom?
transliteration: Ya ahlan kif mama.

arabic: ماما بخير الحمد لله
english: Mom is fine, thank God.
transliteration: Mama bikhair alhamdulillah.

arabic: تفضلوا اشربوا قهوة عنا
english: Please come have coffee with us.
transliteration: Tfaddalu ishrabu gahwa 'andna.

arabic: مساء الخير انا عم بتفرج على مباراة كرة القدم
english: Good evening, I am watching a football match.
transliteration: masā' il-khēr ana ʿam battfarraj ʿala mubārāt kurat il-qadam

arabic: المباراة كتير حلوة والفرق عم تلعب منيح
english: The match is very nice and the teams are playing well.
transliteration: il-mubārāt ktīr ḥilwe w il-firaq ʿam tilʿab mnīḥ

arabic: اجا رفيقي وسالني كيف حالكَ
english: My friend came and asked me, 'How are you?'
transliteration: aja rafīʾī w sa'alnī kīf ḥālak?

arabic: انا كتير مبسوط باللعبة
english: I am very happy with the game.
transliteration: ana ktīr mabsūṭ bil-luʿbe

arabic: بعد المباراة قلتله باي
english: After the match, I told him bye.
transliteration: baʿd il-mubārāt qultillo bāy

arabic: امبارح اشتريت غرض بس طلع غلط
english: Yesterday I bought an item but it turned out to be wrong.
transliteration: Imbāreḥ ishtarēt gharaḍ bas ṭiliʿ ghalaṭ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: رجعت على المحل وانا حاسة حالي شوي سخيفة
english: I went back to the shop feeling a bit silly.
transliteration: Rajaʿt ʿalā al-maḥall w ana ḥāssa ḥāli shwayy sakhīfa
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: صاحب المحل سألني شو بدك وقلت له بدي ارجع غرض
english: The shop owner asked me what I wanted, and I told him I wanted to return an item.
transliteration: Ṣāḥib al-maḥall sa'alnī shū biddak w qult lo beddi arjaʿ gharaḍ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: سألني شو رقم تلفونك وحكيتله رقم تلفوني صفر سبعة تسعة خمسة خمسة وضحكت وقلت عمري عشرين سنة
english: He asked me 'What's your phone number?' and I told him 'My phone number is 07955' and I laughed and said 'I am twenty years old'.
transliteration: Sa'alnī shū raqam telefonak w ḥakētlo raqam telefonī ṣifr sabʿa tisʿa khamsa khamsa w ḍiḥekt w qult ʿomrī ʿishreen sane
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: ضحك هو كمان ورجعلي الغرض بسرعة
english: He laughed too and processed the return quickly.
transliteration: Ḍiḥek huwwe kamān w rajaʿlī al-gharaḍ bi-surʿa
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: كان الجو غائم في يوم من ايام الخريف وبلش رعد قوي
english: The weather was cloudy on an autumn day and strong thunder started.
transliteration: Kaan el jaww gha'em fi yom min ayyam el kharif w ballash ra'ed qawi.

arabic: سال الولد الصغير امه ليش في رعد وبرق يا ماما
english: The little boy asked his mother, 'Why is there thunder and lightning, Mama?'
transliteration: Sa'al el walad el saghir ommo leish fi ra'ed w barq ya mama.

arabic: جاوبته امه هاي عاصفة صغيرة وعادية يا حبيبي
english: His mother answered him, 'This is a small, normal storm, my darling.'
transliteration: Jaawabto ommo hay aasifa saghira w aadiya ya habibi.

arabic: بس هو ما اقتنع وسال ليش العاصفة بتجي بالخريف ومو بالصيف
english: But he wasn't convinced and asked, 'Why does the storm come in autumn and not in summer?'
transliteration: Bas huwwa ma eqtana' w sa'al leish el aasifa betji bel kharif w moo bel saif.

arabic: ضحكت الام وقالت يا حبيبي انت كل يوم عندك الف سؤال جديد
english: The mother laughed and said, 'My darling, every day you have a thousand new questions.'
transliteration: Daheket el omm w qalet ya habibi enta koll yom 'andak alf su'al jadeed.

arabic: رحنا انا وصاحبي على مقهى مع ابنه الصغير
english: My friend and I went to a cafe with his small son.
transliteration: Rehna ana w saahbi ala maqha ma' ebno el zghir.

arabic: بلش الولد يسأل كتير اسئلة
english: The child started asking many questions.
transliteration: Ballash el walad yis'al ktiir as'ileh.

arabic: سأل عن ريحة القهوة وعن النادل
english: He asked about the smell of the coffee and about the waiter.
transliteration: Sa'al an reehet el gahwe w an el naadel.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي بس هو ضل يسأل
english: We were talking but he kept asking.
transliteration: Konna am nehki bas hu dall yis'al.

arabic: انا كنت بستنى انه يسكت
english: I was waiting for him to be quiet.
transliteration: Ana kont bastanna enno yiskut.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي كيفك اليوم
english: Good morning my neighbor, how are you today?
transliteration: Sabah el kher ya jarti kefek elyom

arabic: صباح النور انا بخير شفت اختك امبارح
english: Good morning, I am fine. I saw your sister yesterday.
transliteration: Sabah el noor ana bkheir sheft okhtek embareh

arabic: ايه صح اختي هون صار لها زمان ما اجت
english: Yes that's right, my sister is here. It's been a long time since she came.
transliteration: Eh sah okhti hon sar laha zaman ma ajat

arabic: اهلين فيها انتي رايحة على الشغل كل يوم
english: Welcome to her. Are you going to work every day?
transliteration: Ahlen fiha enti rayha ala el shoghol kol yom

arabic: ايوا انا بروح كل يوم الصبح
english: Yes, I go every morning.
transliteration: Aywa ana barooh kol yom el sobh

arabic: صباح الخير كيفك يا احمد
english: Good morning, how are you, Ahmed?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir kifak ya Ahmad?

arabic: انا منيح آه تمام بدنا نروح رحلة ع الويك اند
english: I'm good, yes, great. We want to go on a trip this weekend.
transliteration: Ana mnih aa tamam bedna nrouh rehla aal weekend.

arabic: الجبل هواه نضيف وريحته حلوة كتير
english: The mountain air is clean and smells very sweet.
transliteration: El Jabal hawah ndif w rihto helwe ktir.

arabic: يمكن نروح ع الشمال ونشوف البحر الازرق
english: Maybe we'll go north and see the blue sea.
transliteration: Yimkin nrouh aal shamal w nshouf el baher el azraq.

arabic: الرحلة بتكون حلوة كتير و الاكل زاكي
english: The trip will be very nice and the food delicious.
transliteration: El rehla btkoon helwe ktir w el akl zaki.

arabic: مرحباً بالجميع اليوم عنا مباراة كرة قدم ودية بين الجيران
english: Hello everyone, today we have a friendly football match between neighbors.
transliteration: Marhaba bil-jami' al-yom 'anna mubarat kurat qadam widdiyya bayn il-jiran.

arabic: كابتن فريقنا ابو احمد قال اهلاً وسهلاً لكل اللي اجوا يتفرجوا
english: Our team captain Abu Ahmad said welcome to everyone who came to watch.
transliteration: Kapten fariqna Abu Ahmad qal ahlan wa sahlan li-kul illi ajoo yitfarraju.

arabic: بلشت المباراة وحارس المرمى تبعهم وقع لحاله لما اجا يمسك الطابة
english: The match started and their goalkeeper fell by himself when he came to catch the ball.
transliteration: Ballashat il-mubara w haris il-marma taba'hum waqa' la-haloh lamma aja yimsik it-taba.

arabic: كلنا ضحكنا كثير حتى ابو علي اجا لعنده وقال السلام عليكم يا بطل
english: We all laughed a lot, even Abu Ali came to him and said "Peace be upon you, champ."
transliteration: Kullna dahekna ktir hatta Abu Ali aja la-'andoh w qal as-salamu 'alaykum ya batal.

arabic: حارس المرمى قام وهو عم يضحك ورد وعليكم السلام انا بخير بس الطابة كانت اسرع مني
english: The goalkeeper got up laughing and replied "And upon you be peace, I'm fine, but the ball was faster than me."
transliteration: Haris il-marma qam w huwwa 'am yidhak w radd wa alaykum as-salam ana bi-khair bas it-taba kanat asra' minni.

arabic: اليوم بلشت ابكر عشان بدي اشتري تياب جديدة
english: Today I started early because I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: El yom ballashat abkar ashan biddi ashtari tiyab jedide.

arabic: بعدين انا وصاحبي رحنا على السوق
english: Then me and my friend went to the market.
transliteration: Ba'deen ana w sahib-i rehna ala el souq.

arabic: دورنا على اواعي حلوة ولقينا بنطلون جديد
english: We looked for nice clothes and found new pants.
transliteration: Dawwarna ala awaei helwe w laqeena bantalon jedid.

arabic: بعدين تعبنا فقعدنا بمقهى صغير
english: Then we got tired, so we sat in a small cafe.
transliteration: Ba'deen ta'ebna fa qa'adna bi maqha sagheer.

arabic: كنا عم نحكي و شربنا قهوة طيبة
english: We were talking and drank good coffee.
transliteration: Kunna am nehki w sheribna gahwe taybe.

arabic: انا بسكن بمدينة كبيرة وكل سبت بروح على السوق
english: I live in a big city, and every Saturday I go to the market.
transliteration: Ana bas'kon bmadeene kabeere, w kull sabt barooh 'ala s-souq.

arabic: مبارح شفت خضار كتير غريبة حتى البندورة كانت عم تضحك علي
english: Yesterday I saw very strange vegetables, even the tomatoes were laughing at me.
transliteration: Mbarah sheft khudaar kteer ghareebe, hatta l-banadoora kanet 'am tedhak 'alayy.

arabic: حاولت احكي مع البياع عن سعر البصل بس هو كان عم يحكي مع موبايله
english: I tried to speak with the vendor about the price of onions, but he was speaking with his phone.
transliteration: Hawalt ahki ma' l-bayya' 'an se'er l-basal, bas huwwe kan 'am yehki ma' mobailo.

arabic: بالنهاية اشتريت خمسة كيلو بطاطا وموز كتير صار وزني زي الطاولة
english: In the end, I bought five kilos of potatoes and a lot of bananas, my weight became like a table.
transliteration: Bi-n-nehaye ishtarait khamse kilo batata w mawz kteer, sar wazni zayy it-tawle.

arabic: رجعت على البيت تعبان كتير وبس بدي ينام عشر ساعات على السرير
english: I returned home very tired, and I just want to sleep ten hours on the bed.
transliteration: Reje't 'ala l-bait ta'ban kteer, w bas baddi ynam 'ashar sa'at 'ala s-sareer.

arabic: مساء الخير انا منيحة
english: Good evening, I am good.
transliteration: Masa el-kheir, ana mniha.

arabic: كيفك انت وعيلتك
english: How are you and your family?
