transliteration: Kifak inta w 3ayiltak?

arabic: امي بتسلم عليك كتير
english: My mom sends you many greetings.
transliteration: Immi btsallim 3aleik kteer.

arabic: ان شاء الله بنحكي قريبا
english: Hopefully, we'll talk soon.
transliteration: In sha Allah bnehki qareeban.

arabic: تصبح على خير
english: Good night.
transliteration: Tesbah ala kheir.

arabic: اجتمعت العيلة كالعادة حوالي الطاولة الكبيرة وريحة الأكل الزاكي مالية البيت
english: The family gathered as usual around the big table, and the delicious food's aroma filled the house.
transliteration: ijtema'at il-ayle kal-aade hawali it-tawle il-kbeere w reehet il-akel iz-zaaki maalyet il-beet

arabic: الكل كان عم يحكي بحماس ويتبادل قصص يومه وهذا كان التزام اساسي عندهم ليضلوا متواصلين
english: Everyone was talking excitedly and exchanging stories of their day, and this was a fundamental commitment for them to stay connected.
transliteration: il-kull kaan am yahki bi-hamas w yetabaadal qisas yawmo w haada kaan iltizam asaasi 'indhum li-yidallu mutawasileen

arabic: ابو احمد حكى بفخر عن انجاز مهم حققه بشغله هالاسبوع وهالشي بفضل خبرته الطويلة
english: Abu Ahmad spoke proudly about an important achievement he realized at work this week, and this was thanks to his long experience.
transliteration: abu Ahmad haka bi-fakhr 'an injaaz muhimm haqqaqo bi-shughlo hal-usbu' w hal-shi bi-fadl khibrato it-taweele

arabic: ام احمد التفتت لابنهم سامي وتوقعت يحكيلها عن واجبه الجديد بمهنته الصعبة
english: Um Ahmad turned to their son Sami and expected him to tell her about his new duty in his difficult profession.
transliteration: umm Ahmad iltafatat li-ibnhum Sami w tawaqqa'at yahkeelha 'an wajebo il-jadeed bi-mihnato is-sa'be

arabic: بس سامي ابتسم وقال انا استقلت اليوم لحتى افتح مشروعي الخاص وهذا هو الانجاز الحقيقي بحياتي
english: But Sami smiled and said, "I resigned today to open my own business, and this is the real achievement in my life!"
transliteration: bas Sami ibtasam w qaala ana istaqalt il-yawm lahatta aftah mashroo'i il-khaass w haada huw al-injaaz il-haqeeqi bi-hayaati

arabic: انا وصلت عالقهوة بالمساء
english: I arrived at the cafe in the evening.
transliteration: ana waṣalt ʿal-qahwe bil-masāʾ

arabic: شفت رفيقي علي وقلت مساء الخير كيفك
english: I saw my friend Ali and said "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: shuft rfīʾī ʿali w qult masāʾ al-khayr kayfak

arabic: علي جاوب مساء النور انا منيح شكرا
english: Ali replied "Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: ʿali jāwab masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ shukran

arabic: طلبت قهوة و نطرتها
english: I ordered coffee and waited for it.
transliteration: ṭalabt qahwe w naṭartaha

arabic: بعد شوي علي قال باي مع السلامة
english: After a while, Ali said "Bye, goodbye."
transliteration: baʿd shway ʿali qāl bāy maʿ as-salāma

arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق وشفت صاحبي القديم
english: I was walking in the market and saw my old friend.
transliteration: Kunt mashi bil souq w shuft sahbi al qadeem

arabic: سلمنا على بعض وقال صار لي زمان ما شفتك
english: We greeted each other and he said 'It's been a long time since I've seen you!'
transliteration: Sallamna ala ba'ad w qaal sar li zaman ma shuftak

arabic: اختي كانت معي فقلت له هذه اختي ريم
english: My sister was with me, so I told him 'This is my sister Reem'.
transliteration: Okhti kanat ma'i fa qult lo hazihi okhti Reem

arabic: هو سلم عليها بحرارة وقال اهلا وسهلا يا ريم
english: He greeted her warmly and said 'Welcome, Reem!'
transliteration: Huwa sallam alayha bi harara w qaal ahlan wa sahlan ya Reem

arabic: حكينا شوي وبعدين قلنا مع السلامة وكملنا طريقنا
english: We talked a little, then said 'Goodbye' and continued on our way.
transliteration: Hakeena shway w ba'dein qulna ma'a salama w kammalna tareeqna

arabic: بلشت الصبح بسرعة وكنت كتير تعبان
english: The morning started quickly, and I was very tired.
transliteration: Ballashat el suboh bi sur'a w kunt kteer ta'baan.

arabic: جهزت حالي بسرعة للشغل
english: I quickly got ready for work.
transliteration: Jahhazt haali bi sur'a lel shoghl.

arabic: بدي قهوة عشان اصحصح
english: I needed coffee to feel awake.
transliteration: Beddi gahwe ashan asahseh.

arabic: بعدين انا وصاحبي رحنا على مقهى
english: Then, my friend and I went to a cafe.
transliteration: Ba'deen ana w sahiby rehna 'ala maqha.

arabic: النادل جاب لنا قهوة وحسيت حالي احسن
english: The waiter brought us coffee, and I felt better.
transliteration: El naadel jab lana gahwe w haseet haali ahsan.

arabic: انا بالقهوة كل يوم
english: I am at the cafe every day.
transliteration: Ana bil-qahwa kil yom.

arabic: انا ناطر اختي
english: I am waiting for my sister.
transliteration: Ana nater okhti.

arabic: انا بشرب قهوة سودا
english: I drink black coffee.
transliteration: Ana bashrab qahwe sawda.

arabic: اجت اختي هلا
english: My sister just arrived.
transliteration: Ijit okhti halla.

arabic: صار لي زمان ما شفتها
english: It's been a long time since I saw her.
transliteration: Sar li zaman ma shiftha.

arabic: انا وصاحبي قررنا نطبخ اكلة جديدة
english: My friend and I decided to cook a new dish.
transliteration: Ana w sahiby qarrarna natbokh akle jadeede
storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

arabic: صاحبي جاب كل المكونات من السوق
english: My friend brought all the ingredients from the market.
transliteration: Sahiby jab kell il-mukawwanat min is-souq
storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

arabic: بلشت اطبخ الاكلة اول مرة وكانت صعبة شوي
english: I started cooking the dish for the first time, and it was a bit difficult.
transliteration: Ballasht atbokh il-akle awwal marra w kaanet sa'be shway
storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

arabic: هلا عم بستنى الاكل يصير جاهز
english: Now I am waiting for the food to be ready.
transliteration: Halla am bastanna il-akel yseer jahez
storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

arabic: بتمنى طعمتها تكون طيبة
english: I hope its taste is good.
transliteration: Batmanna ta'met-ha tkoon taybe
storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

arabic: مبارح كان عيد ميلاد اختي الصغيرة مريم
english: Yesterday was my little sister Mariam's birthday
transliteration: Mbareh kan Eid milad okhti il-saghira Mariam

arabic: اجت كل العيلة والقرايب والضيوف على بيتنا بالمساء
english: All the family relatives and guests came to our house in the evening
transliteration: Ijet kull il-aa'ila wil-qarayeb w-il-duyoof a'la beitna bil-masa'

arabic: امي جهزت كعكة كبيرة وحلوة كتير مع حلويات شامية متنوعة
english: My mother prepared a big and very sweet cake with various Levantine sweets
transliteration: Ummi jahhazat ka'ka kbeera w-hilwa kteer ma' halawiyat shamiyya mitnawwi'a

arabic: كان الجو كتير حلو وفيه اغاني ورقص والهدايا كانت بتجنن
english: The atmosphere was very nice with songs and dancing and the gifts were amazing
transliteration: Kan il-jaww kteer hilu w-fee aghani w-raqs w-il-hadaya kanat bitjannen

arabic: قضينا سهرة ممتعة وكلنا كنا مبسوطين بهالاحتفال العائلي
english: We spent an enjoyable evening and we were all happy with this family celebration
transliteration: Qaddayna sahra mumti'a w-kullna kunna mabsooteen bi-hal-ihtifal il-aa'ili

arabic: كل يوم انا بروح عالمدرسة
english: Every day I go to school.
transliteration: Kull yom ana barouh al madrasa

arabic: اليوم رحت مع اختي
english: Today I went with my sister.
transliteration: Elyom roht ma'a okhti

arabic: كان في صف عربي جديد
english: There was a new Arabic class.
transliteration: Kan fi saff arabi jadeed

arabic: صار لي زمان ما درست عربي
english: It's been a long time since I studied Arabic.
transliteration: Sar li zaman ma darast arabi

arabic: بعد المدرسة رجعت عالبيت مع ماما
english: After school I returned home with Mom.
transliteration: Ba'd al madrasa raja't al beit ma'a mama

arabic: العيلة بلشت تتجمع عالغدا
english: The family started gathering for lunch
transliteration: El-3eile ballashat tetjamma3 3al ghada

arabic: جدي حكى عن قصص قديمة من زمان
english: My grandfather told old stories from a long time ago
transliteration: Jaddi haka 3an qisas qadimeh min zaman

arabic: انا وصاحبي عم نحكي عن مقهى جديد بالبلد
english: My friend and I are talking about a new cafe in town
transliteration: Ana w sahiby 3am nehki 3an maqha jdid bel balad

arabic: خالتي جابت قهوة بعد الاكل
english: My aunt brought coffee after the meal
transliteration: Khalti jabat gahwe ba3d el akel

arabic: الكبار والصغار كلهم مبسوطين باللمة
english: The old and young, all are happy with the gathering
transliteration: El kbar w el sghar kellem mabsooteen bel lamma

arabic: وصلت على المدرسة بكير اليوم والصف كان فاضي
english: I arrived at school early today, and the classroom was empty
transliteration: Wṣalt ʿala el madrasah bakkeer el yoom wel ṣaff kaan faaḍi

arabic: شفت الباب فاتح بس انا مو شايف اي حدا بالغرفة
english: I saw the door open, but I don't see anyone in the room
transliteration: Shu'ft el baab faateḥ bas ana muu shaayef ayy 7ada bil ghurfeh

arabic: رنيت لرفيقي احمد وسالته وين الكل
english: I called my friend Ahmad and asked him where everyone was
transliteration: Rannayt li-rafii'i Aḥmad w sa'alto weyn el kull

arabic: قالي صارلنا ساعة بالمكتبة عم ندرس لمشروعنا فيك تجي
english: He told me "We've been in the library for an hour studying for our project, can you come?"
transliteration: Qalli "Saarlana saa'a bil maktabeh 3am nodros li-mashruu3na, feek teji?"

arabic: جاوبته اذا بتخلصوا شغلكم بكير صار وقت الغداء فينا ناكل سوا
english: I answered him "If you finish your work early, it's lunchtime, we can eat together"
transliteration: Jaawabto "Itha betkhallṣu shoghlkom bakkeer, ṣaar wa't el ghada', feena na'kol sawa."

arabic: اليوم بلشت مشكلة كبيرة بالبيت
english: Today a big problem started at home
transliteration: Elyom ballashat mushkile kbire bel beit

arabic: ماما كانت زعلانة كتير والمي ما عم تجي
english: Mom was very sad and the water wasn't coming
transliteration: Mama kanat za'lane ktir wel may ma am tiji

arabic: انا بستنى بابا يجي ويشوف شو المشكلة
english: I am waiting for dad to come and see what the problem is
transliteration: Ana bastanna baba yiji w yishuf shu el mushkile

arabic: هو دايما بيعرف يحل كل شي
english: He always knows how to solve everything
transliteration: Hu dayman bya'ref yihel kil shi

arabic: يمكن لازم نجيب صاحب سباك بكرة
english: Maybe we need to bring a plumber friend tomorrow
transliteration: Yemkin lazim njib sahib sabbak bukra

arabic: مساء الخير يا عيلتي اجينا لنحضر مباراة كرة القدم سوا
english: Good evening my family, we came to watch the football match together.
transliteration: masaa al-khayr ya ʿaylati ajayna linaḥḍur mubaraat kurat al-qadam sawa

arabic: اهلاً وسهلاً بالكل قعدنا بالصالون متحمسين كتير
english: Welcome everyone, we sat in the living room very excited.
transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan bil-kull qaʿadna biṣ-ṣaloon mutaḥammiseen kteer

arabic: اللاعب المفضل عندي سجل هدف رائع والكل صرخ بفرح
english: My favorite player scored a wonderful goal and everyone screamed with joy.
transliteration: al-laaʿib al-mufaḍḍal ʿindi sajjal hadaf raaʾiʿ wal-kull ṣarakh bi-faraḥ

arabic: ماما جهزت شاي ومكسرات وقعدنا عم نضحك ونحكي
english: Mama prepared tea and nuts, and we sat laughing and talking.
transliteration: mama jahhazat shaay wa mukassarat wa qaʿadna ʿam niḍḥak waniḥki

arabic: كانت سهرة حلوة مع العيلة والمباراة كانت بتجنن
english: It was a sweet evening with the family and the match was amazing.
transliteration: kaanat sahra ḥilwa maʿa al-ʿayla wal-mubaraat kaanat bitjannin

arabic: ماما شافت الضو خربان
english: Mom saw the light was broken.
transliteration: Mama shafet ad-daw kharban.

arabic: صار لي زمان ما صلحناه
english: It's been a long time since we fixed it.
transliteration: Sar li zaman ma salahnah.

arabic: اختي قالت انا بساعد
english: My sister said 'I will help'.
transliteration: Ukhti qalat ana basa'ed.

arabic: اخي اجا وسأل شو المشكلة
english: My brother came and asked 'What is the problem?'
transliteration: Akhi aja w sa'al shu al-mushkileh.

arabic: ماما ابتسمت رح نصلحها سوا
english: Mom smiled 'We will fix it all together'.
transliteration: Mama ibtasamet rah nislaha sawa.

arabic: اليوم عندنا حفلة كبيرة صار لي زمان ما شفت العيلة
english: Today we have a big party. It's been a long time since I saw the family.
transliteration: Alyoum 'indana hafla kabira sar li zaman ma shuft il-'aylah.

arabic: ماما بدها كل شي يكون حلو جدا
english: Mom wants everything to be very nice.
transliteration: Mama baddaha kull shi yikoun hilu jiddan.

arabic: هذه اختي تساعد ماما في المطبخ
english: This is my sister helping Mom in the kitchen.
transliteration: Hathihi okhti tusa'id Mama fi almatbakh.

arabic: اخي بس ياكل ولا يساعد ابدا
english: My brother just eats and never helps.
transliteration: Akhi bas ya'kul wala yusa'id abadan.

arabic: هذا باباي يقول لا تقلقوا انا هنا للاكل فقط
english: This is my dad saying "Don't worry, I'm here just for the food."
transliteration: Hada babay yaqul la taqlaqu ana huna lil'akl faqat.

arabic: اليوم رحت عالقهوة
english: Today I went to the café
transliteration: Elyom roht aal-qahwa

arabic: انا عم بستنى صاحبتي
english: I am waiting for my friend
transliteration: Ana am bastanna sahobti

arabic: النادل جاب القهوة
english: The waiter brought the coffee
transliteration: En-naadel jab el-qahwa

arabic: عم نحكي عن مشكلة صغيرة
english: We are talking about a small problem
transliteration: Am nehki aan mushkileh saghira

arabic: صاحبتي شوي زعلانة
english: My friend is a little sad
transliteration: Sahobti shway za'lane

arabic: شفت جارتي ام علي وقلتلها صباح الخير يا ام علي شو هال عاصفة في رعد وبرق اليوم
english: I saw my neighbor Um Ali and told her 'Good morning Um Ali, what is this storm? There is thunder and lightning today!'
transliteration: Shuft jarti Um Ali w qultelha Sabah el kher ya Um Ali shoo hal aasifa fi ra'ed w barq el yoom.

arabic: جاوبتني صباح الخير حبيبتي اي والله الجو كتير غائم وعاصف هاي عاصفة خريف حقيقية
english: She answered 'Good morning habibti, yes, the weather is very cloudy and windy, this is a real autumn storm.'
transliteration: Jawabetni Sabah el kher habibti, ay wallah el jaww kteer gha'em w aasef, hay aasifat kharif haqiqiya.

arabic: قلتلها صح الخريف عادة بيكون حلو بس هالسنة غير وبارد
english: I told her 'True, autumn is usually nice, but this year it's different and cold.'
transliteration: Qultelha sah el kharif aadatan bikooun helu bas hal sana gheir w bared.

arabic: ردت علي اي والله بس عم نحاول نخلي البيت دافي بالصوبيا مشان الاولاد ما يمرضوا
english: She replied 'Yes, but we are trying to keep the house warm with the heater so the kids don't get sick.'
transliteration: Raddet alayi ay wallah bas am nhawel nkhalli el beit dafi bel soobya mishan el awlad ma yemradu.

arabic: وافقتها وقلتلها انتبهي على حالك ودخلت بسرعة لجوا من الهوا القوي
english: I agreed and told her to take care, and went inside quickly because of the strong wind.
transliteration: Wafaqtaha w qultelha entebhi ala halek w dakhalet bsor'a la juwwa min el hawa el qawi.

arabic: اليوم صار وقت نصلح الغسالة لانها ما عم تشتغل منيح
english: Today it's time to fix the washing machine because it's not working well.
transliteration: El yoom saar wa't nosle7 el ghassaleh la'ennaha ma 3am teshteghil mneeh.

arabic: مرتي سالتني شو رح نعمل اذا ما اشتغلت ابدا
english: My wife asked me what we will do if it doesn't work at all.
transliteration: Marti sa'aletni shoo ra7 ne3mal itha ma eshtaghalet abadan.

arabic: جاوبتها لازم نصلحها فورا عشان ما تتراكم الغسيل
english: I answered her, we must fix it immediately so the laundry doesn't pile up.
transliteration: Jaawabtaha laazem nosle7ha fawran 3ashaan ma tetraakam el ghaseel.

arabic: راح اتصل بالتقني هلا ليجي يشوفها
english: I will call the technician now for him to come see it.
transliteration: Ra7 attasel bil taqani halla la yeeji yshoofha.

arabic: اذا بيقدر يجي اليوم راح نفرح كتير ونخلص من المشكلة
english: If he can come today, we will be very happy and get rid of the problem.
transliteration: Itha bi'eqdar yeeji el yoom ra7 nefra7 kteer w nekhlas men el mushkeleh.

arabic: انا كنت امشي في الشارع
english: I was walking on the street.
transliteration: Ana kunt amshi fi ash-shaare'

arabic: ما بعرف وين بيتي
english: I don't know where my house is.
transliteration: Ma ba'ref wein beiti

arabic: سالت شب وين السوق
english: I asked a young man where the market is.
transliteration: Sa'alt shab wein as-soo'

arabic: قال لي امشي دغري
english: He told me to walk straight.
transliteration: Qal li imshi doghri

arabic: بس هو كان انا
english: But he was me!
transliteration: Bas huwwa kan ana

arabic: في ولد صغير بسأل كتير اسئلة
english: There is a small boy who asks many questions.
transliteration: Fi walad saghir bise'al ktir as'ileh

arabic: هو دايما بسأل ماماه ماما ليش السما زرقا
english: He always asks his mom, 'Mama, why is the sky blue?'
transliteration: Huwa dayman bise'al mamah Mama lesh el sama zarqa

arabic: وبعدين بسأل اخته اختي وين بتروح البسة
english: Then he asks his sister, 'My sister, where does the cat go?'
transliteration: Waba'den bise'al okhto okhti wein bitrooh el bisseh

arabic: ماماه بس بتضحك وبتقول يا حبيبي
english: His mom just laughs and says, 'Oh my dear!'
transliteration: Mamah bas bitdehak w bteqool ya habibi

arabic: هو بضل يسأل اسئلة كل اليوم
english: He keeps asking questions all day long.
transliteration: Huwa biddall yise'al as'ileh kil el yom

arabic: اليوم اتصلت بصديقتي مريم وحكينا كتير عن اخبارها واهلها
english: Today I called my friend Maryam and we spoke a lot about her news and her family.
transliteration: Elyom etassalt bi sadeeqati Maryam w hakeena kteer an akhbarha w ahelha
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هي تسكن بمدينه تانيه بس قريبه منا شوي
english: She lives in another city but a bit close to us.
transliteration: Heyye teskon bi madeene tanya bas areebe menna shway
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: سالتها اذا بدها تجي لعندي نشرب قهوه بكره
english: I asked her if she wants to come to my place to drink coffee tomorrow.
transliteration: Sa'alta ella iza beddha teji la'andi neshrob ahwe bokra
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: قالت لي انها مشغوله شوي بس يمكن تقدر تيجي بعد الظهر ونقعد بالغرفه
english: She told me she's a bit busy but maybe she can come in the afternoon and we'll sit in the room.
transliteration: Aalat li enna mashghooleh shway bas yemken ta'dar teji ba'd el dohor w no'od bel ghurfa
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اتفقنا ترن علي لما تكون جاهزه لتجي لعندي
english: We agreed she would call me when she is ready to come to my place.
transliteration: Ettefa'na terenn alayya lamma tkoun jahzeh la teji la'andi
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: بلشت الدنيا تمطر كتير بعد الضهر
english: It started raining heavily in the afternoon.
transliteration: ballashat ed dunya tomṭor kteer ba'd ed dohor

arabic: فجأة المي بلشت تنزل من سقف المطبخ
english: Suddenly, the water started leaking from the kitchen ceiling.
transliteration: faj'atan el may ballashat tenzel men saqf el maṭbakh

arabic: ماما كانت زعلانة شوي من هاي المشكلة
english: Mom was a little sad because of this problem.
transliteration: mama kanat za'lane shway men hay el mushkile

arabic: اتصلنا بالسباك لحتى يحل المشكلة
english: We called the plumber to solve the problem.
transliteration: ettaṣalna bes sabbak laḥatta yiḥell el mushkile

arabic: اجا وضحك وصلحها بسرعة
english: He came, laughed, and fixed it quickly!
transliteration: aja we ḍeḥek we ṣallaḥha be sor'a

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي شو هالريحة الزاكية من بيتك اليوم
english: Good morning, my neighbor! What's this delicious smell from your house today?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya jarti, shoo hal-reeha ez-zakyeh min baytek el-yom?

arabic: اهلين يا ام فادي عم بعمل كيكة بس الظاهر نسيت اضيف السكر
english: Hello, Um Fadi! I'm making a cake, but it seems I forgot to add sugar.
transliteration: Ahleen ya Umm Fadi, 'am ba'mel kika bas el-zaher nseet adif es-sukkar.

arabic: ههه عشان هيك الريحة لحالها بتشهي بس الطعمة الله اعلم
english: Haha, that's why the smell alone is appetizing, but the taste, God knows!
transliteration: Hahaha, 'ashan heik er-reeha la-halha bitshahhi bas et-ta'ma Allah a'lam.

arabic: مظبوط يمكن بدها شوية دبس تمر بدل السكر
english: Exactly! Maybe it needs a little date molasses instead of sugar.
transliteration: Mazboot, yumken beddaha shwayyet dibs tamr badal es-sukkar.

arabic: فكرة ممتازة تعالي جربي عندي القهوة وبنحكي بالوصفة
english: Excellent idea! Come try coffee at my place and we can talk about the recipe.
transliteration: Fekra mumtaza! Ta'ali jarribi 'andi el-qahwe w bnehki bel-wasfe.

arabic: لينا اتصلت بصاحبتها سارة وقالت لها صباح الخير
english: Lina called her friend Sara and said to her Good morning
transliteration: Lina ittaṣalat bi-ṣāḥibitha Sara w-qālat lahā ṣabāḥ al-khayr
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: سارة ردت عليها وقالت صباح النور كيفك اليوم
english: Sara replied to her and said Morning of light how are you today
transliteration: Sara raddat ʿalayhā w-qālat ṣabāḥ an-nūr kīfik al-yōm
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: لينا جاوبت انا منيحة الحمد لله وانتي شو عاملة
english: Lina answered I am good praise be to God and what are you doing
transliteration: Lina jāwabat ana mnīḥa al-ḥamdulillāh w-inti shū ʿāmleh
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: سارة قالت انا بالبيت وبدي نطلع سوا هالاسبوع
english: Sara said I am at home and I want us to go out together this week
transliteration: Sara qālat ana bil-bēt w-bidde niṭlaʿ sawa hāl-usbūʿ
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: لينا وافقت وقالت تمام بحكيكي بعدين مع السلامة
english: Lina agreed and said Okay I'll talk to you later goodbye
transliteration: Lina wāfaqat w-qālat tamām baḥkīki baʿdēn maʿ as-salāma
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: الدنيا عم تمطر برا و الجو بارد كثير
english: It's raining outside and the weather is very cold
transliteration: id-dunya ʿam tumṭur barra w il-jaww bārid ktīr

arabic: أنا قاعد بالبيت و عم بشرب نسكافيه سخن
english: I'm sitting at home and drinking hot Nescafé
transliteration: Ana qāʿed bil-bēt w ʿam bashrab neskāfē sakhin

arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت ضربة قوية على الشباك طلعت قطة عم تحاول تهرب من المطر
english: Suddenly I heard a loud bang on the window; it was a cat trying to escape the rain
transliteration: Fajʾa samiʿt ṣōt ḍarbeh qawiyye ʿalash-shubbāk ṭalaʿat qiṭṭa ʿam tiḥāwil tihrab min il-maṭar

arabic: بعد شوي رن التلفون و قالت أمي مساء الخير كيفك يا ابني أنا منيح شكرا
english: A little later the phone rang, and my mom said 'Good evening, how are you, my son?' I replied 'I'm fine, thank you'
transliteration: Baʿd shway rann it-tilifōn w qālat ummi masāʾ al-khayr kayfak ya ibni ana mnīḥ shukran

arabic: قررت انو أحسن شي لهيك يوم هو اني كمل النسكافيه و اتفرج على فيلم
english: I decided that the best thing for such a day is to finish the Nescafé and watch a movie
transliteration: Qarrart inno aḥsan shī la-hēk yōm huwwe inni kammil in-neskāfē w atfarraj ʿala film

arabic: مساء الخير كيفك يا جارتي
english: Good evening, how are you, my neighbor?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr, kayfik ya jārti?

arabic: مساء النور انا منيحة شكرا كيفك انت
english: Good evening (reply), I'm fine, thank you. How are you?
transliteration: Masāʾ an-nūr, ana mnīḥa, shukran. Kayfak inta?

arabic: انا منيح الحمد لله
english: I'm fine, praise be to God.
transliteration: Ana mnīḥ, al-ḥamdu lillāh.

arabic: انا لازم روح هلا عندي شغل
english: I have to go now, I have work.
transliteration: Ana lāzim rūḥ hallāʾ ʿandi shughl.

arabic: مع السلامة باي
english: Goodbye, bye.
transliteration: Maʿ as-salāma, bāy.

arabic: بكرا بدنا نسافر على الجبل الجو هناك حلو كتير
english: Tomorrow we want to travel to the mountain, the weather there is very nice.
transliteration: Bokra bedna nsafer 'ala el jabal el jaw honak helw kteer.

arabic: بس كان عنا مشكلة صغيرة بالمطبخ المي كانت تنزل من السقف
english: But we had a small problem in the kitchen, the water was dripping from the ceiling.
transliteration: Bass kan 'anna mushkileh zġeere bil maṭbakh el may kanet tenzel min el saqf.

arabic: بسرعة جبنا السباك وهو صلحها
english: Quickly we brought the plumber and he fixed it.
transliteration: Be sor'a jebna el sabbak w howe ṣallaḥha.

arabic: هلا كل شي تمام وماما مو زعلانة ابدا
english: Now everything is fine and mom is not sad at all.
transliteration: Hella kol shi tamam w mama mo za'lane abadan.

arabic: رح نشوف شجر اخضر كتير ونشم هوا نقي
english: We will see a lot of green trees and smell fresh air.
transliteration: Raḥ nshoof shajar akhdar kteer w nshemm hawa naqi.

arabic: جدتي وانا رحنا عالسوق اليوم
english: My grandmother and I went to the market today
transliteration: Jaddati w ana rahna a'as-souq el-yom

arabic: جدتي شافت خضرة وفواكه هي بتعرفها من زمان
english: My grandmother saw vegetables and fruits she has known for a long time
transliteration: Jaddati shafat khodra w fawakeh hiye bta'rafha min zaman

arabic: اما انا فشفت اشياء جديدة وحكيت مع البياع عن الاسعار
english: But I saw new things and spoke with the vendor about the prices
transliteration: Amma ana fa-shuft ashya' jadideh w haket ma' el-bayya' 'an el-as'ar

arabic: جدتي حبت السوق التقليدي كتير بس انا حبيت الاقسام الحديثة
english: My grandmother loved the traditional market a lot, but I loved the modern sections
transliteration: Jaddati habbat es-souq et-taqlidi kteer bas ana habbet el-aqsam el-haditheh

arabic: بعدين اكلنا مناقيش وشربنا شاي سوا وكان يوم حلو
english: Then we ate mana'eesh and drank tea together, and it was a nice day
transliteration: Ba'dein akalna manaqish w sharibna shay sawa w kan yom helu

arabic: انا قاعد بالقهوة اليوم
english: I am sitting at the cafe today.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bil qahwe elyom

arabic: بدي قهوة كبير كتير
english: I want a very big coffee.
transliteration: Biddi qahwe kbir kteer

arabic: ريحة القهوة حلو كتير هون
english: The smell of coffee is very nice here.
transliteration: Reehet el qahwe helu kteer hon

arabic: انا بسمع صوت موسيقى حلو
english: I hear nice music.
transliteration: Ana basma' sowt mooseeqa helu

arabic: انا ناطر صاحبي يجي هلا
english: I am waiting for my friend to come now.
transliteration: Ana nater sahbi yiji halla

arabic: ليلى دخلت المطبخ وشافت المي على السقف.
english: Layla entered the kitchen and saw the water on the ceiling.
transliteration: Layla dakhalat al-matbakh wa shafat al-may ala al-saqf.

arabic: إمها بلشت تزعل من المشكلة الكبيرة.
english: Her mother started to get sad about the big problem.
transliteration: Immaha ballashat tiz'al min al-mushkila al-kabira.

arabic: أخوها قال: أنا بدي أحلها بسرعة.
english: Her brother said: "I want to solve it quickly."
transliteration: Akhuha qal: "Ana biddi ahillaha bi-sur'a."

arabic: أبوها جاب سباك مشان يصلح المي.
english: Her father brought a plumber to fix the water.
transliteration: Abuha jab sabbak mishan yisallih al-may.

arabic: الكل شاف السباك صلح السقف بسرعة.
english: Everyone saw the plumber fixed the ceiling quickly.
transliteration: Al-kull shaf al-sabbak sallih al-saqf bi-sur'a.

arabic: اليوم قررت اطبخ طبخة جديدة لاول مرة في حياتي
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish for the first time in my life.
transliteration: El yōm qarart aṭbukh ṭabkha jadīde li awal marra fī ḥayātī

arabic: كانت صعبة شوي بس كتير حلوة وبدها تركيز
english: It was a bit difficult but very nice and needed focus.
transliteration: Kānat ṣaʻbe shway bas ktīr ḥilwe w badaha tarkīz

arabic: رفيقتي ريم اتصلت فيني وسألتني وين بتشتغلي اليوم يا شاطرة
english: My friend Rima called me and asked me "Where do you work today, smarty?"
transliteration: Rafīqtī Rīm ittaṣalat fīni w sa'alatni wēn btishraghli el yōm yā shāṭra?

arabic: قلتلها انا مش طباخ بس عم جرب اكون طباخ في البيت اليوم
english: I told her "I'm not a chef, but I'm trying to be a chef at home today."
transliteration: Qultilha ana mish tabbākh bas ʻam jarrib akūn tabbākh fī el bēt el yōm

arabic: ضحكت وقالتلي بلكي بتصيري تفتحي مطعم خاص فيكي
english: She laughed and told me "Maybe you'll open your own restaurant."
transliteration: Ḍaḥikat w qālatli balki bitṣīrī taftaḥi maṭʻam khāṣṣ fīki

arabic: اليوم عم تمطر كتير
english: Today it's raining a lot.
transliteration: El yom 'am tomṭor kteer

arabic: في مشكلة صغيرة بالسقف
english: There is a small problem with the ceiling.
transliteration: Fi mushkile sghire bes saqf

arabic: المي عم تنزل على الارض
english: The water is coming down to the floor.
transliteration: El may 'am tenzal 'ala el arḍ

arabic: ماما اتصلت بالسباك بسرعة
english: Mom called the plumber quickly.
transliteration: Mama ettaṣalat bes sabbak be sor'a

arabic: السباك اجا و صلحها
english: The plumber came and fixed it.
transliteration: Es sabbak aja w ṣallaḥha

arabic: صباح الخير اليوم عيد ميلادي
english: Good morning, today is my birthday!
transliteration: ṣabāḥ al-khayr al-yawm ʿīd mīlādī

arabic: اجت جارتي قالت لي السلام عليكم اهلا وسهلا
english: My neighbor came and said to me, "Peace be upon you, welcome!"
transliteration: ijat jāratī qālat lī as-salāmu ʿalaykum ahlan wa sahlan

arabic: انا كتير مبسوط بس نسيت وين الكيك
english: I am very happy, but I forgot where the cake is.
transliteration: anā katīr mabsūṭ bas nisīt weyn il-kīk

arabic: ماما جابت الكيك بس وقعت شمعة صغيرة
english: Mom brought the cake, but a small candle fell.
transliteration: māmā jābat il-kīk bas waqaʿat shamʿa ṣaghīra

arabic: كلنا ضحكنا واكلنا الكيك الطيب
english: We all laughed and ate the delicious cake.
transliteration: kullunā ḍiḥiknā w akalnā il-kīk aṭ-ṭayyib

arabic: كان بعد الضهر عم بشتي وانا لحالي بالبيت
english: It was a rainy afternoon and I was home alone.
transliteration: kan ba'ed ed-dohor amm bishatti w ana la hali bil bayt

arabic: حسيت حالي زهقان فرحت عملت كاسة شاي
english: I felt bored, so I went and made a cup of tea.
transliteration: hassayt hali zah'an fa rahet amalt kaset shay

arabic: بعدين قعدت جنب الشباك وشفت المطر عم ينزل كتير
english: Then I sat by the window and saw the rain falling heavily.
transliteration: ba'den qa'adt janb esh shubbak w sheft el matar amm yenzal kteer

arabic: فجأة اجا بسّي مشمش وطلع فيني كانه عرف اني بدي العب
english: Suddenly, my cat, Mishmish, came and looked at me as if he knew I wanted to play.
transliteration: faj'ah eja bessi mishmish w tala' fini ka'anno araf enni biddi al'ab

arabic: لعبنا شوي بعدين اكلت انا وياه و نمنا سوا عالكنباية
english: We played for a bit, then I ate with him and we both slept on the couch.
transliteration: le'ebna shway ba'den akalt ana wiyyah w nemna sawa al kanabaye

arabic: انا رحت على السوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roḥt 'ala es-souq el-yom.

arabic: شفت ناس كتير وسمعت صوت عالي
english: I saw many people and heard a loud sound.
transliteration: Sheft nas ktiir w semi't ṣout 'aali.

arabic: سلمت على البياع وحكيت معه شوي
english: I greeted the vendor and talked with him a little.
transliteration: Sallamt 'ala el-bayya' w ḥakeit ma'o shway.

arabic: كان عنده خضرة فريش بس في مشكلة صغيرة بالسعر
english: He had fresh vegetables but there was a small problem with the price.
transliteration: Kan 'endo khoḍra fresh bas fi mushkile ṣghiire bes-se'er.

arabic: بعدين اشتريت التفاح بسرعة ورجعت عالبيت
english: Then I bought the apples quickly and returned home.
transliteration: Ba'dein eshtarait et-tuffaḥ be sor'a w reja't 'al-beit.

arabic: ليلى فاتت الدكانة. شافت الخال أبو سمير.
english: Layla entered the shop. She saw Uncle Abu Samir.
transliteration: Layla fatat ad-dukkaneh. Shafat il-khal Abu Samir.

arabic: أهلاً ليلى! كيفك هلق؟
english: Hello Layla! How are you now?
transliteration: Ahlan Layla! Kifek halla'?

arabic: ردت ليلى: منِيحة، يسلمو. عندك كتاب؟
english: Layla replied: Fine, thank you. Do you have a book?
transliteration: Raddet Layla: Mniha, yislamoo. Andak ktab?

arabic: آه، هاد هو! يلا مع السلامة.
english: Ah, that's it! Okay, goodbye.
transliteration: Aa, had hu! Yalla ma'a salameh.

arabic: ابتسمت ليلى: شكراً خالو، باي.
english: Layla smiled: Thank you uncle, bye.
transliteration: Ibtasamat Layla: Shukran khalo, bye.

arabic: نحنا رحنا على السوق
english: We went to the market
transliteration: Nahna rohna ala as-souq
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: اختي كانت معي
english: My sister was with me
transliteration: Okhti kanat ma'i
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: سلمنا على البائع بحرارة
english: We greeted the vendor warmly
transliteration: Sallamna ala al-ba'e' biharara
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: صار لنا زمان ما جينا لهون
english: It's been a long time since we came here
transliteration: Sar lana zaman ma jeena lahon
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: باباي اشترى خضار طازجة
english: My dad bought fresh vegetables
transliteration: Babay ishtara khodar tazaja
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: انا رحت على السوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana ruht 'ala es-souq el-yom.

arabic: كان في ناس كتير وانا ضعت
english: There were many people and I got lost.
transliteration: Kan fi nas ktir w ana di't.

arabic: حسيت بخوف شوي ما عرفت وين اروح
english: I felt a little scared, I didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Hassayt bi khawf shway ma 'araft weyn aruh.

arabic: سالت بياع عن الطريق بسرعة
english: I quickly asked a vendor for the way.
transliteration: Sa'alt bayya' 'an et-tariq be sor'a.

arabic: هو ساعدني ولقيت طريقي
english: He helped me and I found my way.
transliteration: Huw sa'adni w laqayt tariqi.

arabic: جدو وحفيدو عم يحضروا مباراة كرة قدم
english: Grandfather and his grandson are watching a football match.
transliteration: Jaddo wa ḥafīdo ʿam yaḥḍaru mubārāt kurat qadam.

arabic: مساء الخير جدو كيفك انا منيح
english: Good evening, grandpa, how are you? I'm fine.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr jaddo kayfak ana mnīḥ.

arabic: الحفيد بيحب يشوف لاعبين جداد وسرعة اللعب
english: The grandson likes to see new players and the speed of the game.
transliteration: Al-ḥafīd bīḥibb yashūf lāʿibīn jdād wa surʿat al-laʿib.

arabic: الجد بيحكي عن ايام زمان ومهارة اللعب القديمة
english: The grandfather talks about olden days and the old skill of playing.
transliteration: Al-jadd bīḥkī ʿan ayyām zamān wa mahārat al-laʿib al-qadīma.

arabic: بعد المباراة قال الجد مع السلامة
english: After the match, the grandfather said goodbye.
transliteration: Baʿd al-mubārāt qāl al-jadd maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: كنت ماشي بالشوارع القديمة وشميت ريحة خبز طازة كتير حلوة
english: I was walking in the old streets and smelled the very nice fresh bread.
transliteration: Kunt mashe bel shawarea el qadeeme w shammayt reehet khubez taze kteer helwe.

arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت حدا عم ينادي اسمي والتفتت بسرعة
english: Suddenly I heard someone calling my name and quickly turned around.
transliteration: Faj'a smeat sawt hada am yenadi esmi w eltafattet bsor'a.

arabic: كان رفيقي القديم رامي يلي ما شفته من سنين طويلة وعيونه كانت عم تضحك
english: It was my old friend Rami whom I hadn't seen for many years, and his eyes were smiling.
transliteration: Kan rafiqi el qadeem Rami yalli ma shufto min sneen taweeleh w oyouno kanet am tedhak.

arabic: سلمت عليه بحرارة وحسيت بفرحة كبيرة لما ضميته
english: I greeted him warmly and felt great joy when I hugged him.
transliteration: Sallamt aleh bi harara w hassayt bi farha kbeere lamma dammayto.

arabic: قعدنا نشرب قهوة سوا وحكينا كتير عن ايامنا الحلوة القديمة
english: We sat and drank coffee together and talked a lot about our sweet old days.
transliteration: Qa'adna neshrab qahwe sawa w hakeena kteer an ayyamna el helwe el qadeeme.

arabic: امبارح اشتريت غرض من السوق
english: Yesterday I bought an item from the market.
transliteration: Imbareḥ ishtarayt gharaḍ min es-souq.

arabic: بس كان خربان فرجعت للبياع اليوم
english: But it was broken, so I returned to the vendor today.
transliteration: Bas kan kharban faraja't lil-bayya' el-youm.

arabic: البياع كان مشغول مع ناس كتير
english: The vendor was busy with many people.
transliteration: El-bayya' kan mashghoul ma' nas kteer.

arabic: هو صلحها بسرعة واعطاني ياها
english: He fixed it quickly and gave it to me.
transliteration: Houwa ṣallaḥha be sor'a w a'ṭani yaha.

arabic: بس بعدين عرفت اني رجعت الغلط
english: But then I realized I had returned the wrong one.
transliteration: Bas ba'dein 'areft inni rajja't el-ghalaṭ.

arabic: مساء الخير يا صديقي انا ناطر بالقهوة من زمان
english: Good evening my friend, I've been waiting at the café for a long time.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr yā ṣadīqī, ana nāṭir bil-qahwa min zamān.

arabic: شفت رفيقي جاي وابتسمت لاله وسلمت عليه كيفكَ
english: I saw my friend coming, smiled at him, and greeted him. How are you?
transliteration: Shuft rafīqī jāy w-ibtisamt la-ilo w-sallamt ʿalayh. Kayfak?

arabic: رد عليي انا منيح الحمد لله شكرا على سؤالك
english: He replied to me: I'm fine, praise be to God, thank you for asking.
transliteration: Radd ʿalayyi: ana mnīḥ il-ḥamdulillāh, shukran ʿala suʾālak.

arabic: طلبنا قهوة سادة وقعدنا نحكي عن الشغل والعيلة لساعات طويلة
english: We ordered plain coffee and sat talking about work and family for long hours.
transliteration: Ṭalabnā qahwe sāde w-qaʿadnā niḥkī ʿan ish-shughl w-il-ʿēle li-sāʿāt ṭawīle.

arabic: بعد ما خلصنا ودعنا بعضنا وقلنا باي ومع السلامة
english: After we finished, we said goodbye to each other and said "bye" and "goodbye".
transliteration: Baʿd mā khalaṣnā waddaʿnā baʿḍnā w-qulnā "bāy" w- "maʿ as-salāma".

arabic: بارح اشتريت كنزة جديدة لفصل الخريف بس طلعت كتير كبيرة علي
english: Yesterday I bought a new sweater for autumn, but it turned out to be too big for me
transliteration: Bareh eshtareit kanzeh jdeedeh lafasl el khareef bas tala'at kteer kbeereh alayya

arabic: اليوم الجو كان عاصفة وفي رعد وبرق فقلت لازم ارجعها بسرعة
english: Today the weather was stormy with thunder and lightning, so I said I must return it quickly
transliteration: Elyom el jaww kan aasifeh w fi ra'ed w barq fa qolt lazim arrajje'ha besor'a

arabic: لما وصلت عالمحل كان غايم والابواب مسكرة وما في حدا
english: When I arrived at the shop, it was cloudy and the doors were closed and no one was there
transliteration: Lamma weselt a'al mahal kan gha'em w el abwab msakkara w ma fi hada

arabic: تطلعت عالباب لقيت ورقة صغيرة مكتوب عليها المحل صار متحف
english: I looked at the door and found a small paper written on it "The shop became a museum"
transliteration: Ttala'at a'al bab laqeet wara'a zgheereh maktoob alayha "el mahal sar mat'haf"

arabic: ضحكت وقلت هلا عندي كنزة كبيرة وقطعة من التاريخ
english: I laughed and said now I have a big sweater and a piece of history
transliteration: Dehekt w qolt hala'a 'andi kanzeh kbeereh w qit'a men et tareekh

arabic: اليوم بدي اطبخ طبخة جديدة
english: Today I want to cook a new dish.
transliteration: El-yom baddi atbokh tabkha jdideh.

arabic: انا ما بعرف كتير بس رح جرب
english: I don't know much but I will try.
transliteration: Ana ma ba'ref kteer bas rah jarreb.

arabic: هلا شو الساعة لازم خلص الاكل
english: What time is it now? I need to finish the food.
transliteration: Halla' shu as-saa'a? Lazem khalles el-akel.

arabic: الاكل صار جاهز بس شكله غريب شوي
english: The food is ready but its shape is a bit strange.
transliteration: El-akel sar jahez bas shaklo ghareeb shway.

arabic: يمكن المرة الجاي بصير احسن
english: Maybe next time it will be better!
transliteration: Yomken el-marra el-jay baseer ahsan!

arabic: ليث طفل صغير بحب يسال كتير
english: Laith is a small child who loves to ask a lot.
transliteration: Layth ṭifl ṣghir biḥibb yis'al ktīr

arabic: اليوم سال ابوه ليش البياع بالسوق ببيع تفاح
english: Today he asked his dad why the vendor in the market sells apples.
transliteration: El yōm sa'al abūh lēsh el-bayyā' bi-s-sūq bibī' tuffāḥ

arabic: ابوه جاوبه بسرعة الناس بتحب التفاح
english: His dad answered him quickly, people love apples.
transliteration: Abūh jāwabu be sor'a en-nās btiḥibb et-tuffāḥ

arabic: ليث سال طيب ليش الناس بتحب التفاح يا بابا
english: Laith asked, 'Okay, why do people love apples, dad?'
transliteration: Layth sa'al ṭayyib lēsh en-nās btiḥibb et-tuffāḥ yā bābā

arabic: الاب تعب وقال انت ببغاء مو طفل
english: The dad got tired and said, 'You are a parrot, not a child.'
transliteration: El-ab ta'ib w qāl inta babaghā' mū ṭifl

arabic: جدي راح عالمحل امبارح واشترى بلوزة
english: My grandfather went to the shop yesterday and bought a blouse.
transliteration: Jaddi rah al-mahall imbareh w ishtara bluzeh.

arabic: بس البلوزة كانت كتير كبيرة عليه وما حبها
english: But the blouse was too big for him and he didn't like it.
transliteration: Bass el-bluzeh kanat kteer kbeereh alayh w ma habbha.

arabic: انا حكيتله خلينا نرجعها اونلاين بس هو ما عرف كيف
english: I told him, "Let's return it online," but he didn't know how.
transliteration: Ana haketlo khallina nrajje'ha online bass hu ma araf keef.

arabic: قام جدي وقلي يلا نروح عالمحل دغري
english: My grandfather stood up and told me, "Let's go to the shop right away."
transliteration: Qam jaddi w qalli yalla nrouh al-mahall doghri.

arabic: شاف البائع وصار يحكي معاه كتير وهيك رجع البلوزة
english: He saw the salesman and started talking a lot with him, and that's how he returned the blouse.
transliteration: Shaf el-ba'e' w sar yehki ma'ah kteer w heek rajja' el-bluzeh.

arabic: ليلا راحت على الشغل اليوم
english: Layla went to work today.
transliteration: Layla rāḥat ʿala ash-shughl al-yōm.

arabic: شافت زميلها ابو سامي كبير بالعمر
english: She saw her colleague Abu Sami, who is old.
transliteration: Shāfat zamīlha Abu Sami kabīr bil-ʿumr.

arabic: ليلا قالت مساء الخير كيفك ابو سامي قال انا منيح شكرا
english: Layla said "Good evening, how are you?". Abu Sami said "I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: Layla qālat masāʾ al-khayr kayfak Abu Sami qāl ana mnīḥ shukran.

arabic: بعد الشغل ليلا قالت باي
english: After work, Layla said "Bye".
transliteration: Baʿd ash-shughl Layla qālat bāy.

arabic: ابو سامي قال مع السلامة
english: Abu Sami said "Goodbye".
transliteration: Abu Sami qāl maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: لمياء كانت عم تخطط لعرسها الكبير و كانت مبسوطة كتير
english: Lamya' was planning her big wedding and was very happy
transliteration: Lamya' kanat 'am tkhaṭṭeṭ li'orsaha l-kbeer w kanat mabsooṭa kteer

arabic: راحت هي و امها على السوق لتختار خضرة و فواكه
english: She and her mother went to the market to choose vegetables and fruits
transliteration: raḥat hiye w emmaha 'ala s-souq litikhtar khoḍra w fawakih

arabic: شافوا بياع كبير عندو تفاح حلو كتير
english: They saw a big vendor who had very sweet apples
transliteration: shafu bayya' kbeer 'endo tuffaḥ ḥelw kteer

arabic: كان في ناس كتير بالسوق بس اختاروا كل شي بسرعة
english: There were many people in the market but they chose everything quickly
transliteration: kan fi nas kteer be s-souq bas ikhtaru kol shi be sor'a

arabic: هلا لازم يجهزوا كل شي بالمطبخ للعرس الجاي
english: Now they need to prepare everything in the kitchen for the upcoming wedding
transliteration: halla lazim yijahhezu kol shi bel maṭbakh lil-'ors il-jay

arabic: انا رحت على السوق الصبح
english: I went to the market in the morning.
transliteration: Ana roht 'ala s-suq as-subeh.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: شفت بياع خضرة وحكيت له صباح الخير
english: I saw a vegetable seller and said to him, 'Good morning.'
transliteration: Shoft bayya' khodra w hakeit-lo sabah el-kheir.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: هو رد علي صباح النور يا أخي
english: He replied to me, 'Morning of light, my brother.'
transliteration: Huwa radd 'alayy sabah an-nur ya akhi.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: قلت له مرحباً بدي بندورة لو سمحت
english: I said to him, 'Hello, I want tomatoes please.'
transliteration: Olt-lo marhaba biddi banadura law samaht.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: اشتريت البندورة ورجعت على البيت
english: I bought the tomatoes and returned home.
transliteration: Ishtareit el-banadura w raja't 'ala l-beit.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: انا فقت الصبح بدي اشرب قهوتي
english: I woke up this morning wanting to drink my coffee
transliteration: Ana faqt es-sobeh beddi ashrab ahweti

arabic: بس ماكينة القهوة خربانة
english: But the coffee machine is broken
transliteration: Bas makeenet el ahwe kharbaane

arabic: اخي بيشرب ميته دايما بعد ما يفيق
english: My brother always drinks his water after he wakes up
transliteration: Akhi byeshrab mayyeto dayman ba3ed ma yfeeq

arabic: نحنا منشرب شاينا سوا العصر
english: We drink our tea together in the afternoon
transliteration: Ne7na mneshrab shayna sawa el 3aser

arabic: شو بدي اعمل هلا لاشرب قهوتي
english: What should I do now to drink my coffee
transliteration: Sho beddi a3mel halla la ashrab ahweti

arabic: انا رحت عالسوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roḥt ʿas-souq el-yōm.

arabic: شفت ناس كتير وبياع خضرة
english: I saw many people and a vegetable vendor.
transliteration: Sheft nās ktīr u bayyāʿ khoḍra.

arabic: البياع كان عم ببيع تفاح احمر
english: The vendor was selling red apples.
transliteration: El-bayyāʿ kān ʿam bibīʿ tuffāḥ aḥmar.

arabic: قلتله بدي كيلو تفاح لو سمحت
english: I told him I want a kilo of apples please.
transliteration: Qultellu biddī kīlo tuffāḥ law samaḥt.

arabic: هو اعطاني التفاح بسرعة ورحت عالبيت
english: He gave me the apples quickly and I went home.
transliteration: Huwwe aʿṭānī et-tuffāḥ be sorʿa u roḥt ʿal-bēt.

arabic: رن كريم على صاحبه فجاوبه صاحبه وهو مو متذكر الرقم
english: Karim called his friend, and his friend answered, not remembering the number.
transliteration: rann Karim ala ṣaḥibuh fa-jawabo ṣaḥibuh wahuwa moo mutadhakkir al-raqm

arabic: قال كريم اهلا انا كريم شو إسمك شكلي بدأت انسى صحابي
english: Karim said: "Hello, I am Karim, what is your name? It seems I'm starting to forget my friends."
transliteration: qaal Karim ahlan ana Karim shoo ismak shakli bada't ansa ṣaḥabi

arabic: ضحك صاحبه وقال انا علي كيفك يا زلمة الحمد لله بخير
english: His friend laughed and said: "I am Ali, how are you, man? I'm fine, thank God!"
transliteration: ḍiḥik ṣaḥibuh wa qaal ana Ali kifak ya zalameh al-ḥamdulillāh bi-khēr

arabic: جاوبه كريم الحمد لله بخير بس ليش ما حفظت رقمي معقول نسيتني
english: Karim replied: "I'm fine, thank God, but why didn't you save my number? Did you really forget me?"
transliteration: jawabo Karim al-ḥamdulillāh bi-khēr bas leesh ma ḥafaẓt raqmi ma'qool niseetni

arabic: رد علي بمزح لا يا صاحبي بس انت اللي ما بتتصل كتير
english: Ali replied jokingly: "No, my friend, it's just you who doesn't call often!"
transliteration: radd Ali bi-mazḥ la ya ṣaḥibi bas inta illi ma bitattasil ktīr

arabic: صحيت صباح بكير بس كنت تعبانة كتير
english: I woke up early in the morning but I was very tired.
transliteration: ṣaḥeet ṣabaḥ bakeer bas kunt ta'baneh kteer

arabic: يا الله الساعة صارت تسعة ولازم اروح الشغل بسرعة
english: Oh God, it's nine o'clock and I need to go to work quickly.
transliteration: ya Allah es-sa'a ṣaret tes'a w lazim arooḥ esh-shoghl be sor'a

arabic: شفت برا عم تمطر والدنيا زحمة
english: I saw outside it's raining and it's crowded.
transliteration: shoft barra 'am tomṭor w ed-dinya zaḥmeh

arabic: رحت عالمطبخ بسرعة عشان اعمل قهوة
english: I went to the kitchen quickly to make coffee.
transliteration: roḥt 'al-maṭbakh be sor'a 'ashan a'mal qahwe

arabic: بالطريق شفت بياع خضرة عم يبيع بالسوق
english: On the way, I saw a vegetable vendor selling in the market.
transliteration: baṭ-ṭareeq shoft bayya' khoḍra 'am ybee' bes-souq

arabic: ريحة المناقيش الطازجة كانت معبية "مقهى الروشة" بحمرا، بيروت، وهاد خلاني حس بالجوع هلق.
english: The smell of fresh manakish filled "Al-Rawsha Cafe" in Hamra, Beirut, and that made me feel hungry now.
transliteration: Rihet el-manaqeesh et-tazja kanat ma'abbiye "Maqha el-Rawsha" bi-Hamra, Beirut, w had khallani ahes bel-jou' halla'.

arabic: أنا ليلى، عمري تلاتة وعشرين سنة، وبدرس تصميم غرافيكي بالجامعة الأمريكية ببيروت، وكتير طموحة.
english: I am Layla, I am twenty-three years old, and I study graphic design at the American University of Beirut, and I am very ambitious.
transliteration: Ana Layla, 'omri talateh w 'ishreen saneh, w badros tasmeem ghrafiki bel-jami'a el-amrikiyyeh bi-Beirut, w kteer tamoo7a.

arabic: أنا بفيق بكّير بالصبح وبغسّل وجهي، وبعد ما البس، بفطر وبشرب قهوة قبل ما أروح عالجامعة.
english: I wake up early in the morning and wash my face, and after I get dressed, I have breakfast and drink coffee before I go to university.
transliteration: Ana bafeeq bakkeer bel-sobo7 w baghasel wajhi, w ba'ed ma albas, baftar w bashrab qahwe qabel ma aroo7 'al-jami'a.

arabic: بروح بالباص، وهلق عندي محاضرة مهمة ولازم أدرس منيح للامتحان، شو بدي أعمل؟
english: I go by bus, and now I have an important lecture and I must study well for the exam, what should I do?
transliteration: Baroo7 bel-bas, w halla' 'andi mu7adara mohimma w lazem adros mneeh lel-emti7an, shoo baddi a'mel?

arabic: بس المقهى كتير زحمة اليوم وهيك، معلش، ما عم بقدر أركز على دراستي هون أبداً.
english: But the cafe is very crowded today and like this, it's okay, I can't focus on my studies here at all.
transliteration: Bass el-maqha kteer za7meh el-yom w hek, ma'lesh, ma 'am beqdar arkiz 'ala dirasati hoon abadan.

arabic: بعد الظهر، بتغدّى عادة وبقابل أصحابي، بس اليوم بشتغل على إيجاد فرصة تدريب.
english: In the afternoon, I usually have lunch and meet my friends, but today I am working on finding an internship opportunity.
transliteration: Ba'ed ez-zohr, batghadda 'adehtan w baqabel as7abi, bass el-yom bashtaghel 'ala ijad forsat tadreeb.

arabic: فجأة شفت الدكتور فادي، أستاذي بالجامعة، قاعد لحاله بشتغل على اللابتوب تبعه هون.
english: Suddenly I saw Dr. Fadi, my professor at the university, sitting alone working on his laptop here.
transliteration: Faj'atan shoft ed-doktor Fadi, ostazi bel-jami'a, qa'ed la7alo bashtaghel 'ala el-laptop taba'o hoon.

arabic: قررت أروح لعنده وسلم عليه، يمكن عندي اجتماع صغير معه عن مشاريعي الجديدة.
english: I decided to go to him and greet him, maybe I have a small meeting with him about my new projects.
transliteration: Qarrart aroo7 la 'ando w asallem 'aleih, yemken 'andi ejtema' zgheer ma'o 'an masaree'i ej-jdeedeh.

arabic: بالعادة برتاح شوي بعد المحاضرة، بس هلق الأهم إني أعمل إنطباع منيح لمستقبلي المهني.
english: Usually I rest a little after the lecture, but now the most important thing is to make a good impression for my professional future.
transliteration: Bel-'adeh bartaa7 shway ba'ed el-mu7adara, bass halla' el-aham enni a'mel entiba' mneeh le-mustaqbali el-mehani.

arabic: يا رب تكون بداية خير، وإنشالله بقدر أستفيد من هالموقف كتير!
english: Oh Lord, may it be a good start, and hopefully I can benefit a lot from this situation!
transliteration: Ya rabb tkoun bedayet kheer, w Inshallah baqdar astefeed min hal-maw'ef kteer!

arabic: ليلى، اللي عمرها 28 سنة، كانت عم تفكر بسعر 3 أقلام هندسة بمكتبة الفكر ببيروت.
english: Layla, who is 28 years old, was thinking about the price of 3 engineering pens at Al-Fikr Bookstore in Beirut.
transliteration: Layla, illi 3omraha 28 saneh, kanat 3am tfakker bi-se3er 3 aqlam handaseh bi-maktabet al-Fikr bi-Beirut.

arabic: بعد ما أنا بفيق بكّير وبغسّل وجهي كل يوم، عندي محاضرة وحدة بس الساعة 9 الصبح بالجامعة.
english: After I wake up early and wash my face every day, I have only one lecture at 9 AM at the university.
transliteration: Ba3ed ma ana bfiq bakkeer w-bghassil wajhi kull yom, 3indi muhadara wahdeh bass el-sa3a 9 es-subuh bil-jam3a.

arabic: اليوم، بروح عالجامعة بالباص رقم 12، لأنه سيارتي الـ 2005 بدها تصليح بـ 100 ألف ليرة.
english: Today, I go to the university by bus number 12, because my 2005 car needs repair for 100,000 Liras.
transliteration: El-yom, brouh 3al-jam3a bil-bas raqam 12, la'anno sayyarti el-2005 bidda taslih bi-100 alf lira.

arabic: هلق، كل قلم لحاله سعره 15 ألف ليرة، يعني 3 أقلام بيطلعوا 45 ألف ليرة، آه يا ويلي.
english: Now, each pen alone costs 15,000 Liras, meaning 3 pens total 45,000 Liras, oh my goodness.
transliteration: Hallaq, kull qalam lahalo se3ro 15 alf lira, ya3ni 3 aqlam biyitla3u 45 alf lira, ah ya wayli.

arabic: وبدها كمان 2 ورق كبير للمشروع الأخير، كل ورقة بـ 8 آلاف ليرة، والمشروع لازم يتسلم بعد يومين.
english: And she also needs 2 large sheets of paper for the final project; each sheet costs 8,000 Liras, and the project must be submitted after two days.
transliteration: W-bidda kaman 2 waraq kbeer lil-mashrou3 el-akheer, kull waraqa bi-8 alaf lira, wel-mashrou3 lazem yitsallam ba3ed yomein.

arabic: مجموع كل شي صار 61 ألف ليرة، وهي معها بس 50 ألف ليرة بجزدانها، في 11 ألف ليرة ناقصين.
english: The total of everything became 61,000 Liras, and she only has 50,000 Liras in her purse; there are 11,000 Liras missing.
transliteration: Majmou3 kull shi sar 61 alf lira, w-hiyya ma3ha bass 50 alf lira bi-juzdanha, fi 11 alf lira naqseen.

arabic: بعد الظهر، قبل ما أروح أقابل أصحابي بالحمرا، برتاح شوي بالبيت، بس هلق ما في وقت أبدًا، عندي موعد الساعة 5.
english: In the afternoon, before I go to meet my friends in Hamra, I usually rest a little at home, but now there's no time at all, I have an appointment at 5 o'clock.
transliteration: Ba3ed ez-zuhr, qabl ma arouh oqabel ashabi bil-Hamra, berta7 shway bil-beit, bass hallaq ma fi waqt abadan, 3indi maw3ed el-sa3a 5.

arabic: صاحب المحل، زكريا اللي عمره 55 سنة، شاف حيرتها وقال: "خلص، خدي خصم 10 آلاف ليرة، بتطلع 51 ألف".
english: The shop owner, Zakaria, who is 55 years old, saw her confusion and said: "Okay, take a 10,000 Lira discount, it comes out to 51,000."
transliteration: Saheeb el-mahall, Zakaria illi 3omro 55 saneh, shaf hayritha w-qal: "Khalas, khudi khasm 10 alaf lira, bititla3 51 alf."

arabic: ليلى ابتسمت، كان ضايلها ألف ليرة زيادة، وهيك قدرت تشتري كل أغراضها وتلحق مشروعها.
english: Layla smiled; she had an extra thousand Liras left, and this way she could buy all her supplies and catch up on her project.
transliteration: Layla ibtasamet, kan dayelha alf lira ziyadeh, w-heik ideret tishtri kull aghradha w-tilhaq mashrou3ha.

arabic: بروح عالشغل بالسيارة وبشتغل طول اليوم لما ما بكون بالجامعة، بس اليوم قدرت توفر 10 آلاف ليرة.
english: I go to work by car and work all day when I'm not at university, but today she managed to save 10,000 Liras.
transliteration: Brouh 3ash-shoghl bis-sayyara w-bashtaghil tool el-yom lamma ma bakoun bil-jam3a, bass el-yom ideret twaffir 10 alaf lira.

arabic: بعد هالقصة، عرفت ليلى إنها لازم تدير مصاريفها بشكل أفضل، خصوصاً إنه عندها 3 مشاريع تانية هالاسبوع.
english: After this story, Layla knew that she must manage her expenses better, especially since she has 3 other projects this week.
transliteration: Ba3ed hal-qissa, 3irifet Layla inna lazem tdeer masarifeha bi-shakl afdal, khsusan inno 3indaha 3 masharee3 tanya hal-usbuh.

arabic: بعد ما بشتغل طول اليوم بحب زور عمتي
english: After I work all day, I like to visit my aunt.
transliteration: Baʻd mā bashtaghel ṭūl el-yōm bḥibb zūr ʻammiti.

arabic: امبارح بعد الظهر برتاح شوي قبل ما اطلع
english: Yesterday afternoon I rested a little before I left.
transliteration: Imbāreḥ baʻd eḍ-ḍuhr bartāḥ shway qabl mā eṭlaʻ.

arabic: وصلت عند عمتي و سلمت عليها وبعدين قعدنا نحكي
english: I arrived at my aunt's and greeted her, then we sat and talked.
transliteration: Waṣalt ʻind ʻammiti w sallamt ʻalayhā w baʻdēn qaʻadnā neḥki.

arabic: سألتني عمتي كيف بشتغل هالايام و اذا عندي اجتماعات
english: My aunt asked me how I'm working these days and if I have meetings.
transliteration: Sa'alatni ʻammiti kif bashtaghel hal-ayyām w iza ʻindi ijtimāʻāt.

arabic: قلتلها كلشي منيح وبقضي وقت ممتع معها
english: I told her everything is good, and I spend a good time with her.
transliteration: Qultelha kull shi mnīḥ w baqḍi waqt mumteʻ maʻha.

arabic: صباح الخير يا امي شو عم تعملي اليوم
english: Good morning mom, what are you doing today?
transliteration: ṣabāḥ al-khayr ya ummi shu ʿam taʿmali al-yōm

arabic: الام ردت صباح النور يا حبيبي عم بحضر الفطور
english: The mother replied "Morning of light my darling I'm preparing breakfast"
transliteration: al-umm raddat ṣabāḥ an-nūr ya ḥabibi ʿam baḥaddir al-fuṭūr

arabic: الطفل سأل وليش لازم ناكل فطور وليش السما زرقا
english: The child asked "And why do we have to eat breakfast and why is the sky blue?"
transliteration: aṭ-ṭifl saʾal wa-lēsh lāzim nākul fuṭūr wa-lēsh as-sama zarqa

arabic: الام ابتسمت وقالت يا ابني عندك كتير اسئلة كل يوم
english: The mother smiled and said "My son you have many questions every day"
transliteration: al-umm ibtasamat wa-qālat ya ibni ʿindak ktīr asʾila kull yōm

arabic: مرحباً باسئلتك بس لازم نفطر هلا بعدين منجاوب
english: Welcome to your questions but we must have breakfast now then we'll answer
transliteration: marḥaba bi-asʾilatuk bas lāzim nifṭar halla baʿdēn minjāwib

arabic: رحت على السوق امبارح
english: I went to the market yesterday.
transliteration: Ruḥt 'ala es-souq imbareḥ

arabic: كان في ناس كتير عم تشترى خضرة وتفاح
english: There were many people buying vegetables and apples.
transliteration: Kan fi nas ktir 'am teshtari khoḍra w tuffaḥ

arabic: فجأة شفت رفيقي القديم عم يبيع تفاح
english: Suddenly, I saw my old friend selling apples.
transliteration: Faj'a sheft rafi'i el-adeem 'am yabi' tuffaḥ

arabic: صوته كان دافي كتير وضحكته حلوة
english: His voice was very warm and his laugh was sweet.
transliteration: Sowto kan dafi ktir w daḥketo ḥelwe

arabic: حكينا بسرعة عن ايام زمان وكنا مبسوطين
english: We talked quickly about old times and we were happy.
transliteration: ḥakayna be sor'a 'an ayyam zaman w kunna mabsooṭeen

arabic: امبارح رحت على بيت عمتي
english: Yesterday I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: Imbareh roht ala beit ammati

arabic: هي كتير بتحبنا وكلنا بنحبها
english: She loves us a lot and we all love her.
transliteration: Hiyye kteer btehebbna w kullna mnehebbha

arabic: اكلنا منسف زاكي وشربنا قهوة مع بعض
english: We ate delicious Mansaf and drank coffee together.
transliteration: Akalna mansaf zaki w sharibna ahwe ma' ba'd

arabic: قعدنا وحكينا قصص حلوة وضحكنا كتير
english: We sat and spoke nice stories and laughed a lot.
transliteration: Qa'adna w hakeina qisas helwe w dehekna kteer

arabic: كان يوم حلو وكلنا انبسطنا بهالجمعة العائلية
english: It was a nice day and we all enjoyed this family gathering.
transliteration: Kan yom helw w kullna enbasatna bhal jam'a al-a'iliyeh

arabic: امبارح اشتريت قميص بس كان قياسه غلط
english: Yesterday I bought a shirt, but it was the wrong size
transliteration: Imbāriḥ ishtarēt qamīṣ bas kān qiyāso ghalaṭ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: لهيك اليوم الصبح قررت ارجعه للمحل
english: So, this morning I decided to return it to the shop
transliteration: La-hēk il-yōm iṣ-ṣubiḥ qarrart arji'o lil-maḥall
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: ركبت سيارتي ومريت من جنب محطة الباصات وانا رايح
english: I took my car and drove past the bus station on my way there
transliteration: Rakabt sayyārtī u marrēt min janb maḥaṭṭit il-bāṣāt w ana rāyiḥ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: لما وصلت البياع كان كتير متعاون وبدلني اياه بالقياس الصح
english: When I arrived, the seller was very helpful and exchanged it for the correct size
transliteration: Lamma waṣalt il-bayyā' kān ktīr muta'āwin u bad-dalnī iyyāh bil-qiyās iṣ-ṣaḥḥ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: هلأ انا مبسوط وجاهز ليومي
english: Now I'm happy and ready for my day
transliteration: Halā' ana mabṣūṭ u jāhiz li-yōmī
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: اتصلت بصديقتي سارة اليوم
english: I called my friend Sarah today
transliteration: Ittaṣalt be ṣadīqti Sāra el-yōm

arabic: سألتها كيف حالها وحال العائلة
english: I asked her how she and her family were
transliteration: Sa'altha kīf ḥālha w ḥāl el-ʿā'ila

arabic: قالت لي ان اباها صلح سقف المطبخ بسرعة قبل ما تمطر
english: She told me that her father fixed the kitchen ceiling quickly before it rained
transliteration: Qālat lī inn abāha ṣallaḥ saqf el-maṭbakh be sor'a qabl ma tomṭor

arabic: بعدين حكينا عن السوق والخضرة والتفاح
english: Then we talked about the market, vegetables, and apples
transliteration: Baʿdēn ḥakēna ʿan es-souq w el-khoḍra w et-tuffaḥ

arabic: كانت مكالمة حلوة كتير وخلتني ابتسم
english: It was a very sweet call and made me smile
transliteration: Kānat mukālama ḥilwa ktīr w khallatni abtasim

arabic: لارا، بتعرفي ليش التاريخ مادة صعبة؟
english: Lara, do you know why history is a difficult subject?
transliteration: Lara, bti'rifi lesh at-taarikh maaddeh sa'beh?

arabic: مرحبا وسام، شو هالسؤال؟ بس لا، مش كثير. ليش عم تسأل؟
english: Hi Wissam, what's this question? But no, not really. Why are you asking?
transliteration: Marhaba Wissam, shu hal-su'aal? Bas la, mish ktiir. Lesh 'am tis'al?

arabic: عندي امتحان تاريخ بكرة، وأنا ما درست منيح.
english: I have a history exam tomorrow, and I didn't study well.
transliteration: 'Andi imtihan taarikh bokra, w ana ma darast mniih.

arabic: معلش حبيبي، فينا ندرس سوا هلق هون بالقهوة.
english: Never mind, my dear, we can study together now here at the café.
transliteration: Ma'lesh habibi, fiina ndros sawa hala' hon bil-qahweh.

arabic: بس أنا جوعان كثير، ما أكلت شي بعد المدرسة.
english: But I'm very hungry, I didn't eat anything after school.
transliteration: Bas ana jaw'aan ktiir, ma akalt shi ba'd il-madrasa.

arabic: يلا، نطلب مناقيش زعتر من هون، ومنراجع شوي.
english: Come on, let's order za'atar manakish from here, and we'll review a bit.
transliteration: Yalla, notlob manaa'eesh za'tar min hon, w mnraaji' shway.

arabic: فكرة منيحة! أنا بحب مناقيش الزعتر كثير.
english: Good idea! I love za'atar manakish a lot.
transliteration: Fikra mniihah! Ana bahebb manaa'eesh iz-za'tar ktiir.

arabic: إيه، ومنخلص الفصل الأول سوا.
english: Yes, and we'll finish the first chapter together.
transliteration: Eh, w mnkhalos il-fasel il-awwal sawa.

arabic: تمام، هيك أحسن من إني أدرس لحالي.
english: Okay, this is better than me studying alone.
transliteration: Tamaam, heik ahsan min inni adros lahali.

arabic: إنشالله مننجح بالامتحان كلنا، وبعدين نروح على البيت.
english: God willing, we will all succeed in the exam, and then we'll go home.
transliteration: Inshallah mnanjah bil-imtihan kullna, w ba'dein nrouh 'al-beit.

arabic: ريحة شاي النعنع عبت شقة ليلى المرتبة بعد الظهر.
english: The smell of mint tea filled Layla's organized apartment in the afternoon.
transliteration: Rihet shay el-na'na' 'abbat sheqet Layla el-murattabeh ba'ed ed-dhohur.

arabic: ليلى، عمرها ٢٢، طالبة منظمة، كانت بدها تخطط لرحلة صيفية.
english: Layla, 22 years old, an organized student, wanted to plan a summer trip.
transliteration: Layla, 'omraha 22, talibeh munazameh, kanat biddaha tkhattet la-rehleh sayfiyyeh.

arabic: بس رفقاتها، زين وماريا، كان عندهم أفكار تانية، يعني شو نعمل؟
english: But her friends, Zein and Maria, had other ideas, meaning, what should we do?
transliteration: Bas refqataha, Zein w Maria, kan 'andhom afkar taniyye, ya'ni shu ni'mal?

arabic: زين قال: "أنا راح أسافر على العقبة، بنروح نعمل غطس هناك؟"
english: Zein said: "I will travel to Aqaba, shall we go diving there?"
transliteration: Zein qal: "Ana rah asafir 'ala el-'Aqaba, binrouh ni'mal ghats honak?"

arabic: ماريا حكت: "لا لا، أنا بدي أزور قرايبي بدمشق هالصيف."
english: Maria said: "No, no, I want to visit my relatives in Damascus this summer."
transliteration: Maria hakat: "La la, ana biddi azour qarayibi bi-Dimashq hal-sayf."

arabic: ليلى تنهدت، بعدين قالت: "شو رأيكم نروح على بيروت أسبوع؟"
english: Layla sighed, then said: "What do you think we go to Beirut for a week?"
transliteration: Layla tanahhadat, ba'dein qalat: "Shu ra'yekum nirouh 'ala Beirut osbou'?"

arabic: "هيك راح نغير جو، ونشوف البحر، ونجرب مناقيش الجبنة."
english: "This way we will change atmosphere, and see the sea, and try cheese manakish."
transliteration: Heik rah nghayyir jaww, w nshouf el-bahr, w njareb manaqeesh el-jibneh.

arabic: زين وماريا وافقوا بسرعة، "يلا، فكرة حلوة، راح نحجز بكرا!"
english: Zein and Maria quickly agreed, "Yalla, a nice idea, we will book tomorrow!"
transliteration: Zein w Maria wafa'u bi-sur'a, "Yalla, fikra hilwe, rah nihjez bukra!"

arabic: راح يدفعوا تقريبا ٥٠٠ ألف ليرة لبنانية للفندق الصغير.
english: They will pay approximately 500,000 Lebanese Liras for the small hotel.
transliteration: Rah yidfa'u taqriban khams miyet alf lira Lubnaniyyeh lil-funduq es-saghir.

arabic: ليلى ابتسمت، "إنشالله رحلتنا راح تكون أحلى رحلة صيفية!"
english: Layla smiled, "Inshallah, our trip will be the best summer trip!"
transliteration: Layla ibtasamat, "Inshallah rehletna rah takoun ahla rehleh sayfiyyeh!"

arabic: لينا فقت بكير، لقيت كتاب قديم كتير.
english: Lina woke up early, she found a very old book.
transliteration: Lina faqt bakkeer, laqayt kitaab qadeem kteer.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: كانت عم تدور عليه بسوق الحميدية بدمشق.
english: She was looking for it in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh in Damascus.
transliteration: Kaanat 'am tdawwer 'alayh bi Souq al-Hamidiyyeh bi Dimashq.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: الكتاب كان مغبر كتير وريحتو قديمة.
english: The book was very dusty and its smell was old.
transliteration: El-kitaab kaan mghabbar kteer w reehto qadeemeh.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: فجأة، لقت جواه خريطة صغيرة!
english: Suddenly, she found a small map inside!
transliteration: Faj'a, laqat juwwa khareeTa zgheereh!
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: "شو هاد؟" قالت لينا، بعيون متفاجئة.
english: "What is this?" Lina said, with surprised eyes.
transliteration: "Shoo haad?" qaalat Lina, bi-'uyoon mitfaj'a.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: قررت دغري تروح تشرب شاي النعنع بالمقهى.
english: She decided right away to go drink mint tea at the cafe.
transliteration: Qarrarat doghri trooh tishrab shay el-na'na' bil-maqha.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: لازم تحكي رفقاتها عن أفكار تانية.
english: She needs to tell her friends about other ideas.
transliteration: Laazim tahki refqataha 'an afkar taniyye.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: بكرا منشوف شو في بهالخريطة القديمة.
english: Tomorrow we will see what is in this old map.
transliteration: Bokra mnshoof shoo fee bihal-khareeTa el-qadeemeh.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: إنشالله بتساعدنا بمشروع التاريخ الصعب.
english: God willing, it will help us with the difficult history project.
transliteration: Inshallah btisaa'idna bi-mashroo' et-taarikh es-sa'eb.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: أكلت مناقيش الجبنة وكانت كتير منيح.
english: She ate cheese manakish and it was very good.
transliteration: Akalat manaqeesh el-jibneh w kaanat kteer mniih.
storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

arabic: كيفك يا ليلى؟ شو عم تعملي هون؟
english: How are you, Layla? What are you doing here?
transliteration: Keefik ya Layla? Shu 'am te'mali houn?

arabic: ردت ليلى بخجل: أهلاً نور، عم بحضر لامتحان التاريخ بكرا.
english: Layla replied shyly: Hello Noor, I'm preparing for the history exam tomorrow.
transliteration: Raddat Layla bi-khajal: Ahlan Noor, 'am bahedder la-imtihan at-taarikh bokra.

arabic: كانت ليلى طالبة جامعة عمرها ٢٢ سنة، شوي خجولة بس شاطرة.
english: Layla was a 22-year-old university student, a bit shy but smart.
transliteration: Kanat Layla talibet jami'a 'omraha 22 saneh, shway khajoule bas shatra.

arabic: المادة صعبة كتير، وهي بدها تنجح فيها منيح.
english: The subject is very difficult, and she wants to succeed well in it.
transliteration: Al-maaddeh sa'beh kteer, w hiyyeh beddaha tenjah fiha mneeh.

arabic: شربت شاي النعنع السخن، وأكلت مناقيش الجبنة الشهية.
english: She drank the hot mint tea, and ate delicious cheese manakish.
transliteration: Sherbet shay el-na'na' as-sokhon, w akalet manaqeesh el-jibneh ash-shahiyyeh.

arabic: قالت نور: يلا ليلى، خلينا ندرس سوا ونراجع.
english: Noor said: Come on Layla, let's study together and review.
transliteration: Qalat Noor: Yalla Layla, khallina nedros sawa w mnraaji'.

arabic: ابتسمت ليلى وشعرت بشوي شجاعة وثقة.
english: Layla smiled and felt a bit of courage and confidence.
transliteration: Ibtasamat Layla w sha'aret bi-shway shajaa'a w thiqa.

arabic: قالت: إنشالله رح ننجح، هالمادة بدها جهد.
english: She said: God willing we will succeed, this subject needs effort.
transliteration: Qalat: Inshallah rah nennjah, hal-maaddeh beddaha jahd.

arabic: القهوة كانت مرتاحة، والاجواء ساعدتهن يركزوا.
english: The café was comfortable, and the atmosphere helped them focus.
transliteration: Al-qahweh kanat mertaha, wal-ajwaa' sa'adethon yrakkezu.

arabic: قعدوا سوا، وبلشوا يدرسوا بتركيز لأكثر من ساعتين.
english: They sat together, and started studying with focus for more than two hours.
transliteration: Qa'adou sawa, w ballashou yedrosou bi-tarkeez la'aktar min sa'atayn.

arabic: اليوم كانت مباراة كرة قدم مهمة كتير بفريقنا
english: Today was a very important football match for our team
transliteration: El yom kānat mubarāt kurat qadam muhimma ktīr bfarīqna

arabic: قبل المباراة كان سامي عصبي كتير بس حاول يكون جدّي
english: Before the match, Sami was very nervous, but he tried to be serious
transliteration: Qabl el mubarāt kān Sami 'aṣabī ktīr bas ḥāwal ykūn jidiyy

arabic: كل اللاعبين كانوا مركزين بطريقة جدية وما حدا حكى كتير
english: All the players were seriously focused and no one talked much
transliteration: Kull el la'ibīn kānū mmarkazīn bi ṭarīqa jidiyye w mā ḥada ḥaka ktīr

arabic: لما سجلوا الهدف الاخير الكل صاروا يصرخوا وفرحوا كتير
english: When they scored the last goal, everyone started screaming and were very happy
transliteration: Lamma sajjalu el hadaf el akhīr el kull ṣārū yiṣrkhū w faraḥū ktīr

arabic: بالاخير ربحنا المباراة وسامي اللي كان عصبي صار كتير مرح
english: In the end, we won the match, and Sami, who was nervous, became very joyful
transliteration: Bel akhīr rbeḥna el mubarāt w Sami illi kān 'aṣabī ṣār ktīr mareḥ

arabic: كان في ولد صغير بيسأل كتير
english: There was a small boy who asked a lot.
transliteration: Kan fi walad ṣaghīr byis'al ktīr.

arabic: امه تعبت من اسئلته
english: His mother got tired of his questions.
transliteration: Ummu ta'ebet min as'ilto.

arabic: سالها ليش البياع بالسوق ببيع تفاح وخضرة
english: He asked her why the vendor in the market sells apples and vegetables.
transliteration: Sa'alha lesh el-bayya' bes-souq byibī' tuffaḥ w khoḍra.

arabic: هي تنهدت وقالت ما بعرف يا حبيبي
english: She sighed and said, 'I don't know, my dear.'
transliteration: Hiyye tanahhadat w qālat ma ba'ref ya ḥabībi.

arabic: بس هو ضل يسأل ليش وليش
english: But he kept asking why and why.
transliteration: Bas huwwa ḍall yis'al lesh w lesh.

arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق وشميت ريحة مناقيش الجبنة
english: I was walking in the market and smelled the cheese manakish.
transliteration: Kunt mashi bil-souq w shammeet reehet manaqeesh el-jibneh.

arabic: فجأة شفت رفيقتي القديمة لينا جنب محل الشاي
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Lina next to the tea shop.
transliteration: Faj'ah sheft rafeeqti el-qadeemeh Lina janb mahal el-shay.

arabic: لينا كانت عم تشرب شاي النعنع وتضحك مع رفقاتها
english: Lina was drinking mint tea and laughing with her friends.
transliteration: Lina kanat 'am tishrab shay el-na'na' w tidhak ma' refqataha.

arabic: سلمت عليها وتنهدت وقالت يا الهي ما تغيرتي ابدا
english: I greeted her and she sighed and said "Oh my god, you haven't changed at all."
transliteration: Sallamt 'aleha w tanahhadat w qalet "Ya ilahi ma taghayyarti abadan".

arabic: حكينا شوي عن رحلة صيفية قديمة وضحكنا كتير
english: We talked a bit about an old summer trip and laughed a lot.
transliteration: Hakeena shway 'an rehleh sayfiyyeh qadeemeh w dahakna kteer.

arabic: امبارح الصبح ليلى شافت جارها عمر زعلان كتير وهو عم يسقي زرع بيته
english: Yesterday morning Layla saw her neighbor Omar very upset while he was watering his house plants
transliteration: Imbaareh es-ṣubḥ Layla shaafet jaarahha Omar za'laan kteer w huwwe 'am yisqi zara' beitu

arabic: ليلى قربت وسألته صباح الخير يا جار ليش شكلك متضايق اليوم
english: Layla approached and asked him Good morning neighbor why do you look bothered today
transliteration: Layla qarrabet w sa'altu ṣabaaḥ el-kheer ya jaar leesh shaklak mitḍāyiq ilyawm

arabic: عمر جاوبها اهلين يا ليلى انا قلقان شوي عشان بنتي عندها امتحان صعب بكرة
english: Omar replied to her Hello Layla I'm a little worried because my daughter has a difficult exam tomorrow
transliteration: Omar jaawabha ahleen ya Layla ana qalqaan shway ashaan binti 'andha imtiḥaan ṣa'b bukra

arabic: ليلى حست بحزنه وقالتله ما تقلق ان شاء الله كل شي بيمشي تمام هي شاطرة
english: Layla felt his sadness and told him Don't worry God willing everything will go well she is clever
transliteration: Layla ḥassat bi-ḥuznu w qa'atlu maa taqlaq in sha' Allah kull shi byimshi tamaam hiyye shaaṭra

arabic: عمر ارتاح شوي وحس بالمبسوط وشكر ليلى كتير على كلامها الحلو
english: Omar relaxed a little and felt happy and thanked Layla a lot for her kind words
transliteration: Omar irtaaḥ shway w ḥass bil-mabsooṭ w shakar Layla kteer 'ala kalaamha el-ḥilw

arabic: قعدت بالكافيه المفضل تبعي وعم استنى رفيقي يجي
english: I sat in my favorite cafe waiting for my friend to arrive.
transliteration: Qa'adt bil-kafi el mufaddal taba'i w 'am astanna rafiqi yiji.

arabic: طلبت قهوة سادة من النادل وقلت له بدي اشربها وانا عم استنى
english: I ordered a plain coffee from the waiter and told him I wanted to drink it while waiting.
transliteration: Talabt ahwe sada min en-nadel w olt lo baddi ashrabaha w ana 'am astanna.

arabic: بعد شوي اجا رفيقي و قال اهلين كيفك
english: After a little while, my friend arrived and said "Hi, how are you?"
transliteration: Ba'd shway aja rafiqi w al ahlan kifak.

arabic: قلت له اهلين انا منيح بس ليش تأخرت عشر دقايق
english: I told him "Hi, I'm good, but why were you ten minutes late?"
transliteration: Olt lo ahlan ana mnih bas lesh ta'akhkhart ashar da'aye'.

arabic: ضحك رفيقي و قال اسف كان في عجقة سير بالطريق هلأ
english: My friend laughed and said "Sorry, there was traffic on the road just now."
transliteration: Dhek rafiqi w al assef kan fi 'aj'et sayr bit-tari' halla'.

arabic: الصبح بكير قامت أمي تحضر الفطور لعيد ميلاد أختي الصغيرة
english: Early in the morning, my mother woke up to prepare breakfast for my little sister's birthday.
transliteration: Aṣ-ṣubḥ bakīr qāmat ummī tiḥaḍḍir il-faṭūr li-ʿīd mīlād ukhtī aṣ-ṣaghīra.

arabic: اختي الصغيرة مرحة كتير بس اوقات بتصير خجولة لما تشوف ناس جداد
english: My little sister is very fun, but sometimes she becomes shy when she sees new people.
transliteration: Ukhtī aṣ-ṣaghīra marḥa ktīr bas awqāt bitṣīr khajoule lamma tishūf nās jdid.

arabic: بعد الفطور فتحت هداياها اللي كانت كلها ألعاب ولوازم مدرسة
english: After breakfast, she opened her gifts which were all toys and school supplies.
transliteration: Baʿd il-faṭūr fataḥat hadāyāhā illī kānāt kullhā alʿāb w lawāzim madrasa.

arabic: أبي طيب وكريم دايما بيجيب أحسن شي النا حتى لو كان مشغول كتير
english: My father is kind and generous; he always brings the best for us even if he is very busy.
transliteration: Abī ṭayeb w karīm dāyman bījīb aḥsan shī ilnā ḥattā law kān mashghūl ktīr.

arabic: بالليل عملنا كيكة صغيرة احتفلنا فيها بشكل بسيط قبل ما تروح تنام مبسوطة
english: In the evening, we made a small cake and celebrated simply before she went to sleep happily.
transliteration: Bi-l-layl ʿamalna kīke ṣaghīra iḥtafalna fīhā bi-shakl basīṭ qabl mā trūḥ tnām mabṣūṭa.

arabic: امبارح الدنيا مطرت كتير سقف المطبخ صار ينقط
english: Yesterday, it rained a lot. The kitchen ceiling started to leak.
transliteration: Imbareḥ id-dunya maṭṭarat ktiir. Saqf il-maṭbakh ṣaar ynaqqiṭ.

arabic: جدتي قالت بدنا بياع قديم يصلحها متل اللي بالسوق
english: My grandmother said: 'We need an old vendor to fix it, like the one from the market.'
transliteration: Jiddeti qaalat: 'Bidna bayya' qadiim yiṣalliḥha mitl illi bis-souq.'

arabic: اخي قال لا يا جدتي انا بصلحها بسرعة من فيديو ع الانترنت
english: My brother said: 'No, grandma, I can fix it quickly with a video from the internet.'
transliteration: Akhi qaala: 'La ya jiddeti, ana baṣalliḥha be sor'a min video 'al-internet.'

arabic: جدتي ما فهمت شو يعني انترنت
english: Grandma didn't understand what 'internet' meant.
transliteration: Jiddeti ma fehmet shoo ya'ni internet.

arabic: اخي شاف الفيديو و صلح السقف
english: My brother watched the video and fixed the ceiling.
transliteration: Akhi shaf il-video w ṣallaḥ is-saqf.

arabic: مساء الخير احمد كيفك
english: Good evening, Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr Ahmad kayfak?

arabic: مساء النور انا منيح شكرا خلينا نخطط لرحلة ع نهاية الاسبوع
english: Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you. Let's plan a trip for the weekend.
transliteration: Masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ shukran khallīna nkhaṭṭiṭ la-riḥla ʿa nihāyat al-usbūʿ.

arabic: شو رأيك نروح عالجبل الهوا هناك بارد كتير وريحته حلوة
english: What do you think if we go to the mountain? The air there is very cold and smells sweet.
transliteration: Shū raʾyak nrūḥ ʿal-jabal? Al-hawa hnāk bārid ktīr w-rīḥtu ḥilwa.

arabic: فكرة ممتازة بتخيل صوت العصافير والمي
english: Excellent idea! I imagine the sound of birds and water.
transliteration: Fikra mumtāza! Batkhayyal ṣūt al-ʿaṣāfīr wal-mayy.

arabic: يلا بشوفك بكرا باي مع السلامة
english: Okay, see you tomorrow. Bye, goodbye!
transliteration: Yalla bashūfak bukra. Bāy, maʿ as-salāma!

arabic: صباح الخير اليوم عيد ميلاد رفيقي احمد
english: Good morning Today is my friend Ahmad's birthday
transliteration: Sabāḥ al-khayr al-yōm ʿīd mīlād rafīqī Aḥmad

arabic: بدي اعمل حفلة صغيرة و مفاجأة اله
english: I want to make a small party and a surprise for him
transliteration: Biddī aʿmal ḥafla ṣaghīra w mufājaʾa ilēh

arabic: اجا كل رفقاتنا و صرنا نحكي مرحبا اهلا وسهلا
english: All our friends came and we started saying Hello welcome
transliteration: Aja kull rifqātnā w ṣirnā naḥkī marḥaba ahlan wa sahlan

arabic: احمد طلع من غرفته و هو لابس بيجامة النوم
english: Ahmad came out of his room wearing his pajamas
transliteration: Ahmad ṭalaʿ min ghurfato w huwwa lābis bījāmat an-nawm

arabic: كلنا ضحكنا كتير و هو كان مستغرب بس مبسوط
english: We all laughed a lot and he was surprised but happy
transliteration: Kullna ḍaḥiknā katīr w huwwa kān mustaghrib bas mabṣūṭ

arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق و فجأة لمحت وجه مألوف
english: I was walking in the market and suddenly I spotted a familiar face.
transliteration: Kunt mashi bil-souq w faj'a lamaḥt wajh ma'loof.

arabic: كانت رفيقتي القديمة ليلى اللي كانت دايمًا صبية مرحة وطيبة كتير
english: It was my old friend Layla, who was always a fun and very kind young woman.
transliteration: Kanat rafee'ti al-qadeema Layla illi kanat dayman sabiyye marḥa w ṭaybe kteer.

arabic: تفاجأت كتير و رحت سلمت عليها بفرحة
english: I was very surprised and went to greet her with joy.
transliteration: Tafaja't kteer w roḥt sallamt 'alayha bi-farḥa.

arabic: قعدنا نحكي شوي عن شغلها الجديد و حياتها اللي صارت جدية اكتر
english: We sat and talked a bit about her new job and her life which had become more serious.
transliteration: Qa'adna neḥki shway 'an shughlha al-jadeed w ḥayatha illi ṣarat jidiyye aktar.

arabic: بس الغريب انو لما حكيت عن ذكرياتنا القديمة ما تذكرتني ابداً و كانت خجولة كتير
english: But the strange thing is that when I talked about our old memories, she didn't remember me at all and was very shy.
transliteration: Bas al-ghareeb inno lamma ḥakeet 'an zikrayatna al-qadeema ma tzakkaratni abadan w kanat khajoule kteer.

arabic: امبارح رحت على السوق
english: Yesterday I went to the market.
transliteration: Imbāreḥ roḥt ʿala s-sūq
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: اشتريت غرض للمطبخ بس كان خربان
english: I bought an item for the kitchen but it was broken.
transliteration: Ishtarēt gharaḍ lal-maṭbakh bas kān kharbān
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: رجعت بسرعة على المحل
english: I returned quickly to the shop.
transliteration: Rajaʿt be sorʿa ʿala l-maḥall
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: حكيت مع البياع وحكيتله عن الغرض
english: I spoke with the vendor and told him about the item.
transliteration: ḥakēt maʿ el-bayyāʿ w ḥakētlo ʿan el-gharaḍ
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: البياع صلحلي اياه
english: The vendor fixed it for me.
transliteration: El-bayyāʿ ṣallaḥli iyyāh
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: اليوم رحت ع السوق لاشتري ملابس جديدة
