english: Today I went to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Al-yawm riht 'a as-souq la-ashtari malabes jdeedeh

arabic: دخلت محل وشفت قميص كتير جميل
english: I entered a shop and saw a very beautiful shirt.
transliteration: Dakhalt mahall w shuft qamees kteer jameel

arabic: كنت بدي اشتريه بس كان كتير غالي
english: I wanted to buy it, but it was really expensive.
transliteration: Kunt baddi ashtareeh bas kaan kteer ghali

arabic: بعدين لقيت بنطلون كان رخيص وحلو كمان
english: Then I found a pair of trousers that were cheap and also nice.
transliteration: Ba'deen laqeet bantaloon kaan rakhees w helu kamaan

arabic: فاشتريت البنطلون وتركت القميص الغالي ليوم تاني
english: So, I bought the trousers and left the expensive shirt for another day.
transliteration: Fa-ashtarayt al-bantaloon w tarakt al-qamees al-ghali li-yom taani

arabic: انا قاعد بالكافيه
english: I am sitting in the cafe.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bil-cafe.

arabic: انا بشوف ناس كتير برة
english: I see many people outside.
transliteration: Ana bashoof nas kteer barra.

arabic: بعض الناس رايحة على السوق
english: Some people are going to the market.
transliteration: Ba'd en-nas rayha 'al es-souq.

arabic: يمكن يشتروا تفاح او خضرة
english: Maybe they will buy apples or vegetables.
transliteration: Yemkin yishtaru tuffaḥ aw khoḍra.

arabic: النادل جاي بسرعة مع قهوتي
english: The waiter is coming quickly with my coffee.
transliteration: En-nadel jay be sor'a ma' qahweti.

arabic: عم تمطر كتير هالعشية بالمدينة
english: It's raining heavily this afternoon in the city.
transliteration: aam temtor kteer halashiyye bilmadeene

arabic: انا قاعد بغرفتي حد الشباك عم اسمع المطر
english: I'm sitting in my room next to the window, listening to the rain.
transliteration: ana qa'ed bghurfati hadd elshubbak aam esma' elmatar

arabic: اخي عم ينام على سريره هلأ
english: My brother is sleeping on his bed now.
transliteration: akhi aam ynam ala sareero hala'

arabic: بعد شوي امي رح تجي و رح ناكل عشا عالطاولة
english: Later, my mom will come and we will eat dinner at the table.
transliteration: ba'ed shway emmi rah teji w rah nakol asha aal tawle

arabic: منحب نحكي و نرتاح لما يكون عم تمطر برا
english: We like to talk and relax when it's raining outside.
transliteration: mnehebb nehki w nertaah lamma ykoon aam temtor barra

arabic: دخلت على سوق قديم كتير وما عرفت وين انا
english: I entered a very old market and didn't know where I was
transliteration: Dakhalet ala souq qadeem kteer w ma areft wein ana

arabic: حاولت استعمل الموبايل لخريطة بس ما كان في شبكة
english: I tried to use my phone for a map, but there was no signal
transliteration: Hawalet esta'mel el mobile la khareeta bas ma kan fee shabakeh

arabic: سألت شب صغير وين الطريق للقلعة بس هو جاوبني بكلمات غريبة
english: I asked a young guy 'Where is the way to the citadel?' but he answered me with strange words
transliteration: Sa'alt shab zghir wein el tareeq lal qal'a bas houw jawabni bi kalimat ghareebeh

arabic: بعدين شفت ست كبيرة وسألتها نفس السؤال وهي فهمتني بسرعة
english: Then I saw an old woman and asked her the same question, and she understood me quickly
transliteration: Ba'dein shoft sett kbeereh w sa'altaha nafs el su'al w heeya fehmetni bi sur'a

arabic: شرحتلي الطريق بوضوح وصرت اعرف كيف ارجع البيت
english: She explained the way clearly to me and I knew how to get back home
transliteration: Sharahatli el tareeq bi wudhooh w serekt a'ref keef arja' el beit

arabic: اليوم كان عيد ميلاد اخي الصغير
english: Today was my little brother's birthday.
transliteration: El-yom kan 'eid milad akhi es-saghir.

arabic: اجوا ناس كتير على بيتنا للاحتفال
english: Many people came to our house to celebrate.
transliteration: Ajaw nas ktiir 'ala beitna lil-ihtifal.

arabic: كنا بالمطبخ عم نجهز الكيك وبسرعة سمعنا صوت غريب
english: We were in the kitchen preparing the cake, and quickly we heard a strange sound.
transliteration: Kunna bil-maṭbakh 'am njahez el-keik w bi-sor'a sem'na sawt ghariib.

arabic: بلشت تمطر والمي نزلت من السقف شوي شوي
english: It started to rain and water slowly came down from the ceiling.
transliteration: Ballashat tomṭor wel-may nazalet min es-saqf shway shway.

arabic: اخي ضحك وقال هاد احلى عيد ميلاد مع مطر داخلي
english: My brother laughed and said "This is the best birthday with indoor rain".
transliteration: Akhi dehek w qaal "had aḥla 'eid milad ma' maṭar dakhili".

arabic: كل يوم جمعة الصبح بروح على السوق لحتى اشتري الخضار والفواكه الطازجة
english: Every Friday morning I go to the market to buy fresh vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Kull yom jum'a es-sobh baruh 'ala es-suq lahatta eshteri el-khodar wal-fawakeh et-tazaja.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: اليوم كان الجو دافي شوي مع انه احنا باخر الخريف والناس كانت عم تتسوق عادي
english: Today the weather was a bit warm even though we are at the end of autumn and people were shopping normally.
transliteration: El-yom kan el-jaw dafi shway ma' anno ehna be-akher el-kharif wan-nas kanat 'am tettsawwaq 'adi.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: فجأة صار الجو غائم وشفنا برق خفيف بالبعيد
english: Suddenly the weather became cloudy and we saw faint lightning in the distance.
transliteration: Faj'a sar el-jaw gha'em w shofna barq khafif bel-ba'id.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: بعد دقايق بلش رعد قوي وبلشت الدنيا تصير عاصفة
english: After minutes, strong thunder started and it began to get stormy.
transliteration: Ba'd daqa'eq ballash ra'ed qawe w ballashit ed-dunya tasir 'asifa.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: الكل استعجل يخلص مشترياته ليرجع على البيت قبل ما تشتد العاصفة أكثر
english: Everyone rushed to finish their shopping to return home before the storm intensified more.
transliteration: El-koll esta'jal yekhalleṣ mushtarayaato leyarja' 'ala el-bet qabl ma teshtadd el-'asifa akthar.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: ليلى بلشت شغل جديد بالمكتب هاد الاسبوع
english: Laila started a new job at the office this week.
transliteration: Layla ballashat shoghl jdid bil maktab had el isbu'.

arabic: مديرها ابو كريم زلمة جدّي كتير وطيب بس مرات بصير عصبي شوي مع التكنولوجيا الجديدة
english: Her manager Abu Karim is a very serious and kind man, but sometimes he gets a little nervous with new technology.
transliteration: Mudirha Abu Karim zalame jidiyy ktir w tayeb bas marrat biṣir 'aṣabī shway ma' el tiknolojia el jdide.

arabic: بالعكس سارة زميلتها الاصغر منها ثرثارة كتير و دايماً مرحة بالاجتماعات
english: On the contrary, Sarah, her younger colleague, is very talkative and always fun in meetings.
transliteration: Bil 'aks Sara zamiletha el asghar minha tharthara ktir w dayman marḥa bil ijtima'at.

arabic: ابو كريم بحب يشتغل بهدوء بينما سارة بتفضل تحكي عن كل اشي بصوت عالي وبسرعة
english: Abu Karim likes to work quietly, while Sarah prefers to talk about everything loudly and quickly.
transliteration: Abu Karim biḥibb yishtaghel bi hudoo' baynama Sara btfaḍḍel taḥki 'an kil ishi bi ṣoot 'ali w bi sur'a.

arabic: مع انه في اختلافات بيناتهم بس التنين اذكياء وبيشتغلوا منيح سوا
english: Even though there are differences between them, both are smart and work well together.
transliteration: Ma' anno fi ikhtilafat baynathum bas el tnen adhkiya w bi ishtaghlu mnih sawa.

arabic: اليوم رحت ازور خالتي لانها كانت تعبانة
english: Today I went to visit my aunt because she was unwell.
transliteration: L-yōm ruḥt azūr khāltī la-ʾinnahā kānet taʿbāne.

arabic: لما شفتها قلتلها صحة وعافية يا خالتي كيف صحتك اليوم
english: When I saw her, I told her, "Health and well-being, my aunt, how is your health today?"
transliteration: Lammā shuftahā qultillāhā ṣiḥḥa w-ʿāfye yā khāltī, kīf ṣiḥḥtak l-yōm?

arabic: جاوبتني وقالت انا بدي دوا للرشح لاني حاسة حالي كتير مرضت
english: She answered me and said, "I need medicine for a cold because I feel very sick."
transliteration: Jāwabitnī w-qālat: "Ana biddī dawa la-r-rashḥ la-ʾinnī ḥāssit ḥālī ktīr mariḍt."

arabic: طمنتها وحكيتلها ان شاء الله بتصيري احسن قريبا
english: I reassured her and told her, "Hopefully you get better soon."
transliteration: Ṭammanthā w-ḥakaytillāhā: "In shāʾ Allāh bitṣīrī aḥsan qarīban."

arabic: بعدين عرضت عليها اروح عالصيدلية لاجيب دوا العلاج
english: Then I offered to go to the pharmacy to get the treatment medicine.
transliteration: Baʿdēn ʿaraḍt ʿalēhā arūḥ ʿa-ṣ-ṣaydalīyye la-ajīb dawa l-ʿilāj.

arabic: رحت على الملعب امبارح
english: I went to the stadium yesterday
transliteration: ruḥt 'ala el-mal'ab embāreḥ

arabic: كان في ناس كتير عم تتفرج
english: There were many people watching
transliteration: kān fī nas ktīr 'am tetfarraj

arabic: اللعيبة ركضوا بسرعة كبيرة
english: The players ran very quickly
transliteration: el-la'eeba rakaḍu be sor'a kbīra

arabic: بلشت الدنيا تمطر شوي
english: It started to rain a little
transliteration: ballashet ed-dinya tomṭor shwayy

arabic: بس اللعبة كملت وكانت حلوة
english: But the game continued and it was nice
transliteration: bass el-lo'ba kammalet u kānīt ḥilwe

arabic: ليلى، طالبة آثار عمرها ٢٨ سنة وشغوفة بالتاريخ، رأت عمو أبو فادي بمحل كنوز الشام بسوق الحميدية عابساً، فقالت: صباح الخير يا عمو، كيفك اليوم؟
english: Layla, a 28-year-old archaeology student passionate about history, saw uncle Abu Fadi in his shop "Treasures of Sham" in Souk al-Hamidiyah frowning, so she said: "Good morning, uncle, how are you today?"
transliteration: Layla, talibat athar umruha 28 sana wa shaghoufa bil tareekh, ra'at ammu Abu Fadi bi mahal Kunooz ash-Sham bi Souk al-Hamidiyah aabisan, fa qalat: Sabah al-khair ya ammu, keefak al-yawm?

arabic: أجاب أبو فادي بتعب واضح وهو يرتب تحفة نحاسية: أهلًا ليلى، والله مو منيح أبدًا، في شغلة كبيرة شاغلة بالي كثير.
english: Abu Fadi replied with clear tiredness while arranging a copper artifact: "Hello Layla, honestly not well at all, there's a big matter really bothering me a lot."
transliteration: Ajab Abu Fadi bi ta'ab wadeh wa huwa yurattib tuhfa nuhasiya: Ahlan Layla, wallah mou mneeh abadan, fi shaghlah kabira shaghlah bali katheer.

arabic: اقتربت ليلى أكثر، وهمست بقلق: مرحباً عمو، شو صاير معك؟ شكلك مو على بعضك أبداً اليوم.
english: Layla approached closer, and whispered worriedly: "Hello uncle, what happened with you? You don't look yourself at all today."
transliteration: Iqtarabat Layla akthar, wa hamasat bi qalaq: Marhaba ammu, shou sayer ma'ak? Shaklak mou ala ba'dak abadan al-yawm.

arabic: في تلك اللحظة، مرّ أبو محمد، صاحب كافيه الروشة الشهير، فسلم بابتسامة: يا صباح الورد أبو فادي! كيف صحتك؟
english: At that moment, Abu Mohammad, owner of the famous "Al-Rawsha" cafe, passed by and greeted with a smile: "Morning of roses Abu Fadi! How is your health?"
transliteration: Fi tilka al-lahza, marr Abu Mohammad, sahib Kafe al-Rawsha ash-shaheer, fa sallam bi ibtisama: Ya sabah al-ward Abu Fadi! Keef sahhtak?

arabic: أجاب أبو فادي وهو يتنهد ويفرك جبينه: أهلًا وسهلًا أبو محمد، والله تعبان شوي، بس أنت كيفك؟
english: Abu Fadi replied while sighing and rubbing his forehead: "Welcome Abu Mohammad, honestly a bit tired, but how are you?"
transliteration: Ajab Abu Fadi wa huwa yatanahhad wa yafrk jabeenah: Ahlan wa sahlan Abu Mohammad, wallah ta'ban shway, bas enta keefak?

arabic: قال أبو محمد بمزاح خفيف: أنا منيح الحمد لله، بس شكلك أنت ما عم تسلّم منيح على زباينك الوفيين!
english: Abu Mohammad said with a light joke: "I'm good, praise be to God, but it seems you're not greeting your loyal customers well!"
transliteration: Qal Abu Mohammad bi muzah khafeef: Ana mneeh al-hamdu lillah, bas shaklak enta ma am tsallim mneeh ala zabaynak al-wafiyyeen!

arabic: ابتسمت ليلى بلطف وقالت: معلش عمو، بس أنا هون كرمال الكتاب القديم عن الفولكلور اللي حكيتلك عنه.
english: Layla smiled gently and said: "Excuse me uncle, but I'm here for the old book about folklore that I told you about."
transliteration: Ibtasamat Layla bi lutuf wa qalat: Ma'lesh ammu, bas ana houn karmal al-kitab al-qadeem an al-folklore illi hakaytlik anhu.

arabic: تذكّر أبو فادي وهزّ رأسه بحيرة: آه، أهلًا فيكي ليلى، بس والله هلق مو وقته أبدًا، عندي مشكلة بمبلغ ٥٠ ألف ليرة سورية.
english: Abu Fadi remembered and shook his head confusedly: "Ah, welcome Layla, but honestly, now is not its time at all, I have a problem with 50 thousand Syrian pounds."
transliteration: Tazakkar Abu Fadi wa hazz ra'sah bi heera: Ah, ahlan feeki Layla, bas wallah hallaq mou wa'toh abadan, indi mushkilah bi mablagh 50 alf lira souriya.

arabic: أصرت ليلى وهي ترى قلقه: طيب، يسلمو عمو، بس أنا يمكن بقدر ساعدك بشي؟
english: Layla insisted as she saw his worry: "Okay, thank you uncle, but maybe I can help you with something?"
transliteration: Asarrat Layla wa hiya tara qalaqah: Tayyib, yeslamu ammu, bas ana yumkin biqdar sa'edak bi shi?

arabic: نظر إليها أبو فادي بتقدير وبعض الأمل وقال: أهلًا ليلى، تصدقي ممكن. بدي أسألك عن شي قبل ما تروحي.
english: Abu Fadi looked at her with appreciation and some hope and said: "Hello Layla, believe me, maybe. I want to ask you about something before you leave."
transliteration: Nazar ilayha Abu Fadi bi taqdeer wa ba'd al-amal wa qal: Ahlan Layla, tsaddiqi mumkin. Biddi as'alik an shi qabl ma trouhi.

arabic: ليلى، المهندسة المعمارية المعروفة بدقة تصاميمها، كانت عم تحاول تقنع إدارة فندق قصر الياسمين ببيروت بتغيير تصميم قاعة المؤتمرات.
english: Layla, the architect known for the meticulousness of her designs, was trying to convince the management of the Jasmine Palace Hotel in Beirut to change the conference hall layout.
transliteration: Layla, al-muhandisa al-mi'mariya al-ma'roufa bi-diqqat tasameemha, kanat 'am t'hawel tuqni' idarat funduq qasr al-yasmeen bi-Beirut bi-taghyeer tasmeem qa'at al-mu'tamarat.

arabic: كانت بترفض أي اقتراح بديل، مصرة على طاولات مستطيلة الشكل وترتيب معين يناسب شاشاتها التفاعلية الكبيرة.
english: She was refusing any alternative suggestion, insisting on rectangular tables and a specific arrangement that suited her large interactive screens.
transliteration: Kanat bitrufud ayyi iqtirah badeel, musirra 'ala tawilat mustateelat ash-shakl wa-tarteeb mu'ayyan yunasib shashatiha at-tafa'uliya al-kabeera.

arabic: يا مدام، هيك الترتيب بيخالف تعليمات السلامة العامة وما فينا نغيره بسهولة، قال مدير الفندق بصبر محدود.
english: Madam, this arrangement violates public safety instructions and we cannot change it easily, said the hotel manager with limited patience.
transliteration: Ya Madam, hek at-tarteeb biykhalif ta'leemat as-salama al-'amma w-ma feena n'ghayyirou bi-suhoola, qaal mudeer al-funduq bi-sabr mahdoud.

arabic: تنهدت ليلى بعمق وشرحت له أهمية هذا المؤتمر العالمي لمستقبل شركتها، وعرضت تدفع مبلغ إضافي ألف دولار.
english: Layla sighed deeply and explained to him the importance of this international conference for her company's future, offering to pay an additional thousand dollars.
transliteration: Tanahhadat Layla bi-'umq w-sharahat lahu ahammiyat hadha al-mu'tamar al-'alami li-mustaqbal sharikatha, w-'aradat tadfa' mablagh idafi alf dolar.

arabic: فجأة، رفع المدير نظره إليها وابتسم ابتسامة خافتة، إنتِ ليلى، صح؟ ليلى الشامية من الجامعة اللبنانية؟
english: Suddenly, the manager raised his gaze to her and smiled faintly, "You are Layla, right? Layla Al-Shamiya from the Lebanese University?"
transliteration: Faj'atan, rafa' al-mudeer nazrahu ilayha w-ibtassam ibtisama khafita, "Inti Layla, sah? Layla ash-Shamiya min al-Jami'a al-Lubnaniya?"

arabic: صُدمت ليلى للحظة ثم تعرفت عليه: يا هلا! ما بصدق! أنت مازن؟ كنا رفقات بالهندسة المعمارية!
english: Layla was shocked for a moment then recognized him: "Oh hello! I don't believe it! You are Mazen? We were friends in architecture!"
transliteration: Sudimat Layla lil-lahza thumma ta'arrafat 'alayhi: "Ya hala! Ma bisaddiq! Anta Mazen? Kunna rifqat bil-handasa al-mi'mariya!"

arabic: ضحك مازن وقال: الدنيا صغيرة كتير، عنجد، ما كنت متوقع شوفك هون عم تتفاوضي على قاعة!
english: Mazen laughed and said: "The world is so small, truly, I never expected to see you here negotiating for a hall!"
transliteration: Dahik Mazen w-qaal: "ad-dunya sagheera kteer, 'anjad, ma kunt mitwaqqa' shoufik hon 'am titfawadi 'ala qa'a!"

arabic: بعد تبادل أطراف الحديث وتذكر أيام الجامعة في بيروت، وعدها مازن يشوف شو ممكن يعمل لتلبية طلبها الخاص.
english: After exchanging pleasantries and reminiscing about university days in Beirut, Mazen promised her he would 'see what he could do' to meet her special request.
transliteration: Ba'd tabadul atraf al-hadeeth w-tadhakkur ayyam al-jami'a fi Beirut, wa'adha Mazen yishouf shou mumkin yi'mal li-talbiyat talabha al-khas.

arabic: شربا فنجان قهوة مع بعض، واتفقا على حل وسط يرضي الجميع مع الحفاظ على معايير السلامة.
english: They drank a cup of coffee together, and agreed on a compromise that satisfied everyone while maintaining safety standards.
transliteration: Shariba finjan qahwa ma' ba'd, w-ittafaqa 'ala hall wasat yardi al-jamee' ma' al-hifaz 'ala ma'ayir as-salama.

arabic: عاد مازن إلى مكتبه ممسكاً بهاتفه، مصمماً على تعديل الخرائط الهندسية للقاعة بأقصى سرعة ممكنة.
english: Mazen returned to his office holding his phone, determined to modify the architectural plans for the hall as quickly as possible.
transliteration: 'Aada Mazen ila maktabihi mumsikan bi-hatifihi, musammiman 'ala ta'deel al-kharait al-handasiya lil-qa'a bi-aqsa sur'a mumkin.

arabic: خرجت ليلى من الفندق بابتسامة عريضة، مرتاحة أن العقد سيتم توقيعه أخيراً بفضل الصدفة والصداقة القديمة.
english: Layla left the hotel with a wide smile, relieved that the contract would finally be signed thanks to chance and old friendship.
transliteration: kharajat Layla min al-funduq bi-ibtisama 'areeda, murtaha anna al-'aqd sayatimm tawqi'u akhiran bi-fadl as-sudfa w-as-sadaqa al-qadeema.

arabic: وصلت ليلى على الفندق ببيروت، بس فجأة تذكرت إنها ما عم تلاقي حجزها بموبايلها.
english: Layla arrived at the hotel in Beirut, but suddenly remembered she wasn't finding her booking on her phone.
transliteration: wasalat layla 'ala al-funduq bi-bayrut, bas faj'a tadakkart innaha ma 'am talaqi hajzaha bi-mobaylaha.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: يا الله، أنا دايماً هيك، بنسى أهم الأوراق تبعي لما بكون مستعجلة.
english: Oh God, I'm always like this, I forget my most important papers when I'm in a hurry.
transliteration: ya allah, ana dayman heik, bansa ahamm al-awraq taba'i lamma bakoun musta'jileh.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: راحت لعند موظفة الاستقبال، وهي طالبة جامعية بعمرها، وقالتلها:
english: She went to the receptionist, a university student her age, and told her:
transliteration: rahat la-'ind muwazzafet al-istiqbal, w hiyye talibeh jami'iyyeh bi-'umraha, w qaletlaha:
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: مرحبا، كيفك؟ أنا ليلى، عندي حجز غرفة باسمي بس شكلي ضيّعت تأكيد الحجز من إيميلي.
english: Hello, how are you? I am Layla, I have a room booking under my name but it seems I lost the booking confirmation from my email.
transliteration: marhaba, keefik? ana layla, 'andi hajz ghurfah bi-ismi bas shakli dayya't ta'keed al-hajz min e-maili.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: الموظفة، اسمها سارة، ابتسمت بلطف وبلشت تدوّر على اسمها بقاعدة بيانات الفنادق.
english: The employee, her name is Sara, smiled kindly and started looking for her name in the hotels' database.
transliteration: al-muwazzafeh, ismaha sara, ibtasamat bi-lutuf w ballashat tdawwer 'ala ismaha bi-qa'det bayanat al-fanadiq.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: بعد دقيقتين، قالت سارة:
english: After two minutes, Sara said:
transliteration: ba'd daqiqa-tein, qalet sara:
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: معلش، ما عم لاقي أي حجز باسم ليلى، أكيدة من التاريخ؟
english: No worries, I'm not finding any booking under Layla's name, are you sure about the date?
transliteration: ma'lesh, ma 'am talaqi ayy hajz bi-ism layla, akideh min al-tareekh?
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: فجأة تذكرت ليلى إنها ممكن تكون حجزت باسم تاني أو في خطأ إملائي.
english: Suddenly Layla remembered that she might have booked under another name or there was a spelling mistake.
transliteration: faj'a tadakkart layla innaha mumkin takoun hajzat bi-ism tani aw fi khata' imla'i.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: قالت:
english: She said:
transliteration: qalet:
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: جربي باسم 'ليلى أحمد' أو 'ليل' بس يمكن يكونوا كتبوا حرف ناقص بالاسم.
english: Try with the name 'Layla Ahmad' or 'Layl' but maybe they wrote a missing letter in the name.
transliteration: jarribi bi-ism 'layla ahmad' aw 'layl' bas mumkin yakoonu katabu harf naqis bi-l-ism.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: وفعلاً، بعد ثواني، سارة لقت حجزها باسم 'ليلا' بغرفة مطلة على منطقة الحمرا.
english: And indeed, after seconds, Sara found her booking under the name 'Leila' in a room overlooking the Hamra area.
transliteration: w-fi'lan, ba'd thawani, sara laqat hajzaha bi-ism 'leila' bi-ghurfah mutilleh 'ala mintaqet al-hamra.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: تنهدت ليلى براحة كبيرة وقالت:
english: Layla sighed with great relief and said:
transliteration: tanahhadat layla bi-raha kabeerah w qalet:
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: يسلمو إيديكي سارة، إنقذتيني! رح أدفع العشرين ألف ليرة لبنانية عربون بكرا.
english: Thank your hands Sara, you saved me! I will pay the twenty thousand Lebanese liras deposit tomorrow.
transliteration: yislamu ideiki sara, inqazteeni! rah adfa' al-'ishreen alf lira lubnaniyyeh 'arboun bukra.
storyTitle: The Booking Problem at Hamra Hotel

arabic: سارة تتصل بصديقتها رنا مساء الخير يا رنا
english: Sara calls her friend Rana. Good evening, Rana!
transliteration: Sara tattasil bi sadeeqatiha Rana. Masa' al-khair ya Rana.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: كيف حالك اليوم وما اخبارك انا بخير شكرا
english: How are you today? What's new? I'm fine, thank you.
transliteration: Keef halik al-youm w ma akhbarik? Ana bikhair shukran.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اريد ان نذهب الى مطعم جديد يوم غد للغداء
english: I want us to go to a new restaurant tomorrow for lunch.
transliteration: Ureed an nadhhab ila mat'am jadeed youm ghadan lil ghada'.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: نعم فكرة جيدة لكن افضل ان نشرب قهوة في بيتي
english: Yes, that's a good idea, but I prefer that we drink coffee at my house.
transliteration: Na'am fikra jayyida, lakin ufaddil an nashrab qahwa fi bayti.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: حسنا نلتقي في بيتك مع السلامة
english: Okay, we'll meet at your house. Goodbye.
transliteration: Hasanan naltaqi fi baytik. Ma'a as-salama.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: طارق: والله يا لارا، الوضع السياسي عنا بلبنان صار لا يطاق، هيك عم حس حالي ضايع بلا أمل.
english: Tareq: Really, Lara, the political situation here in Lebanon has become unbearable; I feel so lost without hope.
transliteration: Tareq: Wallahi ya Lara, al-wad' al-siyasi 'anna bi-Lubnan sar la yutaq, heik 'am hess hali daye' bila amal.

arabic: لارا: بعرف شعورك يا طارق، بس ما فينا نستسلم لهالدرجة، لازم نضل عم نجرب نلاقي حلول.
english: Lara: I know your feeling, Tareq, but we can't surrender to this extent; we must keep trying to find solutions.
transliteration: Lara: Ba'ref shu'ourak ya Tareq, bas ma fina nastaslem la-hal-daraje, lazim ndall 'am njareb nla'i hulul.

arabic: طارق: حلول؟ شو هي الحلول لما كل يوم عم تتفاقم الأزمات الاقتصادية والاجتماعية بالبلد؟
english: Tareq: Solutions? What are the solutions when every day the economic and social crises in the country are escalating?
transliteration: Tareq: Hulul? Shu hiye al-hulul lamma kull yom 'am tatafaqam al-azamat al-iqtisadiyya wal-ijtimaiyya bil-balad?

arabic: لارا: مضبوط، الأوضاع صعبة، بس يمكن التغيير لازم يبلش منّا، من جيل الشباب الواعي والمثقف.
english: Lara: True, the situations are difficult, but maybe change must start from us, from the aware and educated youth generation.
transliteration: Lara: Mazbout, al-awda' sa'be, bas yumken al-taghyeer lazim yiblash minna, min jeel al-shabab al-wa'i wal-muthaqqaf.

arabic: طارق: عم حاول كتير بالجامعة إوعّي طلابي على أهمية المشاركة السياسية وضرورة التفكير النقدي.
english: Tareq: I'm trying a lot at the university to awaken my students to the importance of political participation and the necessity of critical thinking.
transliteration: Tareq: 'Am hawel kteer bil-jami'a iwa''i tullabi 'ala ahammiyyat al-musharaka al-siyasiyya wa-darurat al-tafkeer al-naqdi.

arabic: لارا: وهذا شي كتير مهم يا طارق، تعليم الجيل الجديد هو أساس بناء مستقبل أفضل للكل.
english: Lara: And this is very important, Tareq, educating the new generation is the foundation for building a better future for everyone.
transliteration: Lara: W hada shi kteer muhimm ya Tareq, ta'leem al-jeel al-jadeed huwe asas bina' mustaqbal afdal lil-kull.

arabic: طارق: بس يا لارا، أحياناً بحس كأنه جهودي كلها بتروح بالهوا، والناس صارت يائسة من أي تغيير.
english: Tareq: But Lara, sometimes I feel like all my efforts are going to waste, and people have become desperate for any change.
transliteration: Tareq: Bas ya Lara, ahyanan bahess ka'anno juhudi kullha bitrouh bil-hawa, wal-nas sarat ya'isa min ayy taghyeer.

arabic: لارا: معلش، هاد إحساس طبيعي بظل هالظروف، بس تذكر إنه الإحباط هو أكبر عدو للتغيير.
english: Lara: Never mind, this is a natural feeling under these circumstances, but remember that frustration is the biggest enemy of change.
transliteration: Lara: Ma'lesh, had ihsas tabi'i bi-zill hal-zuroof, bas tzakkar inno al-ihbat huwe akbar 'adduw lil-taghyeer.

arabic: طارق: كلامك صحيح، يمكن لازم نركز على المبادرات المحلية الصغيرة يلي ممكن تحدث فرق حقيقي.
english: Tareq: Your words are true, maybe we need to focus on small local initiatives that can make a real difference.
transliteration: Tareq: Kalamak sahih, yumken lazim nrakkez 'ala al-mubadarat al-mahaliyya al-saghira yalli mumkin tuhdith farq haqiqi.

arabic: لارا: بالزبط! متل حملات التوعية البيئية أو دعم المشاريع الشبابية يلي بتخلق فرص عمل جديدة.
english: Lara: Exactly! Like environmental awareness campaigns or supporting youth projects that create new job opportunities.
transliteration: Lara: Bil-zabt! Mitel hamalat al-taw'iya al-bi'iyya aw da'm al-mashari' al-shababiyya yalli bitkhloq furas 'amal jadeeda.

arabic: طارق: بتعرفي، في عنا مشروع صغير بالجامعة للتوعية بالحقوق المدنية، بس ما لقينا دعم كافي.
english: Tareq: You know, we have a small project at the university for civil rights awareness, but we haven't found enough support.
transliteration: Tareq: Bta'refi, fi 'anna mashrou' sagheer bil-jami'a lil-taw'iya bil-huquq al-madaniyya, bas ma laqeena da'm kafi.

arabic: لارا: يمكن فينا نلاقي جهات مانحة أو منظمات غير حكومية ممكن تهتم بهيك مبادرات قيمة.
english: Lara: Maybe we can find donor entities or non-governmental organizations that might be interested in such valuable initiatives.
transliteration: Lara: Yumken fina nla'i jihat maniha aw munazzamat ghayr hukumiya mumkin tahtamm bi-heik mubadarat qayyima.

arabic: طارق: فكرة ممتازة يا لارا! ليش ما منعمل قائمة بهالجهات وبنتواصل معهم الأسبوع الجاي؟
english: Tareq: Excellent idea, Lara! Why don't we make a list of these entities and contact them next week?
transliteration: Tareq: Fikra mumtaza ya Lara! Leish ma mna'mel qa'ime bi-hal-jihat w-bnetwasal ma'hum al-usbu' al-jay?

arabic: لارا: يلا، اتفقنا! ببلش أنا ببحث عن المنظمات يلي بتدعم مشاريع الشباب والتنمية المحلية.
english: Lara: Okay, agreed! I'll start by searching for organizations that support youth projects and local development.
transliteration: Lara: Yalla, ittafa'na! Bballash ana bbahath 'an al-munazzamat yalli bted'am mashari' al-shabab wal-tanmiya al-mahaliyya.

arabic: طارق: يسلمو إيديكي يا لارا، حسيت هلا في بصيص أمل بإنو فينا نغير شي بهالبلد.
english: Tareq: Thank you, Lara, now I feel a glimmer of hope that we can change something in this country.
transliteration: Tareq: Yeslamu idayki ya Lara, haseit halla fi basees amal bi'inno fina nghayyir shi bi-hal-balad.

arabic: حدّقت ليلى، معلمة الإنجليزية المصممة، بشاشة لابتوبها بذهول.
english: Layla, the determined English teacher, stared at her laptop screen in astonishment.
transliteration: Haddaqat Layla, mu'allimat al-ingliziyya al-musammima, bi-shashat laptop-ha bi-dhuhool.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: كانت الساعة تقريباً تسعة بالليل في شقتها الصغيرة بجميزة.
english: It was almost nine at night in her small apartment in Gemmayzeh.
transliteration: Kanat is-sa'a taqriban tis'a bil-leil fi shiqqatiha as-saghira bi-Gemmayzeh.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: اكتشفت للتو أن عضو البرلمان لمنطقتها، الأستاذ فادي، خان وعده.
english: She had just discovered that the Member of Parliament for her area, Mr. Fadi, had betrayed his promise.
transliteration: Iktashafat lil-taww anna 'udw al-barlaman li-mantiqatiha, al-ustadh Fadi, khan wa'dah.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: قبل أسبوعين، وعد الناخبين بدعم قانون إصلاح التعليم الجديد.
english: Two weeks ago, he promised the voters to support the new education reform law.
transliteration: Qabl usbuein, wa'ad an-nakhbeen bi-da'm qanun islah at-ta'leem al-jadeed.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: لكن، شو هالصدمة، صوّت ضد مشروع القانون بالبرلمان اليوم.
english: But, what a shock, he voted against the bill in Parliament today.
transliteration: Lakin, shoo hal-sadma, sawwat didd mashrou' al-qanun bil-barlaman el-yom.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: كانت سياسة التعليم هادي مهمة جداً لمستقبل طلابها ببيروت.
english: This education policy was very important for the future of her students in Beirut.
transliteration: Kanat siyasat at-ta'leem hadi muhimma jiddan li-mustaqbal tullabiha bi-Beirut.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: تنهدت بعمق، "يعني معقول هلق كل شي يروح هيك؟"
english: She sighed deeply, "I mean, is it possible now for everything to go like this?"
transliteration: Tanahhadat bi-'umq, "Ya'ni ma'qul hallaq kull shi yeruh heik?"
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: قررت ليلى فوراً إنها لازم تتصرف وما تسكت على هالفساد.
english: Layla immediately decided that she must act and not stay silent about this corruption.
transliteration: Qarrarat Layla fawran innaha lazim titassarraf wama tuskut 'ala hal-fasad.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: بدأت تفكر كيف ممكن تعمل حملة صغيرة لتوعية الناس.
english: She started thinking about how she could launch a small campaign to raise people's awareness.
transliteration: Bada'at tfakkir keef mumkin ta'mil hamleh sghireh li-taw'iyat an-nas.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: يمكن تتواصل مع الصحافة أو حتى تنظيم وقفة احتجاجية سلمية.
english: Maybe she could contact the press or even organize a peaceful protest.
transliteration: Yimkin titawasul ma' as-sahafa aw hatta tanzeem waqfet ihtijajiyyeh silmiyeh.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: فجأة، خطر ببالها فكرة، تتواصل مع زميلها السابق، "سامي"، اللي بيشتغل بالدبلوماسية.
english: Suddenly, an idea came to her mind: contact her former colleague, Sami, who works in diplomacy.
transliteration: Faj'atan, khatar bi-balha fikra, titawasul ma' zameelha as-sabiq, "Sami", illi b-yishtaghel bil-diplomasiyyeh.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: يمكن سامي يقدر يساعدها تفهم آليات عمل الحكومة أكثر.
english: Maybe Sami could help her understand the mechanisms of government work better.
transliteration: Yimkin Sami yi'dar yisa'idha tafham aliyat 'amal al-hakumeh akthar.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: مسكت تليفونها، وقلبها عم يدق بسرعة، وبعتتله رسالة.
english: She grabbed her phone, her heart beating fast, and sent him a message.
transliteration: Masakat telefunha, w-qalba 'am yidugg bi-sur'a, w-ba'atat-lo risaleh.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: كانت مصممة تغير الوضع، حتى لو كان الأمر صعباً جداً.
english: She was determined to change the situation, even if the matter was very difficult.
transliteration: Kanat musammima tghayyir al-wad', hatta law kan al-amr sa'ban jiddan.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: بكرة، رح تبدأ معركتها الصغيرة ضد الظلم، مدعومة بإيمانها بالديمقراطية الحقيقية.
english: Tomorrow, she will begin her small battle against injustice, supported by her belief in true democracy.
transliteration: Bukra, rah tabda' ma'rakataha as-saghira didd az-zulm, mad'ooma bi-imanha bid-dimuqratiyyeh al-haqiqiyyeh.
storyTitle: Layla and the Battle for Reform

arabic: شو هالخبرية يا جماعة؟ معقول الحكومة ما عم تتحرك بخصوص مشروع قانون البيئة؟
english: "What's this news, folks? Is it possible the government isn't moving on the environmental bill?"
transliteration: Shu hal-khabariyye ya jama'a? Ma'qoul el-Hukouma ma 'am tetḥarrak bi-khuṣouṣ mashrou' qanoun el-bī'a?
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: هيك تساءلت ليلى، الطالبة الجامعية في علوم السياسة، وهي تتصفح أخبار الظهر بكافيه الروشة ببيروت.
english: Layla, a determined political science university student, wondered this while browsing noon news at Cafe Rawda in Beirut.
transliteration: Hēk tasā'alat Layla, aṭ-ṭāliba al-jāmi'iyya fī 'ulūm as-siyāsa, wa hiya tatṣaffaḥ akhbār aẓ-ẓuhr bi-kāfīh ar-Rawḍa bi-Bayrūt.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: كانت ليلى تدرس آليات عمل السلطة التشريعية، خصوصاً كيف يتم تشريع القوانين.
english: Layla was studying the mechanisms of the Legislative branch, especially how laws are legislated.
transliteration: Kānat Layla tadrus ālīyāt 'amal as-Sulṭa at-Tashrī'iyya, khuṣūṣan kayfa yatimmu tashrī' al-qawānīn.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: لم تفهم لماذا البرلمان يؤخر هذا القانون المهم، فالوضع البيئي أصبح حرجاً جداً.
english: She didn't understand why Parliament was delaying this important law, as the environmental situation became very critical.
transliteration: Lam tafham limādhā al-barlamān yu'akhkhir hādhā al-qānūn al-muhim, fal-waḍ' al-bī'ī aṣbaḥa ḥarijan jiddan.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: فجأة، سمعت صوتاً مألوفاً من طاولة مجاورة؛ كان دبلوماسي معروف يتحدث مع سياسي بارز.
english: Suddenly, she heard a familiar voice from an adjacent table; it was a well-known diplomat talking with a prominent politician.
transliteration: Faj'atan, sami'at ṣawtan ma'lūfan min ṭāwila mujāwira; kāna diblōmāsī ma'rūf yataḥaddath ma'a siyāsī bāriz.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: قالت ليلى لنفسها:
english: Layla said to herself:
transliteration: Qālat Layla li-nafsihā:
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: يا ربي، شو عم بيحكوا هدول عن الفساد والتشريع؟
english: "Oh my Lord, what are these two talking about corruption and legislation?"
transliteration: Ya Rabbī, shu 'am bīḥkū hadōl 'an al-fasād wat-tashrī'?
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: سمعت الدبلوماسي يقول:
english: She heard the diplomat saying:
transliteration: Sami'at ad-diblōmāsī yaqūl:
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: الموضوع معقد، بعض أعضاء البرلمان من حزب المعارضة يرفضون التصويت.
english: "The issue is complex, some Members of Parliament from the Opposition party refuse to vote."
transliteration: Al-mawḍū' mu'aqqad, ba'ḍ a'ḍā' al-barlamān min ḥizb al-mu'āraḍa yarfuḍūn at-taṣwīt.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: أضاف السياسي:
english: The politician added:
transliteration: Aḍāfa as-siyāsī:
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: لأنهم بدهم صفقة على مشروع ثاني، للأسف الفساد منتشر بكل السلطات.
english: "Because they want a deal on another project; unfortunately, corruption is widespread in all branches."
transliteration: Li'annahum bidhum ṣafqa 'ala mashrou' thānī, lil-'asaf al-fasād muntashir bi-kull as-sulṭāt.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: تغيرت ملامح وجه ليلى، شعرت بخيبة أمل كبيرة تجاه الديمقراطية ومؤسساتها.
english: Layla's facial features changed; she felt great disappointment towards democracy and its institutions.
transliteration: Taghayyarat malāmiḥ wajh Layla, sha'arat bi-khaybat amal kabīra tujāh ad-dīmuqrāṭiyya wa mu'assasātihā.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: كانت تفكر بورقتها البحثية عن إصلاح السياسة، وكيف يمكن للناخبين إحداث تغيير.
english: She was thinking about her research paper on policy reform and how voters could bring about change.
transliteration: Kānat tufakkir bi-waraqatihā al-baḥthiyya 'an iṣlāḥ as-siyāsa, wa kayfa yumkin lil-nākhibīn iḥdāth taghyīr.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: قررت ليلى أن تُعمق بحثها في ملف الفساد، فالقانون وحده لا يكفي.
english: Layla decided to deepen her research into the corruption file, as law alone is not enough.
transliteration: Qarrarat Layla an tu'ammiq baḥthahā fī malaf al-fasād, fal-qānūn waḥdahu lā yakfī.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: حملت حقيبتها وتوجهت نحو مكتبة الجامعة، عازمة على فهم تعقيدات السياسة اللبنانية.
english: She carried her bag and headed towards the university library, determined to understand the complexities of Lebanese politics.
transliteration: Ḥamalat ḥaqībatahā wa tawajjahat naḥwa maktabat al-jāmi'a, 'āzima 'ala fahm ta'qīdāt as-siyāsa al-lubnāniyya.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: أدركت أن فهم النظام الديمقراطي يتطلب الغوص أعمق من مجرد قراءة الأخبار.
english: She realized that understanding the democratic system requires diving deeper than just reading the news.
transliteration: Adrakat anna fahm an-niẓām ad-dīmuqrāṭī yataṭallab al-ghawṣ a'maq min mujarrad qirā'at al-akhbār.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: بدأت ليلى تفكر بمشاركة اكتشافاتها مع زملائها الطلاب، لتوعيتهم حول قضايا الوطن.
english: Layla began thinking about sharing her discoveries with her fellow students, to raise their awareness about national issues.
transliteration: Bada'at Layla tufakkir bi-mushārakat iktishāfātihā ma'a zumalā'ihā aṭ-ṭullāb, li-taw'iyatihim ḥawla qaḍāyā al-waṭan.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: أنهت ليلى مشروبها الجلاب، وخرجت من الكافيه، ففكرها مليء بالسياسة والإصلاحات الضرورية.
english: Layla finished her jallab drink and left the cafe, her mind full of politics and necessary reforms.
transliteration: Anhat Layla mashrūbahā al-jallāb, wa kharajat min al-kāfīh, fa-fikruhā malī' bi-as-siyāsa wal-iṣlāḥāt aḍ-ḍarūriyya.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: إنها تعلم الآن أن طريق الإصلاح طويل وشائك، لكنها مصممة على المضي قدماً.
english: She now knows that the path of reform is long and thorny, but she is determined to move forward.
transliteration: Innahā ta'lam al-'ān anna ṭarīq al-iṣlāḥ ṭawīl wa shā'ik, lakinnahā muṣammama 'ala al-muḍī quduman.
storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe

arabic: ليلى كانت عم تدرس بمقهى بحمرا، بيروت، وهالجو الهادي بيناسبها دايماً.
english: Layla was studying in a cafe in Hamra, Beirut, and this calm atmosphere always suited her.
transliteration: Layla kanat 'am tidrus bi-maqha bi-Hamra, Beyroot, w-hal-jaww il-hadi bi-yenasibha dayman.

arabic: فجأة، التلفزيون بالزاوية اللي عادةً ما حدا بيهتم فيه، لفت انتباهها بخبر عاجل.
english: Suddenly, the TV in the corner, which usually no one pays attention to, caught her attention with breaking news.
transliteration: Faj'atan, it-tilfizyon bi-z-zawiyye illi 'adatan ma hada bi-yehtamm fi, lafat intibahahha bi-khabar 'ajil.

arabic: المذيع كان عم يحكي بسرعة عن "الكويت" و"اعتراض" "صواريخ إيرانية" بتصاعد التوتر.
english: The anchor was speaking quickly about "Kuwait" and "intercepting" "Iranian rockets" amidst escalating tension.
transliteration: Il-mudhi' kan 'am yihki bi-sur'a 'an "il-Kuwait" w-"i'tirad" "sawarikh Iraniyya" bi-tasa'ud it-tawatur.

arabic: قلب ليلى دق بقوة؛ سمعت إشاعات، بس هاد الخبر حسيتو حقيقي ومختلف.
english: Layla's heart pounded strongly; she had heard rumors, but this news felt real and different.
transliteration: Qalb Layla daqq bi-quwwa; simi'at isha'at, bas had il-khabar hassayto haqiqa w-mukhtalif.

arabic: "شو هاد؟" همست لحالها، "يعني التوتر عنجد عم يزيد هيك بهالسرعة؟"
english: "What is this?" she whispered to herself, "meaning, is the tension really increasing like this so quickly?"
transliteration: "Shoo had?" hamsat li-halha, "ya'ni it-tawatur 'anjad 'am yizeed hayk bi-hal-sur'a?"

arabic: أبو سامي، عامل المقهى، جابلها كاسة جلاب، لاحظ وشها القلقان فوراً.
english: Abu Sami, the cafe worker, brought her a glass of Jallab, immediately noticing her worried face.
transliteration: Abu Sami, 'amil il-maqha, jablaha kaset jallab, lahaz wishsha l-qalqan fawran.

arabic: "خير إن شاء الله يا بنتي،" قال بلطف، "الدنيي مقلوبة شوي هالايام، معلش."
english: "Hopefully it's good, my daughter," he said gently, "the world is a bit upside down these days, it's okay."
transliteration: "Kheir in sha' Allah ya binti," qal bi-lutuf, "id-diniyya maqlouba shway hal-ayyam, ma'lesh."

arabic: ليلى تذكرت محاضراتها بالعلوم السياسية عن تأثير عدم الاستقرار الإقليمي.
english: Layla remembered her political science lectures about the impact of regional instability.
transliteration: Layla tadakkarat muhadarat-ha bil-'uloom is-siyasiyya 'an ta'thir 'adam il-istiqrar il-iqlimi.

arabic: الأخبار كملت، ذاكرة "تهديدات" ضد "مواقع أميركية وإسرائيلية" رداً على "هجمات محتملة".
english: The news continued, mentioning "threats" against "American and Israeli sites" in response to "potential attacks."
transliteration: Al-akhbar kammalat, dhakira "tahdidat" didd "mawaqi' Amrikiyya w-Isra'iliyya" raddan 'ala "hajamat muhtamala."

arabic: مسكت موبايلها، وقررت تتصل بعمها عماد، الصحافي المتقاعد، لتفهم الوضع.
english: She grabbed her phone, and decided to call her uncle Imad, the retired journalist, to understand the situation.
transliteration: Masakat mobaylha, w-qarrarat tittasil bi-'ammha 'Imad, is-sahafi il-mutaqa'id, la-tifham il-wada'.

arabic: "مرحبا عمو، كيفك؟" بلشت، "سمعت أخبار الصواريخ، أنا قلقانة كتير."
english: "Hello uncle, how are you?" she started, "I heard the news about the rockets, I am very worried."
transliteration: "Marhaba 'ammu, kifak?" ballashat, "simi't akhbar is-sawarikh, ana qalqana kteer."

arabic: صوت عماد الهادي طمنها، وشرحلها تعقيدات السياسة الإقليمية بوضوح.
english: Imad's calm voice reassured her, and he clearly explained the complexities of regional politics to her.
transliteration: Sowt 'Imad il-hadi tamman-ha, w-sharah-laha ta'qidat is-siyasa l-iqlimiyya bi-wudhooh.

arabic: نصحها دايماً تبحث عن المعلومات من مصادر موثوقة، مو بس إشاعات.
english: He advised her to always look for information from reliable sources, not just rumors.
transliteration: Nasah-ha dayman tibhas 'an il-ma'lumat min masadir mawthoqa, moo bas isha'at.

arabic: ليلى حست بشوية هدوء، بس التوتر بالجو كان لسا ملموس، متل ريحة القهوة القوية.
english: Layla felt a little calm, but the tension in the air was still palpable, like the smell of strong coffee.
transliteration: Layla hassat bi-shwayyat hudoo', bas it-tawatur bil-jaww kan lissa malmoos, mitl rihet il-qahwe il-qawiyya.

arabic: دفعت لأبو سامي خمسين ألف ليرة لبنانية حق الجلاب، متمنية بكرا أفضل.
english: She paid Abu Sami fifty thousand Lebanese Liras for the Jallab, wishing for a better tomorrow.
transliteration: Dafa'at li-Abu Sami khamseen alf lira Lubnaniyya haqq il-jallab, mutamanniyya bukra afdal.

arabic: قامت من كرسها، وطلبت من أبو سامي، "يسلمو إيديك، بدي روح هلق."
english: She got up from her chair, and told Abu Sami, "Thank you, I need to leave now."
transliteration: Qamat min kursiyya, w-talabat min Abu Sami, "Yislamu ideek, biddi rooh halla'."

arabic: المشوار للبيت كان طويل، والافكار براسها عم تتصارع، شو بدها تعمل لتهدي قلبها؟
english: The walk home was long, and thoughts were fighting in her head, what did she need to do to calm her heart?
transliteration: Il-mishwar lil-bet kan taweel, wil-afkar bi-ras-ha 'am tittasara', shoo biddaha ti'mal la-tihdi qalbaha?

arabic: قررت ليلى تبدأ ببحث معمّق عن التحليلات السياسية الموثوقة لتفهم الصورة كاملة.
english: Layla decided to start an in-depth search for reliable political analyses to understand the full picture.
transliteration: Qarrarat Layla tibda' bi-bahth mu'ammaq 'an it-tahlilat is-siyasiyya l-mawthoqa la-tifham is-soora kamila.

arabic: هي لم ترغب بالاستسلام للخوف، بل أرادت مواجهة الواقع بمعرفة تامة، هيك كانت شخصيتها.
english: She did not want to surrender to fear, but rather wanted to face reality with full knowledge, that's how her personality was.
transliteration: Hiyya lam targhab bil-istislam lil-khawf, bal aradat muwajahat il-waqi' bi-ma'rifa tamma, hayk kanat shakhsiyatha.

arabic: بالفعل، قضت ليلى ساعات طويلة بتقليب المقالات وتحليل البيانات، باحثة عن كل التفاصيل.
english: Indeed, Layla spent long hours sifting through articles and analyzing data, searching for every detail.
transliteration: Bil-fi'l, qadat Layla sa'at taweela bi-taqlib il-maqalat w-tahlil il-bayanat, bahitha 'an kull it-tafasil.

arabic: اكتشفت أنّ الأخبار كانت مبالغ فيها أحياناً، والواقع أكثر تعقيداً مما يظهر على الشاشات.
english: She discovered that the news was sometimes exaggerated, and reality was more complex than what appeared on screens.
transliteration: Iktashafat anna al-akhbar kanat mubalagh fiha ahianan, wal-waqi' akthar ta'qidan mimma yazhar 'ala ash-shashat.

arabic: بهالمعرفة، حست بقدرة أكبر على مواجهة أي تحديات ممكنة، وصارت مرتاحة أكثر.
english: With this knowledge, she felt a greater ability to face any possible challenges, and became more at ease.
transliteration: Bi-hal-ma'rifa, hassat bi-qudra akbar 'ala muwajahat ayy tahaddiyat mumkin, w-sarat murtaha akthar.

arabic: كان يوم عيد ميلاد أمي بالخريف والجو برا عاصفة وفي رعد وبرق
english: It was my mother's birthday in autumn, and the weather outside was stormy with thunder and lightning
transliteration: Kaan yoom eid milad ommi bil-kharīf wal-jaww barra aasifa w fi ra'ed w barq

arabic: بس جوات البيت كان دافي والكل متجمعين لنحتفل فيها
english: But inside the house it was warm, and everyone was gathered to celebrate her
transliteration: Bass jawwat il-beit kaan dāfi wil-kill mitjamma'een la-nahtifil feeha

arabic: عماتي وخالاتي وأولاد عمي وعمتي كلهم اجوا وجابوا هدايا حلوة
english: My paternal aunts, maternal aunts, and cousins all came and brought nice gifts
transliteration: Ammati w khalatī w awlad ammi w ammati killhum ajoo w jaboo hadaya hilwa

arabic: ضحكنا وغنينا أغاني عيد الميلاد وأكلنا كعكة كبيرة لذيذة
english: We laughed and sang birthday songs and ate a big delicious cake
transliteration: Dahaqna w ghannayna aghani eid il-milad w akalna ka'ke kbeere ladhīdha

arabic: هي اللحظات الحلوة بتخلي القلب دافي وبتذكرنا بقيمة العيلة
english: These sweet moments make the heart warm and remind us of the value of family
transliteration: Hay il-lahazat il-hilwa btikalli il-qalb dāfi w btadhakkirna bi-qeemet il-a'ile

arabic: رحت على السوق
english: I went to the market.
transliteration: Ruḥt 'ala es-souq.

arabic: شفت ناس كتير هناك
english: I saw many people there.
transliteration: Shuft nas ktiir hunaak.

arabic: فجأة شفت رفيقي القديم
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend.
transliteration: Faj'a shuft rfiiqi el-qadiim.

arabic: انا كنت كتير مبسوط لما شفته
english: I was very happy when I saw him.
transliteration: Ana kunt ktiir mabsoot lamma shuftu.

arabic: هو كمان كان مبسوط يشوفني بسرعة
english: He was also happy to see me quickly.
transliteration: Huwwe kamaan kaan mabsoot yishuufni be sor'a.

arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق
english: I was walking in the market.
transliteration: Kunt maashi bis-soo'

arabic: بعدين تهت وحسيت حالي حيران
english: Then I got lost and felt confused.
transliteration: Ba'deen tehet w hassayt haali hayran

arabic: شفت رجل وقررت اسأله
english: I saw a man and decided to ask him.
transliteration: Shaft rajul w qarrart as'alo

arabic: قلت له لو سمحت وين الشارع
english: I told him "Excuse me, where is the street?"
transliteration: Qult-lo law samaht wein ash-shaare'

arabic: هو قال لي روح دغري وبعدين لف يمين
english: He told me "Go straight and then turn right."
transliteration: Huwwe qaali rooh doghri w ba'deen leff yameen

arabic: اليوم رحنا على السوق انا وعيلتي
english: Today we went to the market, me and my family.
transliteration: El-yōm reḥna ʿala es-sūʾ ana w ʿēltī.

arabic: شفنا ناس كتير وبياع الخضرة كان عم يضحك
english: We saw many people and the vegetable vendor was laughing.
transliteration: Shefna nās ktīr w bayyāʿ el-khoḍra kān ʿam yeḍḥak.

arabic: امي اشترت تفاح احمر وخضرة طازجة
english: My mother bought red apples and fresh vegetables.
transliteration: Emmī eshtarāt tuffāḥ aḥmar w khoḍra ṭāzaja.

arabic: بابا حمل الاكياس الكبيرة ونحن رجعنا عالبيت مبسوطين
english: Father carried the big bags and we returned home happy.
transliteration: Bābā ḥamal el-akyās el-kbīra w neḥna rejʿna ʿal-bēt mabsūṭīn.

arabic: كان يوم حلو بالسوق مع العيلة
english: It was a nice day at the market with the family.
transliteration: Kān yōm ḥelū be es-sūʾ maʿ el-ʿēla.

arabic: كان يوم خريف والجو فيه ضباب خفيف
english: It was an autumn day and the weather had light fog.
transliteration: Kaan yom khareef wal jaww fee dabab khafeef.

arabic: كنت ماشي بالشوارع و فجأة حسيت اني ضعت و ما عرفت وين اروح
english: I was walking in the streets and suddenly I felt lost and didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Kunt maashi bish-shawari' w faj'a hassayt inni di't w ma 'araft wayn arooh.

arabic: لمحت رجال كبير واقف بعيد فقررت اسأله عن الطريق
english: I spotted an old man standing far away so I decided to ask him about the way.
transliteration: Lamaht rajjal kabeer waqif ba'eed fa qarart as'alo 'an it-tareeq.

arabic: قلت له عفوا يا عمو ممكن تدلني على سوق الحميدية لو سمحت
english: I said to him "Excuse me, uncle, could you please show me the way to Al-Hamidiyah Souq?"
transliteration: Qult lo 'afwan ya 'ammo mumkin tidillini 'ala Souq il-Hamidiyyeh law samaht.

arabic: جاوبني روح دغري بعدين لف يمين عند الاشارة بتلاقيه قدامك
english: He answered me "Go straight then turn right at the traffic light, you'll find it in front of you."
transliteration: Jaawabni rooh dughri ba'dein liff yameen 'and il-ishaara bitlaaqeeh quddamak.

arabic: مساء الخير احمد كيفك
english: Good evening, Ahmad. How are you?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr, Ahmad. Kayfak?

arabic: مساء الخير خالد انا منيح شكرا
english: Good evening, Khalid. I'm fine, thank you.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr, Khalid. Ana mnīḥ, shukran.

arabic: شو رايك نروح على سفرة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: What do you think about going on a trip this weekend?
transliteration: Sho rāyak nrūḥ ʿa safra ʿutlat nihāyat al-usbūʿ?

arabic: فكرة حلوة وين حابب نروح
english: Good idea! Where do you want to go?
transliteration: Fikra ḥilwa! Wēn ḥābeb nrūḥ?

arabic: خلينا نروح على الجبل باي
english: Let's go to the mountain. Bye!
transliteration: Khallīna nrūḥ ʿa al-jabal. Bāy!

arabic: كنت ماشي بالطريق الصبح وشميت ريحة قهوة زكية
english: I was walking on the road in the morning and smelled a pleasant coffee aroma.
transliteration: Kunt maashi bittareeq issubh w shammeit reehet qahwe zakiyye.

arabic: فجأة شفت وجه مألوف وسمعت ضحكة بتشبه ضحكة صديقي القديم
english: Suddenly I saw a familiar face and heard a laugh that resembled my old friend's laugh.
transliteration: Faj'atan shuft wajh ma'loof w simi't dahke bitishbah dahket sadeeqi lqadeem.

arabic: ناديت عليه بصوت عالي وهو لف ورجع حضني كتير بفرح
english: I called out to him loudly, and he turned around and hugged me very happily.
transliteration: Naadeit 'aleih bi-sawt 'aali w huwwa laff w raja' hadanni kteer bi-farah.

arabic: حكينا شوي عن حالنا وسألته كيفك زمان ما شفناك
english: We talked a little about ourselves and I asked him, 'How are you? It's been a long time since we saw you!'
transliteration: Hakeina shwayy 'an haalna w sa'alto, 'Keefak? Zamaan ma shifnaak!'

arabic: اتفقنا نشوف بعض مرة تانية قريب ونشرب قهوة
english: We agreed to see each other again soon and drink coffee.
transliteration: Ittefaqna nshoof ba'd marra taanye qareeb w nishrab qahwe.

arabic: كان يوم خريف غايم وكنا متحمسين لمباراة كرة القدم
english: It was a cloudy autumn day and we were excited for the football match.
transliteration: Kan yawm kharif gha'em w kunna mutahammisin la-mubarat kurat al-qadam.

arabic: الملعب كان مليان ناس والجو كان دافي رغم الغيوم
english: The stadium was full of people and the weather was warm despite the clouds.
transliteration: Al-mal'ab kan malyan nas wal-jaww kan dafi raghm al-ghuyum.

arabic: فجأة صار في رعد وبرق قوي بالسما خلى الكل يتفاجأ
english: Suddenly there was strong thunder and lightning in the sky which surprised everyone.
transliteration: Faj'a sar fi ra'ed w barq qawi bis-sama khalla al-kull yitfaja'.

arabic: الجو قلب عاصفة والرياح صارت قوية والضباب بلش ينتشر
english: The weather turned into a storm and the winds became strong and fog started to spread.
transliteration: Al-jaww qalab aasifa wal-riyah sarat qawiya wal-dabab ballash yantashir.

arabic: بس اللاعبين ضلوا مكملين والمباراة صارت أحلى بالحماس والتشجيع
english: But the players kept going and the match became more exciting with enthusiasm and cheering.
transliteration: Bas il-la'ibin dallu mkammilin wal-mubarat sarat ahla bil-hamas wal-tashji'.

arabic: اليوم رحنا على السوق انا و امي
english: Today, my mother and I went to the market.
transliteration: El-yōm ruḥna ʿala es-souq ana w immi.

arabic: كان في ناس كتير و بياعين بيبيعوا خضرة
english: There were many people and vendors selling vegetables.
transliteration: Kān fī nās ktīr w bayyaʿīn bibīʿu khoḍra.

arabic: امي اشترت تفاح احمر كبير
english: My mother bought big red apples.
transliteration: Immi ishtarāt tuffāḥ aḥmar kbīr.

arabic: شميت ريحة الخبز الطازة كتير طيبة
english: I smelled the fresh bread, it was very delicious.
transliteration: Shammēt rīḥit el-khubz eṭ-ṭāza ktīr ṭayybe.

arabic: كان يوم حلو كتير و رجعنا على البيت مبسوطين
english: It was a very nice day, and we returned home happy.
transliteration: Kān yōm ḥilw ktīr w rejiʿna ʿala el-bēt mabṣūṭīn.

arabic: ليلى مشيت بشارع الحمرا.
english: Layla walked on Hamra Street.
transliteration: Layla mashat bishari' el Hamra.

arabic: فجأة، شافت رامي.
english: Suddenly, she saw Rami.
transliteration: Faj'a, shafat Rami.

arabic: كان صديق قديم.
english: He was an old friend.
transliteration: Kan sadiq qadim.

arabic: رامي ابتسم، "مرحبا، كيفك ليلى؟"
english: Rami smiled, "Hello, how are you Layla?"
transliteration: Rami ibtasam, "Marhaba, kifik Layla?"

arabic: ليلى جاوبت، "أنا منيح، شكرا."
english: Layla answered, "I'm good, thank you."
transliteration: Layla jawabat, "Ana mneeh, shukran."

arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق فجأة سمعت صوت بقول السلام عليكم
english: I was walking in the market, suddenly I heard a voice saying "Peace be upon you".
transliteration: kunt mashi bil-souq faj'a semi't sowt biqul as-salāmu ʿalaykum

arabic: رديت وعليكم السلام ولما التفتت شفت رفيق قديم
english: I replied "And upon you be peace" and when I turned around, I saw an old friend.
transliteration: raddayt wa ʿalaykum as-salām w lamma ltafatt shoft rafiq qadim

arabic: قلتله مرحباً يا حسام أهلاً وسهلاً كيفك
english: I told him "Hello, Husam, welcome, how are you?"
transliteration: qult-ilo marḥaba ya Husam ahlan wa sahlan keefak

arabic: بلشنا نحكي عن ايام زمان وضحكنا كتير على الذكريات
english: We started talking about old times and laughed a lot at the memories.
transliteration: balashna nahki ʿan ayyam zaman w dehekna ktir ʿala az-zikrayat

arabic: بعدين قلي انا اسمي خالد مش حسام انت غلطان
english: Then he told me "My name is Khaled, not Husam, you are mistaken!"
transliteration: ba'dein qalli ana ismi Khaled mish Husam inta ghaltan

arabic: ماما قالتلي مساء الخير يا بنتي بدنا نرجع هاد الفستان للمحل
english: Mom told me, "Good evening, my daughter, we need to return this dress to the shop."
transliteration: Mama qālatli masāʾ al-khayr ya binti badna narjiʿ hād il-fustān lil-maḥall

arabic: رحنا انا وامي على المحل
english: My mom and I went to the shop.
transliteration: Ruḥna ana w-immi ʿala l-maḥall

arabic: البائع قال كيفِك
english: The salesman said, "How are you?"
transliteration: Il-bāʾiʿ qāl kayfik

arabic: امي قالت انا منيحة شكراً
english: My mom said, "I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: Immi qālat ana mnīḥa shukran

arabic: البائع قال اهلاً وسهلاً وساعدنا بسرعة
english: The salesman said, "Welcome!" and helped us quickly.
transliteration: Il-bāʾiʿ qāl ahlan wa sahlan w-sāʿadna bi-surʿa

arabic: عم نجهز لحفلة كبيرة
english: We are preparing for a big party.
transliteration: A'am njehhez la hafleh kbeereh

arabic: امي راحت عالسوق تشتري خضرة وتفاح من بياع شاطر
english: My mom went to the market to buy vegetables and apples from a clever vendor.
transliteration: Immi raḥat a'as-souq teshtri khoḍra w tuffaḥ min bayya' shaṭer

arabic: السقف بالمطبخ كان مكسور وبلشت تمطر
english: The ceiling in the kitchen was broken and it started to rain.
transliteration: Es-saqf bel-maṭbakh kan maksour w ballashet tomṭor

arabic: ابي صلح السقف بسرعة
english: My dad fixed the ceiling quickly.
transliteration: Abi ṣallaḥ es-saqf be sor'a

arabic: بس الحفلة كانت لقطتنا الصغيرة
english: But the party was for our little cat!
transliteration: Bas el-hafleh kanet le qittetna es-sagheera

arabic: صديقتي اتصلت فيني بالمساء
english: My friend called me in the evening
transliteration: Ṣadīqtī ittaṣalit fīni bil-masāʾ

arabic: انا قلت مساء الخير كيفك
english: I said 'Good evening, how are you?'
transliteration: Ana qult masāʾ al-khayr kayfik?

arabic: هي ردت مساء النور انا منيحة شكرا
english: She replied 'Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you!'
transliteration: Hiya raddat masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥa shukran

arabic: سالت عن اهلها كيف امك وابوك
english: I asked about her family, 'how are your mother and father?'
transliteration: Sa'alt 'an ahliha kayf ummik wa abuk?

arabic: هي قالت بخير وانا قلت شكرا
english: She said they are fine, and I said 'thank you'
transliteration: Hiya qālat bikhayr w ana qult shukran

arabic: اليوم قررت اطبخ اكلة جديدة بالبيت
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish at home.
transliteration: El-yōm qarrart aṭbukh akle jdīde bil-bēt.
storyTitle: A New Dish and Family Gathering

arabic: اجا اخي وعائلته على البيت وقال السلام عليكم
english: My brother and his family came home and said Peace be upon you.
transliteration: Aja akhi u ʿāʼilto ʿalā l-bēt w qāl as-salāmu ʿalaykum.
storyTitle: A New Dish and Family Gathering

arabic: ردينا وعليكم السلام وحكينا اهلا وسهلا تفضلوا
english: We replied And upon you be peace and said Welcome please come in.
transliteration: Raddīna wa ʿalaykum as-salām w ḥakayna ahlan wa sahlan tfaḍḍalu.
storyTitle: A New Dish and Family Gathering

arabic: بلشنا نجهز الاكل سوا وانا كنت كتير مبسوطة
english: We started preparing the food together and I was very happy.
transliteration: Ballashna njaḥḥiz il-akl sawa w ana kunt ktīr mabsuṭa.
storyTitle: A New Dish and Family Gathering

arabic: كانت سفرة لذيذة وجمعة عائلية حلوة كتير
english: It was a delicious meal and a very lovely family gathering.
transliteration: Kānit sufra ladhīdha w jamʿa ʿāʼiliyya ḥilwa ktīr.
storyTitle: A New Dish and Family Gathering

arabic: انا رحت على حارة جديدة امبارح
english: I went to a new neighborhood yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roḥt 3a ḥara jdīde embaréḥ.

arabic: بس ضعت وما عرفت وين بيت رفيقتي
english: But I got lost and didn't know where my friend's house was.
transliteration: Bas ḍi3t w ma 3areft wēn bēt rfīqti.

arabic: شفت شب صغير وسألته عن الطريق بس حكالي كلام ما فهمته
english: I saw a young guy and asked him for directions, but he spoke to me in words I didn't understand.
transliteration: Sheft shabb ṣghīr w sa'alto 3an aṭ-ṭarīq bas ḥakāli kalām ma fhemtu.

arabic: بعدين شفت ختيار وسألته ودلني على الطريق بوضوح
english: Then I saw an old man and asked him, and he showed me the way clearly.
transliteration: Ba3dēn sheft khtiyār w sa'alto w dallani 3aṭ-ṭarīq bwuḍūḥ.

arabic: وبالآخر وصلت على بيت رفيقتي مبسوطة
english: And in the end, I arrived at my friend's house happy.
transliteration: W bel-ākher waṣalt 3a bēt rfīqti mabṣūṭa.

arabic: مرحبا، كيفك؟ أنا بدي آخد طاولة لشخص واحد بس.
english: Hello, how are you? I want to take a table for one person only.
transliteration: Marhaba, keefak? Ana biddi aakhod tawle la shakhs waahed bas.

arabic: لينا، طالبة جامعية عمرها خمسة وعشرين سنة، كانت تعبانة كتير بعد ما اشتغلت كتير اليوم.
english: Lina, a twenty-five-year-old university student, was very tired after she worked a lot today.
transliteration: Lina, taalibe jaami'iyye 'omraha khamse w 'ishreen sane, kaanet ta'bane kteer ba'd ma ishtaghalet kteer il-yom.

arabic: فتحت قائمة الطعام بمقهى ساروجة بعبدون، وعقلها كان مشوش لأنه ما نمت منيح الليلة الماضية.
english: She opened the menu at Cafe Sarouja in Abdoun, and her mind was confused because she didn't sleep well last night.
transliteration: Fatahet qaayimet it-ta'am bi-maqha Sarouja bi-Abdoun, w 'aqla kaan mshawwash li'anna ma nemet mneeh il-leile il-maadiye.

arabic: النادلة، شابة مبتسمة، سألتها: "شو صار معك؟ حابة تطلبي شي؟"
english: The waitress, a smiling young woman, asked her: 'What happened to you? Do you want to order something?'
transliteration: In-naadile, shabbe mubtasime, sa'aletha: 'Shoo saar ma'ek? Haabbe totlobi shi?'

arabic: لينا تنهدت وقالت: "والله ما بعرف، كل شي هون بيشهّي، يمكن بدي مناقيش بس كمان الفلافل بتجنن."
english: Lina sighed and said: 'Honestly, I don't know, everything here looks delicious, maybe I want manakish but also the falafel is amazing.'
transliteration: Lina tnahhadet w 'aalet: 'Wallah ma ba'ref, kull shi hon byshahhi, yumkin biddi manaaqeesh bas kamaan il-falaafel btejannen.'

arabic: النادلة ابتسمت واقترحت: "ليه ما بتجربي صحن فلافل مع عصير برتقال فريش؟ هو كتير طيب اليوم."
english: The waitress smiled and suggested: 'Why don't you try a falafel plate with fresh orange juice? It's very good today.'
transliteration: In-naadile ibtasamet w iqtarahet: 'Leh ma btejarribi sahn falaafel ma' 'aseer burtu'aal fresh? Huwwe kteer tayyeb il-yom.'

arabic: لينا فكرت للحظة: "اه، فكرة حلوة! خلص، بدي صحن فلافل وعصير برتقال، يسلمو كتير."
english: Lina thought for a moment: 'Ah, good idea! Okay, I want a falafel plate and orange juice, thank you very much.'
transliteration: Lina fakkarat la-lahza: 'Ah, fikra helwe! Khalas, biddi sahn falaafel w 'aseer burtu'aal, yislamo kteer.'

arabic: وهي عم تستنى أكلها، تذكرت إنه أصدقائها ما عرفو يوصلو عالوقت بسبب زحمة السير ببيروت.
english: While she was waiting for her food, she remembered that her friends didn't know how to arrive on time due to the traffic in Beirut.
transliteration: W hiyye 'am testanna aklha, tzakkarat inno asdiqa'ha ma 'arafo yawsalo 'al-waqt bisebab zahmet is-seir bi-Beirut.

arabic: بعد شوي، النادلة جابتلها صحن الفلافل السخن والعصير المنعش، وكانت ريحته بتشهّي.
english: After a while, the waitress brought her the hot falafel plate and the refreshing juice, and its smell was delicious.
transliteration: Ba'ed shwayy, in-naadile jaabetlaha sahn il-falaafel is-sokhnon wal-'aseer il-mun'ish, w kaanet reehto bteshahhi.

arabic: لينا أكلت بسعادة، وشربت عصيرها كله، وحست إنه أخيراً رح تقدر تركز بدراستها بعد ما شبعت.
english: Lina ate happily, and drank all her juice, and felt that finally she would be able to focus on her studies after she was full.
transliteration: Lina akalet bi-sa'aade, w sherbet 'aseerha kullo, w hasset inno akheeran rah te'dar terakkez bi-diraasetha ba'd ma shabe'et.

arabic: كان صباح جميل مشيت بالشارع
english: It was a beautiful morning I walked in the street
transliteration: Kaan ṣabāḥ jamīl mashayt bi-sh-shaareʿ

arabic: فجأة شفت رفيقي القديم احمد
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed
transliteration: Faj'ah sheft rafeeqi l-qadeem Ahmed

arabic: قلتلو صباح الخير احمد مرحباً
english: I told him Good morning Ahmed hello
transliteration: Qult-ilo ṣabāḥ al-khayr Ahmed marḥaba

arabic: ابتسم احمد وقلي اهلاً وسهلاً
english: Ahmed smiled and told me welcome
transliteration: Ibtasam Ahmed w-qali ahlan wa sahlan

arabic: بس لما قربت طلع مو احمد هاد اخوه الصغير
english: But when I got closer it wasn't Ahmed it was his younger brother
transliteration: Bas lamma qarrabt talaʿ moo Ahmed had akhooh as-ṣaghir

arabic: نحنا رحنا على بيت جدي وجدتي مبارح كان في لمة عائلية كبيرة وسفرة مليانة اكل طيب
english: We went to my grandparents' house yesterday; there was a big family gathering and a table full of delicious food.
transliteration: Neḥna roḥna 3ala bayt jeddi w jeddti imbareḥ kaan fi lamma 3aa'iliyya kbeere w sufra malyaane akel ṭayyeb.

arabic: جدي الكبير دايماً بحب يحكي كيف هو اكل كل الاكل لما كان صغير وما كان في كتير
english: My grandfather always likes to tell how he ate all the food when he was young and there wasn't much.
transliteration: Jeddi l-kbeer dayman biḥebb yeḥki keef huwwe akal kell el akel lamma kaan zġeer w ma kaan fi kteer.

arabic: بنت عمتي الصغيرة ما بتحب القهوة هي شربت عصير برتقال وحكت عن فيديوهاتها الجديدة
english: My little cousin (daughter of my paternal aunt) doesn't like coffee; she drank orange juice and talked about her new videos.
transliteration: Bint 3ammti ṣ-ṣġeere ma btḥebb el qahwe hiyye sharbat 3aṣeer burtuqāl w ḥakat 3an videohat-ha l-jdeede.

arabic: امي حكت انها راحت على السوق مبارح لتشتري اغراض بينما اخوي حكى انه شاف فيلم حلو كتير
english: My mother said she went to the market yesterday to buy groceries while my brother said he saw a very nice movie.
transliteration: Immi ḥakat inna-ha raaḥat 3ala s-soo' imbareḥ la-tishtari aġraaḍ baynama akhūy ḥaka inno shāf film ḥelo kteer.

arabic: بالرغم من كل هاي الاختلافات الكل انبسط بالجمعة والاكل اللذيذ
english: Despite all these differences, everyone enjoyed the gathering and the delicious food.
transliteration: Bilraġm min kell haadi l-ikhtilaafat el kell inbasaṭ bil-jam3a wal-akel il-ladheedh.

arabic: انا قاعد بالمقهى ناطر رفيقي
english: I am sitting at the cafe, waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bel-maqha naater rafi'i.

arabic: شايف كتير ناس برا
english: I see many people outside.
transliteration: Shayef kteer nas barra.

arabic: في بياع عم يبيع تفاح وخضرة جنب المقهى
english: There is a vendor selling apples and vegetables next to the cafe.
transliteration: Fi bayya' 'am yibee' tuffaḥ w khoḍra janb el-maqha.

arabic: بلشت تمطر شوي فالناس اجت تحت السقف
english: It started to rain a little, so people came under the roof.
transliteration: Ballashat tomṭor shway fal-nas ijat taḥt es-saqf.

arabic: اجا النادل بسرعة وجاب قهوتي
english: The waiter came quickly and brought my coffee.
transliteration: Ija en-naadel be sor'a w jaab qahwati.

arabic: مساء الخير يا ابي كيفكَ؟
english: Good evening father, how are you?
transliteration: Masaa al-khayr ya abi kayfak?

arabic: انا منيحة شكراً بدنا نروح رحلة بالويك اند.
english: I'm fine thank you, we want to go on a trip this weekend.
transliteration: Ana mnīḥa shukran badna nrūḥ riḥla bil-weekend.

arabic: امي قالت فكرة كتير حلوة.
english: My mother said it's a very nice idea.
transliteration: Ommi qālat fikra ktīr ḥilwa.

arabic: رح نروح على الجبل ونشوف الطبيعة.
english: We will go to the mountain and see nature.
transliteration: Raḥ nrūḥ ʿala l-jabal w nshūf at-ṭabīʿa.

arabic: كل العيلة مبسوطة كتير على الرحلة شكراً.
english: All the family is very happy about the trip, thank you.
transliteration: Kull il-ʿēle mabsūṭa ktīr ʿala r-riḥla shukran.

arabic: اليوم رحت على السوق المحلي
english: Today I went to the local market.
transliteration: Elyoum roht ala es-souq el-mahali.

arabic: كانت ريحة الخضار والفواكه الطازجة كتير حلوة
english: The smell of the fresh vegetables and fruits was very nice.
transliteration: Kanat reehet el-khodar w el-fawakeh et-tazejeh kteer helwe.

arabic: شفت الوان كتير حلوة من التفاح الاحمر والبرتقال الاصفر
english: I saw many beautiful colors of red apples and yellow oranges.
transliteration: Shoft alwan kteer helwe min et-tuffah el-ahmar w el-bortoqal el-asfar.

arabic: اشتريت بندورة وخيار طازج عشان نعمل سلطة
english: I bought fresh tomatoes and cucumbers to make a salad.
transliteration: Ishtareet bandoura w khiyar tazej ashan ne'mel salata.

arabic: السوق كان مليان ناس والجو كان مفعم بالحياة
english: The market was full of people and the atmosphere was vibrant with life.
transliteration: Es-souq kan malyan nas w el-jaw kan muf'am bil-haya.

arabic: كنا كلنا متحمسين لمباراة كرة القدم الكبيرة بين فريقنا والفريق المنافس
english: We were all excited for the big football match between our team and the rival team
transliteration: kunna kullna mitaḥammisīn la-mubāraat kurat il-qadam il-kbīra bēn farīqna w-il-farīq il-munāfis

arabic: في البداية لعب فريقنا منيح وسجل هدف خلانا كتير مبسوطين
english: In the beginning, our team played well and scored a goal that made us very happy
transliteration: fil-bidāye li'ib farīqna mnīḥ w-sajjal hadaf khallāna ktīr mabsūṭīn

arabic: فجأة الفريق التاني سجل هدفين بسرعة وحسيت حالي قلقان كتير
english: Suddenly, the other team scored two quick goals and I felt very worried
transliteration: faj'atan il-farīq it-tāni sajjal hadafēn bi-sur'a w-ḥassēt ḥāli qal'ān ktīr

arabic: الجمهور صار يشجع بصوت عالي على أمل فريقنا يفوز
english: The crowd started cheering loudly hoping our team would win
transliteration: il-jumhūr ṣār yishajje' bi-ṣōt 'āli 'ala amal farīqna yifūz

arabic: بالنهاية فريقنا خسر بس الكل حس بفخر بجهدهم
english: In the end, our team lost but everyone felt proud of their effort
transliteration: bin-nihāye farīqna khisir bas il-kull ḥass bi-fakhr bi-juhdum

arabic: السلام عليكم يا شباب خلينا نشوف المباراة
english: Peace be upon you young men let's watch the match
transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ya shabāb khallīna nishūf al-mubārāh

arabic: وعليكم السلام يا جدي مرحباً انا عم تابعها على التلفون
english: And upon you be peace my grandfather hello I am following it on the phone
transliteration: Wa ʿalaykum as-salām ya jiddi marḥaba ana ʿam tābiʿha ʿala at-tilifōn

arabic: بس انا بحب اشوفها على التلفزيون الكبير هيك بتستمتع اكتر
english: But I like to watch it on the big television that way you enjoy more
transliteration: Bas ana baḥibb ashūfha ʿala at-tilifizyōn al-kabīr heyk bitistamtiʿ akthar

arabic: التلفون بيعطيني كل الاخبار فورا وبتشوف تعليقات الناس كمان
english: The phone gives me all the news immediately and you see people's comments too
transliteration: At-tilifōn biyaʿṭīni kull al-akhbār fawran wabitshūf taʿlīqāt an-nās kamān

arabic: يا بني زمان كنا نلعب بالطابة برا مو نتفرج على شاشة صغيرة
english: My son in the old days we used to play with the ball outside not watch on a small screen
transliteration: Ya buni zamān kunna nilʿab biṭ-ṭāba barra mū nitfarraj ʿala shāsha ṣaghīra

arabic: اليوم الدنيا عم تمطر
english: Today it's raining
transliteration: El yom ed-dunya am temtor

arabic: انا هلق بالبيت مع امي
english: I am now at home with my mother
transliteration: Ana halla bel beit ma'a ommi

arabic: امبارح ما مطرت بس اليوم مطرت
english: Yesterday it didn't rain but today it rained
transliteration: Embarah ma matarat bas el yom matarat

arabic: بنتي عم ترسم بالصالة
english: My daughter is drawing in the living room
transliteration: Binti am tersom bes sala

arabic: هاد الجو كتير مريح بالبيت
english: This weather is very relaxing at home
transliteration: Had el jaw ktiir mureeh bel beit

arabic: انا رحت على السوق امبارح واشتريت جزدان غريب كتير
english: I went to the market yesterday and bought a very strange wallet.
transliteration: Ana roḥt 3ala al-soo' embaréḥ wa-shtareet jizdān ghareeb kteer.

arabic: بالبيت اكتشفت انه الجزدان بيعمل صوت قطة كل ما افتحه
english: At home, I discovered that the wallet makes a cat sound every time I open it.
transliteration: Bil-bayt aktashaft inno el-jizdān bya3mal ṣowt qiṭṭa kill ma aftaḥo.

arabic: قلت لازم ارجعه لانه ما بدي كل العالم تفكر عندي قطة بمحفظتي
english: I said I must return it because I don't want everyone to think I have a cat in my wallet.
transliteration: Qult lāzem arja3o la'anno ma biddi kill el-3ālam tfakker 3andi qiṭṭa bi-maḥfaẓti.

arabic: فرجعت عالسوق بكير اليوم لحتى ابدله بشي عادي
english: So I went back to the market early today to exchange it for something normal.
transliteration: Fa-raja3t 3al-soo' bakkeer el-yōm la-ḥatta abaddelo bi-shee 3ādi.

arabic: صاحب المحل ضحك كتير وقلي هاد جزدان العاب للاطفال بالغلط
english: The shop owner laughed a lot and told me this was a toy wallet for children by mistake.
transliteration: Ṣāḥib el-maḥall ḍiḥik kteer w-qali hād jizdān al3āb lil-aṭfāl bil-ghalaṭ.

arabic: اليوم الصبح رحت عالسوق
english: This morning I went to the market.
transliteration: El-yom es-sobḥ roḥt ʿa es-souq.

arabic: اشتريت تفاح بس كان مو منيح
english: I bought apples, but they were not good.
transliteration: Eshtarayt tuffaḥ bas kan moo mniḥ.

arabic: رجعت عند البياع بسرعة
english: I went back to the vendor quickly.
transliteration: Rajaʿt ʿind el-bayyaʿ be sorʿa.

arabic: هو صلحلي المشكلة واعطاني غيرهم
english: He fixed the problem for me and gave me different ones.
transliteration: Huwa ṣallaḥli el-moshkila w aʿṭani ghayrhom.

arabic: هلا عندي تفاح منيح كتير للمطبخ
english: Now I have very good apples for the kitchen.
transliteration: Halah ʿindi tuffaḥ mniḥ ktir lel-maṭbakh.

arabic: مساء الخير يا سارة كيفك
english: Good evening, Sara, how are you?
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr ya Sara, kayfik?

arabic: انا منيحة شكرا عم فكر وين نروح عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: I'm fine, thank you, I'm thinking where we should go for the weekend.
transliteration: Ana mnīḥa, shukran, 'am fakker wein nrouḥ 'uṭlet nihāyet al-usbū'.

arabic: في مكان حلو بالجبل مع هوا نقي ومي باردة
english: There's a nice place in the mountains with fresh air and cold water.
transliteration: Fī makān ḥelū bil-jabal ma' hawā naqī w may bārde.

arabic: يا ريت نروح هناك الجو رح يكون رائع
english: I wish we could go there, the weather will be wonderful.
transliteration: Yā rēt nrouḥ honāk, al-jaww raḥ yekūn rā'e'.

arabic: تمام خلينا نخطط للعطلة رح تكون رحلة حلوة كتير شكرا
english: Okay, let's plan for the trip, it will be a very nice trip, thank you.
transliteration: Tamām, khallīnā nkhaṭṭeṭ lil-'uṭla, raḥ takūn riḥla ḥelwe ktīr, shukran.

arabic: اليوم قررت اطبخ اكلة جديدة بالمطبخ
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish in the kitchen.
transliteration: El yoom qarrart otbokh akleh jadeedeh bel matbakh.

arabic: مسكت السكينة وانا خايف ما اعرف اقطع الخضار صح
english: I held the knife, afraid I wouldn't know how to cut the vegetables correctly.
transliteration: Masakt es sikkeeneh w ana khaayef ma a'ref aqta' el khodaar sah.

arabic: حطيت كل شي بالطنجرة الكبيرة ونسيت شو لازم احط بالاول
english: I put everything in the big pot and forgot what I needed to put first.
transliteration: Hattayt kull shi bet tanjarah el kbeereh w neseet shoo laazem ahutt bel awwal.

arabic: بعد ساعة صار عندي اكل غريب ما بيشبه اي طبخة بعرفها
english: After an hour, I had strange food that didn't resemble any dish I knew.
transliteration: Ba'ed saa'ah saar 'andi akel ghareeb ma byeshbeh ay tabbakhah ba'refha.

arabic: لما حطيت الاكل بالصحن قررت احسن شي اطلب دليفري
english: When I put the food on the plate, I decided the best thing was to order delivery.
transliteration: Lamma hattayt el akel bes sahn qarrart ahsan shi otlob delivery.

arabic: اليوم كان اول يوم شغل لي بالمكتب الجديد
english: Today was my first day of work at the new office.
transliteration: El-yōm kān awwal yōm shughl lī bil-maktab el-jadīd

arabic: قابلت زميل جديد وسالني مساء الخير كيفك
english: I met a new colleague and he asked me, "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: Qābalt zamīl jadīd w sa'alnī masā' al-khayr, kayfak

arabic: انا شب فقلت له انا منيح شكرا
english: I'm a guy, so I told him, "I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: Ana shab fa-qultu lahu ana mnīḥ, shukran

arabic: هو ضحك وقال اوه سوري انا كمان منيح
english: He laughed and said, "Oh, sorry, I'm fine too."
transliteration: Huwa ḍaḥik w qāl "ōh sōrī ana kamān mnīḥ"

arabic: بالليل لما رجعت عالبيت قلت باي للشغل ومع السلامة للمشاكل
english: At night, when I returned home, I said "bye" to work and "goodbye" to problems.
transliteration: Bil-lēl lammā raja't 'al-bēt, qult bāy lil-shughl w ma' as-salāma lil-mashākil

arabic: فقت بسرعة الصبح
english: I woke up quickly in the morning
transliteration: Fi't be sor'a es-ṣubḥ

arabic: رحت على المطبخ وعملت قهوة
english: I went to the kitchen and made coffee
transliteration: Ruḥt 'ala el-maṭbakh w 'amalt 'ahwe

arabic: كان في ناس كتير بالشارع
english: There were many people in the street
transliteration: Kan fi nas ktir bish-shari'

arabic: شفت بياع عم يبيع خضرة
english: I saw a vendor selling vegetables
transliteration: Shuft bayya' 'am yabi' khoḍra

arabic: لازم اروح على الشغل هلا
english: I need to go to work now
transliteration: Lazem aruḥ 'ala esh-shughul halla'

arabic: كان بعد الظهر شتي والسما كانت رمادية كتير
english: It was a rainy afternoon and the sky was very grey.
transliteration: Kaan ba'd ed-dhohr sheti w es-sama kaanet ramadiyyeh kteer.

arabic: حسيت شوي زعلانة بالاول بس بعدين قررت اطبخ شي دافي بالمطبخ
english: I felt a bit sad at first, but then I decided to cook something warm in the kitchen.
transliteration: Hassait shway za'laaneh bel awwal bas ba'dain qarrart otbokh shi daafi bel matbakh.

arabic: اخذت سكينه وبلشت حضّر خضرا للاكل بطنجره كبيره
english: I took a knife and started preparing vegetables for the food in a large pot.
transliteration: Akhazt sikkeeneh w ballasht hadder khodra lel akel bi tanjarah kbeereh.

arabic: ريحة الاكل الطيبه عبّت البيت وخلتني حس حالي مبسوطة كتير
english: The delicious smell of the food filled the house and made me feel very happy.
transliteration: Reehet el akel et-tayybeh 'abbat el beit w khallatni hess haali mabsootah kteer.

arabic: بعد شوي رح اكل من صحني واشرب شاي بكاسه وانا مرتاحة جوا
english: Soon I will eat from my plate and drink tea from a glass, feeling relaxed inside.
transliteration: Ba'd shway raḥ aakol min sahni w ashrab shay bi kaaseh w ana mertaahah juwwa.

arabic: رحت على السوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today
transliteration: Ruḥet ʿala es-souq el-yom

arabic: كان في ناس كتير وبياعين عم يبيعوا خضرة وتفاح
english: There were many people and vendors selling vegetables and apples
transliteration: Kan fi nas kteer o bayyaʿeen ʿam ybeeʿu khoḍra w tuffaḥ

arabic: فجأة شفت رفيقي القديم جنب بياع التفاح
english: Suddenly, I saw my old friend next to the apple vendor
transliteration: Faj'a sheft rafee'i el-adeem jannb bayyaʿ et-tuffaḥ

arabic: مشيت بسرعة لعنده وناديت اسمه
english: I walked quickly towards him and called his name
transliteration: Mesheet be sor'a la ʿando w nadeet esmo

arabic: كنا مبسوطين كتير انه شفنا بعض
english: We were very happy to see each other
transliteration: Kenna mabsooṭeen kteer enno shefna baʿḍ

arabic: مساء الخير كيفك
english: Good evening, how are you?
transliteration: Masaa al-khayr, kayfik?

arabic: أنا ضايعة في المدينة
english: I am lost in the city.
transliteration: Ana ḍāyi'a fil madīna.

arabic: وين السوق من فضلك
english: Where is the market, please?
transliteration: Wayn as-sūq min faḍlak?

arabic: شكرا جزيلا لمساعدتك
english: Thank you very much for your help.
transliteration: Shukran jazīlan li-musā'adatuk.

arabic: انا منيحة هلا
english: I'm fine now.
transliteration: Ana mnīḥa halla.

arabic: انا طالبة في المدرسة
english: I am a student at school.
transliteration: Ana talibe fi el madrasa.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: جدي كان مدرس قديم
english: My grandfather was an old teacher.
transliteration: Jaddi kan mudarris qadim.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: هو يحب الكتب كثيرا
english: He loves books very much.
transliteration: Huwwe yuhebb el kutub ktheeran.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: اختي الان مهندسة وتعمل على الحاسوب
english: My sister is now an engineer and works on the computer.
transliteration: Ukhti el aan muhandisa wa ta'mal 'ala el hasoub.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: هي تحب التكنولوجيا الجديدة
english: She loves new technology.
transliteration: Hiyye tuhebb el tiknolojya el jadide.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: انا كنت عم امشي وضعت بالمدينة
english: I was walking and got lost in the city.
transliteration: Ana kunt ʿam amshi wdiʿt bil-madīna.

arabic: مساء الخير كيفك انا ضعت
english: Good evening, how are you? I am lost.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr, kayfak? Ana diʿt.

arabic: هو ابتسم وقلي انا منيح البيت هون
english: He smiled and told me, "I'm fine, the house is here."
transliteration: Huwwe ibtasam w qalli: "Ana mnīḥ, el-bayt hōn."

arabic: انا قلت شكرا كتير
