english: I said, "Thank you very much."
transliteration: Ana qult: "Shukran ktīr."

arabic: بعدين عرفت انه ابي وانا قدام بيتي
english: Then I realized it was my father, and I was in front of my own house!
transliteration: Baʿdēn ʿaraft inno abī w ana quddām baytī!

arabic: وصلت عالبيت وشفت رفيقتي سارة فقلتلا مساء الخير كيفك
english: I arrived at the house and saw my friend Sara, so I said to her, "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: Waṣalt ʿal-bēt w shuft rafīʾitī Sāra fa-ʾultilla masāʾ al-khayr kayfik?

arabic: الحفلة كانت كتير حلوة وفي كتير ناس وعيد ميلاد سعيد
english: The party was very nice, and there were many people, and a happy birthday!
transliteration: Al-ḥafla kānat ktīr ḥilwe w fī ktīr nās w ʿīd mīlād saʿīd!

arabic: سارة قالتلي انا منيحة شكرا انك اجيتي
english: Sara told me, "I'm fine, thank you for coming."
transliteration: Sāra ʾālatlī ana mnīḥa shukran ʾinnik ʾajayti.

arabic: اكلنا كاتو طيب وشربنا عصير كتير
english: We ate delicious cake and drank a lot of juice.
transliteration: ʾAkalna kāto ṭayyib w sharibna ʿaṣīr ktīr.

arabic: بس صار الوقت متاخر قلت للكل مع السلامة وباي
english: When it got late, I told everyone "Goodbye" and "Bye".
transliteration: Bas ṣār al-waʾt mitʾakhkhir ʾult lil-kull maʿ as-salāma w bāy.

arabic: انا كل يوم بجي ع القهوة
english: I come to the cafe every day
transliteration: Ana kull yōm bajī ʿa al-qahwe

arabic: اليوم مساء الخير شفت رفيقي احمد
english: Today, good evening, I saw my friend Ahmad
transliteration: Al-yōm masāʾ al-khayr sheft rafīʾī Aḥmad

arabic: قلتلو مساء الخير كيفك
english: I said to him 'Good evening, how are you?'
transliteration: Qultillo masāʾ al-khayr kayfak

arabic: رد عليي مساء النور انا منيح شكرا
english: He replied 'Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you'
transliteration: Radd ʿalayyī masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ shukran

arabic: بعد القهوة قلنا مع السلامة
english: After the coffee, we said 'Goodbye'
transliteration: Baʿd al-qahwe qulna maʿ as-salāma

arabic: رحنا نزور خالتي
english: We went to visit my aunt.
transliteration: ruḥna nzour khalti

arabic: بالطريق مرينا بالسوق و شفنا ناس كتير
english: On the way, we passed by the market and saw many people.
transliteration: beṭ-ṭariq marrina bes-souq w shefna nas kteer

arabic: اشترينا تفاح طازة من بياع
english: We bought fresh apples from a vendor.
transliteration: ishtarayna tuffaḥ ṭaze men bayya'

arabic: لما وصلنا خالتي كانت بالمطبخ عم تعمل قهوة
english: When we arrived, my aunt was in the kitchen making coffee.
transliteration: lamma weṣelna khalti kanet bel-maṭbakh ʿam teʿmal qahwe

arabic: ريحة القهوة كانت قوية كتير و طيبة
english: The smell of coffee was very strong and good.
transliteration: riḥet el-qahwe kanet qawiyye kteer w ṭayybe

arabic: اليوم الجو ممطر كثير
english: Today the weather is very rainy.
transliteration: El yōm el jaw mumṭir kithīr.

arabic: انا قاعد بالبيت و مبسوط
english: I am sitting at home and happy.
transliteration: Ana qāʿid bil-bayt w mabṣūṭ.

arabic: عم اشرب شاي و اقرا كتاب
english: I am drinking tea and reading a book.
transliteration: ʿAm ashrab shāy w aqra kitāb.

arabic: بشوف المطر من الشباك
english: I see the rain from the window.
transliteration: Bashūf el maṭar min esh-shubbāk.

arabic: هاد وقت حلو كتير
english: This is a very nice time.
transliteration: Hād waqt ḥilw kithīr.

arabic: صباح الخير انا رحت على الشغل
english: Good morning I went to work
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ana ruḥt ʿala esh-shoghl

arabic: الجو كان بارد شوي فانا لبست كنزة قطن
english: The weather was a bit cold so I wore a cotton sweater
transliteration: El-jaww kaan baared shwayy fa-ana labast kanze qoṭon

arabic: وصلت على مكتبي الساعة تسعة
english: I arrived at my office at nine o'clock
transliteration: Waṣalt ʿala maktabi es-saaʿa tesʿa

arabic: بعدين شفت مديري عم يلبس تي شيرت جديد
english: Then I saw my boss wearing a new t-shirt
transliteration: Baʿdeen sheft mideeri ʿam yilbas ti-sheert jadeed

arabic: بس المدير كان لابس تي شيرت فيه صور قطط صغيرة
english: But the boss was wearing a t-shirt with pictures of small cats
transliteration: Bass el-mideer kaan laabes ti-sheert feeh ṣuwar qiṭaṭ ṣagheera

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد سارة لازم نصحى بكير
english: Today is Sarah's birthday. We need to wake up early.
transliteration: El-yom 'eid milad Sara lazem neṣḥa bakkiir

arabic: رحت على السوق بسرعة لاشتري اغراض
english: I went to the market quickly to buy things.
transliteration: Ruḥt 'ala es-souq be sor'a la-ashtari aghrad

arabic: شفت بياع التفاح والخضرة هناك
english: I saw the apple and vegetable vendor there.
transliteration: Shuft bayya' et-tuffaḥ wal-khoḍra hunaak

arabic: بعدين رجعت على البيت وجهزنا الكيك بالمطبخ
english: Then I returned home and we prepared the cake in the kitchen.
transliteration: Ba'dein reji't 'ala el-beit w jahhazna el-keek bel-maṭbakh

arabic: اجوا ناس كتير لعيد الميلاد وكان يوم حلو
english: Many people came for the birthday and it was a nice day.
transliteration: Ajaw nas ktiir la-'eid el-milad w kan yom helw

arabic: اليوم الجو بارد وبرا عم تمطر
english: Today the weather is cold and it's raining outside.
transliteration: El-yom el-jaw bareḍ w barra 'am tomṭor
storyTitle: A Warm Day at the Cafe

arabic: نحن قاعدين بكافيه صغير مع اهلي
english: We are sitting in a small cafe with my family.
transliteration: Neḥna qa'idīn b-kafeh ṣghīr ma' aḥli
storyTitle: A Warm Day at the Cafe

arabic: في ناس كتير بالمقهى وهنن مبسوطين
english: There are many people in the cafe and they are happy.
transliteration: Fī nas ktīr bel-maqha w hennin mabsoṭīn
storyTitle: A Warm Day at the Cafe

arabic: ابي طلب قهوة وامي طلبت شاي بسرعة
english: My father ordered coffee and my mother ordered tea quickly.
transliteration: Abi ṭalab qahwe w emmi ṭalabet shay be sor'a
storyTitle: A Warm Day at the Cafe

arabic: الجو دافي وحلو هون
english: The atmosphere is warm and nice here.
transliteration: El-jaw dafi w ḥilu hon
storyTitle: A Warm Day at the Cafe

arabic: امي اشترت لعبة سيارة صغيرة من السوق
english: My mom bought a small toy car from the market.
transliteration: Ommi ishtarat lu'bet sayyara saghira min es-souq.

arabic: بس السيارة كانت مكسورة شوي
english: But the car was a little broken.
transliteration: Bas es-sayyara kanat maksoora shway.

arabic: رحت انا وماما بسرعة عند البياع نرجعها
english: I went with Mom quickly to the vendor to return it.
transliteration: Roḥt ana w Mama be sor'a ʿand el-bayyaʿ nrajjeʿha.

arabic: البياع كان لطيف كتير وصلحها النا
english: The vendor was very kind and fixed it for us.
transliteration: El-bayyaʿ kan latif kteer w ṣallaḥha lna.

arabic: رجعنا على البيت مبسوطين كتير
english: We returned home very happy.
transliteration: Rajaʿna ʿala el-bet mabsooṭeen kteer.

arabic: اليوم عيلتي بدها تشتري تياب جديدة
english: Today my family wants to buy new clothes.
transliteration: El-yōm ʿēltī biddha tashtarī tiyāb jdīdē.

arabic: رحنا على السوق الكبير
english: We went to the big market.
transliteration: Ruḥnā ʿala es-sūq el-kbīr.

arabic: شفنا بياع عنده تياب حلوة كتير
english: We saw a vendor who had very nice clothes.
transliteration: Shufnā bayyāʿ ʿindoh tiyāb ḥilwa ktīr.

arabic: ماما اختارت جاكيت دافي الي
english: Mom chose a warm jacket for me.
transliteration: Māmā ikhtārat jākīt dāfī ilī.

arabic: كلنا كنا مبسوطين بالتياب الجديدة
english: We were all happy with the new clothes.
transliteration: Kullnā kunnā mabsūṭīn bil-tiyāb el-jdīdē.

arabic: لينا كانت قاعدة في البيت لما رن تلفونها فجأة
english: Lina was sitting at home when her phone suddenly rang.
transliteration: Lina kānat qāʻida fī l-bēt lammā rann tilifōnhā faj'a.

arabic: رفعت السماعة وكانت متفاجئة لما سمعت صوت رفيقتها سارة اللي ما حكت معها من زمان
english: She picked up and was surprised when she heard the voice of her friend Sara, whom she hadn't spoken to in a long time.
transliteration: Rafaʻat is-sammāʻa w-kānat mutafājiʼa lammā samiʻat ṣōt rfīʼthā Sāra illī mā ḥakat maʻhā min zamān.

arabic: سالتها لينا وين بتشتغلي هلا او لسا طالبة بالجامعة
english: Lina asked her, "Where do you work now, or are you still a university student?"
transliteration: Sa'alatha Lina wēn btishraghli halla' aw lissā ṭāliba bil-jāmiʻa?

arabic: سارة جاوبتها بصوت سعيد انها لقت شغل جديد في مكتب كبير بوسط البلد
english: Sara answered with a happy voice that she found a new job in a big office downtown.
transliteration: Sāra jāwabathā bi-ṣōt saʻīd innahā laqat shughl jdīd fī maktab kabīr bi-wasaṭ il-balad.

arabic: لينا فرحت كتير لسارة وتمنتلها كل التوفيق بشغلها الجديد قبل ما يسكروا الخط
english: Lina was very happy for Sara and wished her all the best with her new job before they hung up.
transliteration: Lina fariḥat ktīr li-Sāra w-tamannatlahā kull it-tawfīq bi-shughlahā l-jdīd qabl mā yisakkrū l-khaṭṭ.

arabic: مساء الخير تيتة كيفك ليلى عم تخطط لعرسها
english: Good evening Teta, how are you? Layla is planning her wedding.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr Tēta, kayfik? Layla ʿam tkhaṭṭiṭ li-ʿirshā.

arabic: ليلى بدها عرس صغير وبسيط بالبيت مع الاصحاب بس
english: Layla wants a small and simple wedding at home with just friends.
transliteration: Layla bidhā ʿurs ṣaghīr w basīṭ bil-bēt maʿ al-aṣḥāb bas.

arabic: بس تيتها بدها عرس كبير كتير وفيه كل العيلة والجيران
english: But her grandmother wants a very big wedding with all the family and neighbors.
transliteration: Bas Tētihā bidhā ʿurs kabīr ktīr w fīh kull al-ʿīle wal-jīrān.

arabic: تيتها قالت لازم يكون فيه دبكة ومغني مشهور
english: Her grandmother said there must be dabke and a famous singer.
transliteration: Tētihā qālat lāzim yakūn fīh dabke w mughannī mashhūr.

arabic: ليلى قالتلها شكرا تيتة رح فكر بالموضوع ومع السلامة
english: Layla told her, 'Thank you Teta, I will think about the matter, and goodbye.'
transliteration: Layla qālat lahā shukran Tēta, raḥ fakker bil-mawḍūʿ, w maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: كنت كتير مبسوطة لما رحت زور خالتي
english: I was very happy when I went to visit my aunt
transliteration: Kunt ktīr mabṣūṭa lamma ruḥt azūr khāltī

arabic: استقبلتني بحفاوة و قعدنا نشرب قهوة في الصالون
english: She welcomed me warmly, and we sat drinking coffee in the living room
transliteration: Istaqbalatnī biḥafāwa w qaʻadnā nishrab qahwa fī aṣ-ṣālōn

arabic: سألتها وين بتشتغل هلأ بعد ما غيرت مكتبها القديم
english: I asked her where she works now after she changed her old office
transliteration: Sa'altaha wēn btishraghel hallā' baʻd mā ghayyarat maktabha l-qadīm

arabic: جاوبتني بابتسامة انها هلا بتشتغل طباخ في مطعم جديد
english: She answered me with a smile that she now works as a chef in a new restaurant
transliteration: Jāwabatnī b-ibtisāma innaha hallā' btishraghel ṭabbākh fī maṭʻam jadīd

arabic: انبسطت كتير من زيارتي الها و بتمنى ازورها مرة تانية قريب
english: I really enjoyed my visit to her and hope to visit her again soon
transliteration: Inbaṣaṭt ktīr min ziyārtī ilha w batmanna azūrha marra tānye qarīb

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد رفيقتي انا رحت ع السوق
english: Today is my friend's birthday, I went to the market.
transliteration: El-yom 'eed meelad rafee'ti ana roḥt 'a es-souq.

arabic: شفت ناس كتير واشتريت تفاح
english: I saw many people and bought apples.
transliteration: Sheft nas kteer w eshtareet tuffaḥ.

arabic: واشتريت كمان خضرة للمطبخ
english: And I also bought vegetables for the kitchen.
transliteration: W eshtareet kaman khoḍra lel-maṭbakh.

arabic: رفيقتي كانت مبسوطة كتير لما شافتني
english: My friend was very happy when she saw me.
transliteration: Rafee'ti kanat mabsooṭa kteer lamma shafetni.

arabic: احتفلنا بسرعة وكانت حفلة حلوة
english: We celebrated quickly and it was a nice party.
transliteration: Eḥtafalna be sor'a w kanat ḥafla ḥelwa.

arabic: وصلت عند خالي المساء وكان الجو لطيف
english: I arrived at my uncle's in the evening and the weather was pleasant.
transliteration: Waṣalt ʿind khālī al-masāʾ wa kān al-jaww laṭīf

arabic: اول ما فتح الباب قلتله مساء الخير كيفكَ
english: As soon as he opened the door, I said to him 'Good evening, how are you?'
transliteration: Awwal ma fataḥ al-bāb qultillo masāʾ al-khayr kayfak

arabic: رد خالي بمساء النور انا منيح انتي كيفك انا منيحة شكرا
english: My uncle replied 'Evening of light, I'm fine, how are you? I'm fine, thank you.'
transliteration: Radd khālī bi-masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ inti kayfik ana mnīḥa shukran

arabic: قضينا وقت حلو وحكينا كتير بس اضطريت امشي بدري لاني عندي شغل بكرة
english: We had a nice time and talked a lot, but I had to leave early because I have work tomorrow.
transliteration: Qaḍḍaynā waqt ḥilu w ḥakaynā ktīr bas iḍṭarayt amshī badrī la-ʾannī ʿindī shughl bukra

arabic: سلمت عليه وقلتله مع السلامة وهو قلي باي
english: I greeted him goodbye and said to him 'Goodbye', and he said 'Bye' to me.
transliteration: Sallamt ʿalayh w qultillo maʿ as-salāma w huw qāl li bāy

arabic: بفيق بكير وبروح على شغلي
english: I wake up early and go to my work.
transliteration: bafee' bakeer w baroo7 'ala shoghli

arabic: بالشغل بشوف رفيقي وبقول له مساء الخير كيفك
english: At work, I see my friend and tell him, "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: bish-shoghl bashoof rafee'i w ba'ool lo masāʾ al-khayr kayfak?

arabic: هو بجاوب انا منيح شكرا
english: He answers, "I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: huwwe bejāweb ana mnīḥ shukran

arabic: الصوت عالي وريحة القهوة طيبة كتير
english: The sound is loud and the coffee smell is very good.
transliteration: as-sawt 'aali w reeḥet il-ʾahwe taybe kteer

arabic: بعد الشغل بقول مع السلامة وبروح على البيت
english: After work, I say "Goodbye" and go home.
transliteration: ba'd ish-shoghl ba'ool ma' as-salāma w baroo7 'ala al-bayt

arabic: مرحبا دكتور، كيفك؟
english: Hello doctor, how are you?
transliteration: Marhaba doctor, keefak?

arabic: أهلا يا ليلى، منيح، وأنتِ كيفك؟
english: Welcome Layla, fine, and how are you?
transliteration: Ahlan ya Layla, mneeh, w enti keefik?

arabic: الحمد لله، بس تأخرت شوي، معلش؟
english: Praise be to God, but I'm a bit late, is it okay?
transliteration: Alhamdulillah, bas ta'akhkhart shway, ma'alesh?

arabic: لا أبداً، تفضلي اقعدي، إنشالله خير.
english: No, not at all, please sit (fem), God willing, it's good.
transliteration: La abadan, tfaddali 'o'odi, inshallah kheir.

arabic: يسلمو دكتور، بشوفك بكرا إنشالله.
english: Thank you doctor, I'll see you tomorrow God willing.
transliteration: Yislamo doctor, bashoufak bokra inshallah.

arabic: صحيت الصبح وسمعت صوت غريب بالمطبخ
english: I woke up this morning and heard a strange sound in the kitchen.
transliteration: Sahhet es-sobeh w sema't sowt ghareeb bel-matbakh.

arabic: كانت الحنفية عم تنقط مي شوي شوي
english: It was the faucet dripping water slowly.
transliteration: Kanet el-hanafiyye 'am tenqot may shway shway.

arabic: هاي مشكلة لانه لازم نوفر مي
english: This is a problem because we need to save water.
transliteration: Hay mushkileh la'annu lazem nwaffer may.

arabic: بظن بدي احكي مع حدا يصلحها
english: I think I need to call someone to fix it.
transliteration: Bazonn beddi ehki ma' hada ysalehha.

arabic: مهم انه بيتنا يكون دايما منيح
english: It's important that our house is always in good condition.
transliteration: Mohem enno baytna yekun dayman mneeh.

arabic: صحيت بكير اليوم
english: I woke up early today.
transliteration: ṣaḥeet bakkeer el-yōm

arabic: رحت عالمطبخ بسرعة لاعمل قهوة
english: I went to the kitchen quickly to make coffee.
transliteration: roḥt 'al-maṭbakh be sor'a la-a'mel qahwe

arabic: بعدين مشيت عالسوق
english: Then I walked to the market.
transliteration: ba'dīn masheet 'as-souq

arabic: كان في ناس كتير وبياعين عم يبيعوا تفاح وخضرة
english: There were many people and vendors selling apples and vegetables.
transliteration: kān fī nas kteer w bayya'een 'am yibī'u tuffaḥ w khoḍra

arabic: اشتريت شوية اغراض ورحت عشغلي
english: I bought some things and went to my work.
transliteration: ishtarayt shwayyet aghrāḍ w roḥt 'a-shughli

arabic: عم نجهز لحفلة كبيرة
english: We are preparing for a big party.
transliteration: 'am njahez lahafle kbire

arabic: بدنا نروح على السوق نشتري اغراض
english: We need to go to the market to buy things.
transliteration: bedna nrouh 'ala es-souq neshtri 'agraad

arabic: بدنا نشتري تفاح و خضرة من بياع شاطر
english: We want to buy apples and vegetables from a good vendor.
transliteration: bedna neshtri tuffaḥ w khoḍra men bayya' shaṭer

arabic: كتير ناس رح يجوا على الحفلة
english: Many people will come to the party.
transliteration: kteer nas raḥ yeju 'ala el-hafle

arabic: المطبخ جاهز للاكل بسرعة
english: The kitchen is ready for food quickly.
transliteration: el-maṭbakh jahez lel-'akl be sor'a

arabic: عم نجهز للعرس وفي كتير شغل لازم نعمله
english: We are preparing for the wedding and there is a lot of work we need to do.
transliteration: a'm njehhez lel-o'rs w fi kteer shoghl lazim na'malo

arabic: بدنا نلاقي قاعة حلوة وممكن تكون هون قريب
english: We want to find a beautiful hall and it's possible it could be here nearby.
transliteration: bedna nla'i qa'a helwe w mumkin tkoun hawn qareeb

arabic: صحيح التجهيزات صعبة بس رح تطلع الحفلة بتجنن
english: It's correct that the preparations are difficult, but the party will turn out amazing.
transliteration: saheeh at-tajheezaat sa'be bas rah tetla' al-hafle bitjannen

arabic: يلا خلينا نبلش مكالمات ونشوف الموردين اليوم
english: Let's go, let's start making calls and checking with suppliers today.
transliteration: yalla khallina nballish mukalamat w nshoof al-mowarradeen al-yom

arabic: عرفت انه كل هالتعب رح يستاهل لما نشوف الفرحة بوجوه الكل
english: I knew all this effort would be worth it when we see the joy on everyone's faces.
transliteration: arafet inno kull hat-ta'ab rah yestahel lamma nshoof al-farha b-wujooh al-kull

arabic: اليوم رحت على السوق مع امي
english: Today I went to the market with my mother.
transliteration: El yom roht a'al es-souq ma' emmi

arabic: السوق كان مليان ناس وريحة الخضرة حلوة كتير
english: The market was full of people and the smell of vegetables was very nice.
transliteration: Es-souq kan malyan nas w rihet el khoḍra helwe kteer

arabic: شفت بياع عم يبيع تفاح احمر كبير
english: I saw a vendor selling big red apples.
transliteration: Shoft bayya' a'am ybee' tuffaḥ aḥmar kbeer

arabic: كان التفاح طازج ولونه احمر كتير حلو
english: The apples were fresh and their color was a very beautiful red.
transliteration: Kan et-tuffaḥ ṭazaj w lono aḥmar kteer ḥelw

arabic: اشترينا تفاح وشوي خضرة ورجعنا عالبيت مبسوطين
english: We bought apples and some vegetables and returned home happy.
transliteration: Eshtarayna tuffaḥ w shway khoḍra w reja'na a'al bayt mabsooṭeen

arabic: بدنا نجهز للحفلة الكبيرة
english: We need to prepare for the big party.
transliteration: Bedna njehhez lal-ḥafle el-kbire

arabic: امي راحت ع السوق تشتري خضرة
english: My mom went to the market to buy vegetables.
transliteration: Ommi raḥat a es-souq teshtari khoḍra

arabic: واشترت كمان فواكه من بياع
english: And she also bought fruits from a vendor.
transliteration: W eshtarat kaman fawakeh min bayya'

arabic: كتير ناس رح يجوا ع بيتنا
english: Many people will come to our house.
transliteration: Kteer nas raḥ yeeju a beitna

arabic: لازم ننظف المطبخ بسرعة
english: We must clean the kitchen quickly.
transliteration: Lazem nnazef el-maṭbakh be sor'a

arabic: اليوم كنت بالسوق
english: Today I was in the market
transliteration: El yoom kunt bis-soo

arabic: شفت رجل عم يبيع الخضره الطازجه
english: I saw a man selling fresh produce
transliteration: Sheft rajul aam ybee el khora et-taazaja

arabic: هو طويل وشعره اسود مثل اخي
english: He is tall and his hair is black like my brother
transliteration: Huwwe taweel w sha'ro aswad mitl akhi

arabic: تطلعت عليه وقلت مرحبا يا رامي
english: I looked at him and said hello, Rami
transliteration: Tala'at alayh w qult marhaba ya Rami

arabic: هو صديقي القديم وصرنا نحكي كتير
english: He is my old friend and we started talking a lot
transliteration: Huwwe sadeeqi el qadeem w serna nehki kteer

arabic: مساء الخير يا امي كيفك
english: Good evening, mom, how are you?
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr ya ummi kayfik?

arabic: مساء النور انا منيحة شكرا يا بنتي
english: Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you, my daughter.
transliteration: Masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥa shukran ya binti

arabic: لازم نختار قاعة العرس الكبيرة للعائلة كلها
english: We must choose the big wedding hall for the whole family.
transliteration: Lāzim nakhtār qāʿat al-ʿurs al-kabīra lil-ʿāʾila kullaha

arabic: كتير متحمسة للعرس والكل رح يكون مبسوط
english: I'm very excited for the wedding and everyone will be happy.
transliteration: Ktīr mutaḥammisa lil-ʿurs w-il-kull raḥ yakūn mabsoot

arabic: تمام امي بشوفك بكرا باي
english: Okay mom, I'll see you tomorrow, bye.
transliteration: Tamām ummi bashūfik bukra bāy

arabic: مساء الخير كان في مباراة كرة قدم كبيرة بالحارة
english: Good evening, there was a big football match in the neighborhood.
transliteration: Masāʾ al-khayr kān fī mubārāt kurat qadam kbīra bil-ḥāra.
storyTitle: The Football Match in the Neighborhood

arabic: اجا رفيقي علي وقال لي مساء الخير كيفكَ
english: My friend Ali came and said to me, "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: Ija rafīqī ʿAlī w qāl lī masāʾ al-khayr kayfak?
storyTitle: The Football Match in the Neighborhood

arabic: رديت عليه مساء النور انا منيح شكرا الك
english: I replied to him, "Evening of light, I'm fine, thank you."
transliteration: Raddayt ʿalayh masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ shukran ilak.
storyTitle: The Football Match in the Neighborhood

arabic: كانت المباراة حماسية كتير والكل عم يشجع بصوت عالي
english: The match was very exciting, and everyone was cheering loudly.
transliteration: Kānat al-mubārāt ḥamāsiyye ktīr w il-kull ʿam yshajjiʿ bi-ṣōt ʿālī.
storyTitle: The Football Match in the Neighborhood

arabic: بعد ما خلصت المباراة سلمت عليه وقلت له باي مع السلامة
english: After the match finished, I greeted him and said, "Bye, goodbye."
transliteration: Baʿd mā khalaṣat al-mubārāt sallamt ʿalayh w qult lo bāy maʿ as-salāma.
storyTitle: The Football Match in the Neighborhood

arabic: قام احمد بكير اليوم مشان الشغل
english: Ahmed got up early today for work.
transliteration: qaam Ahmad bakkeer el yom meshan esh-shoghl.

arabic: بعدين عمل قهوة وشربها بسرعة
english: Then he made coffee and drank it quickly.
transliteration: ba'deen amal ahwa w sharibha bi sur'a.

arabic: فتح الشباك وسمع صوت العصافير
english: He opened the window and heard the sound of birds.
transliteration: fataḥ esh-shubbak w sima' sowt el 'asaafeer.

arabic: جهّز حالو وسكر الباب وراح
english: He got himself ready and closed the door and left.
transliteration: jahhaz haalo w sakkar el baab w raah.

arabic: بالطريق شاف رفيقو وسلم عليه بسرعة
english: On the way, he saw his friend and greeted him quickly.
transliteration: bit-tareeq shaaf rafeeqo w sallam 'alayh bi sur'a.

arabic: جدي كان بياع بالسوق طول حياته
english: My grandfather was a vendor in the market his whole life.
transliteration: jaddi kan bayya' bes-souq tool ḥayato

arabic: كان يبيع تفاح وخضرة للناس كل يوم
english: He used to sell apples and vegetables to people every day.
transliteration: kan yabee' tuffaḥ w khoḍra lennas kull yom

arabic: انا اليوم بشتغل بالمكتب ورا كومبيوتر
english: Today I work in an office behind a computer.
transliteration: ana el-yom bashteghil belmaktab wara kombyuter

arabic: لما كان كومبيوتري خربان ما عرفت اصلحه بسرعة
english: When my computer was broken, I didn't know how to fix it quickly.
transliteration: lamma kan kombyuteri kharban ma 'reft asalleḥo be sor'a

arabic: جدي بيعرف يصلح كل شي بايديه بس انا لا
english: My grandfather knows how to fix everything with his hands, but I don't.
transliteration: jaddi bya'ref yṣalleḥ kull shi beedeih bas ana la

arabic: اليوم بدنا نجهز لحفلة كبيرة كتير
english: Today we want to prepare for a very big party.
transliteration: El-yom biddna njahez la-hafle kbeereh kteer.

arabic: بفيق بكير كل يوم وببلش شغلي للحفلة
english: I wake up early every day and start my work for the party.
transliteration: Bafee bakkeer kull yom w bballesh shoghli lil-hafle.

arabic: رح نروح على السوق الكبير نشتري الخضرة الطازجة
english: We will go to the big market to buy fresh produce.
transliteration: Rah nrooh aal-soo el-kbeer nishtri el-khodra et-tazaja.

arabic: انا جوعان وبدي مناقيش جبنه زاكيه للحفلة
english: I am hungry and I want delicious cheese manakish for the party.
transliteration: Ana jawaan w biddi manaqeesh jibneh zakyeh lil-hafle.

arabic: بكره رح نجهز كل شي سوا انشالله تطلع الحفلة حلوة
english: Tomorrow we will prepare everything together, God willing the party turns out beautiful.
transliteration: Bokra rah njahez kull shi sawa, inshallah tetlaa' el-hafle helwe.

arabic: صديقي احمد بيحب يلعب طابة كل يوم جمعة بالمساء
english: My friend Ahmad loves to play football every Friday evening.
transliteration: Sadeeqi Ahmad biḥibb yilʿab ṭābe kull yōm jumʿa bil-masāʾ.

arabic: اليوم قبل ما يلعب شفتو وسألتو مساء الخير كيفك
english: Today before he played I saw him and asked him Good evening how are you?
transliteration: Il-yōm qabl ma yilʿab shuftu w saʾaltu masāʾ al-khayr kayfak?

arabic: رد عليي مساء النور انا منيح شكرا
english: He replied to me Evening of light I'm fine thank you.
transliteration: Radd ʿalayyi masāʾ an-nūr ana mnīḥ shukran.

arabic: بعد المباراة كنا كتير مبسوطين واحمد سجل هدف حلو
english: After the match we were very happy and Ahmad scored a nice goal.
transliteration: Baʿd il-mubārāh kunna ktīr mabsūṭīn w Ahmad sajjal hadaf ḥilu.

arabic: حكينا شوي وبعدين سلمنا على بعض حكيتلو باي ومع السلامة
english: We talked a bit and then said goodbye to each other I told him bye and goodbye.
transliteration: Ḥakayna shway w baʿdēn sallamnā ʿala baʿḍ ḥakaytu-lo bāy w maʿ as-salāma.

arabic: العيلة اجتمعت على الاكل بالمطبخ
english: The family gathered for a meal in the kitchen.
transliteration: El-ʿayle ejtamaʿat ʿalā el-ʾakel bel-maṭbakh

arabic: الام كانت مبسوطة كتير لما شافت كل ولادها
english: The mother was very happy when she saw all her children.
transliteration: El-ʾomm kānet mabsooṭa kteer lamma shāfet koll wlādha

arabic: الاب حكى كيف اشترى خضرة طازة من السوق
english: The father told how he bought fresh vegetables from the market.
transliteration: El-ʾab ḥaka keef eshtarā khoḍra ṭāza men es-souq

arabic: الاولاد اكلوا تفاح وضحكوا بصوت عالي
english: The children ate apples and laughed loudly.
transliteration: El-ʾawlād akalo tuffaḥ w ḍeḥko be ṣoot ʿāli

arabic: الجو كان دافي والكل حس بالفرح
english: The atmosphere was warm and everyone felt joy.
transliteration: El-jaww kān dāfi wel-koll ḥass bel-faraḥ

arabic: بدنا نخطط لرحلة حلوة هالويكند
english: We want to plan a nice trip this weekend.
transliteration: Bedna nkhattat la rehleh helweh hal-weekend.

arabic: بتحب تزور ضيعه صغيره وتكون مرتاح
english: Do you like to visit a small village and be comfortable?
transliteration: Btehebb tzoor day'a sagheereh w tkoon mertah?

arabic: ممكن ناكل مناقيش جبنه زاكيه على الفطور هناك
english: Maybe we can eat delicious cheese manakish for breakfast there.
transliteration: Mumken nakol manaqeesh jibneh zakyeh alal-ftoor hnak.

arabic: اكيد رح نروح على السوق الكبير وهو عم يبيع الخضره الطازجه
english: Surely we will go to the big market and he is selling fresh produce.
transliteration: Aked rah nrooh aala as-soo' el kbeer w huwwe aam ybee' el khodra et-tazajeh.

arabic: بعدين بنشرب قهوة عربية بساحة الضيعة
english: Then we drink Arabic coffee in the village square.
transliteration: Ba'deen bnishrab ahweh arabiyyeh bi sahet ed-day'a.

arabic: اليوم عيلتنا عم تخطط لعرس اختي الكبيره
english: Today our family is planning my older sister's wedding.
transliteration: El yom 3eiltna 3am tkhattet la 3ers okhti el kbeere.

arabic: جدتي بتحب العرس يكون بالبيت متل زمان وامي بتحكي عن عرس كبير بالمدينه
english: My grandmother likes the wedding to be at home like in the old days, and my mom talks about a big wedding in the city.
transliteration: Jaddeti bthebb el 3ers ykoon bel beit metel zaman w emmi btehki 3an 3ers kbeer bel madeene.

arabic: بس اختي بدها شي جديد ومختلف يمكن بمطعم حلو
english: But my sister wants something new and different, maybe in a nice restaurant.
transliteration: Bas okhti baddaha shi jdeed w mukhtalif yumken bi mat3am helu.

arabic: جدتي بتقول انه لازم يكون في طاوله كبيره للاكل واختي بتفضل بوفيه صغير
english: My grandmother says there must be a big table for food, and my sister prefers a small buffet.
transliteration: Jaddeti bte'ool inno laazem ykoon fi tawle kbeere lal akel w okhti btfaddel bufih sgheer.

arabic: كل واحد عنده راي وهلا عم يحاولوا يتفقوا على التفاصيل
english: Everyone has an opinion, and now they are trying to agree on the details.
transliteration: Kull wahed 3ando ra'y w hala' 3am yhaawloo yettifqo 3ala el tafaseel.

arabic: السلام عليكم يا سارة كيفك اليوم خلينا نخطط لرحلة نهاية الأسبوع
english: Peace be upon you, Sara, how are you today? Let's plan a weekend trip.
transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ya Sara kifek el yom khallina nkhatet la rehlet nihayet el osbou3

arabic: وعليكم السلام انا فرحت كتير بهالفكرة الحلوة أهلاً وسهلاً بفكرة السفر
english: And upon you be peace! I was very happy with this nice idea. Welcome to the idea of traveling!
transliteration: Wa ʿalaykum as-salām ana farahet kteer behal fekra el helwe ahlan wa sahlan befekret el safar

arabic: شو رأيك نروح عالجبل الجو هناك كتير حلو ومريح وبتنبسطي أكيد
english: What do you think about going to the mountain? The weather there is very beautiful and relaxing, and you'll definitely enjoy it.
transliteration: Shoo ra2yek nrouh 3al jabal el jaw honak kteer helou w mureeh w betenbeseti akeed

arabic: انا انبسطت لما سمعت اقتراحك وقررنا نحجز غرفة بفندق صغير
english: I was delighted when I heard your suggestion, and we decided to book a small hotel room.
transliteration: Ana enbasatet lama seme3et eqterahek w qarrarna nahjez ghurfa befondo2 zghir

arabic: رحلتنا رح تكون ممتعة كتير وانا متحمسة شوف الطبيعة الخلابة
english: Our trip will be very enjoyable, and I'm excited to see the stunning nature.
transliteration: Rehletna rah tkoun mumte3a kteer w ana mutahammiseh shouf et tabi3a el khallabeh

arabic: انا اتصلت برانية اليوم
english: I called Rania today
transliteration: Ana ittaṣalt bi-Rania el-yom

arabic: سألتها كيف هي وعيلتها
english: I asked her how she and her family are doing
transliteration: Sa'altaha kif hiyye w 'eiltaha

arabic: قالتلي اخوها صلح حنفية المطبخ بسرعة
english: She told me her brother fixed the kitchen tap quickly
transliteration: Qaletli akhuha ṣallaḥ ḥanafiyyet el-maṭbakh be sor'a

arabic: وحكتلي انه الدنيا كانت عم تمطر مبارح
english: And she told me it was raining yesterday
transliteration: W ḥaketli inno ed-dunya kanat 'am tomṭor mbareḥ

arabic: اتفقنا نطلع عالسوق قريب نشتري خضرة
english: We agreed to go to the market soon to buy vegetables
transliteration: Ittafaqna niṭla' 'as-souq qareeb nishtari khoḍra

arabic: رحت على السوق اليوم
english: I went to the market today
transliteration: ruḥtu 'ala es-souq el-yom

arabic: بس انا ضعت وما عرفت وين بيتي
english: But I got lost and didn't know where my house was
transliteration: bas ana ḍi'tu w ma 'araft wein beiti

arabic: شفت ناس كتير وسألت واحد
english: I saw many people and asked one person
transliteration: shuft nas kteer w sa'alt waḥed

arabic: قلت له وين شارع الورد لو سمحت
english: I told him "Where is Rose Street, please?"
transliteration: qultu lahu wein shāre' el-ward law samaḥt

arabic: البياع حكى لي لف يمين بعد الباب
english: The vendor told me "Turn right after the door"
transliteration: el-bayya' ḥaka li leff yameen ba'd el-bab

arabic: علي اجا عند جاره احمد الصبح
english: Ali came to his neighbor Ahmad in the morning.
transliteration: Ali aja ind jaaro Ahmad es-soboh

arabic: قعدوا وحكوا عن الشغل والبيت
english: They sat and talked about work and home.
transliteration: Qa'adu w-hakau an esh-shoghl w-el-beit

arabic: احمد سأل علي ليش سكر الباب بسرعة مبارح
english: Ahmad asked Ali why he closed the door so quickly yesterday.
transliteration: Ahmad sa'al Ali lesh sakkar el-baab b-sor'a mbareh

arabic: علي ضحك وقال انا ما سكرت الباب بالمرة
english: Ali laughed and said I didn't close the door at all.
transliteration: Ali dehek w-qaal ana ma sakkart el-baab bel-marra

arabic: بعدين شافوا قطة صغيرة نامت جنب الباب
english: Then they saw a small cat sleeping next to the door.
transliteration: Ba'dein shaafu qetta saghira namet janb el-baab

arabic: انا قاعد بكافيه حلو ناطر رفيقي
english: I am sitting in a nice cafe waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed bi-kafeh helu naater rafi'i

arabic: الجو هادي كتير والسلام جميل بالمدينة
english: The atmosphere is very calm and peace is beautiful in the city.
transliteration: El jaw hadi kteer w es-salaam jameel bil-madeeneh

arabic: شفت ست قاعدة لحالها وباين عليها هي خايفة على ولادها
english: I saw a woman sitting alone, and it was clear she was scared for her children.
transliteration: Sheft sett qa'edeh la-halha w bayen 'aleyha heyye khayfeh 'ala wlaadha

arabic: فكرت يمكن انا ماني آمن هون متلها او يمكن هي عم بتفكر بالحرب
english: I thought maybe I am not safe here like her, or maybe she is thinking about the war.
transliteration: Fakkart yimkin ana maani aamen hon mitelha aw yimkin heyye 'am bitfakkir bil-ḥarb

arabic: فجأة قامت ولبست جاكيتا العسكري وطلعت جندية شجاعة
english: Suddenly, she stood up, put on her military jacket, and turned out to be a brave soldier.
transliteration: Faj'a qamet w libset jakita el-'askari w tala'at jundiyyeh shujaa'a

arabic: ليث طفل صغير بحب يسأل كتير
english: Laith is a small child who loves to ask a lot of questions.
transliteration: Layth ṭifl ṣaghīr biḥibb yis'al ktīr

arabic: اليوم سأل ابوه ليش في ناس كتير بالسوق
english: Today he asked his father why there are many people in the market.
transliteration: El-yōm sa'al abūh līsh fī nās ktīr b es-sūq

arabic: الاب جاوب عشان يشتروا تفاح وخضرة
english: The father answered 'because they buy apples and vegetables'.
transliteration: El-ab jāwab 'ashān yishtaru tuffāḥ w khoḍra

arabic: ليث سأل بسرعة وليش البياع بيبيع
english: Laith quickly asked 'And why does the vendor sell?'
transliteration: Layth sa'al be sor'a w līsh el-bayya' bibī'?

arabic: الاب تعب بس ضحك ليث ما بمل من الاسئلة
english: The father got tired but smiled, Laith doesn't get bored of questions.
transliteration: El-ab ti'ib bas ḍiḥik, Layth mā biyammel min el-as'ila

arabic: ابني قام بكير اليوم
english: My son got up early today.
transliteration: ebni qaam bakeer el yom

arabic: قعد جنبي وبلش يسأل كتير اسئلة
english: He sat next to me and started asking many questions.
transliteration: qaad janbi w ballash yis'al kteer as'ileh

arabic: كل سؤال كان اطول من التاني
english: Every question was longer than the other.
transliteration: kull su'al kaan atwal min et taani

arabic: حاولت اعمل كل جهدي لاجاوب على كل شي
english: I tried to do my best to answer everything.
transliteration: hawalt amal kull johdi la ajaweb ala kull shi

arabic: بس لما شاف عيوني تعبانة سكت شوي
english: But when he saw my tired eyes, he was quiet for a bit.
transliteration: bas lamma shaaf oyooni ta'baneh sakat shway

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد بنتي
english: Today is my daughter's birthday
transliteration: El yom eid milad binti

arabic: امبارح امي عملت كاتو كبير
english: Yesterday my mother made a big cake
transliteration: Embarah ommi amalet gato kabeer

arabic: هلق عم نحضر للضيوف بالبيت
english: Now we are preparing for guests at home
transliteration: Halla aam nhaddar lid-dyoof bil beit

arabic: اخي كتير مبسوط بالاحتفال
english: My brother is very happy with the celebration
transliteration: Akhi kteer mabsoot bil-ihtifal

arabic: ممكن ناكل الكاتو بعد شوي تفضل
english: We can eat the cake after a bit, please
transliteration: Mumkin nakol el gato ba'ed shway tfaddal

arabic: اجتمع ناس كتير بالشارع ليشوفو مباراة كرة قدم
english: Many people gathered in the street to watch a football match.
transliteration: Ijtama' nas kteer bish-shaare' liy-shoofoo mubarat kurat qadam

arabic: كان في بياع عم يبيع تفاح وخضرة جنبهم
english: There was a vendor selling apples and vegetables next to them.
transliteration: Kan fi bayya' 'am yabee' tuffaḥ wa khoḍra janb-hom

arabic: الكل كان عم يشجع فريقه بحماس
english: Everyone was cheering for their team enthusiastically.
transliteration: El-kull kan 'am yishajje' fareeqo bi-ḥamas

arabic: فجأة بلشت تمطر بسرعة قوية
english: Suddenly, it started raining very quickly.
transliteration: Faj'a ballashat tomṭor be-sor'a qawiyya

arabic: الناس ركضو على المحلات والمقاهي ليستخبوا من المطر
english: The people ran to shops and cafes to take shelter from the rain.
transliteration: An-nas rakḍoo 'ala l-maḥallat wal-maqahi liy-staḫabboo min al-maṭar

arabic: الدنيا صارت تمطر والسقف بالمطبخ كان ينقط ماء
english: It started to rain, and the ceiling in the kitchen was leaking water.
transliteration: Ed-dunya ṣārat tomṭor w es-saqf bel-maṭbakh kān yenqoṭ mayy.

arabic: ماما قالت بدنا نصلح السقف بسرعة
english: Mama said: "We need to fix the ceiling quickly."
transliteration: Mama qālat bedna nṣalleḥ es-saqf be sor'a.

arabic: بابا راح ع السوق يلاقي حدا يصلحها
english: Baba went to the market to find someone to fix it.
transliteration: Baba rāḥ a s-souq ylāqi ḥada yṣalleḥha.

arabic: هناك لقى بياع بيبيع تفاح وخضرة
english: There he found a vendor selling apples and vegetables.
transliteration: Honāk laqa bayya' biybi' tuffaḥ w khoḍra.

arabic: البياع قال انا بعرف صلحها وصلح السقف بسرعة
english: The vendor said "I know how to fix it" and fixed the ceiling quickly.
transliteration: El-bayya' qāl ana ba'ref ṣalleḥha w ṣallaḥ es-saqf be sor'a.

arabic: ليلي عم تحاول تركز على مشروعها الهندسي المهم، بس صوت أخيها الصغير كان كتير عالي.
english: Layla is trying to focus on her important architectural project, but her little brother's voice was very loud.
transliteration: Layla a'am tahawil trakkiz 'ala mashru'aha al-handasi al-muhim, bas sawt akhiha al-saghir kan ktir 'ali.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: أمها دخلت الغرفة وعم تقول لأخيها: "معلش يا حبيبي، هلق أختك بدها هدوء."
english: Her mother entered the room and was telling her brother: "It's okay, my dear, now your sister needs quiet."
transliteration: Ommaha dakhalat al-ghurfa w 'am taqul la akhiha: "Ma'lesh ya habibi, hallaq okhtik baddaha hudoo'."
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: بعد شوي، أبوها رجع من الشغل وهو عم يحكي على التلفون بصوت عالي، ونسي إنها عم تدرس.
english: A little later, her father returned from work while talking loudly on the phone, and he forgot that she was studying.
transliteration: Ba'd shway, abuha raja' min al-shughl w huwwe 'am yahki 'ala al-telefon bi sawt 'ali, w nisi innaha 'am tidrus.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: أختها الكبيرة، ريم، كانت قاعدة بالصالون عم تحضر مسلسلها المفضل بصوت عالي كمان.
english: Her older sister, Reem, was sitting in the living room watching her favorite series loudly too.
transliteration: Okhtaha al-kbireh, Reem, kanat qa'de bil-salon 'am tahdhur musalsalaha al-mufaddal bi sawt 'ali kaman.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: ليلي حست حالها رح تجن من كل هالضجة، وتمنت لو جدها وجدتها كانوا هون يساعدوها.
english: Layla felt like she would go crazy from all this noise, and wished her grandfather and grandmother were here to help her.
transliteration: Layla hassat halha rah tijinn min kull hal-dhajja, w tamannat law jaddaha w jaddatha kanu hon yusa'duha.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: فجأة، ستي الكبيرة دخلت البيت ومعها صينية كنافة، وابتسامتها خففت التوتر شوي.
english: Suddenly, her elderly grandmother entered the house with a tray of knafeh, and her smile eased the tension a little.
transliteration: Faj'a, Sitti al-kbireh dakhalat al-beit w ma'aha siniyyet knafeh, w ibtisamatha khaffafet al-tawatur shway.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: جدتها شافت ليلي وشو عم يصير، وقالت بصوت هادي لأبوها وأمها: "يا جماعة، خلينا نروق شوي."
english: Her grandmother saw Layla and what was happening, and said in a calm voice to her father and mother: "Folks, let's calm down a bit."
transliteration: Jaddatha shafat Layla w shu 'am yaseer, w qalat bi sawt hadi la abuha w ommaha: "Ya jama'a, khallina nrawwiq shway."
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: أخيها الصغير وأختها ريم، لما شافوا الكنافة وسِمعوا كلام جدتهم، قعدوا فوراً وسكتوا.
english: Her little brother and her sister Reem, when they saw the knafeh and heard their grandmother's words, sat down immediately and became silent.
transliteration: Akhiha al-saghir w okhtaha Reem, lamma shafu al-knafeh w sim'u kalam jaddathom, qa'adu fawran w sakatu.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: ليلي قدرت تركز على مشروعها أخيراً، وشكرت جدتها بقلبها على هالمساعدة الثمينة.
english: Layla was finally able to focus on her project, and thanked her grandmother in her heart for this valuable help.
transliteration: Layla qderet trakkiz 'ala mashru'aha akhiran, w shakarat jaddatha bi qalbaha 'ala hal-musa'adeh al-thamineh.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: بعد ما خلصت شغلها، كل العائلة اجتمعوا ياكلوا كنافة ستي اللذيذة مع بعضهم بفرح.
english: After she finished her work, the whole family gathered to eat Sitti's delicious knafeh together joyfully.
transliteration: Ba'd ma khallasat shughlha, kull al-'a'ileh ijtama'u ya'klu knafet Sitti al-ladhitha ma' ba'dhom bi farah.
storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home

arabic: كان ريحة القهوة التركية معبّية شارع الحمرا.
english: The smell of Turkish coffee filled Hamra Street.
transliteration: Kaana riihat el-qahwe et-turkiyye ma'abbiyye shaare' el-hamra.

arabic: ليلى شافت أستاذها سامي، بس استحَت تسلّم.
english: Layla saw her professor Sami, but she was shy to greet.
transliteration: Layla shaafet ustaazha Sami, bas estahet tesallem.

arabic: هو شافها وقَلَّها: مرحبا ليلى، كيفك؟
english: He saw her and told her: "Hello Layla, how are you?"
transliteration: Huwwe shaafha w qallha: "Marhaba Layla, kiifak?"

arabic: ليلى ردّت: أهلاً أستاذ، منيح. فيني أسألك عن الواجب؟
english: Layla replied: "Hello professor, I'm good. Can I ask you about the assignment?"
transliteration: Layla raddet: "Ahlan ustaaz, mniih. Fiini as'alak 'an el-waajib?"

arabic: الأستاذ ابتسم وقَلَّها: إي طبعاً، تفضلي اقعدي، بدي أشرب ماته.
english: The professor smiled and told her: "Yes of course, please sit down, I want to drink mate."
transliteration: El-ustaaz ebtasam w qallha: "Ee tab'an, tfaddali eq'odi, biddi ashrab mateh."
